/ /shing / kha skong tshul yang rje nyid kyis rdzogs rim dngos grub snye ma dang /sbas don lta ba'i mig 'byed sogs su ji ltar kha bskangs nas gsung yod pa de bzhin du shes dgos pa yin no/ / ma rgyud kyi nang na sgyu lus kyi bshad pa cung zad kha gsal ba kye rdor gyi skor yin la/ de las 'byung ba'i tshul ni brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u gnyis pa las/ ji ltar sgyu ma rmi lam dang / / ji ltar bar ma'i srid yin pa/ / rtag tu goms pa'i sbyor ba yi/ / dkyil 'khor nyid ni de bzhin 'dod/ / ces sgyu ma mkhan gyes sprul pa'i skyes bu bzhin du yan lag dang nying lag tshang zhing / rmi lam bzhin du rags pa'i lus las logs su phye ba/ tha mal pa'i 'chi ba 'od gsal las bar srid 'grub pa bzhin/lam gye 'od gsal las sgyu ma'i skur ldang tshul rdor 'phreng dang dgongs pa lung ston ji lta ba bzhin gsungs la/ de'i mjug thogs su/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur bar/ / ji ltar shes pa'i bde chen po/ / de yis 'di ni byin brlabs yin/ / zhes phyag rgya chen po lhan skyes kyi ye shes mtshon byed dbang gsum pa'i bde chen ngo sprad pa de'i rgyun gyi 'od gsal las ldang tshul dang /slarayang de'i rgyun yang yang goms pas dag par byas te byin gyis rlob tshul 'dus pa ltar gsungs so/ / rtsa rgyud kyi gnad 'di dag shin tu gsal bar bshad rgyud rdo rje gur las gsungs te/ de'i le'u bzhi bar/ rang yang rangabyin brlabs pa yis/ / byin gyis brlab par bya ba yin/ / cho ga'i rim pas rim pa yis/ / de nas mtshan ma mtshon par bya/ / dang po sprin gye rnam pa ste/ / gnyis pa du ba lta bu'o/ / gsum pa srin bu me khyer dngos/ / bzhi pa mar me gsal 'bar ba'o/ / lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni/sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ / thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu de ste/ /dngos grub nges 'jug nye ba yin/ / zhes sgyu ma'i sku gang las 'grub pa'i 184

ra / /nga stespyo par :re kha'od gsal gyi ye shes dang / de'i mjug thogs su/ phyi nas sgyu ma'i rnam pa ltar/ / rmi lam rnam pa skad cig 'gyur/ / khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ / ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ / 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ / ji srid rdo rje'i lus can rnams/ / ye shes phung po'i blo ldan pa/ /'diyi rjes su thams cad 'brang / / zhes 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu de las sgyu ma dang rmi lam ltar rlung sems tsam gyi lus su skad cig gis ldang tshul mdor bstan la/ de'i rgyas bshad le'u bcu bzhi pa las/ rang byin rlob pa'i spyor ba ru/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka bdun gyis 'od gsal sgrub tshul dang /de nas/ te ru ka dngos bem po min/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka lngas sgyu lus bshad pas/ rtsa bshad gung bsgrigs na rgyud don la mi 'phyug pa'i gzer thebs par 'gyur ro/ / 'on kyang rtsa bshad kyi don 'grel tshul 'di ltar byed dgos pa rgya 'grel rnams su mi gsal zhing / bod kyi ṭika byed snga ma rnams la gtad so ma byung ba rje bla mas sngon med legs bshad kyi srol phyes pa la brten nas mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas brtag gnyis rnam bshad du gsal b.ragasungs pa yin pas/ lam 'di'i sgrub pa lhur len pa'i skye bo blo gros can rnams kyis kyang tshul de shes par bya dgos so/ / de ltar na sgyu ma'i sku'i rnam gzhag la ma rtogs log rtog gi dri ma bsal te 'doms par mdzad pa 'dis gsang chen rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi srog bzung zhing / rig pa 'dzin pa mtha' dag la zung 'jug nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs nye bar mtshon pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ma rgyud kyi lam gyi snying po 'od gsal gyi rnam gzhag gsal bar mdzad tshul ni/ phyi nang phyag rgya'i spros pa las/ / gang gis rgyas gdab de nyid don/ / ma mthong rnams kyang mig phye ste/ / ma rgyud gnad la shid zan btang / / zhes byung / de'ang gur gyi bcu gsum pa 185

/ /las/ / shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i thabs/ / 'di ni rnal 'byor mar brjod do/ / phyag rgya chen po rab sbyor bas/ / gang phyir de nyid la 'jug pa/ / rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud ces bya/ / zhes pha ma'i rgyud gnyis su phye ba'i nang nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud du 'jog byed dang / thugs chos sku 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bde stong gi ye shes nyid yin la/ de sgrub pa'i tshul ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ rdo rje dang pad ma yang dag par sbyor ba ni sems dang sems las byung ba dag gi thabs su gyur pa'o/ / sems dang sems las byung ba mnyam par sbyor ba ni/ bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gye thabs su gyur pa'o/ / zhes dang / rim lnga las/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya sogs la brten nas bsgrub dgos kyang / bde ba de dang stong nyid kyi lta ba sbyor rgyu med na bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes zhes gtam kham po che smras kyang / bde chen de nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po mthar thug tu 'grosted kyi gnad ma shes pa yin pas 'khor rtsa gcod byed du mi 'gyur bar mazad/ srid par 'ching byed kyi chags pa rang ga bar 'gyur nyen che ba'i phyir/ sa ra ha'i do hwa las/ khyim dang khyim na de yi gtam smra yang / /bde chen gnas ni yongs su shes pa med/ / ces dang / snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang / / des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ / 'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms na yang / / 'khor ba 'dir gnas thar pa 'thob mi 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de lta na'ang kha ba'i ljongs 'dir ma rgyud kyi lam la dga' ba lhur byed pa sngon dang phyis su byung ba mang po zhig ni/ phyi'i phyag rgya pad+ma can la sogs pa bzhi'i brtag thabs/rigs kyi dbye bas rtsa sad par byed tshul/ dbab zlog dgram gsum sogs 186

༄ /kyi man ngag kho na 'tshol zhing lag len skyong ba thabs lam par grags pa'i skor dang / nang lus kyi rtsa 'khor la gnad du bsnun pa gtso bor byas te rngub pa dang dgang ba sogs bum pa can gyi rnal 'byor dang / me dmigs ci rigs kyis gtum mo sbar zhing / de las spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba'i 'bar 'dzag gi rim pas dga' bzhi 'dren pa dang / phal mo che gtum mo phal ba sbar bas kyang lus drod skye zhing / des dgun ras rkyang thub pa tsam la rdzogs rim mthon por 'khrul ba phyag rgya par grags pa'i skor sogs mang du byung ngo / /de dag gis rtsa rlung la gnad du bsnun lugs dang bde chen 'dren tshul sogs kyang rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ji lta bar song ba nyung ste/ rim lnga gsal sgron las/byang sems phab pa de nor bu ram sleb pa'i gong gi gnas rnams nas btsan thabs kyis bzlog pa dang / rdo rjer gleb na de ma thag tu bzlog pa'i 'dren mang po dang / btsan thabs su bzlog pa de'ang lus la ma khrems na nad skyed par mthong nas 'grems pa'i tshul rnams snga ma mang pos byed mod kyang /rlung byu tīr thim nas byang sems zhu ba dang / de ltar min pa'i zhu ba'i khyad par phye nas/ de la byang sems gzung dka' sla dang / de btsan thabs su zlog dgos mi dgos dang / bzlog pa lus la ma bkram na nad du 'gyur mi 'gyur gyi khyad par phyed pa'i rnam gzhag mi snang ngo / / zhes gsungs shing /phyag rgya bzhi'i khyad par sogs kyang ji bzhin ma phyed tshul mkhas grub rje'i yig chung nyer gcig tu gsungs pa ltar ro/ / des na bde stong dbyer med kyi bde ba'i cha sgrub tshul yang ji lta ba rje bla ma'i bka' drin gyis shes dgos la/khyad par du bde ba de la rgyas 'debs byed dang / gang la mnyam par 'jog pa'i yul gyi stong pa nyid rtag chad gol ba'i mtha' las 'das pa'i ji lta ba nyid ni rje bla ma nyag gcig gis gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ / de lta bu'i 187

/zab mo'i lta ba dang sbyor rgyu med par lha'i rnal 'byor dang rtsa rlung sogs sngags kyi nyams len zab mor grags pa ji 'dra zhig 'bad pas nyams su blangs kyang gzugs brnyan tsam las mi 'ong ste/ rje bla mas rje btsun red mda' bar phul ba'i gdams pa las/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i gnad gsum gong du bstan pa rnams kyang shes/ sngags kyi thabs lam gyi gdams ngag kyang yod pa klu sgrub dang zla grags 'dra ba de mtshan nyid theg pa rkyang ba'i gdul bya las myur ba dang ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin gyi/ mtshan nyid kyi lam gyi gnad med pa'i sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya de mtshan nyid kyi gdul bya las dman/ zhes nges 'byung byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba gsum med par sngags kyi nyams len bskyangs kyang sa chod shin tu chung bar gsungs la/ de bzhin du gsang phu pa chen po dkon mchog tshul khrims la stsal ba'i bslab bya las kyang / stong nyid kyi lta ba ni sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs gnyis 'dra bar gsungs shing / zhes pa nas/ de'i go ba 'tshol lugs la ni pha rol tu phyin pa las lhag pa ci'ang med cing / lung rigs pa mdo sde'i phyogs gsal bas/ zhes sogs dang / de kho na ltar nges par byed pa'i rigs pa'i bstan bcos rigs tshogs la sogs pa rnams yin no/ / zhes sngags lam gyi'ang lta ba'i khungs gcod sa mdo phyogs dang /khyad par du rigs tshogs la gdams pa'i snying por byed dgos par gsungs pas/ kha cig sngags lam mthon po'i 'ud kyis sbos te rigs tshogs lta bu ciralang mi rtsi ba ni chos kyi gnad ma go ba'i rtags yin no/ / de skad du stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed las/ rdo rje theg pas 'gro ba rnams kyis kyang thabs mkhas pa'i khyad par mtha' yas pa dag gis zin pa'i sgo nas bsgom par bya ba'i de kho na nyid ni/ dbu ma rigs tshogs kyis gtan la phab 1ཿ

sa / /bstodapangosags ldanasa'i 'a 'igang gapa'i stong pa nyid 'di kho na yin gyi/ 'di las khyad par du gyur pa ci'ang med pas theg pa gsum gyi gang zag mchog dman thams cad kyis bsgom bya'i de kho na nyid ni gcig pu 'dir zad pa yin la/ de'ang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa sogs kyi rgyud dang / grub chen gyi gzhung du mas bsgrub tu yod mod kyi/ zhes sogs gsungs so/ / de lta bu'i lta ba'i rgyas 'debs khyad par can yod na 'dod yon gyi rol pa ji tsam che ba bzhin gyes me la bud shing bsnan pa ltar sred sogs nyon mongs spong ba'i nus pa je cher 'gro la/ dug sman du sgyur byed lta bu'i gnyen po yang dag pa'i lta ba med na bde ba ji tsam 'phel ba'i tshod kyis sred pa je 'phel du song ste sdug bsngal ba'i rgyu las mi 'ong ba'i phyir/ rim lnga gsal sgron las/ 'khor 'das ma lus pa'i rang bzhin stong nyid shes pa'i stong pa dang spyor rgyu med par dbang po gnyis sbyor las byang sems mi 'pho ba tsam gyi bde ba sgrub pa ni/ srid pa'i rtsa ba bden 'dzin gyi ma rig pa la ci'ang mi gnod pas/ bde ba de ji tsam spyad pa bzhin bden 'dzin des drangs pa'i sred pa je 'phel du 'gro bas/ skom sred can gyis smig rgyu la chur 'du shes nas zhugs pa dang 'dra bas de 'dra ba ni smad la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshul 'di rje bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin rgya gar grub chen rnams kyang mgrin gcig tu gsungs te/ dpal sa ra has/ ma lus rang bzhin gang gis mi shes pa/ / kun tu ru'i skabs su bde chen sgrub pa ni/ / ji ltar skom pas smig rgyu rnyed pa bzhin/ / skom nas 'chi yang nam mkha'i rgyu rnyed dam/ / zhes dang / gsang ba grub pa las/ de bzhin de nyid med bzhin du/ / ngo mtshar che ba ltar byed pa/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa'i bar/ / shi ba'i 'og tu dmyal bar 'gro/zhes de kho na nyid kyi lta ba med par 'dod pa'i bde ba la dga' dga' ltar 189

/spyod pa dmyal ba'i rgyur gsungs shing / de bzhin du de kho na nyid grub par rgyud drangs pa las kyang / de nyid de nyid kyis shes nas/ / gang zhig lha mo la brten pa/ / de 'grub 'gyur gyi gzhan du ni/ / dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs so/ / bod snga ma mang po zhig dang por grub chen gyi lad mo byas te phyag rgya bsten yang gnyen po med pas sred pa 'phel 'gro ba mthong nas bde ba'i ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pas rang yal du 'gror 'jug cing / de bde stong sbyor ba'i don du rlom pa ni bde stong gi gnad phyogs tsam yang ma go ba'i blun po'i rang bzo yin te/ skyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho las/ bde stong spyor ba'i don ni bde ba skyes pa na de la sred pa skyes kyisadogs nas/ bde ba'i ngo bo la cher bltas pas 'di yin med du yal song ba la mi byed kyi/ bde ba nyid stong nyid nges pa'i 'dzin stangs can du skyes pa bde stong sbyor ba'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar stong nyid rtogs pa gong nas gong du khyad zhugs pa tsam gyis bdag 'dzin mgo gnon pa'i nus pa phul du byung bar 'gyur pas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba la gnod byed stobs ldan du 'gyurab yin te/ de'i phyir bskyed rim 'khor ba'i rtsa ba la gnod byed du 'gyur ba'i gtso bo'ang sgo 'di nas yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rje rgyal pa gnyis pa'i legs bshad kyi cha shas 'di tsam gyis kyang / mdo sngags rgyab 'gal du 'dzin pa dang / mchog sgrub pa la bskyed rim mi dgos par 'dod pa dang / sngags la bsnyad nas spyod pa bag med du byed pa'i log rtog mngapo zhig cig car du ldog par 'gyur ro/ / de lta bu'i bde stong dbyer med du sbyor ba'i lam de nyid rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud thams cad kyi brjod bya'i snying po yin kyang / khyad par du 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor nas shin tu gsal zhing rgyas par gtan la 'bebs pas/ de nyid ma rgyud bye ba bcu drug 1༅

ra / /tshos spyo 'i 'a 'ikwa pa'ab/gi tog lta bur bsngags pa yin te/ red mda' pa'i dris lan las/ bde stong gi rnam gzhag kyi rdor sogs nas dngos su bstan kyang / bde ba de gang las byung ba'i rgyu shes dgos la/ de la spyir bde stong sbyar nas nyams su len pa la bde ba mtshan nyid pa khyad par can 'bar zhing 'dzag dgos la/ bde ba'i ngo bo la che chung dang / gang du 'bab pa'i tshad dam/ mtshams gang nas dga' ba bzhir 'jog cing / dga' ba bzhi po re re la'ang bzhi bzhir yod cing / yas bab kyi dga' ba dang mas brtan gye dga' ba/ bde ba che chung dang lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog 'ong tshul so so'i rnam gzhag rgyas par shes dgos shing / stong pa la mtshan nyid theg pa nas bshad pa las zur du med kyi/ de stong tshul mtshan nyid theg pa nas phul du byung ba'o/ / bde ba'i ngo bo byang sems de lta bu 'bebs byed ni/ nges don gyi mkha' 'gro ma gtum mo rdul gyi me sbar bas 'bebs dgos shing / der 'bar zhing 'dzag pa la phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar dgos pas phyag rgya la'ang bzhir yod cing /debazhi po so so'i ngo bo sten tshul/ mnyam par sbyor tshul/ sbyar nas bde chen 'dren tshul/ bde chen re res spang bya ji ltar spong zhing gang spangs pa'i rtags thob pa/ dga' ba bzhi po'i khyad par/ gtum mo'ang rtsa gang rung gi nang nas 'bar bas snying ga sogs kyi rtsa mdud grol mi thub pas/ ro rkyang gi rlung dbu ma'i nang du zhugs dgos/ zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pas/spyibo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba sogs kyi rtsa mdud grol 'ong ba yin no/ / rtsa rlung de dag las rung du 'gro ba la spyi bo la sogs pa'i rtsa gnas rnams su yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bsgoms pas rtsa rlung las rung du 'gyur ba yin no/ / des na phyag rgya bzhi'i skor/ lus kyi rtsa gnyis phra rags kyi gnas tshul/ de dag gi rlung dbu mar 'jug pa/ rig ma dang snyoms par 191

/ /zhugs nas bde chen 'dren lugs sogs dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gis ston pas/ des na dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor la mkhas par byas shing rgyud la skyed dgos te/ rgya gar 'phags yul dang bod rnams su lam 'di la brten pa'i grub chen sa'i rdul ltar shin tu mang zhing rnal 'byor byed pa sha stag go / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de ltar ma rgyud kun gyi gtso bor gyur pa 'khor lo bde mchog yin par gzigs te/ khyung lhas pa dang / bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs las lca nag dril gsum gye dbang dang / gong gsum sde chen pa las jo lugs/ sa lugs/ mar do lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i bshad bka' yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyun bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa nas nye bar brgyud pa'i man ngag cha tshang bar gsan/ rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīka chen dang / skyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad sogs mdzad de 'di'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud phyogs mthun dang bcas pa'i ngos 'dzin/ bshad rgyud kyis rtsa rgyud 'chad pa'i don gyi gtso bo rdzogs rim yin la / de'i tshul nag po pa'i dpyid thig tu sgo legs par bstan cing / lca dril gyi gzhung na rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung 'dis rim gnyis 'di ston zhes gsal kha byas pa med na'ang / rim gnyis gsung tshul gyi man ngag legs par shes nas 'di rtsa rgyud kyi thad 'di'i dgongs pa bshad rgyud 'di la brten nas bkral par 'dug snyam du rtsa bshad sbyar ba'i gnad kyang go nus tshul dang /'phags yul gyi grub chen so so'i bzhed srol mtha' yas pa'i dbang gis bod 'dir yang bshad rgyun mi 'dra ba bcu bzhi tsam byung na'ang thams cad kyi gtso bo lta bu lca nag dril gsum dang / de'i dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus pa'i bshadasrol ni nā ro pa'i man ngag yin pas/ de'i dgongs pa su ma ti ki rti'i nyung du'i mtshams sbyor bzhin byas na rgyud don mtha' dag la go ba ster 192

༄ / /bstongs 'grel khastag ba'isnangab/phul che zhing / khyad par du le'u nga gcig pas mdor rgyas sbyar tshul gyi steng nas lam gye lus gcig tu 'dril ba'i nges pa khyad par can skyed lugs dang /nang gses kyis bye na grub chen so so'i rten khungs kyi bshad rgyud ma 'dra ba'i dbang gis rten dang brten pa rim dang gcig car skyed tshul/ rgyu rdor 'dzin gyi khyad par sku mdog zhal phyag sogs kyang mi mthun tshul/ rigs kyi dbye bas phyag mtshan gye khyad/ lus dkyil sgom mtshams dang sgom tshul/ tha na sngags cung zad mi 'dra ba tshun chad bzhed pa mi 'dra ba yin pas so sor zhib tu phye ste gsang mtha'i lam gyi snying po mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thol le ba thams cad gsal bar phyes nas don gyi gnad phra rags gang la'ang phyin ci log tu gol pa'i gnas med par mdzad/ khyad par du gang dang bde stong sbyoraba'i yul gyi stong pa nyid ni sngar bshad pa bzhin rigs tshogs rnams su gsungs pa las lhag pa zhig rnam pa thams cad du med la/ de nyid rje bla mas 'jig rten gsum du gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul rgyas par gong du bshad zinapa ltar yin no/ / tshul de dag gi sgo nas ma rgyud kyi bstan pa ming gi lhag ma tsam du song ba na/ rje bla mas shi gso'i sman gyes bslangs pa ltar mdzad pas/ 'dir yang / ma rgyud gnad la shid zan btang / / zhes smosapa rnam thar brda tshig ma'i don bzhin yin te/ rnam thar brda tshig ma las/ shid zan zhes pa'ang de nas go/ zhes pa'i don mkhas grub rjes bkral pa las/ nub sngon ma'i dus su bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bris sku zhig gi 'og na phar la bde mchog gi chos bcu'i mchod pa byed pa'i bkod pa zhig bris/ de 'og na shid zanagatong ba yin zer ba'i yi ge zhig bris 'dug/ de la nub bdun pa'i dus bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor rnams dus phyis 193

/gangs ri'i khrod 'dir shi ba ltar gyur pa la/ rje rin po che 'dis legs par gsal bar mdzad pa ni mi shi ba'i rjes su shid zan gtong ba lta bu yin zer ba'ang de'i tshe go zhes gsung ba'o/ / zhes 'byung ba bzhin no/ / mnal lam 'di dag glang lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du byung tshul/ bya gh+ra'i gong gi tsan+d+ra ni/ / zhes sogs kyis bstan par gsungs pa la/ kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos lo zla'i zla bar mā sa las tsan+d+ra mi 'jug ces dgag pa mdzad/rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas/ kudzi zhes pa yul 'ga' zhig na sgur mo dang mdzes ma la'ang 'jug pas nor sa yod pa de gab tshig la sbyar chog pa'i tshul/gzhan du grags pa'i sgra yi ni/ / zhes daṇ+ḍis bshad pa ltar yin la/tsadz+ra'angatshur bod skad du bsgyur tshe zla ba las gzhan zer rgyu med la/ bod skad du zla ba byas tshe lo zla'i zla ba go thub pas/ rnam thar gsang ba'i gnad gab pa'i dus gab tshig gi lugs dang bstun pa la 'gal ba med par gsungs/kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po ni snyan ngag la mkhas pa rtsod med yin pas de bzhin bzhed kyang mchi ste/ rgya skad kyi ming smos phyin rgya gar na don de la de ltar gragasapa dgos na/ bi kri ta zhes pa lta bu dgos kyi/ lcags stag sogs spor thang gi 'dogs lugs yin pa'i phyir dang / 'dir yang bya gh+ra zhes pa lo la byed pa kun gzigs chen po nyid kyis kyang sor bzhag gnang 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ / kye rdor gyi skor lam 'bras su gsal bas dri ma bsal rgyu med par sngags rim las gsungs na'ang / der sgyu lus kyi rnam gzhag kha 'gengs dgos la/ de rje'i gsung las shes dgos pa sngar bshad pa ltar dang /'od gsal gyi yul stong pa nyid kyi rnam gzhag kyang snga ma kha cig/ kye rdo rje'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud gur gyi drug pa las/ lus dang dbang po'i rang bzhin ni/ / sems las phyi rol gyur med kyang / / gzugs sogs so 194

da / /nga steg /re 'a :reb pabab/sor snang ba rnams/ / sems nyid kho na snang ba yin/ / zhes sogs la brten nas sems tsam gyi lta ba dang mthun par 'chad kyang / de sems gtso bor bshad pa tsam yin gyi/ rgyud 'di'i dgongs pa mthar thug gi lta ba dbu ma kho nar gnas tshul rtsa rgyud du grub mtha' bzhi'i rim pa'i lta ba gsungs pa dang / gur las kyang / kun rdzob tu ni 'jig rten yod/ / dpyad pas gang na'ang 'jig rten ci/ / zhes chos thams cad don dam par med mnyam dang / tha snyad du yod mnyam yin la don zhes yod med mtshungs par gsungs pas/ lta ba'i thad 'di'ang rje bla ma'i drin gyis gsal bar byas pa yin no/ / dus 'khor gyi skor la'ang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang yongs rdzogs/ 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi steng nas rgyud kyi bshad pa/ phyag len gyi mdzub khrid/ spyor drug gi nyams khrid sogs dang /de'i cha lag rdo rje snying 'grel/ phyag rdor stod 'grel/ nā ro pa'i 'grel chen/ rtsis kyi lag len dang bcas par zhib tu sbyangs pas phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rnam gzhag thun mong ma yin pa thams cad thugs su chud/ bka' rtsom dngos gzhi cher ma mdzad kyang rgyud dang man ngag gi gnad mtha' dag legs par bkrol pa'i gsung bshad lan du mar mdzad nas mtha' gzhan du 'dren pa'i log rtog gi dra ba thams cad bcad/ rje nyid kyi zhal las ji ltar 'ongs pa bzhin mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas ṭīka chen dang mngon dkyil sogs mdzad pa yin pas/ don gyis rje rang gis gsungs pa dang khyad med do/ /khyad par phyis kyi dus 'khor pa phal cher lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan pa sogs kyi tshig zin la 'khrul nas thal 'gyur pa'i lugs kyi stong pa ni phung po rnam dpyad kyi chad stong yin la/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ni zag pa med pa'i yon tan thams cad rang chas su rdzogs pa'i chos nyid bden par 195

/ /grub pa zhig yin/ zhes gsor mi rung gi lta bas bslad pa na/ ngan rtog chu 'dzin gyi phreng ba de nyid lung dang rigs pas lhag med du bsal pa 'dis dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs bzang yangs pa'i lha lam gsal bar byas pa yin no/ / des na mkhas pa'i dbang po yid bzang rtse pa'i gsung las/ bstan pa'i bdag po yin pas gzhan gyi bshad pa brgya tshar bas/ rje 'dis bshad pa lan re mdzad pa'ang bstan pa'i rgyun la phan che/ zhes 'byung ba bzhin rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus pa 'dzin pa'i smon lam grub pa'i dbang gis da lta rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs par dus 'khor gyi bshad sgrub gtsang ma'i srol ma nub par yod pa thams cad rje bla ma'i 'phrin las kyi cha shas las byung ba kho na yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dpyal smad seng ge rdzong du bzhugs pa'i tshe dus 'khor dpa' po gcig pa'i zhal gzigs shing / lam 'di la khyod rgyal po zla ba bzang po lta bu gcig 'ong ngo / / zhes lung bstan nas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pa yin no/ / gsum pa de gnyis ngo bo gcig tu spyor ba zung 'jug gi rnam gzhag gsal bar mdzad tshul ni/ bde stong dbyer med smra ba na/ / de nyid ya gyal gcig gyur pa'i/ / bden gnyis dbyer med gtam 'di yang / / khyed kyis 'jig rten gsum du bsgrags/ / zhes byung /de'ang snga rabs pa phal mo che rim pa lnga pa'i zung 'jug gi don 'chad pa na/bdeb chen po dang stong pa nyid gnyis dbyer mi phyed par zung du 'jug pa tsam la zung 'jug gi don du smra ba ma gtogs/ de lta bu'i bde stong dbyer medade nyid ya gyal gcig tu byas nas/ de dang ya gzhan zhig bsdoms te zung 'jug tu 'jog tshul zhig yod pa gtan nas ma shes so/ / bde stong dbyer med tsam la skabs 'di'i zung 'jug gi don mi tshang ste/ rim lnga gsal sgon las/ bde stong dbyer med de nyid la rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi 1ཿ

༄ / /bstodapashāstegs ldan ba'i' 'izlas gabashad pa mdzad pa mang pos bde stong zung 'jug dang bden gnyis zung 'jug ces bshad cing / 'phags lugs kyi zung 'jug gi don kyang de la 'chad pa yod mod kyang / mgon po klu sgrub kyi lugs kyis ni sngar bshad pa'i don gyi lhan skyes kyi bde stong dbyer med de tsam la zung 'jug tu mi byed do/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ snga rabs pa rnams kyis zung 'jug legs par 'jog ma shes pa'i rtsa ba mthar thug ni/ rim pa gsum pa'i sgyu ma'i don bden stong sgyu ma tsam la byas pa'i dbang gis de la bde stong dbyer med kyi stong pa'i don tsam las go rgyu lhag po ma byung ba na/ zung 'jug gi zung du 'jug rgyu'i ya la bde ba dang stong pa nyid gnyis las gzhan ma rnyed par/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa tsam zung 'jug gi don mthar thug tu smras pa yin no/ / rje bla mas ni bde stong gnyi ga thugs kyi khyad par du byas te yul dang yul can bsdoms nas don dam pa'i bden pa zhes ya gcig tu bzhagagazhan don gzugs sku sgrub byed sgyu ma'i sku la kun rdzob kyi bden pa zhes ya gcig tu bzhag ste/ de gnyi ga zung du 'jug pa la skabs 'di'i zung 'jug gi gtso bor ngos bzung ba yin zhing / de ni rim lngar zung 'jug tu 'jog tshul gtso phal sna tshogs pa nyer gcig gam/ nyer gsum gsungs pa'i nang nas gnad che shos/ de nyid shes pa'i rim pa bzhin/ / rang byin brlab dang 'od gsal shes/ / de dag kho na 'dus pa gang / / 'di ni zung 'jug rim pa 'o/ / zhes bdag byin brlab dab 'od gsal gnyis zung dang / de gnyis 'dus pa zung 'jug tu bshad pa dang / kun rdzob dang ni don dam gyi/rnam dbye so sor shes nas ni/ / gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa/ / zung du 'jug par de bshad do/ / zhes kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis zung dang /de gnyis 'dus pa zung 'jug tu gsungs pa de yin la/ 'di ni 'dus pa phyi 197

/ma las/ dngos dang dngos med mi zad gtso/ / stong nyid snying rje mi phyed pa/ / byang chub sems zhes bya ba yin/ / zhes zung 'jug gi byang chub kyi sems ni dngos dang dngos med gnyis 'dus pa la bshad cing / dngos dang dngos med gnyis kyang de nyid las/ gang zhig dngos med shes rab ste/thabs ni dngos po'i mtshan nyid do/ / zhes bshad la/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi drug pa'i thabs shes snyoms par 'jug pa'i don 'chad pa'i tshe sgron gsal du thabs kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang / shes rab don dam pa'i bden par gsungs pa rnams gung bsgrigs na'ang sgyu lus dang 'od gsal zung du 'jug pa de zung 'jug gi gtso bor byed dgos pa 'grub bo/ / dpal mgon klu sgrub dang rje bla ma gnyis lta spyod mdo sngags gang gi thad du'ang bstan pa gsal bar mdzad tshul gyi rnam thar 'dra ba'i dbang gis mdo las lung ston tshul yang mtshungs pa sngar bshad pa bzhin yin la/ klu sgrub lung bstan pa'i lang gshegs kyi lung / yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jig pa/ / nga yi bstan pa 'jig rten 'dir/ / bla med theg chen rab bshad nas/ / zhes pa mdo lugs kyi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i lung bstan du sbyor skabs rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam gsal bar byed pa tsam la sbyar yang /sngags kyi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i lung bstan du 'grel pa'i tshe/ srid zhi'i mtha' 'gog byed sgyu 'od gnyis dang / de zung du 'jug pa'i don gsal bar byed pa'i lung bstan du spyor dgos pa'i phyir/ sgron gsal gye mchan las/ rtsa rgyud la don zab mo du ma zhig yod kyang sgras zin tsam gyi bshad pa la brten na dag pa'i sgyu ma zung 'jug ma rnyed pa dang / de nyid ma 'ongs pa na sus ston 'dri ba ni/ rlung sems gnyis tsam las bsgrubs pa'i sgyu ma 'od gsal du zhugs pa'i 'od gsal gyi rlung sems gnyis tsam las dag 198

da / /nga ste0 'i 'a 'ig dngabab/pa'i sgyu ma'i skur 'khrungs pa'i sgyu lus dang / lhan skyes bde ba chen pos de kho na nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'od gsal gnyis ngo bo gcig tu sbyar ba'i zung 'jug ni rtogs dka' ba'i mthar thug pa yin pas de nyid sus ston zhus pa yin te / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ don 'di ni dpal ldan zla bas bshad tshul ji lta ba yin te/ lung gshegs kyi lung 'di 'dren pa'i mtshams spyor du bstan pa'i snying po 'di lta bu sus ston zhes dri ba bkod pa ni snga 'brel yin pas/ der don 'di sus ston 'dri rgyu'i don dang / mdo lung gi 'dis ston zhes pa'i ston rgyu gnyis po 'dra dgos pa gang zhig/ dri ba'i tshe sgron gsal las/ yongs su dag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor yang rtog pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ so so rang gi rig pa/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul phung po rin po che'i za ma tog gi nang na gnas pa/ yod pa dang med pa'i phyogs gnyis dang bral ba / yi ge'i rjes su 'brang pa rnams dang / rtog ge ba rnams kyi yul ma yin pa / bla ma'i man ngag 'ba' zhig las shes par bya ste/ 'di lta bu'i lha'i de kho na nyid de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das shing / phyag na rdo rje la sogs la sdud pa po rnams kyang med par gyur pa phyi ma'i dus na/ sangs rgyas kyis yang dag par bshad pa 'di rgyun mi 'chad par su zhig gis ston par 'gyur/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na lung 'dis kyang gang gsal bar byed rgyu'i bstanapa'i snying po zab pa'i mthar thug pa zung 'jug gi don du gsungs la/der zung du 'jug rgyu'i ya gnyi ga so sor gsal bar ma byas par zung 'jug gsalabar byed tshul med pa'i don gyis de gnyi ga gsal bar byas na bstan pa'i snying po yongs rdzogs gsal bar byas pa yin par grub cing / rje bla mas kyang mdo sngags thun mong ba'i lam gyi srog 'od gsal stong ba nyid kyi lta ba 1༅

/dang / sngags lam gye thun mong ma yin pa'i bsgrub bya 'dus pa'i zab gnad sgyulus kyi rnam gzhag gnyis sngon dbang po'i tog gi spyan sngar dam bcas pa bzhin gsal bar mdzad pa'i lung bstan 'di'i don yang legs par tshang ba yin no/ / gsum pa bstod pa'i don bsdu ba la/ gsang sngags 'jig rten spyod pa dang / / zhes pa nas/ rdzogs pa'i srol 'di khyod kyis phyes/ /zhes pa'i bar byung / de'ang sho lo ka dang po/ gsang sngags 'jig rten spyod pa dang / / lta ba yid byed bkag tsam du/ / gyur tshe dbang po'i tog gi drung / / dam bcas bzhin du khyod kyis gsos/ / zhes bstan pa'i snying po log rtog gi dri mas sbags te ming tsam du gyur pa gsos tshul dang /de'ang rgya chung du tsam ma yin par sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa ltar sa steng kun tu gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul/ sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed pa ru/ / lung bstan pa yang mchog 'di ste/ / gang las khyod ni rjes dran pa'i/ / yon tan zla dang bral ba'ang 'di/ / zhes pas bstan la/bstan pa cung zad nyams ma thag pa yin na gso sla'ang / de lta ma yin par ston pa dang dpang du gyur pa'i dam pa rnams 'das te yun ring lon zhing /ngan rtog gi dri mas yang nas yang du sbags pas nad gting du song ba bzhin ches gso dka' ba'i skabs yin pa ni/ thub dbang chos kyi nyi ma de/ / zhi ba'i dbyings su gzhol gyur nas/ / ring zhig 'das te chos kyi sras/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob khyod nyid 'khrungs/ / zhes bshad do/ / de lta na'ang rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam gyi mthu yongs su grub pa'i stobs kyis bstan pa'i me ro gzhi nas gsos shing / de'ang phyogs re tsam ma yin par mdo phyogs bslab pa gsum dang / gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhis bsdus pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa gsos pa'i 2khru

sa / /bstodapangosagasaldan 'a 'a 'igs ba/tshul ston par/ bag yod brtul zhugs lhag bsam spyod/ / bde stong ting 'dzin mtha' bral lta / / thub bstan mtha' dag gdan gcig tu/ /rdzogs pa'i srol 'di khyod kyis phyes/ / zhes smos pa yin no/ / de la gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i gol sa dang lhad 'jug byed kyi ngan rtog che shos ni/ der nyon mongs lam du 'khyer pa'i nus pa phul du phyin pa rnams kyi dbang du byas te 'dod yon la ci dgar spyod par gsungs pa la snyad btags nas nang na rtogs pa'i yon tan med bzhin du/ phyi'i spyod pa gang dran 'dzem med du spyad de/ bla ma'i dam tshig sogs la cir yang mi rtsi bar las 'bras khyad du gsod cing / zhe sdang gi dbang du song nas rkyen cung zad tsam la mngon spyod kyi las byed/ 'dod chags kyis dbyen spyos pas glang po che lcags kyu med pa bzhin du spyod cing rang la ltos tshad kyang log pa'i lam der khrid nas rang gzhan thams cad phung khrol la sbyor ba yin pas/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi mthar skyonade lta bu 'byung tshul rgyal ba rang nyid kyis lung bstan te/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ rnal 'byor pa ni bdag ces smra/ / chos ni g.yo yis byed par 'gyur/ / de ni 'dus pa mi shes par/ / dam tshig la sogs spyod byed la/ / gsang ba srung bar mi byed cing / / thams cad du ni rab tu ston/ / mngon sum sangs rgyas 'dra ba yi/ / slob dpon sgod cing bkur mi byed/ / skad cig gis ni khrong khro zhing / / de bzhin skad cig gis rjes chags/ / ma dang sring mo bu mo ste/ / bsgrod min la ni 'gro ba dang / /pha ma gsod cing de bzhin du/ / srog chags gzhan rnams gsod par byed/ / de bzhin rdzun gyi tshig smra zhing / / khyad par du yang rku bar byed/ / gzhan gyi chung ma'i thad 'gro zhing / / smad pa gzhan yang byed par 'gyur/ / de nyid ye shes 'byung ba yi/ / dam tshig rnams ni des mi 201

/ /shes/ / nyes pa cung zad tsam la yang / / mngon spyod dag ni byed 'gyur la/ / rnal 'byor rab sbyor dman pa yi/ / sngags pa la ni 'grub mi 'gyur/rtag tu phyi rol bstan bcos dga'/ / de yi sbyor la mkhas pa dang / /rangagi dam tshig yongs spangs te/ / lcags kyu med pa bzhin du spyod/ /ces gsungs so/ / de bzhin du 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos kyang rang gi 'dul zhing kha ba can 'dir ma 'ongs pa na bstan pa'i sad 'di lta bu 'byung ba thugs kyis ma bzod par/ phyi rabs pa rnams chos dang chos min mi nor ba'i phyir snyigs dus su 'byung rgyu thams cad ches shin tu gsal bar lung bstan te/ de'ang nag phyogs kha rgyal pa na bdud rigs kyi lha 'dres byin gyis brlabs pas/gnas skabs su nus pa che che lta bus rkyen sel sogs la phan thogs pa dang /lha mthong 'dre mthong gi mngon shes phra mos bden bden 'dra ba re bshad pas col chung rnams skyabs kyi mthar thug tu 'dzin cing / de'i rjes su zhugs pa na sangs rgyas kyis ma bstan cing / sngon byon mkhas pa tshad ldan gyis ma gsungs pa'i gdams pa nam mkha' nas bab pa yin/ sa 'og nas thon pa yin/ rmi lam du lhas bstan pa yin/ 'di las zab pa med ces 'brel med kyi kha bo sgrogs shing / don mu stegs kyi lugs dang mthun pa blo sna thur du 'khrid pa'i chos lugs 'dra min mang po gsar du bcos/ cha lugs ya ma zung dgu gyon/ ye shes phab pa yin zer nas 'dres brlams pas rgyud bslad de tshangs spyod la rig ma gtod pa sogs kyis bstan pa'i rmang gzhi 'jig par byed pa/ ming chos kyi mthar thug dang theg pa rim dgu'i rtse rgyal du sgogs kyang / don 'jig rten tha mal ba'i nang nas kyang ma rabs kyi spyod pamad 'tshong dang 'dra ba/ 'ching byed kyi bdag 'dzin ma zhig par sdom 202

sa / /bstodapashasangasaldanapa'i 'a 'isnang gapa'i tshul khrims zhig pa'i zhig po log spyod mkhan rnal 'byor bar brdzus pa mang po 'byung tshul dang / lta ba'i gol sa yul cir yang ma grub pa la dgag sgrub blang dor sogs ci'ang byar med pas/ de'i ngang du yid byed dran 'dzin thams cad bkag ste sems lung ma bstan du had de bzhag na chos sku'i rang zhal mthong ba dang lta ba rtogs pa yin gyi/ rtsol bas byas pa'i chos kyis byang chub mi 'thob ces med par lta ba'i phyogs bzung ste kun rdzob khyad du gsod cing lus ngag gi dge spyor sogs 'gog par byed pa 'byung tshul mtha' dag mngon sum du gzigs te gsungs pa ni/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi rgyal po bka' chems las/ rig par smra zhing rnam par smra ba yi/ / ston pa rnams ni nam langs skar ma bzhin/ / de nas dkar po'i phyogs rnams mthu chung bas/ bdud kyi stobs rnams rgyas par 'gyur ba yis/ / bdud kyis byin brlabs zhig po zer ba 'byung / / log spyod mkhan la rnal 'byor pa zhes zer/ / lung ma bstan la chos kyi sku zhes zer/ / rnyed grags 'dod la chos bshad mkhan po zer/ / chos lugs yin zhes bab col mang po smra/ /'dres brlams pa la ye shes 'bebs zhes zer/ / bdud kyis spro bskyed byin rlabs zer ba 'byung / / gdams ngag zer zhing log chos mang du smra/ /gdams pa zer nas mu stegs gsang tshig ston/ / da ltar log pa'i rgyun la zhugs pa yis/ / bud med pho spyod tho co byed pa 'byung / / rang lugs nyams shing 'jig rten chos lugs nyams/ / de yis rang nyid ngan 'gror 'khrid par byed/ / rgyu 'bras bden par mi shes mi dge sna tshogs spyod/ /chos dang chos min mi byed ngo tsha med par spyod/ / log spyod dag la shin tu dad par 'gyur/ / byas pa'i chos kyis byang chub mi 'thob pas/ / ma byas lhunagrub chos gcig dgos so zer/ / byed ma nus rnams de la dad par 203

/ /'gyur/ / dge ba'i bshes ltar snang ba yid 'grogs 'khrid/ / sngags pa kha cig sngags la rtsing chos byed/ / dam chos yon la bltas nas gsang ba sgogagaser chos zer zhing chos la rin thang gcod/ / 'ga' zhig ma thos rgyud kyang 'chad par byed/ / la la dbang ma thob par dbang skur byed/ /la las dbang bskur zer nas yon yang sdud/ / rnyed bkur dag la chags shing 'dod la zhen/ / rang gi rlung sems dbang du ma 'dus par/ /gsang ba shes rab ye shes mngon sum bskur/ / de dag smad 'tshong rten dngakhyad par med/ / la las dge slong shes rab ye shes ni/ / bud med dang sbyor dbang ni skur bar byed/ / sdom khrims zhig nas dmyal bar 'phen parakhyed/ / de ni log pa'i chos la spyod pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'o na gsang sngags la zhugs kyang 'dod yon la ci dgar spyad mi chog na theg pa che chung gi gnang bkag mi 'dra ba'i khyad med par 'gyur ro snyam na/gnad bkag mi 'dra ba bden mod kyang / theg dman sogs las bkag pa gnang ba'i yul ni de dag las rtogs pa gong mar gyur pa'i sngags pa la yin gyi/ lam nyams len skabs de dag la'ang mi sleb cing / tsha grang bkres skom sogs kyi rkyen thog tu bab pa'i tshe sgyu ma lta bur lta mi thub pa 'jig rten rang dga' ba dang khyad med par/ 'dod yon la spyod pa'i tshe sgyu ma lta bur rol pa skad byed pa ni 'dod zhen gyi gtam rang gis rang bslu ba rdzun shob kho na yin te/ slob dpon mtho btsun gtso legs kyis mdzad pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshul la 'jug pa las/ yang dag pa yi rnal 'byor ba/ / dngos med rtogs shing brtse ldan pa/ / rgyal bas 'di gsungs bden mod kyi/ /da ltar 'di 'dra 'ga' ma mthong / / rdzogs sangs rgyas ltar 'jig rten 'dir/ / ci bder gnas bya gang smra ba/ / khyed la rdzogs sangs mtshan 2slo

༄/ /bskosadonadang mig 'a644stagapa'isnangagama'i cha/ / yod par ci yi phyir mi snang / / gal te sngags kyi bstan pa la/ / snod du gyur pa khyod yin na/ / bdag cag dam tshig la sdang bas/ / 'gal ba smra bar gyur pa yin/ / gal te zas skom sgo nas ni/ /rdzas sogs mnyam par slob byed na/ / sbyin la sogs pa'i lam gyis ni/ /mi slob ces pa ngo mtshar che/ / gal te sgyu ma ltar gnas pa/ / 'di la khyod kyis brten bcas na/ / bkres skom grang sogs gnod pa la/ / khyed kyi sgyu ma gang du song / / 'jig rten gnyen gyis sngags pa la/ / tshogs can khyad par can gsungs pa/ / de tsho khyod la yod min pas/ / rgyu med 'bras bu gang las byung / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar na snyigs ma'i skye bo rnams bsod nams dman zhing nyon mongs pa'i dbang du song ba dang /nag phyogs kyi bdud rigs kha rgyal ba'i dbang gis gsang sngags 'chal bar spyod pa dang / blo'i mthu zhan pas lta ba blos byas dang nyi tshe ba 'ba' zhig tu song ste ngan rtog dang log spyod shin tu dar ba'i tshe/ rje bla mas sngon bskal pa dpag med kyi snga rol nas yang dag pa'i lam 'di nyid spel bar dam bcas shing rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mgrin dbyangs gcig gi sgo nas snying stobs chen po zhes ched du brjod pas bsngags pa mdzad pa'i don bzhin du ngan rtog gi dri ma ma lus par bsal te/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin sre lhad cung zad kyang med pa mdo sngags bshad sgrub zung du 'jug pa'i bka' srol gyis nub rgya bal gyi mtshams nas shar rgya mtsho'i bar du khyab par mdzad pa yin no/ / don 'di la dgongs te rgyal ba rang nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes sa steng thams cad stong pa lta bur gyur pa na/ slar yang sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dang 'dra bar bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i srol phye nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston pa'i rgyal ba gnyis par 'gyur tshul yang yang lung 205

/ston par mdzad de/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi le'u nyer brgyad pa las/ de dus 'jigs su rung ba yi/ / de tshe sems can chos ldan min/ / rtag tu chos la mi gnas gnas shing / / rgyal po rnams ni ma rung yid/ / mi dang mi ma yin rnams ni/ / kun kyang bstan la rnam par sdang / / ngas bshad chos kyi mdzod rnams ni/ / de yis thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ / zhes dus shin tu snyigs mar song nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams tshul dang /bskal pa bsam mi khyab par sngon/ / gzhon nu khyod kyi smon lam 'di/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gang su dag / 'jig rten gnyen gyur mya ngan 'das/de dag bstan pa'i don du ni/ / dus dang dus su bya'o zhes/ / bdag ni byes pa gzhon nu'i gzugs/ / dus kun tu ni rnam par spyod/ / sngags kyi gzugs kyis sems can la/ / de dag der ni rnam par 'dul/ / gzhon nu khyod kyi smon lam 'di/ / sngon chad du ni byas pa yin/ / zhes sangs rgyas rnams 'das rjes su byis pa'i tshul bzung ste de dag gi bstan pa'i srog 'dzin pa'i phyir thugs bskyed rlabs po che sngar nas mdzad tshul/ da ni byis pa'i gzugs thob 'gyur/ / des na khyod la bshad par bya/ / skye bo skyabs ni med pa dang / / sangs rgyas zhing ni stong ba na/ / sngags kyi gzugs kyis sems can la/ / byes pa'i tshul gyis yang dag shod/ / sems can mang po 'dul byed cing / / phun sum tshogs pa sbyin byed la/ / dus kyi tha ma de la ni/ / sems can kun lam chog sbyin byed/ / 'jig rten pa ni mya ngan 'das/ / sa yi steng ni stong gyur na/ / khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyi ni/sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ / de tshe dgon chen rab dga' pa/kha ba can na'ang yod pa yi/ / chu bo gser dang ldan 'gram du/ / nga ni mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ / zhes bstan pa 'di'ang ches shin tu nyams dmas 206

༄/ /gang༄donadang ldagapa'i 'ge'ibastanapa'isnangab/par gyur pa na tha mal pa'i gzugs su byon nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston cing / kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling 'debs pa dang / de'ang dgon pa gcig pu tsam ma yin par dgon pa'i ming grub mtha' spyi la thogs pa ltar ri bo dga' ldan pa'i lugs srol gtsang ma 'byung tshul rgyal ba rang nyid kyis kyang pha shul bu la gtod pa bzhin chos kyi rgyal srid 'jam dbyangs la gtad nas mya ngan las 'da' tshul dang bcas pa bstan la/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus par yang / byang phyogs gang ri'i rgyud kyi sar/ / dge ba ldan pa'i sa phyogs su/ / dam pa'i chos ni rgyas par 'gyur/ / zhes dgon pa dang grub mtha'i mtshan gsal bar gsungs so/ /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud le'u nyer bzhi par bstan pa gso ba'i thabs su dgon pa 'debs pa'i sngon der cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i yar ngo smon lam gye dus mchod btsugs te/ nyin re bzhin dkon mchog la mchod pa dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed tshul/ lhag par bco lnga'i mtshan mo mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul tshul bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan te 'gog pa rir gter du sbas pa'i tshogs dung sogs gter nas 'byin rgyu rnams thar chags su lung bstan yod pa ni rnam thar gyi go rim dang lung gis gsungs tshul gung bsgrigs te blo gros zhib mos dpyad na shes so/ / de bzhin du le'u nyer dgu pa las/gzhon nu khyod kyis yongs zhus pa/ / bu khyod 'jam dpal rab tu nyon/ /nga ni 'jig rten mya ngan 'das/ / sa steng stong par gyur pa dang / / chos kyi mdzod kyang 'jig pa dang / / nyan thos rnams kyang 'das pa na/ / rkang gnyis dam pa ston pa yi/ / gzugs brnyan mchod rten dag kyang bya/ /spos dang dri dang byug pa yis/ / mchod dang bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs gos mchog dang / / gzhan yang nor bu'i gdub kor rgyan/207

/rnam pa sna tshogs bza' dang bca'/ / yang dag sbyar pa dbul bar bya/ /zhes pas kyang jo bo la dbu rgyan dang / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa 'bul tshul sogs bstan cing / der ma zad le'u so drug par/ dang por yi ge ba grags dang / / ston pa'i gzugs brnyan don yang byed/ / blo ldan dang por yi ge ma/ / de bzhin sdom brtson dad pa 'byung / / zhes dang /bstan pa de tshe sa steng du/ / rnam par nyams shing snang med la/ / ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid du 'ong / / byed par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /thams cad byang chub lung bstan te/ / nga yi byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ / de bzhin 'jig rten sbyin gnas 'gyur/ / srid pa gsum gyi mthar yang byed/ / sngags dang rgyud la mngon brtson pas/ / grags pa 'dzin par shes par bya/ / zhes pas kyang rgya skad dang bod skad kyi dbang du byas pa'i rje bla ma'i mtshan sgra gsal po dang / jo bo rin po cher dbu rgyan phul nas shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba byed pa bstan/ ston pa'i gzugs brnyan don yang byed/ / ces pas kyang der sri zhu rgya chen po bstan pa nam gnas par du mi nyams pa'i srol tshugs par mdzad pa de lung bstan pa yin no/ / khyad par du le'u 'di'i mgor rgyal ba rang nyid thog mar 'khrungs tshul/ rab tu byung zhing dka' ba spyad lugs/ sangs rgyas nas chos 'khor bskor ba dang / mu stegs pham par mdzad pa sogs sku tshe 'di'i mdzad pa rags rim zhig gsungs pa'i mthar/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gtad pa yin/ / nga ni 'jig rten mya ngan 'das/ / zhes dngos kyi gdul byardzogs nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la rang gi bstan pa gtad de rgyal tshab tu bskos nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul dang / de nas/ sa steng stong par gyur pa na/ / de nas 'jam dpal sems can la/ / sangs rgyas mdzad pa 208

sa / /bstodapa 'grel bsgo gapa'i ngagabyed par 'gyur/ / thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ / dam pa'i chos ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ / de tshe rtag tu srung bar na/ / 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'gyur ba yin/ / zhes dus kyi tha mar bstan pa'i srog 'dzin pa'i rgyal pa gnyis par 'gyur ba lung bstan to/ / le'u so bzhi pa dang so lnga par bstan pa srung ba'i don du yi dam gshin rje'i gshed la byed cing / de la brten te snying rje'i sgo nas drag las byed tshul dang / sum cu par lcags mkhar skabs kyi phyag rgya'i gnad 'ga' zhig kyang gsungs pa dang / gong du chos rgyal gyi sngags sogs kyang gsungs pa thams cad ri bo dge ldan pa'i bka' srol 'di'iyi dam chos srung du gtso bor gsungs pa yin par zhib tu brtags na shes so/ / deras zad dge ldan gyi bstan pa 'di chos bzhin skyong ba'i rgyal po sbyin bdag rnams kyang lung bstan te/ thog mar/ nga ni sa steng mya ngan 'da'/ / kha ba can gyi nang dag tu/ / sa la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/zhes sogs kyis spyir bod yul thog mar chags tshul dang / lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa/ / rgyal po mi yi lha zhes bya/zhes srong btsan sgam po nas rim par gsungs pa mthar/ / sa srung dang ni be'u dang / / 'od ldan nyid ni phyi ma yin/ / zhes pe'u ste glang dar ma dang /de nas 'od ldan te 'od srung gi bar rgyal po rim par byung yang / 'od srung nas bod sil bur 'thor te spyi'i rgyal po mi 'byung ba dang / / de 'og lugs ni rnam zhig cing / / phyi rol skye dgus nye bar spyod/ / ces dang / tha mar char rgyal ngang tshul te/ / kla klo rnam pa sna tshogs yin/ / zhes phyogs gzhan gyi rgyal po mang po'i dbang du 'gro ba dang / khyad par hor sog gis dbang byed par gsungs/ de tshe bal yul bdag po ni/ / mtshon gyis 'thab pas rnam par 'jig/ces bal pos sde gzar bslang yang kho rang pham 209

/ /par 'gyur tshul rnams gsungs la/ de'i mjug thogs su/ rgya yul kun la brten pa yi/ / rgyal po dbyig gi snying zhes bya/ / sde chen stobs kyang che ba dang / / blon po rgya che nyid dang ni/ / skye po rtsa lag rab tu mang / / kla klos btud dang rnam par rgyal/ / ston pa'i bstan pa de gtso byed/ /gzhon nu bdag nyid chen po nyid/ / de yi sngags ni rab bsgrub pa/ / mthu ni chen po dang ldan pa'i/ / rig pa'i rgyal po yi ge brgyad/ / dpa' bo che zhes rnam par grags/ / phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas chen yin/ / de yi byis pa'i blo yis ni/ / rgyal srid phyir ni rab smon byas/ / gang gis dran pa tsam gyis ni/ / sangs rgyas nyid du nges 'gyur ba/ / mi bdag rgyal thabs nyidakyi phyir/ / de ni bskal pa mi nyung 'gyur/ / mchog gi sbyin pa bla na med/ / bsam pa tsam gyis thob pa nyid/ / tshangs sogs lha rnams thams cad la/ / ma lus lung ni stsol byed na/ / lha ngan phal pa dag dang ni/ /mi yi 'jig rten smos ci dgos/ / lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho/ / grags chen lha yi gnas su 'gro / chos kyi bdag nyid de mthar gyis/ / byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur/ / gzhon nus yongs su bshad pa yi/ / rig pa 'dini de yul du/ / de ni myur du 'grub 'gyur gye/ / rig pa gzhan ni nam yang min/ / byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo che/ / 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'od chen po/ / mngon sum de yi yul dag na/ / byis pa'i gzugs kyis bzhugs pa yin/ / grub pa'i zhing mchog dam pa la/ / mi ni yongs su sgrub par 'gyur/ / rgyal po tu ruṣ+ka zhes bya/ / byang phyogs la ni yang dag brten/ / sde chen brtson 'grus che ba ste/ / de yi gnas su 'byung bar 'gyur/ / shing shun gyon yul ma gtogs pa/ / kha che'i mthar thug ka shir bcas/ / de ni dpag tshad bdun brgya dang / / 'bum phrag gnyis kyi 210

das / / /ba/༷//phrogang gang /sa bdag tu/ / de tshe dus gyi tha ma la/ / de tshe the tshom med par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs kyis 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rgyal srid 'di nyid lung bstan pa yin te/ spyir rgya nag gi rgyal srid tsam sangs rgyas 'jig rten du ma byon pa'i gong nas yod na'ang / 'dir bod kyi rgyal rabs dang / de rjes gzhan mang pos 'dzin cing / de'i mjug tu 'byung bar gsung ba'i dus tshod rgyal rabs 'di dag la 'grigs pa dang / dpag tshad nyis 'bum lhag pa'i sa la dbang byed par gsung ba'ang mtha' skor yin na 'dzam gling spyi'i tshad dang mi 'grigs kyang / rags rtsis kyis zheng du dpag tshad bzhi brgya dang /mchur dpag tshad lnga brgya'i sa de re'u mig tu bgos na dpag tshad nyis 'bum tsam 'byung la/ da lta sog bod thams cad dbang du bsdus pas yul gyi khyon yang de tsam ma mtha' 'byung bar snang / rtsa brgyad stong gi gtsug lag khang / / de yi dus su yod par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / lha khang dag ni mang po byas/ / stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa gcig gi/ / mchod rten mchog ni de bzhinabyas/ / theg pa chen po mchog chos dang / / de bzhin sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum/ / 'jig rten shes rab pha rol phyin/ / de yi yul du rab gnas byas/ / zhes 'byung la/ dgon sde dang gtsug lag khang sogs rgya che zhing grangs mang ba rgyal rabs 'di'i skabs lta bu sngar gang la'ang ma byung snang bas kyang dge ldan pa dang mchod yon du 'brel ba'i skabs kyi rgyal rabs 'di rnams gtso bo yin par shes so/ / der ma zad rgyal po du ma lung bstan pa'i dgos pa'ang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag byed rgyu'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la/'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rgyal rabs 'di rnams ni thun mong ma yin par 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i ring lugs 'di'i sbyin bdag dang rgyab rten du gyur pa mthunagrub yin pa'i byur dang / rje'i rnam thar du dang po ri bo rtse lnga nas 211

/ /phebs pa'i rmi lam dang / mya ngan las 'das te ri bo rtse lngar phebs tshul du ma yod la/ 'dir yang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'od chen po/ / mngon sum de yi yul dag na/ / byis pa'i gzugs kyis bzhugs pa yin/ / zhes pa rnams gung bsgrigs pa'i tshe tsi na'i rgyal khams 'di nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi 'dul zhing yin pa tsam du ma zad rgyal po rnams kyang 'phags mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rang nyid kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir du byin rlabs dang sprul pa'i zlos gar mdzad pa yin par sems so/ / der ma zad/yi ge ha ming slar log nas/ / kla klo'i rgyal pos rab tu mchod/ / yi ge ha bya dge dang ldan/ / dge ba'i don gye lus kyis ni/ / ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'gros dag gis/ / rang gis yul ni nyid du phyin/ / de nyid kyi ni las byas pas/ / rgyal srid dga' dang ldan pa 'thob/ / ces pas kyang kla klo ste sog po'i rgyal po ko shi han gyis dge ldan pa'i bstan pa la sri zhu cher byas te bod ljongs mtha' dag lha 'bangs su sbyar bas dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab srid 'byung ba'ang lung bstan pa yin no/ / de ltar na 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud 'di ni thun mong ma yin par rje bla ma dang ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa 'di'i dbang du byas nas gsung bar snang bas zhib tu drangs pa yin gyi/ gzhan mdo rgyud du ma dang / rgyal po bka' chems/ bka' gdams glegs bam/slobadapon gyi bskul byang dang gter yig tshad ldan du ma/ ma cig gi lung bstan sogs sngon byung ba dang / skabs der lho brag pa dang / rtogs ldan pa sogs la lhag pa'i lhas lung bstan pa rnams su mtshan sgra dang dgon pa'i gnas/ sku tshe snga phyi/ gang du 'tshang rgya ba dang 'phrin las kyi rgyun sogs lung bstan ches mang ba ni rnam thar rnams dang / lung bstan gsal ba'i me long sogs su blta bar bya yi/ 'dir mang gis dogs pas ma bris so/ /212

sa / /bstodapadon shengagacogapa'i 'a 'igang ba/de ltar sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par lung bstan pa'i mdzad pa'i gtso bo ni mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa'i lam bzang 'di nyid yin la/ de'ang yul phyogs re re tsam ma yin par/ sa steng 'di na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srol gtsang ma gang yod rje 'di'i bka' drin gyi cha shas kho na yin te/ byang sham+bha lar yang rje bla ma'i rang lugs 'di nyid dar rgyas su yod tshul paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas ye shes kyis sgrib pa med par gzigs nas gsungs pa zhal las dngos su thos so/ / des na rje bla ma'i yon tan rjes su dran pa rnams kyisakyang rnam thar gyi snying po ngos zin par byas te/ thub bstan yang snying gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul 'di'i sgo nas rje bla ma rjes su dran par bya'o/ /bstanapa gso tshul yang sngon gyi dus bzang po'i skabs cha shas re tsam nyams na'ang mkhas grub kyi skyes bu skar tshogs bzhin du bkra bas/ phyogs mtha' dag nas phyir gso ba dka' tshegs med kyang / rje bla ma 'byon pa'i gong der bstan pa ha cang nyams nas yun ring bas ming gi lhag ma tsam du song ste gzhan sus kyang gso ba'i thabs med pa lta bur gyur yod snang ste/ bstan pa spyi'i dbang du byas na bshad sgrub kyi cha thams cad nas nyag phra ba'i tshul/tshig spyi'i bshad sgrub rtags kyi dge spyong gis/ / thub bstan ming tsam lhag mar gyur pa'i dus/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / zhib par dad pa'i 'jugangogs las gsungs pa ltar yin zhing / khyad par sngags kyi bstan pa de'i sngon nas cher nyams pa'i tshul sdom gsum rab dbye las/ nges na nyan thos theg pa ni/ nyams kyang gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang / / rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la/ / gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ngo / / zhes gsungs pa bzhin yin zhing / rje'i sngags kyi gsung rab du ma'i mjug tu'ang /ring nas nyams pa'i lam gyi gnang 'byed pa/ / zhes dang / sngon chad 213

/ /phyogs 'dir mngon du ma gyur pa'i/ / zhes dang / lam 'di ches cher nyams pa gso phyir dang / / zhes dang / bde mchog bshad sgrub shin tu nyams pa 'di/ / zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis shes so/ / lta ba'i skor yang ring mo zhig nas nyams yod pa'i tshul rtsa shes ṭīka chen las/ / don 'di phra zhing shin tu rtogs dka' bas/ / ring mo zhig nas ches cher nyams par gyur/ / ces dang / legs bshad snying por/ de tshe ring nas nyams pa'i rtogs dka'i gnas/ / gang gis btsal bas rnyed pa'i rigs pa'i lam/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ / mdor na 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ sa yi steng 'di stong pa na/ / zhes dang / de tshe sa steng bstan pa ni/ / rnam par nyams shing snang med la/ / zhes sogs gong du drangs pa ltar/ thub dpang chos kyi nyi ma nyer zhi'i dbyings su gzims shing / rgyal ba'i bstan pa ladapang du gyur pa'i dam pa gong ma thams cad 'das te/ rnam par dag pa'i bshad sgrub kyi snang ba nub pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mun pa'i gling lta bur gyur cing / thar lam phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i gling dang dpung gnyen med pa na/ rgyal ba'i gdung mi 'chad par 'tshob pa'i sras mchog rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jam mgon smra ba'i zla ba de nyid thugs bskyed rlung gi nying rtas drangs te/ thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan du shar bas thar 'dod yid kyi mun pa bsal te phan bde'i lam bzang gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ / bstan pa'i cha re re tsam 'dzin cing spel ba la'ang phan yon dang gdul bya'i don rlabs po che 'byung zhing / bod 'dir sngon chad byon pa'i skyes mchog phal cher gyis bstan pa la bya ba mdzad tshul yang rje'i rnam thar la ltos na mdo'am sngags/ bshad pa'am sgrub pa gang rung re gtso bor bton pa'i phyogs re ba kho na yin la/ rje nyid ni bskal ba mu mtha' yas pa'i snga 214

sa / /bstodasacan saldanapa'i' 'isnangab/rol nas rgyal ba rnams kyi dam chos ma lus pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin du 'dzin pa'i smon lam yongs su grub pa'i stobs kyis sngon thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis mchog 'bring dman pa'i gdul bya so so'i skal ba bzhin rgyu 'bras kye theg pa'i chos kyi sgo mo ji snyed cig stsal pa thams cad rjod byed yi ge na gcig kyang ma lus par bden bzhi'i chos 'khor nas rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar dang / brjod bya 'dul ba'i bcas rkyang phra mo nas bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi bar thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi srol phyes pa yin te/ kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīk+ka las/ de tsam gyis mkhas pa thams cad kyi gtsug na mngon par mtho bar mi 'gyur te/ bka' gdams kyi sku mched gsum dang / glang shar sogs bdag pas gzhan gces 'dzin pa'i sems dpa'/ lce 'brog mar mi sogs sku tshe de'am bar dor zung 'jug brnyes pa'i grub thob/ rngog bu sogs gnas lnga rig pa mkhyen pa'i bla ma mtha' klas pa byung bas so zhe na/ rigs pa de ni 'jug pa ma yin te/ bshad ma thag pa'i mkhas grub de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdoms na dam pa 'di'i yon tan dang mtshungs na'ang / re re bzhin nas dod mi snyoms pa'i rgyu mtshan/bstan pa snga dar la lo paṇa rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / phyi dar la bka' gdams gong ma sogs rgyal ba'i sras po de rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems las lhag pa 'di la mi mnga'ang / 'di nyid kyi tha snyad dang gsang sngags yongs su rdzogs pa de dag la med pas so / / de bzhin du snga dar gye rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang / phyi dar gyi lo chen 'brog mi/ dkar po rnam gsum/ mar mi sogs grub pa'i dbang phyug de dag gi skyed rdzogs kyi yon tan gyi cha nas phan tshun snyoms na'ang / so so thar pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi 215

/ /tshul khrims dang / grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i bzhed gzhung / sgra tshad sogs shes bya ji snyed pa'i yon tan gyi cha nas mchog dman yod do/ / de bzhin du rngog shong dpang bu ston sogs gnas lnga rig pa mkhyen pa rnams kyis thos bsam la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i cha nas khyad par med kyang / bla ma mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bka' drin la brten nas dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed pa dngos bstan stong nyid kyi lta ba dang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgyu lus sogs gnad gsang zab mo sngon chad mkhas pa dang grub pa rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i yul du ma 'tshal ba mtha' dag dam pa 'di nyid kyis gtan la phab pa mngon sum gyis grub pa 'di'o/ / zhes grub mtha' ris med kyi lha sgom spyod pa'i khyad par dang / dam pa gong ma kun gyi rnam thar phyag rjes thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs nas gsungs pa yinal/ yang de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje'i bstod pa dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs las/ rmad byung rnam thar gtsang ma'i khrims dang ldan/ / rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying stobs che/ / bde stong mchog gi rim gnyis rnal 'byor spyod/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal bar shog/ces phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa'i dang tshugs bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar gtsang ma la gnas shing / nang du thun mong ba gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang / thun mong ma yin pa lam rim pa gnyis kyi snying po bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i ting 'dzin zab mo'i rnal 'byor la spyod pas bstan pa yongasajogs rang gi nyams len gyi lus gcig tu 'dril zhing / rjes 'jug mchog dman gyi don du 'gyur ba rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' srol bla na med par gsungs te/ tshul 'di ni bshad rgyud rdor 'phreng gi re bzhi pa las/ nang ni gsang 'dus la rab dga'/ / phyi 216

༄/ / bstosadonadangaldagapa'i 'gye40bstanapa'isnangab/rol nyan thos kyi spyod pa/ / de lta'i man ngag rim pa yis/ / slob ma rnams la rjes su bstan/ / zhes dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi brgyad pa las/nyan thos spyod pa skyong byed cing / / sngags kyi theg pa'i rim par gus/ /zhesagasungs pa rnams kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba yin no/ / des na bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer zhes pa'ang / dam pa 'ga' zhig sho'i rde'u ji ltar 'phang yang grub bzhi lam gyis 'bab pa bzhin/ nyams len gyi sgo gang nas brtsams kyang bstan pa'i gnad thams cad de'i nang du khrig khrig 'dus nas 'ong ba la bzhed pa dang / la la sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/bslab pa gsum dang sngags kyi lam ste lung rtogs kyi grub bzhi bzhir byas nas de thams cad tshang ba'i don du bzhed la/ rje ngag dbang byams pa'i dris lan zhig tu skyes bu chung 'bring gi nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnam dag 'khor bcas yan gru gcig man ngag bdun bslab bya phar phyin dang po lnga dang bcas pa gru gcig shes rab kyi phar phyin mtha' bral lta ba'i skor gru gcigags sngags rdo rje theg pa'i skor gru gcig tu 'jog/ ces lam gyi gtso bo rnam pa gsum sngags dang bcas pa la gsungs pa rnams bshad tshul gyi rnam grangs tha dad pa tsam las don gcig ste/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i gtso bo so thar gyi sdom pa ni/ mdo rtsa ba las/ nges par 'byung ba tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin rtsa ba nges 'byung gi bsam pa la thug cing / theg chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'am bsamagatan gye pha rol tu phyin pa'i gtso bo ni/ rgyan snang las/ theg pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa dang / zhes pa ltar dman pa'i yidabyed sogs kyis g.yeng mi nus pa'i byang chub kyi sems la byed dgos te/spyod 'jug tu'ang bsam gtan gyi le'ur sems skyed cho gas 'dzin tshul 217

/ / sogs gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'ang de yin no/ / des na 'brom chos kyi rgyal pos bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa'i bla ma zhes jo bo la thun mong ma yin pa'i mos gus bskyed pa ltar/ rang cag ri bo dge ldan pa rnams rje bla mas bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer tshul jo bos gsungs pa las kyang ches shin tu gsal bar phyes pa 'di'i sgo nas rje bla ma la mi phyed pa'i dad pa shugs drag po skyed cing / de'ang dang ba'i dad pa gcig pu ma yin par/ rje btsun bla mas nyams len de ltar mdzad/ / thar 'dod bdag kyang de bzhin bskyang 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i don bzhin rang gis kyang lung rtogs kyi bstan pa mtha' dag gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer nus pa zhig byung na snyam pa'i mngon 'dod kyi dad pa dang / de ltar 'ong pa'i thabs tshang la ma nor ba rje bla mas rjen par bstan yod pa 'di bzhin nyams su blangs na nges par 'grub pa thag chod snyam pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa blo 'khul nges pa bskyed de blo dang brtson pa'i rtsal gang yod kyis lag len du 'debs pa dang / da lta dngos su mi nus pa rnams kyang nam zhig ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub nus pa zhig 'ong snyam du smon pa byed cing / de ltar nus par skyabs gsum kun 'dus kye ngo bo 'jam mgon bla ma nyid kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa dang / de'i don du tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la 'bad pa sogs sgo mtha' dag nas shes rgyud la yang dag pa'i lam gye ngag chags brtan po zebs mtshams sbyor ba mjug gi don dang bcas pa ni/ deng dus yab rje'i zhes pa man chad de/ de'ang / deng dus yab rje'i srol bzang yang / / snyigs ma mun pa'i rdul gyis khebs/ / ltar snang bshes gnyen du ma yis/ / skye bo nyam nga'i g.yang du 'khrid/ / kye hud dge ldan bstan pa 'di/ / dpal dang 'byor bas rab rgyas kyang / / bshad dang sgrub pas ches phra ba/ /218

da / /nga stespyo 'i 'a 'id pa'ab/bsam gyen snying nas shes pa 'phyo/ / zhes pa'i sho lo ka gnyis kyis rje bla mas dka' ba brgya phrag gi sgo nas gsal bar phyes pa'i srol bzang po de'ang dus kyi rim pas ches nyams par gyur pa la skyo ba'i tshul dang / lhag mas dad pa dang skyo shas zung gi sgo nas 'dod bya'idon la smon lam btab pa yin no/ /de'ang dper na lam phan tshun thams cad la g.yang shin tu che ba'i sar lam mkhan mkhas pas de'i gseb nas bgrod bde ba'i lam skyon med pa zhig btsal te srol btod kyang / mun sros na lam ji lta ba bzhin mthong mi nus la/ de'i steng du rdul sogs kyis lam dang lam ma yin pa thams cad cha mnyam par g.yogs na lam gyi dbyibs tsam yang shes mi nus so/ / de'i tshe rang nyid gar 'gro gtol med pa'i khar gzhan zhig gis 'dir bgrod na legs zhes g.yang sa ngos su khrid na de'i rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur zhing mi ring bar g.yang du ltung bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ 'jam mgon bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis yang dag pa'i lam gyi srol phyes kyang dus yun ring 'gyangs te da lta skye bo rnams blo'i mthu rim bzhin bri bas rmongs pa'i mun pa 'thib cing snyigs ma'i brlang spyod sna tshogs pa'i rdul gyis g.yogs nas bstan pa'i srol mi mngon par byas/ dam par khas 'che'ang dam pa'i tshul dang mi mthun pa sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi yon tan ci'ang med par chags sdang g.yo sgyu'i 'khor lo bskor te rnyed bkur 'du 'dzi 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba ming dge ba'i bshes gnyen du btags pa du mas rigs mthun gye grwa slob rang gi rjes su zhugs pa thams cad la rgyal pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i gdams pa sna re'ang ston rgyu med par dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshe 'di'i snang shas sgrub pa'i thabs kho na bstan te blo sna thur du 'khrid pa ches mang la/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang /219

/de'i rjes su tshul bzhin du slob pa nyung bas dus ngan snyigs ma'i ngang tshul 'di ltabu bsam gyin skyo ba'i gnas yin no/ / kha cig 'di snyam du da lta ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa rgya bod hor gsum kun tu dar zhing / grwa tshogs dang sbyin bdag sogs gang sa nas 'phel rgyas che bas grub mtha' gzhan thams cad las dbu 'phang mtho ba deng dus 'dra ba sngar ma byung ba lta bu yin pas bstan pa ches cher dar skabs yin gyi/ nyams dmas pa'i dus ga la yin snyam na/ rnyed bkur snyan gsum kho na don du gnyer ba dag de ltar sems pa bden yang / thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis bla ma'i yon tan/bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib/ rang gi gtan 'dun gang bsam na'ang sbun pa dang snying po ma nor bar/ dgos pa'i gtso bo ngos zin pa 'di gal che ste/mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ dam pa rnams kyi chos kyi khri/ / legs bshad smra ba'i dpal gyis mtho/ / 'jig rten phun tshogs dpal rnams kyis/ /khyim gyi rgyal po mthon por byed/ / gang dag rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi/ /dgongs don smra la nus med pa/ / longs spyod ldan pa'i skye bo ni/ / mang yang bstan la dgos nus med/ / legs bshad 'od brgya'i snang ba can/bshes gnyen nyi ma gcig gis kyang / / thub bstan gling bzhi ma lus pa/ /gcig car nyid du gsal bar nus/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ stobs 'byor mnga' thang kha drag dbang che sogs ni 'jig rten gyi rgyal srid sogs khyim pa'i dbang du byas pa'i dpal 'byor rgyas tshul yin la/ chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i dpal 'byor ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin du legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston 'gyed cing de don nyams su len pa kho na yin gyi/ rnyed bkur 'du 'dzi sogs bstan pa nyams byed yin pas dpal dang byur ma nor ba dgos pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas kyi sde snod kyi mdo las/ shā ri'i bu de lta 220

ra / / 'i 'grebartsabacasagasa'is pab/mod kyi bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i gsung rab de ni lhag par rnyed pa dang bkur ste byed pas nub bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te/ shā ri'i bu 'di ltar chos 'dul ba 'di ni rnyed pa dang bkur stes myur du nub par 'gyur ro/ / shā ri'i bu dper na mi dbul po zhigagis gter chen po rnyed nas gzhi de las bde ba dang yid bde ba nyams su phyong ngo / / shā ri'i bu de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ dge slong dag 'di ltar khyim pa la brten pa dang / phu dud byed pa dang / bkur ste byed pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / shā ri'i bu de la khyim pa gang dag gis dge slongagang dag kyang 'jig rten gyi zang zing gis zang zing la mgron du 'bod bar 'gyur zhing / mi dbul po gter la chags pa bzhin du / dge ba ma mthong ba de dag 'jig rten gyi zang zing gis yid bde bar bya ba'i phyir/ de dgagi las kyi mtha' rim bzhin du byed par 'gyur ro/ / de ltar na dge slong de dag kyang 'jig rten gyi zang zing lhur len par 'gyur te / 'jig rten gye zang zing gis 'khol bas chog mi shes pa dang / nye du la 'dod par 'gyur ro/ / bdag nyid shes bzhin du khyim pas shes par bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid dgra bcom pa yin par sgrogs par byed do/ / de dag de ltar shes par byed pa yongs su tshol pa na sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'dor bar 'gyur ro / / zhes dang / gzi brjid can gyi mdo las/ rnyed pa dang bkur ste la brten pa'i dge slong gi kun nas nyon mongs pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgur 'gyur te/ de dag gis mtshams med pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las kyang / rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni gcig tu bag med pa'i rtsa ba yin par brtag par bya'o//rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni dge ba'i rtsa ba 'aprog par brtag par bya'o/ /221

da / / sa skolarnyid pa dang bkur ste ni nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa skyed par brtag par bya'o/ / zhes sogs gsungs la/ zla ba snying po'i mdor yang bstan pa 'jig pa'i rgyu mang du gsungs pa'i gtso bo 'du 'dzi la dga' bar bshad do/ / khyad par du dge ldan pa'i bstan pa 'di la gnod pa'i rkyen che shos 'dod yon la g.yeng bas khyer ba 'dis byed par jo bo yab sras kyis lung bstan te/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ 'dod yon bdud kyi g.yab mo 'byung / / zhes 'di'i lung bstan gyi skabs su gsungs la/ rje bla mas kyang de la dgongs te lhung bzed kha sbub pa'i steng du mchod rten brtsigs nas 'dod yon la mnan pa byas tshul dam pa'i gsung las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /des na gang zag khyad par can srid pa'i phun tshogs la zhen pa gting nas log pas rnyed bkur sogs kyis cung zad kyang kha 'khrid mi nus pa re gnyis la gos 'bum ri ba dang / khang ba brtsegs pa lnga brgya pa'ang 'os par 'dul ba'i mdo las gsungs pa ma gtogs/ snyigs ma'i skye bo col chung rnams la rnyed bkur byung ba ni chos kyi bar chad du 'gro ba las mthun rkyen du 'gro ba nyung ste/de'i phyir mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ bsod nams zer ba'i 'du 'dzi de yang bdud kyi bar chad yin pas spongs/ zhes gsungs so/ / de ltar na bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib ni stobs 'byor che chung gis mi 'jog la/ der ma zad phyi'i cha lugs tsam dang / phyag skor ba/ gar thig/ 'bri mchod sogs lus kyi dge sbyor kho nas kyang bstan pa bzung bar mi 'gyur/ ngag gi bzlas brjod klog 'don rta dbyangs sogs kho nas kyang bstan pa 'dzin mi nus par/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni gtso bor sems kyi steng nas 'jog dgos pa'i phyir te/ bzhi brgya pa las/ shākya gos med bram ze ste/ /gsum po rnams kyi chos yid dang / / mig dang rna bas 'dzin byed pa/ / de 222

ra / /nga stespyo 'i 'a :ba stephyir thub pa'i gzhung lugs phra/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / sems steng nas 'dzin tshul yang ma mtha' 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal du shes nas de las thar 'dod bcos ma tshun chad dang / bdag med phra rags kyi don la sgra spyi'i go ba rags pa re tsam chags na'ang thar pa'i sa bon 'jog nus la/ de med par rtsa rlung dang lha'i sku sgom pa sogs zab zab 'dra ba ji tsam bsgom ste snang ba ban bun gyi rtags thon pa byung yang 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba las med de/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtshos/ chos stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ / 'di'i dmigs khrid gtso bor mi byed par/ / lus 'phrul 'khor gtum mo'i rlung sbyor sogs/ / ngo mtshar yang rkyal ba phus gter yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ gang 'dzin rgyu'am gang la nan tan bya ba'i yul gyi bstan pa ngos zin par bya dgos so/ / des na tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag shes pa ni 'grib/srog ni 'chad/ tshe'i 'du byed ni 'dor/ ston pa'i bstan pa'ang nges par 'jig par 'gyur na ci'i phyir brtson 'grus dang brtul pa brtan pos sgrub par mi byed/ ces gsungs pa ltar 'tsho ba'i srog ni ri gzar gyi 'bab chu bzhin myur du 'gro zhing / phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'ang nyi rgas kyi grib so bzhin 'grib par nye ba'i ngang tshul bsam ste brtson 'grusadang brtul ba brtan pos thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas snying po ci lon byed cing / long bas glang rnga zin pa bzhin tshe rabs thams cad du yang dag pa'i lam bzang 'di dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir smon pa'i mtshams spyor nan tan du bya dgos pas/ 'dir/ zab rgyas chos kyi de nyid don/ / ji bzhin 'doms pa ches dkon yang / / 'khrul bral khyod gsung glegs bam rnams/ / gdung sel dbugs dbyung mchog sbyin 'gyed/ / ces dam pa 223

da / / // lagong ma rnams zhi bar gzhol zhing / da lta bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen du grags pa mang na'ang / zab rgyas kyi gdams pa'i gnad ji lta ba bzhin 'byed par nus pa'i rnam dpyod can sa steng 'dir shin tu dkon no/ / 'on kyang rje bla ma'i legs bshad rnams ma nub par yod la/rangagis nyams su len nus na sngon byon pa'i mkhas grub de dag thams cad dang dngos su mjal yang gsung rgyu 'di las lhag pa med pas/ de dag kun gye zhabs pad bsten pa'i dod por legs bshad 'di rnams la legs par sbyangs nas nyams su lon pas yid kyi gdung ba sel ba zhig byed dgos pa yin te/ rim lnga gsal sgron las/ sa 'dis mkhas grub brgya stong gi / rin cen khur chen 'dzin pa'i tshe/ / 'bad pa du mas de rnams kyi/ / spyan sngar so so'i legs bshad len/ / dus kyi dbang gis de nyams tshe/ / de dag rnams kyi thugs kyi bcud/ / yi ger bkod pa'i gzhung mang rnams/ / bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas/ / legs par sbyangs te len pa ni/ / de yi dod du mkhas pas shes/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / lam srol bzang po de dang tshe rabs phyi ma rnams su'ang mi 'bral ba'i phyir smon pa la/ rgyal kun dgongs pa mthar thug dang / / dbyer med gyur pa khyod kyi bstan/ / gang du ji bzhin gnas pa der/ / rtag tu skye ba 'dzin par shog / ces chos sgrub pa'i rten khyad par can 'grub par smon pa dang / phyogs rer ma gyur thos pa'i chos/ / bsam dang sgom pas nyams blangs nas/ / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang po/ / tshang la ma nor rnyed gyur cig / ces bstan pa spyi la slob par smon pa dang / rtag tu 'jam dbyangs bla ma yis/ / rjes bzung lta bas rgyas btab pa/ / rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam gyis/ / byang chub bde blag thob gyur cig/ces khyad par du bstan pa'i snying po mthar thug pa zab 224

sa / / bstongasatshabastacatsho'i pa'i 'a 'i gastomo'i lta ba dang gsang chen rdo rje theg pa zung du 'jug pa'i lam bzang 'di la bslab ste myur du rdzogs byang thob par smon lam btab pa yin no/ / de'ang dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs bzhed dang mdzad pa'i mthil sems can gyi don kho na yin la/ gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi don sgrub pa'i thabs tshang la ma nor ba rje bla ma'i bka' srol dri ma med pa 'di las lhag pa nam yang 'byung du med pas/ tshul 'di rgyal ba thams cad dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig tu 'bab pa'i bstan pa'i snying po mthar thug tu nges shing / de la yun du slob pa la bstan pa'i srol de nyid sre lhad sogs kyis ma sbags pa'i rgyun rnam par dag pa gang du dar ba'i zhing khams su chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad dang bral zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad tshang ba'i rten phun sum tshogs pa brgyud mar thob pa la rag las pas/ de'i rgyu sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams sogs tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gzhir byas la/ sbyin pa dang bzod pa sogs kyi grogs dang bcas pa'i rgyu tshogs ma tshang ba med par bsgrubs nas legs smon dri ma med pas mtshams sbyor ba gal che ste/ rin chen 'phreng bar nges legs bsgrub pa'i gzhir mngon mtho gsungs pa dang / rgyan las 'azin las phyi ma nyer drug gi gzhir 'gro ba zhi ba'i 'phrin las gsungs pa ltar ro/ / rten de dag la'ang tshul khrims kyi rmang gzhi brtan pa'i steng nas thos bsam sgom gsum la slob pa'i tshul/ thog mar thos pa'i gnas skabs su thos pa sna re tsam ma yin par rje bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad la thos pa mtha' chod par byas/ de'ang thos lo tsam dang kha phyir bltas su ma song bar/ rang sems 'dul ba dang rnam grol sgrub pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu khyer te/ gang thos pa'i don de la bsam pa'i sgo nas sgo 'dogs 225

/ /bcad pa'i nges pa gting tshugs par byas/ sgom pas nyams myong khyad par can skyes te chos dang rang sems 'o chu 'dres pa bzhin ngo bo gcig tu song bas thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i tshul gyis rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang po mtha' dag grangs ma chad par yongs su tshangal/ ngo bo ma nor ba/ go rim ma 'khrugs par rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin du nyams su blangs pas lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag gegs med bde blag tu skye bar smon pa ste/ mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ / sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ / zhes pa ltar bstan pa spyi la slob pa'i tshul lo/ / khyad par yab rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzang 'di la slob pa'i phyir bye brag tu smon pas mtshams sbyor ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam nyid gsum gyi sgo nas dbyer ma mchis kyang / sdom 'byung dang rim lngar/ 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ / lhag pa'i lha ni gcig pu nyid/ / ces pa ltar/ rang cag rnams gang la las 'brel lhag par che ba'i lha skal ni rje bla ma 'di nyid yin zhing / rje rang gis kyang dang por thugs bskyed tshul gyi rten 'brel bzhin mdo sngags zung 'jug gi lam bzang 'di'i bdag po lta bu yin pas/ des na tshe rabs kyi phreng ba thams cad du rje bla mas theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad nas dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa dang / rang gis kyang rtag tu ngus chos 'phags bsten pa ltar sgo gsum bran du phul te mi mnyes pa skad cig kyang mi sgrub par mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas mnyes par byed cing / gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms pa med par mnos te pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gye snying po zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba dang /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i yang snying bde stong zung 'jug gi lam bzang gnyis tshogs kyi sgo nas bskal chen grangs med sogs la mi ltogapar myur ba nyid du 226

das / / /byes(ba/ /ste/ga rdos/phra rags srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal te/ bla na med pa'i byang chub nor bu'i gling du phyin nas/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad kyang yang dag pa'i lam gyi gru gzings 'di la brten nas rang gis brnyes pa'igo 'phang mchog la 'god par gyur cig ces dge tshogs chud mi za ba'i phyir smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab pa yin no/ / mjug gi don sbyar byang ni/ zhes 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa la bstan pa'i snying po gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul las brtsams te bstod pa don dang ldan pa zhes bya ba 'di ni gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang phyug il gog san er ti ni she re ge thu rdo rams pa ngag dbang yon tan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /zhes pa ste gzhan rnams go sla la/ don dang ldan pa zhes pa ni snyan ngag mngon brjod sogs kyis bcings pa'i tshig sbyor kho na gtso bor byas te 'grig 'grig 'dra'ang kun byang gi gnad ci'ang mi ston pas don med pa dang / 'jig rten gyi dpal 'byor mnga' thang sogs yon tan ma yin pa la yon tan du byas pas don log pa lta bu ma yin par/ brjod bya shin tu 'gangs che ba bstan pa'i snying po gsal bar mdzad tshul gyi sgo nas bstod pas na don dang ldan pa zhes smos pa yin no/ / de ltar bstod pa'i dgos pa'am phan yon ni/ dkyil chog nyi shu pa las/ de bzhin gshegs rnams la bstod pa/ / de la sangs rgyas rdo rje sems/ / rang nyid grogs por nye bar gnas/ / zhes bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas sdongs grogs mdzad de lam gye rtogs pa skye sla bar gsungs la/ mdo sde pad dkar las/ g.yeng ba'i sems kyis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ / tshig gcig lan 'ga' brjod 227

/ /par byas pa yang / / de dag kun gyis byang chub mchog 'di 'thob / / ces kun slong khyad par can gyis ma zin par kha tsam gyis bstod pa dang phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras na'ang zhing gi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ nam zhig na byang chub 'grub pa'i sa bon bzhag ste 'khor ba mtha' can du byed par gsungs shing / yon tan legs par mthong ste dad gus rtse gcig pas bstod pa byas na zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang ring min bde blag nyid du thob par 'gyur ba ni/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa las sangs rgyas kun gyesabaskul pa yis/ / bstod tshig zhi ba 'di rnams kyis/ / rdo rje longs spyod bstod na ni/ / de yang sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs so/ / smras pa/ gang yang sa gsum nyin mor byed la snang ba'i gter de kun las rgyal/ / gcan gzan ri dwags phra mo'i sder bcas gdong lnga 'bar ba'i zil gyes gnon/ / 'di na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gsal byed pha rol rgol ba'i snyems phrogs pa/ / mtshungs med rgyal ba gnyis par nges rnyed tshad mas drangs pa'i phyag bgyid do/ / de sras slob mar bcas pa thams cad dang / / kun gzigs rgyal dbang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen/ / 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sogs/ / gzhal dka'i bka' drin phung po bsam zhing dad/ / thub pa chen pos chos kye sgo/ / brgyad khri bzhi stong phye ba las/ / snying po'i nor ni rdo rje theg / mtha' bral phyag rgyas btab pa 'o/ / de tshul ji bzhin 'byed pa ni/ / bstan la ri mor bya ba'i las/ / mchog tu gzigs pa'i thugs bskyed mthu/ / yol med rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin/ / srid 'gro ya ngar 'phyan pa 'chel ba'i rten/ / dmus long zhi ba'i grong 'jug sa mkhan te/ / rgyal kun mdun sar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ / brjod pa don ldan ched brjod 'di bgyis so/ /228

༄/ /bstodapadonadapaldanapa'i 'gre babastanapa'isnangab/'dis mtshon rang gzhan dge tshogs bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / bstan 'dzin skyes bu mchog rnams zhabs brtan cing / / bslab gsum ngur smrig 'chang bas nor 'dzin khyab/ / 'gro kun phan bde'i dpal la spyod gyur cig/tshul khrims rnam dag nyes ltung rnyog mas dben/ /ting 'dzin rlabs 'phreng bye ba spro zhing sdud/ / shes rab gting zab rgyud sde nor bus gtams/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i chu mtsho rgyas gyur cig/bdag sogs 'gro kun rmad byung bkod pa ru/ /bde gshegs seng ge nga ros rjes bzung ste/ /legs gsung snying po'i lam bzang mngon gyur nas/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur bar shog/ces 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po la bstan pa'i snying po gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul las brtsams te bstod pa don dang ldan pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa bstan pa'i de nyid snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni 'jam mgon bla ma'i lugs bzang shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar du spel ba la rlabs po che'i thugasabaskyed kyi mthu grub pa khri chen nam mkha' bzang mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po ches gsung nan chen bos bskul ma gnang bar brten/ dpal ldan bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / nges pa don gye thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas rnam gnyis kyi bka' 'dzin la brten nas rje bla ma'i bstan pa la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i bgrang bya lnga pa skyes bdag ces pa lcags mo lug gi lo nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar mgo brtsams shing / yang khri chen mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che nyid nas dge ldan bstan pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi don kho na thugs la bzhag ste gser zangs las bsgrubs pa'i rgyal ba seng ge nga ro'i snang brnyan 229

/ /thog tshad bzhi pa gtsug lag khang dang bcas gsar bskrun gnang ba'ang lo 'dir legs par grub ste/ spron gyi zla ba'i yar tshes 'phrod spyor phun sum tshogs par spyan dbye'i cho ga bgyis pa'i tshe rten nyid kyi drung du smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mtshams sbyor dang bcas mthar phyin par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni snyigru rat+na ā nan+ta nas bgyis pa 'dis kyang rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzang dri ma med pa phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ /ṭ+wāṃdīs ni/༷ rtesdeshaṃ shrī ༷rte ༷sde rte / ༷/༷ ༷ m+mu bherte byedi/ ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ/ ṭ+wāṃ pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyes 'di ga'i ngag rtsom par du ma 'khod pa rnams rko dgos tshul thebs dang bcas te bskul ba bzhin bsgrubs pa'i tshe bris pa'o/ /230
