༄/ / 'phag pa shesarabashu'i roladuphyinapa༄nas casapa༄7/ / 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa mchan dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya pradz+nyāpā ra mi tā sañtsa ya gāthā/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor bzhi po de dag yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad pa'i phyirakhang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ston cing / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ / na mo gu ru bh+ya rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu las/ dang po lam gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed pa ni/ dga' dang gus dang dad pa'i mchog ni nyer bzhag ste/ / sgrib pa nyon mongs bsal nas dri ma las 'das pa/ / zhes pa'i rkang pa gnyis po 'di buste shrīs snod ldan nyan par bskul ba la sbyar nas sems bskyed kyi ngo bo rkang pa lhag ma gnyis kyis bstan par 'chad kyang slob dpon sh+lau ka gcig po 'dis sems skyed gtso bor bstan nas zhar la snod ldan nyan par bskul bar gsungs pas phyi ma sor bzhag go / 'gro don mngon zhugs nges pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gang la dpa' rnams spyod pa de ni mnyan par gyis/ / zhar byung rab 'byor sogs kyis sher phyin ston pa sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin par dpes bsgrubs pa ni/'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing / / me tog 'bras ldan sman dang nags tshal skyed byed pa/ / ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu 231

/ /bdag rten gnas te/ / de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthu dpal yin/ / rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang / / 'chad dang rigs pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang / / mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa/ / de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ / ci phyir zhe na rgyal bas chos tshul gang bstan pa/ / de la mi mchog slob mar gyur pas mngon bslabs shing / / mngon sum byas nas bslabs pa ji bzhin ston byed de/ / sangs rgyas mthus byed rang gi stobs kyi mthus ma yin/ / nyan thos sangs rgyas dang de yang sher phyin gyi sdoms lta bu'i sems bskyed las 'khrungs pa'am sher phyin rang dbang du ston pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur bar 'dod pas de la bslab par bya'o zhes 'bras bu'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'o/ / gnyis pa gdams ngag gi gtso bo bden pa gnyis la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag ni/ gang la shes rab pha rol phyin mchog mi dmigs shing / / byang chub sems dpa' mi dmigs byang chub sems mi dmigs/ / de skad thos nas rmongs pa med cing mi skrag pa/ / byang chub sems dpa' de ni bde gshegs shes rab spyod/ / gsum pa gdamasadon la sgom byung gi thog ma sbyor lam 'chad pa la/ ngo bo dmigs rnam rgyu gsumagyi khyad par/ 'bras bu mtshungs ldan spang rtogs kyi khyad par/ / rgyu yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen gyi khyad par gsum/ dang po la drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog bzhi las/ drod kyi dmigs pa ni/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ / bden pa'i rten can zhesapa ltar/ gzugs med tshor ba med cing 'du shes sems pa med/ /de la rnam shes rnam pa ni gnas pa ste mngon par zhen pa ni rngul tsam yod pa min/rgyu'i khyad par ni de chos kun la mi gnas gnas pa med par spyod/ / yongs su gzung med bde gshegs rnams kyi byang chub 'thob/ / rtse mo'i dmigs pa ni/ji ltar kun tu rgyu ba phreng can shes pa yis/ / dmigs med phung po rnam par 232

༄/ / 'phagasalashesarabashugayo'akhrusaphyinapabasngagapa casapa'ajig pa 'byung ba ltar/ / byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de ltar chos shes pa/ / mya ngan 'das la mi reg de ni shes rab gnas/ / rnam pa ni yang 'di shes rab 'di ni gang yin su yi yin/ / gang las yin zhes chos 'di thams cad stong par rtog / nye bar brtags nas zhum pa med cing skrag med pa/ / byang chub sems dpa' de ni byang chub nye ba yin/ / bzod pa'i dmigs pa ni/ gal te mi shes bzhin du gzugs su 'du shes shing / /tshor ba sems pa rnam shes phung por spyod byed na/ / phung 'di stong zhes cog na'ang byang chub sems dpa' ni/ / mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin/ / rnam pa ni gang zhig gzugs min tshor min 'du shes sems pa min/rnam par shes la mi spyod gnas pa med par spyod/ / de ni spyod ces bya bar mi dmigs shes rab brtan/ / skye med blo ldan burnyi shrīyo'adi nas chos mchog la sbyar ting 'dzin zhi ba mchog la reg / chos mchog gi dmigs pa byang chub sems gang de ltar 'dir bdag zhir gnas pa/ / de ni sngon gye de ba'in gshegs pas lung bstan yin/ / bdag ni mnyam par gzhag ce'am langs zhes rlom sems med/ / ci phyir zhe na chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes phyir/ / de ltar spyod na bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyod/ / des ni spyod med spyod pa yin par rab shes phyir/ / chos gang spyod pa de yang dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ / gzung rtog gnyis ni gang zhig yod pa ma yin de ni med ces bya/ /byis pa rnams kyis de brtags yod dang med par byed/ / yod dang med pa 'diganyis med pa'i chos yin te/ / 'dzin tog dang po ni byang chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'di rnam byang gzung rtog la yar yang sbyar 'byung / / gang 'dir phung po lnga dag sgyu ma 'drar shes shing / / 'dzin rtog 233

/ /gnyis pa/ sgyu ma gzhan dang phung po gzhan du mi byed la/ / sna tshogs 'du shes bral zhing nye bar zhi spyod pa/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ / yongs 'dzin ni dge ba'i bshes dang ldan zhing lhag mthong ldan gyur pa/ / rgyal ba rnams kyi yum thos skrag par yong mi 'gyur/ / de ltar yongs 'dzin gyi khyad par rjes 'gro'i sgo nas bstan te/ yang ldog 'gro'i sgo nas ston par/ gang zhig sdig pa'i grogs ldan gzhan gyi dring 'jog pa/ / de ni snod so ma btang chus reg zhig pa bzhin/ / bzhi pa theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs ston par ci phyir 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' bya zhe na / chags pa gcod byed kun/ la chags pa zad par 'dod/ / lnga pa sgrub pa'i dmigasapa 'chad par/ rgyal ba rnams kyi byang chub chags med gyur la reg/des na 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i ming thob bo/ / drug pa ched du bya ba chen po gsum ni/ ci phyir de ni sems dpa' che zhes bya zhe na/ / sems can tshogs rnams mang po'i mchog tu gyur pa dang / / sems can khams kyi lta rnams chen po gcod pa ste/ / de phyir sems dpa' chen po zhes ni rab brjod do/ / bdun pa go sgrub 'chad par gtong ba che dang blo che ba dang mthu che dang / / burnyi shrīs 'di nas 'jug sgrub byas/ rgyal ba rnams kyi theg chen mchog la zhugs pa dang / / brgyad pa 'jug sgrub 'chad par/ go cha chen po bgos shing bdud kyi sgyu 'dul ba/ / de yi phyir na sems dpa' che zhes rab tu brjod/ / dgu pa tshogs sgrub ston par/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis bzhi mdor sprul byas te/ / skye bo phal chen mgo mang bye ba gcod byed pa'i/ /gsad bya de dag ci 'dra de ltar byang chub sems/ / 'gro kun sprul 'drar rab shes de la 'jigs pa med/ / gzugs dang 'du shes tshor ba dang ni sems pa dang / / rnam par shes pa ma bcings ma grol yod pa min/ / de 234

༄/ /'phagasapa shesarab)kharaladuphyinapa༄dpa bcasapaltar byang chub la 'jug zhum pa'i sems med pa/ / 'di ni gang zag dam pa rnams kyi go cha mchog / ci phyir 'di ni byang chub theg chen bya zhe na/ / de gang zhon nas sems can thams cad mya ngan zlo/ / theg pa 'di ni mkha' 'dra gzhal med khang chen te/ / dga' skyid bde ba mngon par thob byed zeg pa'i chog / gang zhig zhon nas phyogs su 'gro ba dmigs su med/ /mya ngan 'das par 'gro bar gsungs pa 'gro mi dmigs/ / dper na me shi de yi 'gro rgyu med pa bzhin/ / rgyu des de ni mya ngan 'das zhes rab tu brjod/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi mtha' dang / / da ltar byung bar mi dmigs dus gsum dag pa ste/ / gang dag de ni 'dus ma byas yin spros med de/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ / bcupa ngesa'abyung sgrub pa ston par/ byang chub sems mkhas rig pa gang gi dus kyi tshe / skye med rnam par bsams te 'di ltar spyod byed cing / / snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can 'du shes med/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol mchog spyod pa yin/ / gal te sems can 'du shes sdug bsngal 'du shes skyed/ /'gro ba rnams kyi don bya sdug bsngal spang snyam ste/ / bdag dang sems can yongs rtog byang chub sems dpa' de/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod ma yin/ / bdag ci 'dra ba de 'drar sems can thams cad shes/ / sems can thams cad ci 'dra de 'drar chos kun shes/ / skye ba med dang skye ba gnyis gar mi rtog pa/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ / 'jig rten dag na chos ming ji snyed yongs brjod pa/ /kun la skye ba dang ni yang dag 'das spangs nas/ / ye shes 'chi med dam pa de las gzhal med thob/ / de phyir 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin ces bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig dogs med de ltar spyod/ / shes rab ldan 235

/ /de mnyam nyid gnas par shes par bya/ / chos rnams rang bzhin med par yongs su shes gyur pa/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'jug pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/ / skabayodang po'o/༈rnam mkhyen thob byed kyi thabs lam shes bshad pa la/ / lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig las/ dang po lam shes kyi rten gegs nga rgyal mngon gyur ba dang bralab sogs lam shes kyi yan lag ston par/ gang zhig gzugs la mi gnas tshor la mi gnas shing / / gang zhig 'du shes mi gnas sems par mi gnas la/ / rnam shes gang mi gnas pa chos nyid gnas pa ste/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ / gnyis pa nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ston par/ rtag dang mi rtag bde dang sdug bsngal sdug mi sdug / bdag dang bdag med de bzhin nyid dang de bzhin stong / / 'bras bu thob dang dgra bcom sa la mi gnas shing / / rang rgyal sa dang de bzhin sangs rgyas sar mi gnas/ / de'i rgyu nge4'byed cha mthun ston par/ ji ltar 'dren pa 'dus ma byas khams mi gnas shing / / de bzhin 'dus byas la yang mi gnas gnas med spyod/ / de ltar byang chub sems dpa' gnas la gnas med gnas/ / gnas med gnas yin 'di ni rgyal bas gnas par gsungs/gsum pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ston par/ gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar bya snyam dang / / rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin chos rgyal 'gyur 'dod pa/ / bzod pa 'di la ma brten thob par mi nus te/ /dper na pha rol tshu rol 'gro ngogs mi mthong bzhin/ / chos 'chad pa dang nyan dang bshad bya gang yin dang / / 'bras bu thob dang rkyen rgyal de bzhin 'jig rten mgon/ / mkhas pa gsal bas thob pa'i mya ngan 'das gang yin/de kun sgyu ma lta bur de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ / gang zag bzhi po 'di 236

༄/ /'phagasapa shesarabakres roladubyedapa༄nas casapadag de la mi skrag ste/ / rgyal sras bden la mkhas dang phyir mi ldog pa dang / / dgra bcom dri ma bsal cing som nyi spangs pa dang / / bzhi pa dgeba'i bshes kyis yongs su zin pa'o/ / de ltar rang sangayorgyas kyi lam la yangabyang chub sems mkhas par byas te goms dgos pa bstan pa'i phyir gsungs pa/byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rig de ltar spyod pa ni/ / dgra bcom sa la mi slob rkyen rtogs sa la min/ / thams cad mkhyen nyid ched du sangs rgyas chos rjes slob/ / gang zhig slob mi slob la mi slob de slob yin/ / de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun ston par/ gzugs 'phel yongs su nyams dang yongs su gzung phyir min/ / chos rnams sna tshogs yongs su gzung phyir mi slob par/ / slob cing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang yongs 'dzin la/ / nges 'byungagang yin 'di ni yon tan dga' ba'i slob/ / bzhi pa byang sems kyi mthonga'im ston par/ / gzugs ni shes rab ma yin gzugs la shes rab med/ / rnam shes 'du shes tshor dang sems pa 'di dag ni/ / shes rab ma yin 'di dag la yang shes rab med/ / 'di ni nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs te tha dad med/ / mthong lam gyi rnam pa bden bzhi 'chad par/dmigs pa sdug bden rnams kyi rang bzhin de ni pha mtha' med/ / sems can rnam4kyi phung sogs bskyed pa'i rgyu kun 'byung gi rang bzhin gang yin de yang pha mtha' med/ / nam mkha'i khams ltar sgrib pa zad pa'i 'gog bden chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin de yang pha mtha' med/ / 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i shes rab lam gyi bden pa de yang pha mtha' med/ / ces de ltar bden pa bzhi po de yang pha mtha' med pa ste bdag med pa'i rnam par mnyam pa nyid du bstan pa la/ ci'i phyir dngos po thams cad stong par smra zhe na chos thams cad ni ming du btags pa tsam du zad pas ltab phun tshogs kyi pha rol tu 'gro bar 'dod pa rnams kyisabaden par zhen 237

/pa'i 'du shes rnam par bshig ste sgom dgosaso zhes bstan pa'i phyir gsungs pa/'du shes tshu rol yin zhes 'dren pas yongs su bsgrags/ / 'du shes rnam par bshig nas spong ba pha rol 'gro / gang dag 'du shes bral ba 'di ni rjes thob pa/ / de dag pha rol phyin nas ston pa'i bka' la gnas/ / gal te ston pas kyang ni gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi/ / bskal par bzhugs te sems can zhes sgra yongs bsgrags kyang / / gzod nas dag pas sems can skye bar ga la 'gyur/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ / mthong ba'i lam bsgom pa ni de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan 'thab par 'gyur ro zhes dpe'i sgo nas ston par/ gang tshe nga ni pha rol phyin pa'i mchog 'di dang / /mthun par smra gyur de tshe sngon gyi skyes mchog gis/ / ma 'ongs pa yi dus na sangs rgyas 'gyur ro zhes/ / nga lung bstan par gyur ces rgyal ba de skad gsungs/ / brgya byin gyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ / lnga pa sgom lam gyi byed pa ni/shes rab pha rol phyin pa gang la mgon spyod pa/ / 'di ni gang zhig gus byas 'dzin dang chub byed pa/ / de la dug dang mtshon dang me dang chus mi tshugs/bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyis glags kyang rnyed mi 'gyur/ / drug pa mos pa sgom lam la gsum las dang po rang don mos pa sgom lam ston par/ la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yi/ / mchod rten rin chen bdun las byas shing mchod byed la/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten de dag gang gā yi/ / bye ma snyed kyis bye ba phrag stong zhing bkang ste/ / yongs su brtag bzung zhing rnams bye ba mtha' yas na/ / sems can ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ / las gzhan mi byed lha yi me tog spos rab dang / /byug pas dus gsum bskal pa'am de bas lhag mchod la/ / gang zhig gang las rnam 'dren stobs bcu 'byung 'gyur ba/ / bde bar gshegs kyi yum 238

༄/ /'phagasapa shesarabakhrug roladuphyinapa༄dpa casapa'adi glegs bam la bris te/ / 'chang zhing me tog byug pas bste stang byed gyur na/ / mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams de ni char mi phod/ /gnyisadon mos pa sgom lam ston par/ / rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di rig sngags che/ / sems can khams mang mya ngan sdug bsngal chos zhi byed/ / gang dag 'das dang gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon/ /rig sngags 'di bslabs sman pa'i rgyal po bla med 'gyur/ / gang dag phan dang snying brtser bcas pas spyad spyod pa/ / rig sngags 'di la bslabs nas mkhas pa byang chub reg / 'dus byas bde dang 'dus ma byas bde gang yin pa/ / bde ba de kun 'di las byung bar rig par bya/ / sa bon btab nas sa la gnas te 'byung 'gyur ba/ / tshogs pa rnyed nas rnam mang gzugs dganam par skye/ / pha rol phyin lnga byang chub yon tan ji snyed pa/ / de dag kun kyang shes rab pha rol phyin las skye/ / 'khor los sgyur rgyal lam gang nas ni rtag 'gro ba/ / lam de nyid nas rin chen bdun dang dpung tshogs kun/ / gang nas rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di 'gro / de nyid nas ni yon tan chos kun 'gro bar 'gyur/ / pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag tu med pa'i phan yon 'dzin pa dang / / mchod rten la bkur ste bya ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ / gzhan don mosapa sgom lam ston par/ rgyal bas brgya byin dri ba yongs dris lan gsol ba/ / gal te gang gā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas zhing gyur la/ /de kun rgyal ba'i ring bsrel byur bur gtams gyur kyang / / bdag ni shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di nyid len/ / ci slad ce na sku gdung mi gus bdag ma lags/ / 'on kyang shes rab yongs su bsgos pas mchod par bgyid/ /dper na rgyal po brten mi rim gro thob pa ltar/ / sangs rgyas ring bsrel shes rab pha rol phyin la brten/ / nor bu rin chen yon tan kun ldan rin 239

/thang med/ / gab tshe gang du stsal pa de ni phyag bgyi 'os/ / de phyung gyur kyang gab tshe la ni dga' bgyid de/ / yon tan de dag nor bu rin chen de yi lags/ / de bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin mchog yon tan gyis/ / rgyal ba mya ngan 'das kyang ring bsrel mchod pa brnyes/ / de ltas gang zhig rgyal ba'i yon tan 'dzin 'tshal des/ / shes rab pha rol phyin blang 'di ni thar pa lags/ / sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste/ / tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no/ / dge chos chud mi gsan phyir yongs su 'dzin pa yin/ / 'di ni chos rnams thams cad tshul gcig ston par byed/ / dper na 'dzam bu'i gling na shing rnams bye ba stong / /rnam pa sna tshogs rnam pa du ma gzugs mang ba/ / grib mar gyur pa'i grangs su brjod pa ma gtogs par/ / grib ma sna tshogs med cing bye brag yod ma yin/ / de bzhin rgyal ba'i pha rol phyin lnga 'di dag kyang / / shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i ming nyid 'thob par 'gyur/ / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid phyir yongs su bsngos byas na/ / byang chub ces bya drug po 'di kun ro gcig 'gyur/ / yon tan yongs su brjod pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ / mos pa 'di gsum gyi bcos ma'i nyeyopa spang ba ni gom pa yin par shes nas sher phyin bcos ma spang ba'i phyir rjes 'gro'i sgo nasasher phyin bcos ma'i mtshan nyid ston par/ byang chub sems dpa' gal te rab tu mi shes bzhin/ / gzugs dang 'du shes tshor dang sems pa rnam par shes/ / mi rtag yongs su ston pa bcos la spyod pa ste/ /mkhas pa nam yang chos rnams 'jig par mi byed do/ / ldog 'gro'i sgo nas sher phyin rnal mar slob tshul 'chad par/ gang la gzugs min tshor min 'du shes mi dmigs shing / / rnam par shes pa ma yin sems pa mi dmigs la/chos kun skye med stong pa'i tshul du rab shes pa/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol 240

༄/ /'phagashasashesarab podzalasaphyinapasdudapa bcasapaphyin mchog spyod pa yin/ / bdun pa sgom lam gyi phan yon ni/ de ltar mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstod pa dang bkur ste dang bsngags pa la sogs pa mdzad do zhes ston par/ la las gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na/ / sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas/ / gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bres te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ / ci phyir zhe na smra mchog de dag 'dir bslabs nas/ / chos rnams mtha' dag stong pa nyid du 'dir ston byed/ / de thos nyan thos myur du rnam par grol la regarang rgyal byang chub dang ni sangs rgyas byang chub reg/myu gu med par 'jig rten sdong 'byung yod med na/ / de la yal 'dab me tog 'bras bu ga la 'byung /byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yong med na/ / 'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung / / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gang tshe 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed/ / de tshe sems can las byed brtson pa de bzhin du/ / mkhas pa shes phyir 'jig rten byang chub sems byung na/ / ye shes kyis ni sems can yon tan chos dang ldan/ / dper na ma dros mtsho la klu bdag med gyur na/ / 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung 'bab par ga la 'gyur/ / chu klung med na me tog 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur/ / rgya mtsho la yang rin chen gzugs mang med par 'gyur/ / de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde gshegs kyi/ ye shes 'jig rten 'di dag kun tu ga la 'byung / / ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med/ / rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med par 'gyur/ / 'jig rten 'di na snang byed srog chags ji snyed pa/ / kun gyis snang bar bya phyir 'od rnams phyung ba bas/ / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gcig phyung ches mchog ste/ / snang byed tshogs kyi 'od 241

/rnams kun gyis char mi phod/ / bsod nams kyi rnam grangs kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o/stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa ltar/ rgyan du'ang bsngo ba brgyad par gsungs kyang don la 'gal ba med pas/ 'dir de las go rim ldog ste brgyad pa rjes su yi rang sgom lam ston par/ nyan thos tshogs rnams ji snyed sbyin dang tshul khrims dang / /sgom dang rab tu ldan pa'i bsod nams tshogs bskyed pa'ang / / byang chub sems dpa' rjes su yi rang sems gcig la/ / nyan thos tshogs kyi bsod namasaphung pos char mi phod/ / dgu pa bsngo ba sgom lam ston par/ 'das dus sngon gyi sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gang / / zhing mang mtha' yas bye stong dag na gang bzhugs dang / / gang yang mya ngan 'das pa'i 'jig rten mgon po rnams/ / sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir rin chen chos ston pa/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bskyed pa nas/ / rnam par 'dren parnams kyi dam chos zad kyi dus/ / de bar rgyal ba de dag bsod nams gang yin pa/ / pha rol phyin dang ldan dang sangs rgyas chos gang dang / /gang yang sangs rgyas sras rnams dang ni nyan thos dang / / slob dang mi slob dge ba zag bcas zag med pa/ / bsdus nas byang chub sems dpa' rjes su yi rang zhing / / 'gro ba'i don rgyu byang chub phyir ni thams cad bsngo/ /'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas bsngo ba khyad par du bya dgos zhes ston par/yongs bsngo gal te sems su 'du shes 'byung 'gyur zhing / / byang chub 'du shes yongs bsngo sems can 'du shes na/ / 'du shes phyir na lta gnas sems ni gsum la chags/ / dmigs pa yod pas yongs su bsngos par chud ma yin/ / 'o na ji ltar bsngo zhe na/ gal te 'di ltar chos 'di 'gags shing zad pa dang / / gang du yongs su bsngo ba de yang zad pa dang / / chos kyis chos la nam yang mi bsngo shes gyur na/ / de ltar rab tu shes pas yongs su 242

ra / /'tham ru 3ba rang6)lo bzang pabasngos pa yin/ / gzhan dag na re/ bsngo ba dag pa dang / ma dag pa zhes pa mtshan mar 'du shes med pa dang yod pas 'jog na/ mdo sde kha cig tu dmigs pa gtso bor gsungs pa ci zhe na/ de ni las dang po pa kha cig gzhug pa'i phyir yin gyi/mngon zhen gyis bcingasapa'i dge ba rnams ni gcig tu rnam par dag pa min no zhes bstan pa'i phyir gsungs pa/ gal te mtshan mar byed na de ni bsngo ma yin/ /ci ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin/ / ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba/ / dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ / bsngo ba'i don bsdu bar/ de ltas 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ba bslabakhya ste/ / ji ltar rgyal ba de dag dge ba de mkhyen pa'i/ / rnam pa gang yin 'byung gang mtshan nyid gang yin la/ / rjes su yi rang de lta de ltar yongs su bsngo/ / bsngo ba'i 'bras bu ston par de ltar bsod nams byang chub yongs su sngo byed na/ / dug med sangs rgyas mi spong rgyal bas gsungs pa smra/de ltar yongs bsngo dpa' bo 'jig rten dmigs can gyis/ / byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed thams cad zil gyis gnon/ / yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o/ / bcu pa sgrub pa sgom lam ston par dmus long dmigs bu med pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams/ / lam yang mi shes grong khyer 'jug par ga la 'gyur/shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'di/ / dmigs bu med pas byang chub reg par nus ma yin/ / gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur pa/de tshe mig rnyed gyur cing 'di yi ming thob bo/ / dper na ri mo'i las ni yongasazin mig med pa/ / ji srid mig ma bris par rngan pa mi thob bzhin/gang tshe 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dkar nag chos/ / shes rab rnam par bshig nas rdul tsam mi dmigs tshe/ / 'jig rten dag na shes rab pha rolasbyin grangs 'gro / nam mkha' gang la'ang cung zad mi gnas de dang 243

/ /'dra/ / de'i tshe chos kyi dbyingasal mngon par zhen pa'ang phyin ci log tu bstan pa'i phyir gsungasapa gal te bdag ni rgyal ba'i shes rab spyad bya zhing / / sems can sdug bsngal reg pa khrag khrig mang dgrol sems/ / sems can 'du shes yongs rtog byang chub sems dpa' de/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchogaspyod ma yin/ / de'i 'og tu rnam dag sgom lam yin kyang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogayodang / zhes sogs ltar rnam dag sgom lam de nyid skye ba dang mi skye ba'i rgyu gnyiyoshes dgos pas rgyu gnyis ston par/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig sngon spyad spyod pa'i tshe/ / pha rol phyin 'dir spyad pa mkhas pa som nyi med/ / thos ma thag tu de ni ston pa'i 'du shes skyed/desani byang chub zhi ba myur du rtogs par 'gyur/ / sngon spyod tshe na sangs rgyas khrag khrig bkur byas kyang / / rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin la ma dad na / / thos nas blo chung de yis 'di ni spong byed de/ / spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro / de gnyis kyi don bsduyote yum la dad pas slob rigs pa dpe dang bcas te gdams pa ni/ de lta bas na gal te sangs rgyas ye shes mchog / reg par 'dod na rgyal ba'i yum 'dir dad par gyis/dper na tshong pa rin chen gling du song nas ni/ / zong zad slar log lta bur gyur na mi rung ngo / / dmyal ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o/ / bcu gcig pa rnam dag sgom lam la gnyis las dang po spyir bstan pa ni/ gzugs kyi dag pa 'bras bu dag par rig par bya/ / gnyis pa khyad par du bstan pa ni/ 'bras bu gzugs dag thams cad mkhyen nyid dag par 'gyur/ / thams cad mkhyen nyid 'bras bu dag dang gzugs dag pa/ / nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs te dbyer med gcad du med/ / skabs gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar rgyu lam shes bshad zin nas lam gyi gol sa shesapa'i phyir du lam shes 244

༄/ / 'phagasapa shesarabakyisajoladuphyinapa༄dpa casaparnam par dag byed kyi gzhi shes ston pa la de mtshon byed kyi chos dgu las dang po shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang / gnyis pa snying rjes zhi la mi gnasapa'i gzhi shesaganyis ston par/ dpa' po gar spyod shes rab pha rol phyin pa yis/ /khams gsum yang dag 'das la rnam par grol ba'ang min/ / nyon mongs bsal bar gyur kyang skye ba ston par byed/ / rga dang na dang 'chi ba med kyang 'chi 'pho ston/ / zhes gsungasate 'dis ni srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis 'gog pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pa'i 'brayoyum la ring ba'i gzhi shes dang / de'i thabs la mkhas pa'i 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes te gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos gsum pa bzhi pa gnyisakyang shugs la 'phangs pa yin no/ / de nasalnga pa mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes ston par/ 'gro ba 'di dag ming dang gzugs kyi 'dam la chags/ / rlung gi 'khor lo lta bu'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khyam/ / 'gro ba 'khrul ba ri dwags rgyar chud 'drar shes nas/ / drug pa mtshan 'dzin gyi gnyen pos zin pa'i gnyen po gzhi shes ston par shes rab ldan pa mkha' la bya bzhin rnam par rgyu/ / bdun pa gzhi shes sbyor ba dang / brgyad pa spyoraba'i 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid gnyis bsdoms te 'chad par/ spyod pa yongs dag gang zhig gzugs la mi spyod cing / / rnam shes 'du shes tshor ba sems par mi spyod na/ / de ltar spyod pa chags pa thams cad yongs spong zhing / /chags las rnam grol bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyod/ / rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o/ / dgu pa mthong lam ston par/ de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba/ / chags pa bcad nas grol la chags pa med par 'gro / nyi ma sgra gcan gza' bral lhang nger 'dug pa dang / / me btang rtswa dang shing dang nags tshal sreg pa bzhin/ / skabs gsum pa'o/ /de ltar shes bya mkhyen gsum gyi rnam bzhag bshad zin nas/ nyams len sbyor bzhi'i rnam bzhag bshad pa la bzhi las/ dang po dbang du byed pa'i rgyu rnam rdzogs 245

/ /sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig gi dang po bsgom bya rnam pa'i rang bzhin gtan la 'bebs pa la/ chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin dag cing yongs dag par/byang chub sems dpa' shes rab pha rol phyin lta na/ / byed pa po yang mi dmigs chos kun mi dmigs te/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ / bstod pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o/ / zhes byung 'di skabs gsum pa'i mjug tu mthong lam la sbyar ba ni slob dpon seng bzang gi sdud 'grel dang mi mthun pasador bar bya'o/ / bu shī'i sdud 'grel dang mthun yang khas blangs mi rung ste/rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos gcig mtshang ba'i phyir/ de nyid kyi sdud 'grel du rten dang bcas pa'i spyor ba dang / / yon tan skyon ni mtshan nyid bcas/ / zhes rtsa ba'i tshig bcos ste/ sbyor ba'i rten dang por bgrangs pa'i chos bcu gcig 'dren tshul gcig bshad mod kyang / 'phags seng sogs kyi 'grel ba tshad ldan gang na'ang de 'dra mi snang zhing / rgyan gyi skabs bzhi par mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa de tsam zhig rgyas par bshad pa dang dngos su'agal bar snang ngo / / gnyis pa rnam pa de dag sgom pa'i sbyor ba bshad pa la sbyor ba sgom pa po ngos bzung ba sngon du 'gro dgos pas dang po sbyor ba'i snod ston par/ rgyal ba la ni lha rgyal brgya byin gyis zhus pa/ / byang chub sems dpa' shes rab spyod pa ji ltar brtson/ / phung po khams la rdul tsam brtson par mi byed cing / / phung por mi brtson de ni byang chub sems dpa'i brtson/ / gang zhig chos 'di sprul dang sgyu ma 'drar thos nas/ / som nyi med cing slob la phyir zhing sbyor byed pa/ / sems can de ni ring nas theg chen zhugs rig bya/ / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang la lhag byas yin/ /theg pa chen po mnyan pa sogs kyis bar chad las 'das pa'i bya ba rtogs pa'i ched du dbugs phyung ba'i tshig dpe'i sgo nas ston par/ dgon pa'i lam ni dpag tshad mang por zhugs pa'i mis/ / gnag dzi mtshams kyi nags tshal phun sum tshogs mthong na/ / 'di dag grong dang grong khyer nye ba'i rtags snyam ste/ /246

༄ / / 'tham la shes rang4)lo'abadu cas padabugs phyin rnyed par gyur cing chom rkun 'jigs pa med/ / de bzhin byang chub yongs su tshol tshe rgyal rnams kyi/ / shes rab pha rol phyin 'di mnyan pa gang thob pa/ / de ni dbugs phyin thob par gyur cing 'jigs med de/ /dgra bcom sa la ma yin rkyen rtogs sa la min/ / de ltar rten bstan nas rten pa sbyor ba'i ngo bo dpe sngon du 'gro bas ston pa ni/ mi zhig rgya mtsho'i chu ni lta phyir 'gro ba yis/ / gal te shing dang nags tshal ri mthong da dung ring / / ci ste rtags ma mthong na rgya mtsho chen po ni/ / nye bar gyur to snyam ste de la som nyi med/ / de ltar byang chub dam par rab zhugs rgyal ba yi/ / shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di nyan rig par bya/ / rnam par 'dren pas mngon sum lung bstan ma gyur kyang / / sangs rgyasabyang chub ring por mi thogs bdag reg 'gyur/ / zhes ri dang shing sogayokyi mtshan ma dang 'dra ba'i mthong spang gi rnam rtog rags pa rnams chos mchog tu mi snang ba na rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba'i mthong lam la nye bar shes pa ste sbyor ba bcu pa bar chad med pa dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba bstan to/ / de'i 'og tu lo 'dab rnying pa lta bu'i chos mchog man gye rtog pa las 'dasanas lo 'dab gsar ba lta bu'i zag med kyi chosagasar pa'i rten du gyur pa'i sbyor ba bcu gcig pa byang chub dang nye ba'i sbyor ba ston par/ dpyid dus bzang la sdong po lo ma lhags gyur na/ / yal gas ring por mi thogs lo 'bras me tog bskrun/ / shes rab pha rol phyin 'di su yi lag thob pa/ /ring bor mi thogs 'dren pa rnams kyi byang chub thob/ / bcu gnyis pa rdzogs byang myur du 'thob pa'i sbyor ba ston par dper na bud med sbrum gang sdug bsngal nyen gyur na / / de ni de yi btsa' ba'i dus la bab ces bya/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i shes rab nyan/ / dga' dang 'dun pa skyed pa myur du byang chub reg / sbyor ba 'di gsum gser phreng las de ltar dngos su sbyar zhing / bud dha shrīs gong gi spyor ba'i rten ston pa'i gzhung las/rgyal ba la ni lha rgyal brgya byin gyes zhus pa/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kho na 247

/ /rten la spyor te/ lhag ma'i dngos zin sbyor ba bcu bshad cing de yang phung po khams la zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba bkag pa'i sbyor ba bstan/lung bstan thob pa'i sbyor ba dang phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba gnyis/ gang zhig chos 'di sprul dang sgyu ma 'drar shes dang / zhes dang / som nyi med cing slob la phyir zhing sbyor byed pa/ zhes pa'i rkang pa gnyis po re re'i mthar sems can de ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis sbyar ba rim bzhin bstan/ nges par 'byung ba'i sbyor ba ni/ dgon pa'i lam ni zhes sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis bstan/ de nas gsum ni sngar bshad pa ltar dang shes rab pha rol zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis/ gang zhig 'dir spyod ces sogs rkang pa gsum gyis rim bzhin 'phel 'grib med pa'i sbyor ba dang / chos dang chos min pa mi dmigs pa'i sbyor ba dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i sbyor ba gsum bstan par byas nas/ 'di ni shes rab ces sogs rkang pa gcig sbyor ba'i yon tan la sbyor ba'i dang po bzhi dpyad dgos shing / tha ma slob dpon dang dngos su 'gal te 'og tu 'chad do/ / slob dpon gyis sbyor ba 'di gsum rim pa ltar chos longs sprul gsum thob byed la sbyar ro/ / 'phel 'grib bkag pa'i sbyor ba ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod tshe rnal 'byor pa/ / gzugs kyi 'phel ba dang ni yongs su 'grib mi mthong / / chos dang chosamin pa sogs su mi mthong ba'i sbyor ba ni gang zhig chos dang chos min chos dbyings mi mthong zhing / / mya ngan 'das la mi reg de ni shes rab gnas/ / gsum pa sbyor ba'ilon tan ston par gang zhig 'dir spyod sangs rgyas chos rnams mi rtog ste/stobs dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa byang chub zhi mi rtog/rnam par mi rtog rtog bral byen gyi rlabs kyis spyod/ / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/yonatan gzung ba yongs su brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o/ / bzhi pa sbyor ba'i skyon 248

sa / / 'phagagal shegayongabakresaḥ'abacophyinapa casalabashad pa la bsal bya'i skyon dang / sel byed kyi gnyen po gnyis dang po la dris lan gnyis las dri ba ni/ smra ba'i zla ba sangs rgyas la ni rab 'byor zhus/ / yon tan dga' ba rnams kyi bar du gcod gang lags/ / lan ni ston pas bka' stsal bar du gcod par 'gyur mang ste/ / de las re zhig cung zad tsam zhig yongs su brjod/ / de yang spyor skyon zhe drug las 'dir dngos su zin pa brgyad de spobs pa ha cang myur ba'i rlom zhing bar ma dor ldog pa'i mi brtan pa ni/ rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig 'dri tshe/ / spobs pa tha dad rnam pa du ma 'byung 'gyur zhing / / 'gro ba'i don ma byas par glog bzhin myur du yang / / yongs su nyams par 'gyur ba 'di ni bdud kyi las/ / theg chen gye sde snod las phyir phyog4shing spong ba'i rgyu mtshan 'dzin pa ste spong ba'i rgyu dngosaston par/ 'di bshad tshe na kha cig som nyi za 'gyur te/ / 'dren pas 'dir ni bdag gi ming yang yongs ma brjod/ / rigs dang sa dang rus kyang yongs su ma brjod ces/ / de ni nyan par mi 'gyur sgong 'gyur bdud kyi las/ /rgyu la mngon par zhen pa nyams pa ste ched cher 'dzin pa nyams pa ni/ de ltar mi shes dedag rtsa ba bor nas ni/ / rmongs pas yal ga dag dang 'dab ma 'tshol bar 'gyur/ / rnam pa thams cad du theg pa mchog kun tu 'dzin pa las nyams pa ni/ glang po rnyed kyang glang po'i rjes ni 'tshol ba ltar/ / shes rab pha rol phyin thos mdo 'tshol de bzhin no/ / gya nom pa'i ro 'bras bu mchog gi bde ba myong ba las nyamasapa ni/ dper na la las ro brgya ldan pa'i zas rnyed la/ /zas mchog rnyed nas zas ngan 'tshol bar byed pa ltar/ / byang chub sems dpa' pha rol phyin pa 'di rnyed nas/ / dgra bcom sa yi byang chub 'tshol byed de bzhin no/ / rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang tshigs su bcad pa'i ro myong zhing de la blta ba ni/ bste stang 'dod par 'gyur zhing rnyed pa 'dod 'gyur dang /lta dang bcas pa'i sems kyis khyim 'dris byed ldan zhing / / lam ma yin pa 249

/ /bdud kyis bstan pa'i sde snod las thabs mkhas pa 'tshol ba ni/ chos btang nas ni chos min bya ba spyod 'gyur ba/ / lam bor lam gol 'gro ba 'di ni bdud kyi las/ / nyan pa po 'dun pa che yang 'chad pa po stoms las kyis nyams pas nyan pa po yang ma dad par gyur te chos mnyan pa las ldog pa ni/ gang dag de yi tshe na 'dun cing dad gyur nas/ / chos kyi dam pa 'di ni nyan du song ba las/ /de dag gis ni chos smra bya bar ldan rig nas/ / dga' ba med cing yid mi bde bar gyur nas 'gro / bar gcod kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa'i don bsdu ba ni/de yi tshe na bdud kyi las 'di 'byung bar 'gyur/ / de tshe gang dag gis ni dge slong mang dkrugs nas/ / shes rab pha rol phyin 'di 'dzin par mi 'gyur ba'i/ / bar du gcod pa rnam mang gzhan yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ / bar chad mang ba'i rgyu mtshan dpe'i sgos bsgrub pa ni/ rin chen rin thang med pa rnyed gyur gang dag yin/ / de dag dkon la dus rnams rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang / / de bzhin rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog /rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang / / zeg pa gsar du zhugs pa'i sems can blo chung ba/ / gang zhig dkon pa'i rin chen 'di ni ma rnyed pa/ / de la bar chad bya phyir bdud ni spro bar 'gyur/ / sel byed gnyen po ni de ltar bar gcod mang yang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag yongs su 'dzin la sbyor/ / bdud kyi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o/ / ci'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyis de la dgongs bar mdzad ce na/ de nyid dpes bsgrub pa ni/ ma zhig na bar gyur la bu ni mang yod pa/ /de kun yid mi bde zhing de la rim gro byed/ / de bzhin phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi sangs rgyas kyang / / yum gyur shes rab dam pa 'di la dgongs pa mdzad/ / lnga pa sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la shes mtshan zhe drug250

༄ / / 'phag la shes rang kroḥ sdun pa bcan pakhyad mtshan bcu drug / byed mtshan bcu gcig / ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug bshad padang bzhi/ dang po la yang gsum las dang po gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sogs bcu drug ston par/ gang dag 'das dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon gang dang / / ma 'ongs dus na 'byung 'gyur de dag 'di las 'byung / / 'jig rten ston pa rgyal ba rnams kyi skyed byed yum/sems can gzhan gyi sems kyi spyod par ston par byed/ / 'jig rten de bzhin nyid dang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid/ / rang rgyal de bzhin nyid dang rgyal sras de bzhin nyid/ / gcig pa nyid de dngos bral gzhan min de bzhin nyid/ / shes rab pha rol phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen/ /lam shes kyi shes mtshan ston par/ mkhas pa 'jig rten gnas sam mya ngan 'das kyang rung / / chos nyid skyon med chos rnams stong pa 'di gnas te/byang chub sems dpas de bzhin nyid 'di rjes su togs/ / de phyir de bzhin gshegs zhes sangs rgyas mtshan gsol to/ / shes rab pha rol phyin pa dga' tshal la brten pa/ / stobs bcu rnam 'dren rnams kyi spyod yul 'di yin te/ / sems can sdug bsngal ngan song gsum las yongs 'don kyang /de dag rnams kyang sems can 'du shes 'gyur ba med/ / dper na seng ge ri sul brten nas 'jigs med par/ / ri dwags phra mo mang skrag byed cing sgra sgogs ltar/ / mi yi seng ge shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ / mu stegs can mang skrag byed 'jig rten sgra yang sgrogs/ / rnam mkhyen gye shes mtshan ston par/ dper na nam mkhar gnas pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer ni/ / sa 'di skem par byed cing gzugs kyang rab tu ston/ / de bzhin chos rgyal shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ / srid pa'i chu klung skems shing chos kyang rab tu ston/ / burtse shrīs 'di man chod khyad mtshan la sbyar yang slob dpon gyi sdud 251

/'grel du snga ma dang dkyus gcig par rnam mkhyen gyi shes mtshan du gsungs pa ni/rgyan las/ brjod dang shes mdzad mngon sum mdzad/ ceyopa dang mthun par snang ngo / / gzugs rnams mi mthong tshor ba dag kyang mi mthong zhing / / 'du shes mthong ba med la sems pa mi mthong zhing / / gang la rnam par shes dang sems yid mthong med pa/ / 'di ni chos mthong yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ / nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa/nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtag par gyis/ / de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ / 'jig rten bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o/ / de'i 'og tu khyad mtshan ston par/ mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis nibasnyad par nus ma yin/ / gang gis de ltar mthong ba de yis chos kun mthong / / rgyal po btang snyoms 'dug cing blon po kun byed ltar/ /sangs rgyas mdzad dang nyan thos chos rnams ji snyed pa/ de dag thams cad shes rab pha rol phyin pa byed/ rgyal po grong du mi 'gro yul 'khor mi 'gro bar/ rang gi yul nas 'du ba thams cad sdud pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid gang du'ang mi 'gro la/ / sangs rgyas sa yi yon tan gang yin thams cad sdud/ / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o/ / gang la bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' dad brtan yod/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog la bsam sbyor ba/ / nyan thos rang rgyal sa gnyis shin tu 'das byas nas/ / zil gyes mi non rgyal ba'i byang chub myur du 'thob/ /dperan rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru ni chag gyur la/ / mi gang ro'am rtsa 'am shing ni mi 'dzin pa/ / chu dbus 'jig par 'gyur te ngogs su phyin mi 'gyur/ / gang zhig 'dzin pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin par 'gyur/ de ltar dad ldan dang ba thob pa gang zhig ni/ / shes rab pha rol phyin yum rjes su mi 252

༄/ /'phagasapa shesarabashubartse laduphyinapa༄dpa bcasapa'ajug min/ / skye rga 'chi dang mya ngan rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yis/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho der ni rtag tu 'khor 'gyur ba/ / gang de shes rab mchog gis yongs su zin pa na/ / dngos po'i rang bzhin mkhas shing don dam ston par byed/ / de dag thabs kyi yon tan shes rab yongs zin na/ / mchog tu rmad byung bde gshegs byang chub myur du reg / dper na la las rdza so ma btang chu skyed na/ / nyam chung phyir ni myur du 'jig par rig par bya/ / so btang bum par chu skyed lam du 'jig pa yi/ / 'jigs pa med cing bde bar khyim du phyin par 'gyur/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' dad pa mang gyur kyang / / shes rab rnam par nyams na myur du ma rung 'gyur/ /dad pas shes rab de ni yongs su zin gyur na/ / sa gnyis shin tu 'das te byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ / dper na bcos legs ma byas gru ni rgya mtsho'inang / / nor dang bcas shing tshong bar bcas te 'jig par 'gyur/gru de legs par bcos legs byas dang ldan gyur na/ / mi 'jig nor dang bcas par ngogs su phyin par 'gyur/ / de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dad pas yongs bsgos kyang / / shes rab med na byang chub las ni myur nyams 'gyur/ / de nyid shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog ldan na/ / ma rmas ma nyams rgyal ba'i byang chub reg par 'gyur/ / ro brgya nyi shu lon te rgas shing sdug bsngal mi/ / langs kyang bdag nyid 'gro bar nus pa ma yin te/ / de ni g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mi yis brten byas nas/ / 'gyel ba'i 'jigs pa med cing bde blag 'gro bar 'gyur/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' shes rab stobs chung ba/ / rab tu zhugs par gyur kyang bar du nyams par 'gyur/ / de nyid thabs dang shes rab mchog gis yongs zin na/ / mi nyams de bzhin gshegs kyi byang chub reg par 'gyur/ / dpe'i le'u ste bcu 253

da / / sa stelabazhi pa'o/ / byang chub sems dpa' dang po'i las kyi sar gnas gang / /lhag pa'i bsam pas sangs rgyas byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ / slob ma bzang po bla ma gus ldan de dag gis/ / bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu brten par bya/ / ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / / de dag shes rab pha rol phyin pa rjes su ston/ / sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes/ / yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsung /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang de bzhin brtson 'grus dang / / bsam gtan shes rab byang chub yongs su bsngo bar gyis/ / byang chub phung por zhen nas mchog 'dzin ma byed tses/ / dang po'i las can de la de skad bstan par bya/ / byed mtshan ni de ltar spyod pa legs 'tsho smra ba'i zla ba rnams/ / 'gro ba'i skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang ni gnas yin te/ /rten dang blo dang gling dang yongs 'dren don 'dod pa/ / gsal byed sgron ma chos mchog smra ba mi 'khrugs yin/ / ngo bo nyid mtshan ston par grags chen ldan rnams bya dka' go cha gyon byed de/ / phung po khams dang skye mched rnams kyi go cha min/ / theg gsum 'du shes bral zhing yongs su gzung ba med/ / mi ldog g.yo ba med cing mi 'khrugs chos can yin/ / de dag 'di 'dra'i chos dang ldan zhing spros pa med/ / ze tshom som nyi yid gnyis bral zhing don dang ldan/ / shes rab pha rol phyin pa thos nas mi nur ba/ /gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog cing mi ldog rig par bya/ / 'dren pa rnams kyi chos 'di zab ste mthong bar dka'/ / sus kyang rtogs pa med cing thob par 'gyur med pa/ / de phyir phan mdzad brtser ldan byang chub brnyes nas 'di/sems can tshogs sus shes snyam thugs khral chung bar mdzad/ / sems can rnams ni gnas la dga' zhing yul rnams 'dod/ / 'dzin la gnas 254

༄/ /'phagasapa shesarabakyisaloladuphyinapasdudapa bcasapashing mi mkhas blun rmongs mun pa bzhin/ / thob par bya ba'i chos ni gnas med 'dzin med de/ / des na 'jig rten dag dang rtsod pa 'byung ba yin/lha'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o/ / nam mkha'i khams ni shar gye phyogs dang lho phyogs dang / / de bzhin nub kyi phyogs dang byang phyogs pha mtha' yas/ / steng dang 'og dang phyogs bcu ji snyed rnams na'ang yod/ / tha dad gyur pa med cing bye brag gyur pa med/ / 'das pa'i de bzhin nyid gang ma byon de bzhin nyid/ / da ltar de bzhin nyid gang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid/ / chos kun de bzhin nyid gang rgyal ba'i de bzhin nyid/ / chos kyi de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad bye brag med/ de ltar rnam rdzogasasbyor ba spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa bshad zin nas/ de'i 'og tu thar pa cha mthun nas bzung ste skye rim bshad pa la/ dang po thar pa cha mthun ni/ bde gshegs byang chub tha dad chos dang bral gyur pa/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig thob 'dod pa/ / thabs dang ldan pas shes rab pha rol phyin la sbyor/ / 'dren pa'i shes rab med na thob par 'gyur ma yin/ / bya zhig lus che dpag tshad brgya rtsa lnga bcu par/ / gyur la 'dab gshog zad de nyam rtsal yod min na/ / de yis sum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas 'dzam gling 'dir/ / bdag nyid mchongs na der ni nyam nyes 'gyur ba yin/ / rgyal ba rnams kyi pha rol phyin pa lnga 'di yang / / bskal pabye ba khrag khrig mang por bsgrubs byas shing / / smon lam mtha' yas rgya chen 'jig rten rtag bsten kyang / / thabs med shes rab bral ba nyan thos nyid du ltung / / nges 'byed cha mthun ston par sangs rgyas theg pa 'di la nges par 'byung 'dod gang / zhes gsungs te bus shrīs rkang pa gcig po 'di mtshan ma med pa'i sbyin sogs kyis nges par 'byung 'dod pa/ zhes mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs zhes pa'i don du byas nas/ thar cha la sbyar mod slob dpon gyes phyi mar sbyar ba 255

/ /ni gang zheyopa'i yig don la'ang 'brel lo/ / 'gro ba kun la sems snyoms pha ma'i 'du shes dang / / phan pa'i sems dang byams pa'i yid kyis brtul bya zhing / / tha ba med cing drang la tshig 'jam smra bar bya/ / de bzhin nyid kyi le'uste bcu drug pa'o/ / phyir mi ldog pa spyi'i mtshan nyid zhu ba ni/ 'jig rten mgon la gnas brtan rab 'byor yongs zhus pa/ / yon tan rgya mtsho nyon mongs ma mchis rtags bstan gsol/ / mthu che ba dag ji ltar slar ldog mi 'gyur ba/ / de ltar yon tan phyogs tsam rgyal bas lung bstan gsol/ /spyor lam gyi phyir mi ldog gi mtshan nyid ston par tha dad 'du shes bral zhing rigs pa ldan tshig smra/ / dge sbyong dag dang bram ze gzhan la rten mi byed/ / mkhas pas dus rnams rtag tu ngan song gsum po spangs/ / de dag dge bcu'i las kyi lam la mngon par brtson/ / zang zing med par 'gro la chos ni rjes su ston/ / chos la gcig tu dga' zhing rtag tu tshig 'jam ldan/ / 'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug par shes bzhin rab tu ldan/ / gnya' shing gang tsam lta zhing 'gro la sems 'khrul med/ / gtsang byas gtsang ma'i gos 'chang gsum po dpen zhing dag / rnyed 'dod ma yin khyu mchog rtag tu chos 'dod pa/ / bdud kyi yul las 'das shing gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog / budha shrī ltar na 'di nas mthong lam gye phyir mi ldog gi mtshan nyid bstan par bshad de/bsam gtan gyi yan lag yongs su zad ces pa dang 'grigs/ bsam gtan bzhi la bsam gtan bsam gtan der mi gnas/ / slob dpon ltar na 'di nas bstan/ grags pa 'dod pa ma yin khro bas sems dkris med/ /khyim par gyur na rtag tu dngos po kun ma chags/ / 'tsho ba'i phyir ni ya ngas longs spyod 'tshol mi byed/ / drag shul spyod sngags mi byed bud med sbyor sngags min/ / 'dod pa'i las can pho mor 'gyur zhes ston mi byed / /256

༄/ /'phagasapa shesarabakyi loladuphyinapa༄dpa casaparab tu dben pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin mchog brtson/ / 'thab dang rtsod dang bral zhing byams pa'i sems kyang brtan/ / kun mkhyen 'dod cing bstan la rtag tu gzhol sems ldan/ / mtha' 'khob kla klo skye bo'i yul mtha' rnam par spangs/ / rang gi sa la dogs med rtag tu ri rab 'dra/ /chos phyir srog kyang 'dor zhing rnal 'byor rab tu brtson/ / mi ldog rtags ni 'di dag yin par shes par bya/ / phyir mi ldog pa'i rnam pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o/ / de'i 'og tu sgom lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid ston dgos kyang /khyad par ma bzung bar khyad par can gyi blo mi skye ba'i phyir sgom pa'i lam gyi zab pa'i khyad par/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste zhes sogs dang mthun par 'dir yang /gzugs dang tshor dang 'du shes sems pa rnam shes rnams/ / zab ste rang bzhin mtshan ma med cing rab zhi ba/ / dper na mda' yis rgya mtshor gting thug 'tshol ba ltar/ / shes rab kyis ni brtags na phung po'i gting mi rnyed/ / de ltar zab pa'i sgom lam de la 'bras bu lhag pa ci zhig yod ces dri ba ni/byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de ltar zab gyur cing / / theg pa don dam chags med gang la phung po dang / / khams dang skye mched yod min chos 'di rtogs pa de'i/ / bsod nams yang dag grub pa de las ci zhig yod/ /de'i lan ston pa ni dper na 'dod chags chos la spyod pa'i skyes bu zhig /bud med dus btab de dang ma phrad de yi ni/ / nyin gcig sems kyi rnam rtogaspyod pa ji snyed pa/ / de snyed bskal par byang chub sems dpa' thob par 'gyur/ / de ltar khyad par bstan nas khyad gzhi sgom lam 'chad pa la/ rnam rtog dgu'i gnyen po sgom lam dgu yod kyang 'dir gsum du bsdus te dang po sgom lam chung du ston par/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig bskal mang bye stong du/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal sbyin byed tshul khrims srung byed kyang / / gang gis shes 257

/ /rab pha rol phyin mchog ldan pa'i chos/ / brjod pa'i legs la sbyin dang tshul khrims char mi phod/ sgom lam 'bring bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig shes rab mchog bsgoms te/ / de las langs nas gos pa med pa'i chos brjod cing / / de yang 'gro ba'i don du byang chub rgyur bsngo na/dge ba de dang mnyam pa 'jig rten gsum na med/ / sgom lam chen po ston par/ bsod nams de yang gsog dang de bzhin stong pa dang / / gsob dang ya ma brla dang snying po med shes par/ / de ltar bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyad spyod na/ / spyod tshe bsod nams dpag tu med pa yongs su 'dzin/ / rgyan las/ dngos po brjod du med pa la/ / nyams pa dang ni 'phel mi rung / zhes pa ltar chos thams cad kyi dbyings su rang bzhin med par mnyam pa'i phyir/ spang bya zad pa dang gnyen po skye ba med pas na rgyal sras rnams kyi rtogs pa mchog dman gyi rim pa'ang mi rigs so snyam pa'i dogs pa bsu bar/ sangs rgyas kyis bshad rab tu sbyar zhing rab bstan pa'i/ / chos 'di thams cad brjod pa tsam du zad shes na/ / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang por brjod byas kyang /chos kyi dbyings la zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/ / de la don dam par 'phel 'grib med par bsgrub na kho bo cag 'dod pa kho na yin pas grub zin sgrub par 'gyur la/ tha snyad du ni 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams rtag pa med pa'i phyir 'phel 'grib kyang sgyu ma tsam du rung bo zhes lan ston par/ rgyal ba rnams kyi pha rol phyin ces bya ba gang / / chos de rnams kyang ming tsam du ni yongs su bsgrags/ /yongs bsngo rlom sems med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni / / nyams pa med cing sangs rgyas byang chub mchog reg 'gyur/ / stong pa nyid kyi le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o/ / kho na re/ kun rdzob tu yang rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba'i byang chub pa mi rigs te/ snga phyir byung ba'i sems can re res kyang nus pa med pa'i phyir min la/sems can rnams ni rnam par shes pa'i rgyun re re ba zhes gsungs pa'i phyir gcig char 258

༄/ /'phagasapa shesarab(tshomadzaladuphyinapachedapa bcasapa'abyung ba mang pos kyang min zhing / snga phyir 'byung ba mang pos kyang min te de dag nang phan tshun 'brel ba med pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtsod pa khong nas bsus te de'i lan dpe'i sgo nas ston par/ 'bru mar snying po 'bar ba phrad pa dang po yis/ / snying po tshig min de med par yang de mi 'tshig / me lce phrad pa tha mas snying po tshig min la/ / me lce tha ma med par snying po tshig min ltar/ / dpe bstan pa de nyid skabs kyi don byang chub pa'i tshul dang sbyar ba ni/ dang po'i sems kyis byang chub mchog reg ma yin la/ / de med par yang de la reg par nus ma yin/ / tha ma'i sems kyis byang chub zhi ba thob min la/ / de med par yang de thob nus pa ma yin no/ / byang chub kyi lam skad cig snga phyi tshogs pa byang chub kyi rgyu yin pa spyir bstan nas/ da ni khyad par du byang chub kyi lam skad cig ma dang po yang sa bon 'dra bar gtso bo'i rgyu yin no zhes bstan pa'i phyir gsungs pa/ sa bon las ni myu gu me tog 'bras bu 'byung / / de yang 'gags la shing yang med pa de min ltar/ / de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub rgyu yin te/ de yang 'gags la byang chub med pa de ma yin/ / skad cig ma gnyis pa yang rgyu yin par ston pa la/ sa bon rnyed nas 'bru dang sā lu la sogs 'byung / / de yi 'bras bu de la yod min med pa'ang min/ / rgyal ba rnams kyi byang chub 'di ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ / dngos po'i rang bzhin bral bas sgyu ma 'byung bar 'gyur/ / byang chub pa'i tshul rgyas par bstan nas don bsdu bar/ chu yi thigs pas bum pa dang po tha ma'i bar/ / rim gyis nyung ngu nyung ngus de yongs 'gengs pa ltar/ / de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub mchog rgyu ste/ / rim gyis dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ / de ltar zhar byung 'phros don dang bcas pa rgyas par bstan nas/ skabs don dkyus ma sgom pa'i lam la gnas pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid dngos ston par/ stong pa mtshan med smon pa med par chos spyod cing / / mya ngan 'das la mi reg 2 da9

/mtshan mar mi spyod pa/ / dper na mnyan pa mkhas pa phar 'gro tshur 'gro yang / / mtha' gnyis mi gnas rgya mtshor gnas pa med pa bzhin/ / slob dpon ltar na 'di nasasrid zhi mnyam nyid kyi spror ba bstan zhing / burnyi shrīs tshigs bcad snga ma dang sbrel nasabashad pa 'di'i thad kyi brgyad stong pa'i tshig zin la 'grig snang / de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam bdag / stobs bcus lung bstan byang chub reg 'gyur rlom sems med/ / 'di la ci yang med ces byang chub skrag pa med/ / de ltar spyod pa bde gshegs shes rab spyod pa yin/ / zhing dag spyor ba ni/ 'jig rten dgon pa'i lam dang chu ge'i nad bcas par/ / mthong nas skrag pa med cing de nas go gyon te/ / phyi ma'i mu mthar rtag tu brtson zhing rab shes nas/ / yongs su skyo ba'i yid ni rdul tsam skyed mi byed/ / gaṅgā'i lha mo'i le'u ste bcu dgu ba'o/ / thabs mkhas sbyor ba bshad pa la mkhas bya'i yul ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i shes rab spyod byed la/ / phung po 'di dag gdod nas stong zhing skye med shes/ /mnyam par ma bzhag sems can khams la snying rje 'jug / bar skabs der yang sangs rgyas chos las yongs mi nyams/ / thabayomakhas dngos la bcu yod pas/ bar chad kyi chos las 'das pa'i thabs mkhasasbyor ba ni/ dper na skyes bu mkhas pa yon tan kun ldan zhing / / stobs ldan mi thub brtson byas sgyu rtsal cho ga shes/ / 'phong dang bzo gnas mang po'i pha rol phyin gyur cing /sgyu ma sgrub shes 'gro don rab tu 'dod pa zhig / pha dang ma dang chung mar bcas pa yongs bsdus nas/ / dgra byed mang ba dgon pa'i lam du phyin pa dang / / de yis dpa' zhing rtul phod skyes bu mang sprul te/ / bde bar song zhing slar yang khyim du 'ong ba ltar/ / de bzhin de tshe byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa yang / / sems can khams rnams kun tu snying rje che skyed cing / /260

༄ / /'phag la theb rab krola'abaco cas pabadud bzhi dag dang sa gnyis las kyang rab 'das nas/ / ting 'dzin mchog la gnas shing byang chub reg mi byed/ / mi gnas pa'i thabs mkhas spyor ba ni/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten/ / de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten/ / sems can las la spyod pa'i rgyu ni de 'dra ste/nam mkha' gang la gnas yin don 'di bsam par gyis/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid gnas pa/ / 'gro la sems can shes pa'i smon lam rten can gyis/ / bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs du ma ston byed cing / /mya ngan 'das la mi reg stong par gnas pa med/ / smon lam gye shugs kyis 'phang ba'i de ni/ gang gi tshe na byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba/ /stong pa zhi ba'i ting 'dzin dam pa 'di spyod pa/ / bar skabs der ni mtshan ma rab tu sgom mi byed/ / mtshan ma med par gnas shing zhi la rab zhi spyod/thun mong ma yin pa'i de ni/ bar snang 'phur ba'i bya la gnas yod ma yin te/de na gnas pa ma yin sa la ltung mi 'gyur/ / de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnam thar sgor spyod pa/ / mya ngan 'das la mi reg mtshan mar spyod ma yin/'di nas ma chags pa'i de bstan par slob dpon gyis gsungs la/ burnyi shrīs/dperan 'phong bslab ces sogs smon lam gyi shugs ci bzhin pa'i thabs mkhas la sbyar ba brgyad stong 'grel chen dang mthun pas/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa'ang gnyis gar gnas sam dpyad/ dper na 'phong bslabs skyes bus gnam du mda' 'phangs te/ / mda' gzhan dag ni phyi bzhin rgyud mar ltong btags nas/snga ma'i mnga' de sa la ltung ba'i skabs mi rnyed/ / mi de 'dod na mda' de sa la ltung bar 'gyur/ / de ltar shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog spyod pa/ /shes rab thabs stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis ni rnam dpyod pa/ / de dag dge ba'i rtsab ji srid ma rdzogs par/ / de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni thob mi byed/261

/mi dmigs pa'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba ni/ dper na dge slong rdzu 'phrul stobs mchog ldan pa zhig / nam mkhar gnas te cig car cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul/ / 'gro dang 'chag pa dang ni nyal dang 'dug pa ston/ / de ni skyo ba med cing de la dub pa med/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa stong gnas shing / / ye shes rdzu 'phrul pha rol son la gnas pa med/ / 'gro ba dag la bya ba rnam pa mtha' yas ston/ / bskal pa bye bar skyo ba med cing dub pa med/ / mtshan ma med pa'i de ni/ dper na mi 'ga' g.yang sa chen por 'dug byed cing / / lag pa gnyis gas gdugs gnyis 'dzin cing nam mkha' la/ / mchong bar byed cing g.yang sa chen por lus bor nas/ /ltung bar mi 'gyur ji srid der ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa snyeng rjer gnas/ / thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi gdugs ni yongs bzung ste/ / chos rnams stong pa mtshan med smon pa med rtog cing / / mya ngan 'das la reg pa med la chos kyang mthong / / smon pa med pa'i de ni/ dper na rin chen 'dod pa rin chen gling song ste/ / rin chen rnyed nas phyir yang khyim du 'ong 'gyur ba/ / der ni ded dpon 'ba' zhig bde bar 'tsho byed cing / / gnyen bshes tshogs yid mi bder 'jog pa min pa ltar/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' stong nyid rin chen gyi/gling du song steng bsam gtan dbang po stobs thob pa/ / mya ngan 'das la reg pa 'ba' zhig mngon dga' zhing / / sems can sdug bsngal yid du 'jog par 'gyur ma yin/ / phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi thabs mkhas sbyor ba ni/dper na don gnyer tshong ba rgyus shes bya ba'i phyir/ / bar gyi grong khyer grong rdal grong gang yin par 'gro/ / der yang mi gnas rin chen gling du'ang mi gnas la/ / rig pa khyim du mi gnas lam la mkhas par 'gyur/ / de 262

༄/ / 'phagasapa shesarabakyipharoladubyedapacadapa casapabazhinabyang chub sems dpa' gsal de nyan thos dang / / rang rgyal rnams kyi shes pa rnam grol kun la mkhas/ / de la mi gnas sangs rgyas ye shes gnas ma yin/ / 'dus ma byas la mi gnas lam gyi tshul shes yin/ / tshad med pa'i thabs mkhasaspyor ba ni/ gang tshe 'gro la byams pa rjes su 'brel byas nas/ / ting 'dzin stong pa mtshan med smon pa med spyod pa/ / de ni mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur zhe 'am/ / 'dus byas yin par gdags nus de ni gnas med do/ / dper na sprul pa'i mi lus mi snang ma yin zhing / / de ni ming gis kyang ni gdags par nus pa ltar/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' rnam thar sgor spyod pa/ / de ni ming gis kyang ni gdags par nus pa yin/ / gal te spyod pa dang ni dbang po yongs dris la/ / byang chub sems dpa' stong pa mtshan ma med pa'i chos/ / yongs su mi ston phyir mi ldog pa sa yi chos/ / mi 'chad de ni lung ma bstan pa yin rig bya/ skabs bzhi pa'o/dbang du bya ba'i 'bras bu rtse sbyor mtshon byed chos brgyad las/ / dang po rmi lam na yang 'khor ba la yid 'byung zhing chos rnams rmi lam lta bur lta ba dang bden tshig gis 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshe zhi ba sogs rtags bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i drod rtse sbyor ston par/drag bcom sa dang rkyen gyi sangs rgyas ye shes dang / / khams gsum dag na rmi lam na yang mi 'dod cing / / sangs rgyas rnams mthong 'gro la chos kyang ston byed pa/ de ni mi ldog lung bstan yin par rig par bya/ / rmi lam na ni sems can ngan song gsum gnas mthong / / skad cig de la ngan song rgyun gcod smon lam 'debs/ / bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis me yi phung po zhi/ de ni mi ldog lung bstan yin par rig par bya/ / mi yi 'jig rten 'byung po'i gdon dang nad mang ba/ / phan dang snying brtser ldan pa'i bden pa'i byen gyis zhi/ / 'on kyang rlom sems med cing nga rgyal skye med pa/ de 263

/ /ni mi ldog lung bstan yin par rig par bya/ / thab4mkhas pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o/ /lung bstan thob par rlom na bdud las 'jug tshul ni/ ci ste de ni bden pa'i byin rlabs sna tshogs dag / 'byor pas bdag lung bstan snyam rlom sems 'byung ba 'am/ / gal te byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyi lung bstan rlom/ / rlom sems gnas pa de ni blo chung shes par bya/ / ming gi gzhi las bdud ni nye bar 'ongs gyur nas/ / 'di skad smras te 'di ni khyod dang pha ma dang / / khyod kyi bdun mes brgyud kyi bar gyi ming yin zhing / / gang tshe khyod ni sangs rgyas 'gyur ba'i ming 'di yin/ / sbyangs sdom rnal 'byor ldan pa ci 'dra 'byung 'gyur la/ / khyod sngon yon tan tshul yang 'di 'dra'o zhes brjod de/ / de skad gang thos rlom sems byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /bdud kyis yongs su bslang zhing blo chung rig par bya/ / dben par sgrub pa byas kyang deyorlom na bdud 'jug tshul ni/ rab tu bden pa'i grong dang grong khyer ri sul dang / / dgon pa dben pa'i nags khrod rab tu sten byed cing /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ / bdud kyis yongs su bslang zhing blo chung rig par bya/ / byang sems kyis dben pa dngos bzung ste de ma byung na don med pa'i dpe dang / de byung na snang tshod kyi sgo nas brnyas mi rung tshul sogs ston par/ rtag tu grong dang yul 'khor grong rdal gnas byed cing / / sems can smin byed byang chub brtson pa ma gtogs pa/ de ni dgra bcom rang rgyal 'dod pa gzhar mi skyed/ / 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i sras kyi dben par gsungs/ / gang zhig dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa'i ri yi sul/ / sgrul gyis gang bar lo mang bye bar gnas byed kyang / / dben pa 'di mi shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de/ / lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnyed nas 'dre bar gnas pa yin/ / byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don brtson 264

༄/ / 'phagasapa shesarabakyisaloladuphyinapasdudapa bcasapabasam gtan dang / / stobs dang dbang po rnam thar ting 'dzin thob de la/'di ni dgon dben spyod pa min snyam brnyas byed pa/ / de ni bdud kyi spyod yul gnas zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ / gang zhig grong dam 'on te dgon par gnas kyang rung / / zeg pa gnyis kyi sems bral byang chub mchog nges na/'di ni 'gro don zhugs pa rnams kyi dben pa ste/ / byang chub sems dpa' drod stom de ni bdag nyid nyams/ / bdud las kyi le'u ste nyer gcig pa'o/ /nyes pa de lta bu mi 'byung ba'ang bshes gnyen bsten pa la rag las pas/ de lta bas nakhyang chub dam pa 'tshol ba yi/ / bsam pa drag ldan mkhas pas nga rgyal nges bcom ste/ / nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa bsten pa ltar/ /g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ / sangs rgyas byang chub mchog zhugs byang chub sems dpa' dag / pha rol phyin dang bcas te dge ba'i bshes su bsten/ / de dag rjes su ston byed 'di ni bsgrub pa'i sa/ / rgyu rnam gnyis kyis sangs rgyas byang chub myur du rtogs/ / rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcu gang bzhugs pa/ / kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ / pha rol phyin 'di byang chub mchog la zhugs rnams kyi/ / gsal dang sgron dang snang dang ston mchog yin zhes bshad/de brgyad stong pa las/ pha rol du phyin pa drug po 'di nyid ston pa'o/ / pha ro' tu phyin pa drug ni lam mo/ / pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni snang ba'o/ / pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni sgon ma'o/ / pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni 'od do/ / pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni skyob pa'o/ / skyabs so/ / gnas so/ zhes sogs mang ste mdor bsdus na sangs rgyas thob pa la phyin drug rjes su ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang / rang gis de sgrub pa'i sa'amaspyod pa ste rgyu gnyis med mi rung yin zhing / de tshang na rtags thob kyang mngon zhen mi skye ba dang skyon yon thams cad rtog pas btags pa tsam gyis 'byung tshul sogs 265

/ston par/ ji ltar shes rab pha rol phyin pa mtshan nyid stong / / chos 'di thams cad mtshan nyid de dang 'drar shes shing / / chos rnams stong zhing mtshan ma med par rab shes na/ / de ltar spyod pa bde gshegs shes rab spyod pa yin/ / sems can yongs su rtog pas zas la 'dod byed cing / /'khor bar chags pa'i yid dang ldan rnams rtag tu 'khor/ / bdag dang bdag gi chos gnyis yang dag min stong ste/ / byis pa bdag nyid kyis ni mkha' la mdud pa bor/ / dper na dogs pa'i 'du shes kyis ni dug langs pa/ dug de khong du song ba med kyang brgyal bar 'gyur/ / de bzhin byis pa bdag dang bdag gir khas len pa/ / bdag der 'du shes yang dag min rtog skye zhing 'jig / ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan/ / bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par byang bar gsungs/ / 'di la gang yang nyon mongs rnam dag 'gyur med par/ /byang chub sems dpas shes rab pha rol phyin pa rtogs/ / rtse mo'i rtse sbyor rnam 'phelabacu drug gis mtshon pa'i dang po 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo snyed kyi sangs rgyas mchod las lhag pa'i bsod nams thob pa'i rnam 'phel ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling na sems can ji snyed ma lus pa/ / de dag thams cad byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ / lo stong bye ba mang por sbyin pa byin byas pa/ / kun kyang 'gro ba'i don phyir byang chub rgyur bsngo yang / / gang zhig shes rab pha rol phyin la mngon brtson pa/ / tha na nyi ma gcig cig rjes su mthun byed na/de la sbyin pa'i phung pos bsod nams char mi phod/ / de phyir g.yel med rtag tu shes rab 'jug par bya/ / thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i nam 'phel ni/shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ / snying rje chen po skyed cing sems can 'du shes med/ / de tshe mkhas pa 'gro ba kun gyi sbyin gnas 266

༄/ / 'phagasapa shesarab)tsongaladuphyinapa༄dpa bcasapa'agyur/ / rtag tu yul 'khor bsod stoms don yod yongs su spyod/ / zung 'brel gye lam de la 'bad dgos tshul dpe dang bcas pa ni/ tabyang chub sems dpa' gang 'dir yun ring 'brel ba yi/ / lha mi ngan song gsum gyi sems can dgrol ba'i phyir/ / lam yangs pha rol sems can khams la ston 'dod pa/ / nyin mtshan shes rab pha rol phyin la brtson par bya/ / mi zhig sngon chad ma rnyed pa yi rin chen mchog / dus gzhan zhig na rnyed par gyur rte dga' ba las/ / rnyed ma thag tu bag med gyur te stor na ni/ / stor pas rin chen mngon 'dod rtag tu sdug bsngal lo/ / de ltar byang chub mchog zhugs rin chen lta bu yi/ / shes rab pha rol phyin la rnal 'byor dor mi bya/rin chen rnyed nas blangs te rab tu brtson dkris nas/ / myur du 'gro bar byed pa zhi bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi le'u ste nyer gnyis pa'o/ / des mi mthun phyogs zil gyis gnon tshul ni/ nyi ma sprin dang bral ba'i 'od zer dra ba can/ / mun nag thibs po'i mun pa thams cad 'joms 'char pa/ / srin bu me khyer srog chags 'byung po thams cad dang / / skar ma'i tshogs dang zla ba'i 'od kun zil gyes gnon/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' shes rab pha rol phyin/ / mchog spyod stong pa dang ni mtshan ma med spyod pa/ / mkhas pas lta ba'i thibs po bcom nas 'gro kun dang / / dgra bcom rang rgyal byang chub sems mang zil gyis gnon/ / gzhan smin par byed ༅ ni/ dper na rgyal po'i bu zhig nor gtong don 'dod pa/ / kun gyi gtso bor gyur te mngon par 'gro bya 'os/'di ni da lta na yang sems can mang dag 'byed/ / thabs thob gyur te rgyal srid gnas na smos ci dgos/ / de ltar shes rab spyod khams byang chub sems dpa' yang / / bdud rtsi sbyin par byed cing lha dang mi rnams dga'/ nya67

/ /'di ni da lta na yang sems can mang phan brtson/ / chos kyi rgyal por gnas par gyur na smos ci dgos/ / brgya byin gyi le'u ste nyer gsum pa'o/ / mdor bsdus pa'i dbang gis don tshan tshang ba mi 'byung yang gzhan smin par byed pa 'di lha'i ris thams cad nye bar 'ongs pa'i rnam 'phel la sbyar na/ bdud thams cad zil gyisaganon pa'i rnam 'phel ni/ de yi tshe na bdud ni zug rngu ldan par 'gyur/mya ngan nyam thag sdug bsngal yid mi bde nyam chung / / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'di yid nur 'gyur zhes/ / 'jigs pa bstan phyir phyogs rnamasasreg cing skar mda' gtong / / gang tshe mkhas pa de dag bsam pa rab ldan zhing / / nyin mtshan shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog don lta/ / de tshe lus sems dag ni mkha' 'gro bya ltar rgyu/ / nag po'i rtsa lag rnams kyis glags rnyed ga la 'gyur/ / rang gi spyod par skyon zhugs na bdud kyis blags rnyed tshul ni/ gang tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'thab dang rtsod gyur cing / / phan tshun mi mthun khros pa'i sems dang ldan gyur pa/ / de tshe bdud ni mchog tu dga' zhing nyams bder 'gyur/ / de gnyis rgyal ba'i ye shes las ni ring 'gyur snyam/ / de gnyis ring du 'gyur zhing sha za 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gnyis ka rang gi dam bcas nyams par byed par 'gyur/ / sdang zhing bzod dang bral la byang chub ga la yod/ / de tshe bdud rnams phyogs dang bcas te dga' bar 'gyur/ / lung bstan ma thob byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig gis/ / lung bstan thob la sems khros rtsod pa rtsom byed na/ / thab skyon ldan sems kyi skad cig ji snyed pa/ / de snyed bskal par gzhi nas go cha bgo dgos so/ / des na bzod pa bsten dgos tshul ni/ sangs rgyas bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pas byang chub reg / sems 'di bzang ba min snyam dran pa skyed byed cing / / so sor 'chags par byed cing phyis kyang sdom byed la/ /268

༄/ / 'phag pa shesarabakyi roladudaga' bar mi byed de ni sangs rgyas chos 'dir slob/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi le'u ste nyer bzhi pa'o/ / chos nyid rtogs pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab kyi bslab pa sogs nang gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam 'phel ston par/ gang zhig slob tshe bslab pa gang yang khas mi len/ / slob pa po dang bslab pa'i chos rnams mi dmigs shing / / bslab dang bslab pa ma yin 'di gnyis mi rtog pa/ / de ltar gang slob de ni sangs rgyas chos 'dir slob/ / byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de lta'i bslab 'di shes/ / de ni gzhar yang bslab nyams tshul khrims 'chal mi 'gyur/ / zhes sangs rgyas kyi rigs su 'gyur ba dang / de ni sangs rgyas chos brnyes bya phyir 'di la slob/ / ces sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / de ni bslab lhag bslab la mkhas te dmigs pa med/ / ces dang / mkhas pa 'od byed rnams kyi shes rab de ltar slob/ /dgeb ma yin sems gcig tsam yang skyed mi byed/ / nyi ma mkha' la 'gro ba'i zer gyis zil gnon pa'i/ / mdun gyi bar snang la ni mun pa mi gnas bzhin/ / zhes bden 'dzin kun btags pa mngon gyur shugs drag mi skye ba dang /mi mthun phyogs ser sna sogs mi skye ba'i rnam 'phel bstan la/ sher phyin gyi nang du phar phyin thams cad bsdus nas nyamasasu len tshul shes pa'i rnam 'phel dpe dang bcas te ston par/ shes rab pha rol phyin la bslab pa byas rnams kyi/ / pha rol phyin pa thams cad 'dir ni 'dus par 'gyur/ / 'jig tshogs lta bar lta ba drug cu gnyis 'dus ltar/ / de bzhin pha rol phyin pa 'di dag 'dus par gsungs/ / dper na srog gi dbang po 'gags na dbang po gzhan/gang dag ji snyed yod pa thams cad 'gag par 'gyur/ / de ltar shes rab spyod pa mkhas pa mchog rnams kyi/ / pha rol phyin pa thams cad 'dir ni 'dus par gsungs/ / 'di man burto shrīs brtan pa la sbyar bar/ brgyad 269

/ /stong par/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des gang ma bslab pa'i phun sum tshogs pa de dag ngas ma mthong ngo / / zhes pa nas/gnas par ni mi byed de bdag gis nyan thos kyi yon tan 'di ni bshad par bya'o/ / zhes slob bo/ zhes rnam 'phel bco lnga pa 'di le'u nyer lnga pa'i mjug tu yod pa bzhin/ slob dpon gyis rnam 'phel la sbyar ba legs pas/byang chub sems mkhas nyan thos yon tan gang dag dang / / de bzhin rang rgyal yon tan kun la slob byed cing / / de dag de la mi gnas 'dod pa mi skyed de/ / 'di ni bdag gis bslab bya yin snyam de phyir slob/ / bslab pa'i le'u ste nyer lnga pa'o/ / burto shrīs 'di man sems kun tu gnas pa la sbyar ba/glingabazhi pa dang stong dag dang / zhes pa dang 'grig kyang / brgyad stong par le'u nyer drug pa'i mgo brtan pa nas bzung ba dang mi 'grig go/ le'u mtshams dang tshig ris gnyis gar bstun dgos na / brgyad stong par snga ma brgya byin yi rang tshul dang /phyi ma stong gsum sogs kyi dpes bstan pa ltar/ rkang pa gnyis re so sor sbyar kyang rung ngam snyam yang / 'dir slob dpon gyi dgongs pa ltar brtan pa ni/ mi ldog byang chub mchog la rab tu zhugs pa yi/ / sems bskyed pa la bsam pa thag pas yi rang ba/ / stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal bas tshad bzung rung / / rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min/ / sems kun tu gnas pa ni/dge ba don gnyer phan 'dod sems can ji snyed pa/ / kun gyi bsod nams phung po la yang yi rang 'gyur/ / de phyir de dag rgyal ba'i yon tan thob gyur nas/ / sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'jig rten chos sbyin byed/'dis yi rang gi yul nam mkha' dang mnyam pas/ stong gsum gyi bsod nams las lhag pa'i rgyu mtshan du 'gro ste/ rtsa ba gzhan phan lhag bsam gye mthu yin la/ phan 'dod ces pa 'dir 'grel pa gnyis gar thar 'dod ces 'bru mnan 'dug pas dpyad 270

༄/ /'phagasapa shesarabakhrung roladubyedapaskudapa bcasapadagos/ de nas mthong lam rtse sbyor la spang bya 'jug pa gzung rtog ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig mi rtog chos rnams kun/ / stong dang mtshan ma med dang spros med yongs shes pa/ / de ni shes rab gnyis kyis byang chub 'tshol mibyed/ / rnal 'byor pa de shes rab pha rol phyin mchog brtson/ / nam mkha'i khams de dang ni nam mkha' der 'gal ba/ / yod pa ma yin gang gis kyang ni de ma thob/ / de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / / nam mkha' lta bu yin te nye bar zhi ba spyod/ / skyes bu rdzas su yod pa'i rten can 'dzin rtog dang po ni / skye bo'i dbus na sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di snyam du/ / skye bo 'di mgu bya snyam mi sems de yang byed/ / rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs rab tu ston par byed mthong yang / / de la lus med sems med ming yang yod ma yin/ / de bzhin shes rab spyod pa nam yang 'di snyam du/ /byang chub rtogs nas 'gro ba yongs su dgrol mi sems/ / skye ba sna tshogs dang ni bya ba mang ldan pa/ / sgyu ma lta bur ston kyang rnam par mi rtog spyod/ / skyes bu btags par yod pa'i rten can 'dzin rtog gnyis pa ni/ dper na sangs rgyas sprul pa sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed/ / byed pa de la dregs pa cung zad skye mi 'gyur/ / de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / / sprul pa sgyu ma bzhin du bya ba thams cad ston/ / shing mkhan bzo bo mkhas pas skyes pa bud med dang / / 'dra ba'i bzo byas de yang bya ba thams cad byed/ / de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / / rnam par mi rtog ye shes bya ba thams cad byed/ / sgyu ma'i le'u ste nyer drug pa'o/ / de ltar spang bya rtog pa bzhi spangs pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstod cing bdud bzhis mi thub tshul ston par/ de ltar spyod mkhas rnams la lha tshogs mang po dag / thal mo sbyar ba btud nas phyag kyang 'tshal bar byed/ /27/

/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed pa'ang / / yon tan bsngags pa'i phreng ba yongs su brjod pa mdzad/ / gang gā'i klung mnyam zhing na sems can ji snyed pa/ / de kun yongs su brtag pa bzung ste bdud gyur la/ / ba spu nyag re las kyang de snyed sprul byas kyang / / de dag kun gyis mkhas la bar chad bya mi nus/ / rgyu rnam bzhi yis byang chub sems dpa' mkhas stobs ldan/ / bdud bzhis thub par dka' zhing bskyod par mi nus te/ / stong par gnas dang sems can yongs su mi gtong dang / / ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin rlabs can/ / rtog pa de bzhi'i gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi rgyu byang chub kyi lam gzhan la ston pa dang sher phyin gyi tshig don gtod pa dang bar chad med pa'i rgyu rang nyid sgrub pa la brtson pa gsum ston par/ de bzhin gshegs yum shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di/ / 'chad tshe byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig mos byed cing / / bsam pa thag pas sgrub par mngon par brtson byed na/ / nges pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la zhugs rig bya/ / mthong rtse bsdus pa'i byang chub chen pos dri ma zad par byed kyang don dam par zad pa dang skye ba med pas gnas pa med par gnas tshul ni/ chos dbyengs de bzhin nyid la gnas pa mi 'gyur zhing / / dper na bar snang sprin bzhin gnas pa med par gnas/ / rig sngags 'chang ba gnas med mkha' rgyu gnas 'dod pa/ / sngags mthus dus min me tog ldan zhing byin gyes rlob/ / de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba/ /togs par byed dang sangs rgyas chos rnams dmigs mi 'gyur/ / 'chad par byed dang chos 'dod lta bar byed mi dmigs/ / 'di ni zhi 'dod yon tan dga' ba'i gnas pa yin/ / de'i phyir nyan rang sogs las gnas tshul khyad par che ba ni/ dgra bcom rnam thar de bzhin gshegs kyi ma gtogs 272

sa / / 'pha khal shes rabakresang bsdudapa bcas papar/ / gnas pa 'di ni nyan thos rang rgyal bcas pa yi/ / gnas pa zhi ba'i ting 'dzin rab zhi bde ldan pa/ / ji snyed kun gyi mchog dang gong na med pa yin/ / 'dab chags mkha' la gnas kyang ltung bar 'gyur ma yin/nya ni chu la gnas kyang 'tshubs te 'chi ba med/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan stobs dag gis/ / pha rol son pa stong gnas mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ / des na sku gsum gyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pas sher phyin la slob dgos pa'i tshul/ sems can kun gyi yon tan mchog tu 'gro ba dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog tu rmad byung mchog reg dang / / chos kyi sbyin pa rab mchog dam pa sbyin 'dod gang / / phan mdzad rnams kyi gnas mchog 'di la bsten par gyis/ / snying po'i le'u ste nyer bdun pa'o/ / byang chub chen porang gi ngo bo ni/ bslab pa 'di ni 'dren pa'i bslab pa yongs brjod pa/bslab pa ji snyed kun gyi mchog dang gong na med/ / mkhas pa gang zhig bslab kun pha rol 'gro 'dod pas/ / sangs rgyas bslab pa shes rab pha rol phyin 'dir slob/ / 'phros don zin nas dkyus ma mthong ba'i lam yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs kyi gter sbyin sogs re re phyin drug phan tshun bsdu4te rnam pa sum cu rtsa drug gi mdzod dang / don dam par sangasargyas kyi rigasasu skyes shing don dam pa'i sa bcu'i yon tan thams cad 'di las skye tshul dpe tshan gnyis dang bcas pa ni/ 'di ni chos gter mchog dang chos mdzod dam pa yin/ / sangs rgyas rigs yin 'gro ba'i bde dang skyid pa'i mdzod/ / 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon po rnams/ / de dag 'di las 'khrungs kyang chos dbyings zad mi 'gyur/ / shing dang 'bras bu me tog nags tshal ji snyed pa/de dag thams cad sa las yang dag 'byung zhing 'thon/ / 'on kyang sa la zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/ / yongs su mi nyams rnam par mi rtog skyo ba 273

/med/ / sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang / / 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams ji snyed pa/ / de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung / / shes rab nams kyang zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa/ / de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ / rkyen rnams tshogs nas sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung / / ma rig 'khrul 'khor de ni zad med 'phel ba med/ / ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ / de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung / / rkyen rnams tshogs nas ye shes 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung / / shes rab pha rol phyin la zad med 'phel ba med/burnyi shrīs 'di bar du byang chub kyi rgyu gsum la sbyar ro/ / mthong ba'i lam seni rnam baspyings kyi ting nge 'dzin las langs nas rten 'brel lugs 'byung ldog dang thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin sogs la zhugayote rang byung sangs rgyasakyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur tshul ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig rten cing 'brel 'byung la/ / skye med zad pa med par shes rab 'di shes te/ / nyi ma sprin med 'od zer 'phro bas mun bsal ltar/ / ma rig thibs po bcom nas rang byung thob par 'gyur/ / me tog bkram pa'i le'u ste nyer brgyad pa'o/ / sgom lam rtse sbyor ston pa la spang bya gzung rtog gnyis ni/ mthu chen ldan pa bsam gtan bzhis kyang gnas byed la/ / rten par byed pa ma yin gnas par byed pa med/ / 'on kyang bsam gtan yan lag bcas pa bzhi po 'di/ / byang chub dam pa mchog thob pa yi rten du 'gyur/ / burnyi shrīs dran pa zhes pas gzung rtog dang /gnas ba zhes pa 'dzin rtog la sbyar te 'di man bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor la sbyar yang /slob dpon ltar na 'dzin rtog gnyis spangs te ting 'dzin mtha' yas pa la goms shing skye ba sna tshogs bzung ste gzhan don sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ shes rab mchog thob bsam 274

༄ / /'phagasagashesarab tshodza'akhrusabyenapasdudapa casapagatan dag la gnas pa ni/ / gzugs med ting 'dzin dam pa bzhi yang nyams su myong / / bsam gtan 'di dag byang chub dam pa mchog la phan/byang chub sems dpa' zag pa zad phyir slob pa min/ / 'di ni yon tan sogs pa'i ngo mtshar rmad byung ste/ / bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas mtshan ma med/ / de la gnas rnams gal te lus ni zhig gyur na / / bsam pa ji bzhin 'dod pa'i khams su yang skye ba/ / chu yi pad+ma bzhin srid par gnas kyang srid pas ma gos pa'i bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor ni/ dper na 'dzam gling mi zhig sngon chad lha yul gyi/ / lha yi grong khyer mtshag tu ma phyin phyis song ste/ / de na yongs su gzung ba'i yul de rnams mthong nas/ /phyis 'dir 'ongs par gyur na chags par mi byed ltar/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yon tan mchog 'chang ba/ / rnal 'byor brtson te bsam gtan ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ / phyir yang 'dod pa'i khams su gnas te chags pa med/ / chu yi pad+ma bzhin du byis pa'i chos mi gnas/ / bsal bya log sgrub ni budha shrī ltar na gong gi 'di ni yon tan sogs pa'i ngo mtshar rmad byung ste/ zhes pa nas bstan pa yin kyang / slob dpon gye dgongs pa ni chos kun bden par med na dmigs pa dang don gnyer blang dor sogs ji ltar 'thad snyam du log par zhugs pa la 'khor gsum gang du'ang chags pa'am zhen pa med par don gnyis rdzogs par byed tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen po sems can yongs su smin bya dang / / zhing sbyang pha rol phyin rdzogs don byed kho nar zad/ / byang chub yon tan pha rol phyin nyams 'gyur 'ong zhes/ / gzugs med khams su skye ba don du gnyer mi byed/ / dper na mi zhig rin chen gter rnams rnyed gyur na/ / de la 'dod pa'i blo ni bskyed par ma byas la/ / des kyang dus gzhan zhig na de dag yongs blangs shing /275
