/ /blangs nas khyim du song ste chags par mi byed ltar/ de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dga' ba dang / / bde sbyin bsam gtan ting 'dzin zhi ba bzhi thob nas/ / bsam gtan bde ldan bsam gtan ting 'dzin thob btang ste/ / 'gro la snying brtser ldan pa phyir yang 'dod khams 'jug /blang dor sogs su zhen na lhag par log zhugs su 'gro ba'i tshul/ / gal te byang chub sems dpa' ting 'dzin bsam gtan gnas/ / dgra bcom rang rgyal theg par 'dod pa'i blo skyed na/ / mnyam par ma bzhag rgod cing sems g.yengs gyur pa ste/ / sangs rgyas yon tan yongs nyams mnyan pa gru zhig bzhin/ / des na sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul du lam la slob dgos pa ni/ gzhan yang gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri dang ro/ / reg dang 'dod yon lnga la mngon par brtson gyur kyang / / dgra bcom rang rgyal theg bral byang chub sems dga' na/ / dpa' bo rtag tu mnyam gzhag yin par shes par bya/ / skabasalnga pa'o/ / ༈mthar gyis sbyor ba ni/ sems can gang dag gzhan phyir sems pa rnam dag pa/ / brtson 'grus pha rol phyin la mngon brtson rnam par spyod/ / dper na bran mo chu chun dbang med rje bo'i dbang / / de bzhin dpa' rnams sems can rkun gyi dbang gis 'gro / skabs drug pa'o/ /'dis phar phyin drug rjes su dran pas mngon par brtson pa dkon mchogagasum dang tshul khrims dang lha rjes su dran nas ci byed de'i dbang du gtong ba las rang dgar mi 'jug pa dang / ngo bo nyid med par rjes su dran pas sems rnam par dag pa bstan pa yin nam snyam la/ / rkang pa dang por rtsa ba'i 'gyur rnams su/ sems can gang dag ces 'byung yang /'grel pa gnyi gas sems can dang gang zag ces sgra bshad byas snang ngo / /276

༄/ /'phagasapa shesarab)tha'a'akhrusaphyinapa༄dpa casapaspyo ba byas sam 'on te rtag tu brdeg kyang rung / / bran mo rje bo la ni zlog chig mi smra yi/ / 'di yis bdag ni bsad par 'gyur du 'ong snyam nas/ /shin tu skrag pa'i yid kyis 'jigs bcas zil gyis gnon/ / de bzhin byang chub ched du byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ / 'gro ba kun la bran gyur bzhin du gnas par bya/ / 'di las byang chub thob cing yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur/rtswa dang shing las me byung bas ni de nyid sreg / skabs bdun pa'o/ /'dis skad cig sbyor bstan tshul ni lhag bsam goms pa mthar thug par bstan pas mtshon te byang semasakyi thams cad mthar phyin par bstan pa yin no/ / bdag gi bde ba btang nas re ba med sems kyis/ / sems can gzhan gyi dgos la nyin mtshan mngon par brtson/ / bu gcig pa la ma ni rim gro byed pa ltar/bsam pa thag pas rnam par skyo med gnas par bya/ / rjes surig pa'i le'u ste nyer dgu pa dang skabayobargyad pa'o/ /'di man chad rgyan dang sbyar du med la/ sbyor ba'i lugs shig sngon nas kyang yod 'dug pa slob dpon gyis bkag go/ 'disachosasku bstan tshul ni sku bzhi mngon dumadzad de 'khor ba ma stongs bar du skyo ba med par bzhugs nas 'phrin las nyer bdun gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad par gsungs pa yin no/ / byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig yun ring 'khor 'dod cing / / sems can don dang zhing sbyong brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ / skyo ba'i blo ni rngul tsam skye bar mi 'gyur na/ /de ni brtson 'grus pha rol phyin ldan g.yel ba med/ / byang chub sems dpa' mi mkhas bskal pa bye ba bgrang / / gal te ring bar 'du shes sdug bsngal byang chub sgrub/ / yang dag chos sgrub byed tshe yun ring sdug bsngal 'gyur/ / des na brtson 'grus pha rol phyin nyams le lo can/ / byang sems mkhas pa rnams dus yun ring dang bya dka' ba la mi lta bar snying stobasabaskyed pa 277

/'phags pa rtag ngu lta bu yin te/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dang po nas bzung ste/ / byang chub bla na med pa thob par 'gyur gyi bar/ / nyin mtshan gcig tsam du ni yid la sems byed na/ / mkhas pa gsal bas brtson 'grus brtsams par rig par bya/ / gal te 'ga' zhig 'di skad ri rab ri ba shig pa'i/ / rjes la byang chub mchog thob 'gyur zhes smra ba las/ / ji ste skyo ba'i blo skyed tshad kyang skyed byed na/ / de tshe byang chub sems dpa' le lor gyur pa yin/ / ji ste de ni 'di tsam tshod lta ci dka' zhes/ / skad cig tsam la ri rab thal bar rlag sems skyed/ / byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa brtson 'grus brtsams pa ste/ / ring por mi thogs 'dren pa'i byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ / de ltar brtson 'grus rtsom pa na'ang mngon zhen med pa gal cheba'i tshul/ 'gro ba yongs su smin par byas nas don bya zhes/ / gal te lus dang ngag dang yid kyis brtson byed na/ / bdag tu 'du shes gnas pas le lor gyur pa ste/ / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las ring 'gyur gnam sa bzhin/ / gang tshe lus dang sems dang sems can 'du shes med/ /'du shes rnam par log nas gnyis su med chos spyod/ / 'di ni byang chub zhi ba mi nyams mchog 'dod pa'i/ / brtson 'grus pha rol phyin ces phan pa mdzad pas gsungs/ / rtag ngus sher phyin 'tshol ba'i phyir chos laphags bsten pa ltaradaka' spyad sdug bsngal la bzod sran dgos tshul/ gal te gzhan las ngan brjod tshig zub thos gyur na/ / bdag bde yin zhes byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dga'/ / su smra sus thos gang gis gang zhig gang gi phyir/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin mchog ldan pa mdzangs pa yin/ / byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig bzod pa'i legs chos ldan/ / gang zhig stong gsum rin chen bkang ste 'jig rten mkhyen/ / sangs rgyas rnams dang dgra bcom rang 278

sa / / 'phagags shesarabashunganga'abacophyinas bcasapargyal phul byas pa/ / sbyin pa'i phung pos de la bsod nams char mi phod/ /bzod la gnas pa'i lus ni yongs su dag 'gyur te/ / sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang mthu stobs pha mtha' yas/ / sems can rnams la tshas rab stong pa sgogs par byed/ / 'di ni bzod ldan de la 'gro ba dgar 'gyur mkhas/gal te sems can la las tsan dan phur ma blangs/ / rab gus byang chub sems dpa' la ni nyug byed la/ / gzhan zhig me mdag mgo la 'thor byed gnyis ka la/ / de yis mnyam zhing stoms pa'i sems ni bskyed par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pas de ltar bzod byas nas/ / sems bskyed de ni byang chub mchog tu yongs bsngos na / / dpa' bo 'jig rten kun la bzod pas dgra bcom dang / / rang rgyal sems can khams kyi ji sted zil gyis gnon/ / bzod byed 'di snyam du yang sems ni bskyed bya ste/ /sems dmyal dud 'gro gshin rje'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal mang / / 'angod pa'i yon tan rgyu yis dbang med gnod myong na/ / byang chub ched du ci phyir da bzod mi bya snyam/ / lcag dbyug mtshon dang bsad dang bcing dang brdeg pa dang / / mgo gcod pa dang rna ba rkang lag sna gcod dang / /'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed bdag gis bzod snyam pa/ / byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa'i pha rol phyin la gnas/ / chos kyi don du mgo rkang lag gcod pa tshun chad kyang 'azod dgos pa'i dper byas nas bstan te/ slob dpon gye sdud 'grel las/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ji snyed bstan pa'i rang bzhin la gnas te rtag ngu bzhin no/ / zhes gsungs so/ / rtag ngu'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o/ / tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur/ / stobs bcu'i spyod yulaganas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med/ / sdom pa bya ba ji snyed kun gyi rjes su 'jug sems can kun la phan phyir de yang byang chub bsngo/ / byang chub 279

/sems dpa' choyo'aphags gnasaskabs 'dod yon lnga la dga' mgur rol pa ltar snang yang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bzhin byang sems kyi tshul khrims dag ma dag rang don yidabyed yod med kyi steng nas 'jog dgos pa ni/ gal te rang rgyal dgra bcom byang chub reg 'dod na/ / tshul khrims 'chal cing mi mkhas de bzhin spyod pa nyams/ / ji ste byang chub zhi ba mchog tu yongs bsngo na / / 'dod yon brtson yang tshul khrims pha rol phyin la gnas/ / chos gang nges pa'i byang chub yon tan 'byung 'gyur ba/ / de ni yon tan chos ldan rnams kyi tshul khrims don/ / chos gang phan byed rnams kyi byang chub yongs nyams pa/ /'di ni tshul khrims 'chal ces rnam par 'dren pas gsungs/ / gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang / / sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste/ / sangs rgyas 'grub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yidabyed na/ / mkhas pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya/ /gal te bskal pa bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu/ / spyod kyang rang rgyal dgra bcom nyid la 'dod skyed na/ / de tshe tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa yin/ / sems bskyed de ni phas pham bas kyang shin tu lce/ / tshul khrims srung zhing byang chub mchog tu yongs bsngo la/ / de yis rlom sems med cing bdag bstod mi byed la/ / nga yi 'du shes sems can 'du shes yongs su spangs/ / byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas brjod/ / tshul khrims de la'ang bden zhen dang rlom sems skyed mi rung ba ni/gal te byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i lam spyod pa / / sems can 'di dag khrims ldan 'di dag khrims 'chal ces/ / sna tshogs 'du shes zhugs pa shin tu tshul khrims 'chal/ / tshul khrims nyams shing de la yongs dag tshul khrims med/ / gang la bdag gi 'du shes sems can 'du shes med/ /280

༄ / / 'phagasapa shesarab kha 'khrusaphyinapasnu bcasapa'adu shes 'dod chags bral la sdom min ga la yod/ / gang la sdom dang sdom pa ma yin rlom sems med/ / 'di ni tshul khrims sdom par rnam par 'dren pas gsungs/ / sems can dag pa gang zhig de ltar khrims ldan pa/ /sdug dang mi sdug kun la lta ba med pa yin/ / mgo dang rkang lag gtong zhing zhum pa'i sems kyang med/ / bdog pa thams cad gtong zhing rtag tu zhen pa med/ / chos rnams rang bzhin bdag med ya ma brlar shes nas/ /bdag gi sha yang gtong la zhum pa'i sems med na/ / de tshe phyi rol dngos po gtong ba smos ci dgos/ / gal te ser sna byed pa de ni gnas med do/ /bdag tu 'du shes dngos la bdag gir 'dzin pas chags/ / blun po rnams la gtong ba'i blo lta ga la yod/ / ser sna'i nyes dmigs byang sems kyi sbyin pa'i phan yon dang bcas pa/ ser sna can ni yi dwags gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /ji ste mir skyes na yang de tshe dbul bor 'gyur/ / de tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems can dbul shes nas/ / gtong la mos par 'gyur 'ing rtag tu lhug par gtong / / gling bzhi legs par brgyan pa mchil ma'i thal ba 'dra/ / byin nas dga' bar 'gyur gyis gling thob de lta min/ / byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa gsal ba srid gsum gyi/ / sems can ji snyed de dag kun la sbyin pa 'di/ / byin par gyur cig snyam du bsams nas sbyin byin la/ / de yang 'gro ba'i don du byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ / sbyin pa byin nas dngos la gnas par byed pa med/ / de ni nam du'ang rnam par smin la re ba med/ / de ltar gtong ba mkhas pa thams cad gtong ba ste/ / chung ngu btang la mang po dpag tu med par 'gyur/ / srid pa gsum na sems can ma lus ji snyed pa/ yongs su brtag pa bzung ste de dag thams cad kyis/'jig rten mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dgra bcom rang rgyal la/ bskal pa mtha' 281

/ /yas sbyin byin nyan thos legs 'tshol na/ / byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa thabs mkhas gang zhig gis/ / de dag bsod nams bya ba'i dngos la yi rang nas/ / sems can don du byang chub mchog rab yongs bsngo na/ /yongs su bsngo bas 'gro ba thams cad zil gyes gnon/ / nor bu mching bu'i phung po chen por gyur pa yang / / rin chen be+eḍūr+ya gcig de kun zil gyesaganon/ / byang sems thabs mkhas pasanor dngos su ma btang yang tshogs rlabs po che tshegs med par rdzogs pa'i tshul ni/ de bzhin 'gro kun sbyin pa'i phung po rgya chen kun/ / rjes su yi rang byang chub sems dpas zil gyis gnon/ / gal te byang chub sems dpas 'gro la sbyin byin nas/ / de la bdagagir mi byed dngos po phangs med na/ / de las dge ba'i rtsa ba mthu chen 'phel 'gyur te/ / sprin med 'od ldan zla dkyil yar gye ngo bzhin no/ / zhes rang gzhan gyi phyin drug gi spyod pa mtha' med du yar spel ba ni/ sdud 'grel las/ cho4'phags bzhin du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bya ba yin par rig par bya'o/ / zhes sbyar bas chos 'phag4kyi le'u ste so gcig pa'o/ / rgya 'grel gzhanaganyis las bar 'dir skabs lnga pa'i le mtsham4byas shing 'og ma 'di rnams sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang / zhesapa'i don du bsam nas mthar gyes sbyor bar bshadado/ / byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yi dwags 'gro ba gcod/ /dbul ba dang ni de bzhin nyon mongs thams cad gcod/ / spyod tshe longs spyod mtha' yas rgyas pa thob par 'gyur/ / sbyin pas sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can yongs smin byed/ / khrims kyis dud 'gro'i 'gro ba du ma'i ngo bo dang / / mi khom brgyad spong de yis dal brtag tu rnyed/ / bzod pas gzugs bzang dam pa rgya chen thob 'gyur te/ / gser mdog sdug cing 'gro bas lta ba'i 'os su 'gyur/ / brtson 'grus kyis ni dkar po'i yon tan 282

༄ / /'pha /lashesangarabacas ro'abaco cas ba'agrib mi 'gyur/ / ye shes mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bang mdzod rnyed par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan gyes ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor/ /rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par sgrub/ /shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ /khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ / mi yi khyu mchog 'khor lo rin chen bskor byas nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'gro la chos kyang ston/ /busnya shis 'di nas skabs drug pa'i le mtshams byas shing de'i rgyu mtshan nyi khri las mthar gyis sbyor ba bcuganyis la re re zhing / mthar gyes bya ba/ mthar gyis slob pa/ mthar gyis sgrub pa gsum du byasanasagasungs kyang / brgyad stong par/ seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rjes surig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de gnyis ga'i dgongs par bsam par snang la/ slob dpon gyis phar phyin bcu dang sbyar te shes rab lhag par thob nas sangs rgyas su sprul te chos bstan pa'i don du mdzad/chos 'di yongs rdzogs byas nas byang chub sems dpa' de/ /'di'ang burto shrīs skad cig spyor ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs surdzog4pa'i lam gyi mthar thug yin par bsam te rkang pa 'di gcig pu skabs bdun par byas kyang / /slob dpon thabs mkhas kyi phar phyin gyi sgo nasatshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i don du mdzad/de bzhin du smon lam gyi phar phyin lhag pas sabargyad par zhing dag spyor ba 'grub pa dang / stobasakyi phar phyin lhag pas so soyang dag rig pa bzhi rjes su mthun pa'i sgo nas chos bstan te semasacan yongs su 'dzin pa dang / yoshes kyi phar phyin lhag pas sangs rgyas kyi sa la reg cing rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rang dbang du bkral nas byang sems gzhan du ma bskrun payochos dang dge 'dun gyi rigs 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas nas chos kun 'dzin ༅ ston par/ yongs dag zhing dang sems can dag pa yongs su 'dzin/ / sangs rgyas rgyud dang chos kyi rgyud kyang yongs su 'dzin/ /de bzhin dge 'dun rgyud dang chos kun yongs su 'dzin/ /283

/ /'gro ba'i nad gso mdzad pa sman pa'i mchog gyur pa/ / shes rab bstan pa byang chub lam ldan 'di gsungs te / / ming ni yon tan rin chen sdud pa byang chub lam/ / lam 'di sems can kun gyis thob par bya phyir bshad/ /yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ / 'dis yongs gtad kyi don bsdus tshul ni/ 'di'i thad kyi brgyad stong par/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i yoshes yongs surdzogasapar 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs theg pa chen po'i lam 'brasakun 'di las 'byung ba'i yon tan rin po che'i 'byung khungs dang sher phyin 'di gang du spyod pa der sangs rgyas bzhugs shing chos ston pa dang dge 'dun 'du ba sogasa'abyung bas mdo sde thams cad las 'di nan tan du srung dgos/zhes lan gsum du gtad pa yin pas/ 'dir/ lam 'di sems can kun gyis thob par bya phyir bshad/ ces pa'i tshig gi nus pa 'don tshul sdud 'grel las/ bya zhes pa ni 'phags pa kun dga' bo la sogs pa la yongs sugatod pa yin/ zhes sher phyin sems can kun gyis thob pa sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa'i gtso bo yin zhing / de sher mdo mi nyam4par gnasapa la rag las pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nan tan du gtad pa yin no/burta shrī dang kha che dha rmā shrīsa'adi'i 'ang rkang pa phyi ma gnyis ma gtogs pa skabs brgyad padang sbyar ba tshig zin 'brel chagasapa ltar 'ongs kyang / brgyad stong pa'i le'u'i rim pa dang sbyar ba'i tshe slob dpon gye sdud 'grel dgongs pa zab par snang ngo / /rgyal yum sher phyin zab mo'i don/ / nyung ngu'i tshig gis bkral ba'i dges/ / rgyal ba'i dgongayopa legs rtogasanas/ / yang dag lam bzang myur bgrod shog /mchan bu 'di ni/ btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sngar rang lo nyer bzhi pa la dpal ldan 'brasaspungs su chos grwa 'grim bzhin pa'i skabs mdo rgyas pa rnams dang rgyan sbyor tshul thad ka re tsam nges thub kyang cha tshang blor mi 'jags pas/ rgyun gyi gshar sbyang la sdud pa dang sbyar na bde bar 'dug snyam nas skabs bzhi pa'i phyed yan bris kyang / grwa skor gyis dus gtugs pasapo ti gzhan rnams 'dzin skyor dang / so so'i mchan dang bsdus don gsar du bri rgyu sogs kyis 'thocan du lus te/ a mchog 284

༄/ /'phag pa shesarab tshor2 bcasaladagon gyi lam rim khri pa lhag bsam rnam dpyod yangs pa 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs kyisastod lo rim pa par du bsgrubs te mjug cha tshang ba byed dgos zhes nan tan du bskul ba bzhin grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa'i snying po dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig///285

/༄༅/ / 'grel ba don gsal gyi steng nas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel sogs mdo rgyan sbyar ba'i gzab bshad kyi zin bris sbas don gsal ba'i sgon me zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /༄7/ / bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi mdzod brnyes te/ / ngo mtshar mdzad pas bstan pa'i snying po mchog / gsal mdzad smra ba'i sgon mer gus btud nas/ / bla ma'i gsung rgyun zin tsam yi ger 'god/ /de'ang rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ / bstan pa rnyed dang bkur ste dang / / bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig / ces gsungs pa ltar/'grob rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gis bsdus pa'i nad ma lus pa sel ba'i sman gcig pu legs tshogs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyid yin la/ de nyid gnas pa gtso bor 'chad nyan la rag las shing / 'chad nyan tshul bzhin du byed pa'ang 'chad pa po dang nyan pa po la rag las pas de'ang bsten bya dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid/sten byed slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ des de bsten pa'i phan yon/ ma bsten pa'i nyes dmigs sogs gzhung gzhan las kyang bshad mod/ rgyan 'dir 286

༄/ /zinabayang / sems mi 'gong ba nyid la sogs/ / zhes sogs kyis bsten bya dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ / zhes sogs kyis nyan bsam sgom pa'i snod slob ma'i mtshan nyid bshad/ bsten pa'i phan yon/ bla ma skyel la sogs pa dang / zhes sogs kyis bshad/ ma bsten pa'i nyes dmigs/ lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang dang / zhes sogs kyis bshad pa yin gsung / de'ang 'chad pa pos kun slong nyon mongs dang ma 'dres pa'i sgo nas 'chad dgos shing / nyan pa pos kyang snod kyi skyon gsum spangs/ 'du shes drug bsten pa'i sgo nas nyan dgos pa yin la / 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel ba don gsal 'di nyid yin la/ de 'chad pa la/mtshan gye don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don gsum/dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du zhes sogs byung / de'ang spyir a sti don du mar 'jug ste/ a snyi mu kha mngon phyogs dang / a sti k+ṣa yang yang dang /a snyi zu zil gnon dang / a bhi sa ma ya mngon rtogs la 'jug pa sogs su yod pa las 'dir ni mngon rtogs la 'jug pa yin gsung / u ba nye ba dang / de sha ston pa la 'jug pas gzhung gi tshig tshogs rgya che zhing go rim 'khrug pa sbas pa'i tshul du bstan pa dag thar chags su gsal bar ston pa ni man ngag ces bya ste/ de'ang rje rin po ches 'jam dbyangs la gzhung dang man ngag gnyis kyi nang nas gang gtso bor byed ces zhus pa'i tshe/ man ngag ni gzhung dang mthun dgos/ gzhung ni nam yang dor bar mi bya/ zhes gsungs pas don gyis man ngag gzhung chen mo dang mi mthun na dor gsungs pa yin la/ de'ang yin te man ngag ces pa gzhung chen mo'i don rtogs pa'i man ngag tu 'gro ba zhig dgos kyi/ man ngag gcig pu bzung bas mi yong ste/287

da / / / ladaper na lde mig gis za 'byed dgos pa yin gyi/ rang lde mig tu 'gro sa'i za la bdag ma byas par 'di lde mig yin zhes lde mig gcig pu bzung bsdad pa la dgos pa med pa yin gsung / rgya gar gyi skad thog mar smos pa'i dgos pa ni chos la yid ches skyes/ / skad la bag chags 'jog / rgyud la byinarlabs 'byung zer ba ltar yin la/ chos la yid ches skyed tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ de'ang rang rgya skad la mkhas pa tsam rgyu mtshan du byas te/ rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi thog mar rgya skad smos mi chog par dang po bkas bcad pa yin la / de'i tshe rgya skad thog mar yod pa'i rtags kyis bstan bcos de lo tsā bas rgya gar nas bsgyur te 'ongs pa'i chos khungs btsun par go nus pas na chos la yid ches skye ba yin/ phyi ma gnyis ni/ spyir dus 'khor sogs nas kyang sangs rgyas kyis skad sna tshogs kyis chos ston par gsungs pa dang / lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ ces sogs ltar slob pa'i dus su sgon lam btab pas 'bras bu'i dus su'ang skad sna tshogs kyis ston pa yod kyang / gtso bor dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis si skṛ ta'i skad du chos gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis skad la bag chags 'jog pa dang / rgyud la byin rlabs 'byung zer ba yin gsung / rgya gar zhes pa la bshad tshul mang po yod de/ rgya gar pa rnams mya ngan gyi tshe zhwa dang gos nag po gyon la/ dus rgyun du dgos dkar po gyon pas rgya gar dang /rgya nag pa rnams mya ngan gyi tshe zhwa dang gos dkar po gyon la/ dus rgyun par gos nag po gyon pas rgya nag zer ba yin zhes bshad la/ kha cig de ni yig don la ma zhugs pas mi 'thad ces zer ba la 'di 'phul yod pa phyis/ga'ang ga blum du bsgyur te ming mtha' 'dren tshul gye dbang gis yin pas skyon med ces zer ro/ / yang 'ga' zhig rgya mtsho chen po las ring du gar bas na 288

ra / /zizug bye /sgo 'argya gar zhes zer ba la/ 'o na bod la sogs pa'ang der 'gyur ro zhen skyon med de/ sar nyal zhes pa ma te la 'jug kyang gzhan la mi 'jug pa yin zer ba sogs yod kyang / phal cher rgya zhes pa dang gar zhes pa so sor bshad mi dgos par grong khyer chen po drug yod pa'i phyogs la rgya gar zhes 'dod rgyal du btags pa 'thad phyogs su mdzad do/ / blo ka sum brgya re la bam po byas pa 'grel ba 'di dang / sh+lau ka nyer lnga re la bam po byas pa sher snying lta bu yin gsung / yum rgyas pa'i rgyas pa blo ka bye ba phrag brgya pa dri za'i yul na yod/ / rgyas pa'i 'bring 'bum phrag brgya pa lha'i yul na yod/ rgyas pa'i bsdus pa stong phrag brgya pa yum 'bum pa 'di yin zhes skyed tshal mkhan po'i phar phyin na 'dug gsung / gser 'phreng las/ khri brgyad stong pa la le'u brgyad cu gya bdun yod pa'i gya bzhi pa ni sdud pa yin pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pa la/ sdud pa dang po nas de'i le'u min kyang lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i tshe phyogs gcig tu bsgyur ba yin zhes skyed tshal mkhan po dang / rje btsun pa'i phar phyin gang rung zhig na 'dug pas de ltar du dogs pa byed lugs shig yod pa 'dra gsung / mngon pa'i sde snod kyis lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston cing 'jam dpal shes rab kyi bdag po yin pas de la phyag 'tshal ba dang / mdo sde'i sde snod kyis ting nge 'dzin gye bslab pa gtso bor ston cing sangs rgyas byang sems ting nge 'dzin gyi bdag po yin pas de la phyag 'tshal ba dang / 'dul ba'i sde snod kyis tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston cing 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams la dbang ba ni sangs rgyas kho na yin gyi/gzhan gyis mi dbang bas de la phyag 'tshal ba yin zhing / dbang tshul ni sangs rgyas kyis rgyu mtshan gzhan med kyang 'di byed rung 'di byed mi rung zhes gsungs pa tsam gyes der 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /289

/gnyis pa la bshad pa la 'jug pa/ bshad pa nyid 'god pa/bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ / zhes pa nas/ spro ba skyes zhes pa'i bar byung / gzhung 'di la mkhas pa'i bshad tshul du ma yod de/ gser gling pa'i btang stoms kyi bshad pa/ lo tsā ba chen po'i 'jam po'i bshad pa/ sher 'byung gi tsub pa'i bshad pa zhes grags pa ltar gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de'ang mkhas pa snga ma bzhi la 'thad mi 'thad sogs kyi zur mi za bar de dag bshad pa'i rnam grangs tsam du bkod nas slob dpon rang nyid kyis kyang 'chad par spro zhes pa'i bshad pa mdzad pas btang stoms kyi bshad pa dang / slob dpon snga ma bzhi'i drin dang man ngag la brten nas 'chad nus kyi/ rang stobs kyis mi nus zhes pa'i bshad pa mdzad pas 'jam po'i bshad pa dang / snga ma bzhis mnyogs pa dang log par rtog pa sogs kyi dri ma sel ma nus shing / slob dpon rang nyid kyis ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa sogs kyi dri ma mtha' dag bsal te 'chad ces pa'i bshad pa mdzad pas tsub mo'i bshad pa zhes zer ba yin la/ de'ang snga ma bzhis sel ma nus tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ thogs med kyis de nyid rnam nges skabs su mkhyen gsum rgyas par bshad nas sbyor bzhi rgyas par ma bshad pas ma rtogs pa'i dri ma dang / dbyig gnyen gyis rnam rig tsam la zhen te sems tsam du bkral bas log par tog pa'i dri ma dang / 'phags pas tshig zin la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos sku rgyas par ma bshad pa dang / / sku gsum du grangs nges par bshad pa dang nyi khri tsam dang sbyar bas the tshom gyi dri ma dang / btsun pas bstan bcos mtha' dag ma rnyed pas na rmongs pa'i dri ma sel ma nus la/ mdor na bshad dgos pa ma bshad cing mi dgos pa bshad pa'i skyon yod ces pa'i don no/ / dbu mar gnas 2༅

sa / /zi stebyes g.yo ༄ gagopa'iblos rnam phye zhes pas/ rang gi mos pa gtsor byed pa/ / zhes pa la zur za ste/ 'dir rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbus la gnas par bshad pa na/ snga ma mthar lhung ba don gyis go ba'i phyir/ spyir 'phags pa thogs med sa gsum pa pa yin pas/ sbas don mngon rtogs dang dngos bstan stong nyid sogs mngon sum su rtogs kyang/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi skabs su yang yang gsungs pa dang go rim 'khrugs pa sogs thams cad la zlos pa'i skyon dang / ma tshang ba med par thar chags su gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam du dril te nyams len la 'khyer shes pa dang / gzhan la ston pa de shin tu rtogs dka' bar gzigs nas/ rje btsun byams pa bsgrubs te zhal gzigs nas dga' ldan du mi lo lnga bcu'am zla ba drug tu chos gsan par gsungs/ des na rang re'i yig char yang gsalasnang 'byung bar sgrub nus na lam kun shes pas khyab par thal zhes ha cang thal pa 'phen tshul la dpag na/ kha cig / dang ba las gus pa dang /gus pa las thos sogs kyis 'jug par bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/dbang rnon gyis mi ldog pa'i dang ba bskyed pa'i snga rol nas rgyan brtsams pa'i 'bras bu'am dgos pa grub zin pa'i phyir te/ mkhyen gsum dang gzhi lam rnam gsum bden med du rtogs zin pa'i phyir zhe na de tsam gyis lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs par rtogs mi dgos pas skyon med ces lan 'debs dgos sam snyam gsung / bstan bcos mtha' dag ma rnyed ces pa tshig don ci rigs pa dang gtso bor don ma rnyed pa la byed gsung / shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ zhes sogs kyi sh+lau ka gcig gis thog mar skyabs 'gro bstan/'gro la zhes sogs kyis slob dpon gyis rang bzo min par dam pa snga ma'i man ngag dang ldan par bstan/ rnam pa kun tu zhes sogs kyis khengs bskyung 291

/bstan la/ de'ang khengs pa ni nga rgyal dang bskyung ba ni de mgo gnon pa'am nyams smad pa yin pas 'chad nyan gyi tshe nga rgyal lam rlom sems zhi bar byed dgos te/ de dang ma bral bar rang nyid mkhas shing chos shin tu zab pa ji tsam bshad kyang rang gzhan gyi don du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na 'dir nga rgyal gtso bor smos shing / mdzod las/ chos sbyin nyon mongs can min pas/ zhes sogs ltar dgos gsung / 'grel ba 'di yum gsum ga dang sgra 'gros mthun zhing / rgyan gyi'ang rgyan yin pas kun gye rgyan du 'gyur ba yin gsung /gnyis pa bshad pa nyid dgod pa la/ mchod par brjod pa dang /rgyas par bshad pa dang / bsdus don gzhan bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/'phags pa byams pa zhes sogs byung / de'ang so so rang gis rig pa zhes pa'i so so rang rig ni so so zhes pa ma 'dres pa la byas nas sgra don gyi spyi dang ma 'dres par rig pa dang / rang gis myong ba ltar gzhan la brjod du med pas so so rang gis rig pa'am/ yang na so so 'phags pa la byas nas 'phags pa nang phan tshun gyi spyod yul yin gyi so skye ba rnams kyi spyod yul min pas na so so rang gis rig pa'o/ / yab sras dgongs pa gcig tu 'gro dgos pas rnam bshad dang rtog ge snang ba gnyis kyis mkhyen gsum la dang ba'i dad pa legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyur rjes thob kyis nges par gsungs pa'ang mnyam gzhag gi rjes su byung ba'i rjes thob la mi byed par stong nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa de'i stobs kyis kun rdzob pa'i chos sgyu ma lta bur gzigs pas snga ma lag rjes 'jog byed dang / phyi ma la de'i lag rjes kyi tha snyad byed pa ltar dus mnyam pa dang ldog pas phye ba'i rjes thob la byed gsung / gser phreng nas 'phags pa byams pa zhes pa nas ched du zhes 292

༄/ /zinabris yodopa yan chad mchod brjod bshad thabs lnga'i dgos pa dang / rnam bshad las mtshams sbyar gyi gzhung la gsungs pas/ de'ang mtshams sbyar ni 'brel bkod pa'am gleng bslang pa yin la/ mtshams sbyor tshul ni du ma yod de/rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas dang / rtsod pa'i sgo nas dang / dri ba'i sgo nas dang /dgos pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyor tshul rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ des na gser phreng nas kyang dgos pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyor tshul de gsungs pa yin gyi/ mtshams sbyor gyi gzhung la mi 'jog par gsungs pa min te/ gzhan du na dgos don gyi gzhung gnyis yod par 'gyur ro/ / yum la bcom ldan 'das ma zhes gsungs pa ni phyogs gcig gi ming gis phyogs can la btags pa yin te/ dper na yum la rgyal ba'i yum zhes pa bzhin no/ / bcom ldan ni legs pa drug dang ldan pa la byed cing legs pa drug ni/ dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang / / zhes sogs ltar/ chos dbyings ye shes kyi byed las sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'i cha nas dbang phyug dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi byed las gzugs bzang dang / mnyam nyid ye shes kyi byed las dpal dang grags pa gnyis dang / sor tog ye shes kyibyed las ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes phun tshogs dang / bya grub ye shes kyi byed las brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ de'ang ser sna dang /phrag dog gnyis kyis rim bzhin dpal 'byor dang grags pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa la gegs byed cing / mnyam nyid ye shes kyis rgyu de gnyis spangs pas 'bras bu'i dpal 'byor dang grags pa phun tshogs 'byung bar byed do/bha ga wan zhes pa 'di la 'das pa'i skad dod med kyang dbang phyug sogs la'ang 'jug cing gzhan dang nor sa yod pas/ de dag las khyad par du 'byed pa'i phyir lo tsā bas 'das zhes pa bla thabs su bsnan par bshad pa 293

/gcig dang / yang kha cig bha ga wan zhes pa 'di la 'das pa'i skad dod med pa'ang min te/ ga byings byas nas te bsnan pas ga te ni song ba la 'jug pas ring du song ba ste gang las song na 'jig rten las song ba'am 'das par bshad pa gcig kyang yod gsung / rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dbang rnon gyis thog mar stong nyid rtogs pa de'ang bum pa lta bu'i steng nas gtanal 'bebs pa yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi steng nas rtogs dgos shing de'i rgyu mtshan yang dbang rnon gyis thog mar mchod brjod kyi tshig thos pa'i tshe/ mchod brjod kyis mkhyen gsum skye med du bstan pas med ces pa dang / 'phags bzhi skyed par bstan pas yod ces pa 'di gnyis 'gal lam snyam pa'i dogs pa skye la/ de'i tshe gcig du bral sogs kyi rigs pas dpyad de mkhyen gsum don dam par skye ba med kyang tha snyad tsam du 'phags bzhi skyed par rtogs pa na sngar gyi dogs pa de sel bar 'gyur gyi/myu gu bden med rtogs pas mkhyen gsum gyi steng gi dogs pa de sel mi nus pa'i phyir/ der ma zad theg chen dbang rnon gyis sems skyed kyi sngon du stong nyid rtogs dgos par dbu ma rgyan las gsungs pa lta bu ni thog mar sems kyi chos nyid rtogs dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang thog mar bden 'dzin spong nus sam mi nus dpyod par 'gyur ba yin la de'ang dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin la ma zhugs pas sems bden med du rtogs pa na bden 'dzin spong nus su mthong ba yin pas skabs don so sor shes par byed dgos gsung / gcig tu bral gyi rigs pa rten 'brel las kyang go sla bas de la bsngags pa dang rnam lnga3ma bdun sogs kyang gcig tu bral je rgyas su btang ba yin la/ rtag chad kyi nyen med pas/ lam gtsor rten 'brel la bsngags shing rigs pa gzhan thams cad rten 'brel gyi rigs pa dang 'gros gcig pa dang rten 294

da / /:sgozug bye /sgo 'a'abrel la rigs pa'i rgyal po zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / dper na blon po rnams kyis bya ba che chung gang la'ang skog tu gros ji tsam byas kyang mthar rgyal po la gtugs te thag gcod dgos pa bzhin du/ rigs pa ga'an rnams kyis dpyad pa ci tsam byas kyang mthar rten 'brel la gtugs dgos pa'i gnad kyis yin zhes lcang skya'i grub mtha' na yod gsung / tshul gsum pa can zhes pa ni spyir tshul gyi sgra 'dra ba la'ang 'jug pa de dang de'i tshul bstan zhes pa lta bu rnams las 'dir tshul dang lugs dang lam gsum don gcig pas bzhed don sgrub pa'i lam srol gsum pa can zhes pa'i don yin gsung /kha cig mkhyen gsum dus gsum gyi 'phags rgyud la yod pas ral gri thang la bzhag pa ltar sa mtshams med/ sbyor bzhi da ltar gyi rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i rgyud nas 'jog dgos pas ral gri lag tu blang ba ltar sa mtshams yod zer ba 'dis mkhyen gsum la sa mtshams med ces tshig la skyon chags pas chu mi thub kyang / don 'di ltar rang lugs la'ang khas len dgos sam snyam ste/ de lta min na lam shes de skabs gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bo'i lam shes yin la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba skabs bzhi pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bo'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba min pa'i rgyu mtshan shod dka' gsung / mkhas pa kha cig mkhyenagasum gyi go rim gleng gzhi dang rtsa 'grel sbyor ba'i ched yin la/ rtsa 'grelasbyor tshul ni/ nyi khri las dge slong lnga stong tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po zhes pas rten gyi gang zag nyan thos dang / thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zhes pa nas/ rnam par grol pa zhes pa'i bar gyis 'bras bu lhag bcas myang 'das dang / cang shes pa glang po chen po zhes sogs kyis lhag med myang 'das dngos su bstan nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes pas rten byang sems dang / gzungs rab tu thob pa zhes 295

/sogs kyis lam shes dngos su bstan/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis zhes pas rten thub dbang dang / ting nge 'dzin rgyal po zhes bya ba la zhes sogs kyis rnam mkhyen dngos su bstan la/ de'ang sher snying lta bu la mtshon na thams cad kyis go sla bas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun zhes pas rten nyan thos dngos su bstan nas thabs dang 'bras bu shugs la bstan/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun zhes pas rten byang sems dngos su bstan nas thabs dang 'bras bu shugs la bstan/ bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhes pas rten thub dbang dang / rnam mkhyen dngos su bstan pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar sbyar ba de'ang phar bltas na 'grig 'dogs kha po zhig yin kyang gaphags seng gnyis dang mkhas pa gzhan gyis de ltar ma sbyar bas mi 'thad gsung / de'ang 'phags pas nyi snang la le'u brgyad du byas nas rab 'byor gyi le'u/ mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi le'u/ spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'u ste gsum gyes mkhyen gsum bstan/de bzhin nyid kyi le'u/ bslab pa'i le'u/ bslab pa rim gyis spyong ba'i le'u/ bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u ste bzhis sbyor bzhi bstan/bslab pa'i 'bras bu'i le'us chos sku bstan la/ de'i rjerta su gleng gzhi bshad pa dang / slob dpon gyis kyang 'grel chen du dgos 'brel gyi 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bstan pa'i dbang du byas nas zhes sogs kyis bshad la/ 'di'i skabs su slob dpon legs ldan gyi 'dod pa brjod pa yin zhing / de'i bzhed pa ltar na sher phyin gyi mdo sde rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi gsang ba'i gnad phra mo yin pas de dag nyan thos rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin la/ de dag gi rtsa ba'i sdud par byed pa po phyag rdor sogs yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang sngon rgyal po yul 'khor skyong la sras stong dang 296

༄ zir+ṣaganyis yod pas/ khye'u chos sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi mdzod 'dzin par smon lam btab/ chos kyi blo gros kyis mdo sde skul ba por smon lam btab pas khye'u chos sems ni phyag rdor dang / chos kyi blo gros ni tshangs pa gtsug phud can yin pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs/gcig du bral gyi sa bcad gnyis pa de/ mtshams sbyar/ rtsa ba/'grel ba gsum gyi 'grel ba la bsdus don/ dgos don gnyis byas nas dang po bsdus don ni/ tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni/ zhes pa nas rjod byed ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa dgos don gyes dbang rnon dang ba skye tshul 'chad pa de yin gsung / nyan thos zhes sogs kyi tshig rkang dang pos 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi dang / de sgrub byed kyi thabs dngos su bstan nas ngan song gi sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi btags pa ba dang / de sgrub byed kyi thabs ring du mi gnas par 'chi ba dran pa dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal bsam pa sogs shugs la bstan pas rkang pa dang pos chung 'bring thun mong gi lam dang / rkang pa gnyis pas sems bskyed dang / gsum pas de'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa bstan pas skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rim pa bstan pa yin gsung / nyan thos dang de'i phyogs su bslan pa zhes sogs kyi don ni nyan thos zhes pa'i tshig rim pa gcig gis rang rgyal shugs la bstan pa yin la/ 'o na nyan thos dang khyad par med dam stam na/ yod de spang bya'i sgo nas gzung rtog spong ba dang / 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul gyi sgo nas srid pa tha ma'i tshe gzhan la ma brten par byang chub 'thob pa/ gzhan don byed tshul gyi sgo nas sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyis chos ston pa sogs rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam gyis lhag pa yin gsung / rnam bshad kye sa bcad ltar na/ yongs su bskor ba de sgrub par byed pa nyid kyis 297

/yum de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa yan chad kyis mchod brjod bshad thabs lnga'i sgo nas bshad pa de rdzogs pa yin la/ 'o na brgal lan gyi gzhung de gang zhe na/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis zhes pa nas/bstod do zhes pa'i bar 'di 'jog cing / de'ang rtsod pa ni/ rgyan gyi mchod brjod 'di bstan bcos kyi brjod bya dang 'gros mthun pa'i phyag yin zhing / mngon rtogs thams cad la bstod phyag mdzad 'dod pa yin na mkhyen gsum tsam nyung ba'i skyon dang / phyogs re tsam la yin na rnam mkhyen gyes kyang chog pas grangs mang ba'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir mi 'thad do zhe na/lan ni/ mngon rtogs thams cad la yin kyang grangs mang nyung sogs kyi skyon yod pa ma yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon rtogs mtha' dag nyams len gyi sgos bsdus pa dang / mkhyen gsum gyis rigs can gsum gye don thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur bas/ de thugs la bzhag nas mkhyen gsum la bstod phyag mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'o/ / gser phreng ltar na/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes pa nas 'thad pa yin no zhes pa'i bar 'di mchod brjod bshad thabs lnga'i brgal lan gyi gzhung la 'jog dgos la/ rang re'i yig char yang kha cig mchod brjod las 'phros par bsam nas de'i rtsod lan du byed pa ni don cung zad kyang ma rtogs pa'i gtam yin zhes rnam bshad ltar gsungs shing / de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang /bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas zhes pa'i tshig 'dis yum de la phyag 'tshal zhes pa yan chad kyis mchod brjod bshad tshar ba'i rnam pa lta bu zhig byas 'dug gsung / /gnyis pa rgyas par phye ste bshad pa la/ dgos don/ bsdus don/tshig don gsum/ dang po la bstan bcos rtsom pa dgos med kyi dogs pa 298

༄ zasaspangs te brjod bya mkhyen gsum spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / mdo dang zlos skyon spangs nas dgos pa yod par bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba/ zhes pa nas/ 'thad pa yin no zhes pa'i bar gyi rtsod lan gye skabs su/ thog mar khong na gnas pa'i dogs pa bsu tshul ni/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod rtsom pa mkhas pa'i lugs yin pas/ rnam bshad ltar na/ mkhyen gsum la bstod phyag mdzad pa shugs la mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsom par dam bcas pas/ de ltar na yul ston dgos pas gzhi gnyen rnam gsum dang bajod byar bsdus nas rtsom pa yin/ dang po ltar na bstan bcos rtsom pa'i 'bad pa don med pa yin te/mngon pa nas ma bshad pa bshad rgyu med cing bshad pa ston na rgyan dang mngon pa zlos/ gnyis pa ltar na gnyen po 'ba' zhig ston na rgyan la brten nas spang bya gang gi gnyen po gang yin mi rtogs la/ spang bya dang bcas par ston na nyon mongs sred pa lta bu gcig la'ang bdag rkyen dbang po drugadamigs rkyen yul drug rgyu rkyen rnam shes drug grogs sems byung dang bcas pa ston dgos la/ de la gzhi bstan dgos pas skyon dang po las mi 'da' ba'o/ / gsum pa ltar na rnam pa gzhi med tsam zhig bsdus na skyes bu la mkho ba'i don ma bshad para'agyur la/ gzhi bsdus pa la bkod pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro zhes rtsod pa 'god do/ / phar phyin rtog ge snang bar/ gzhi gnyen rnam gsum brjod byar byed pa'i bstan bcos rtsom par shes bzhin du re re tsam brjod byar bsdu ba yin nam zhes pa 'dri ba ni 'brel med yin te/dper na lhas sbyin khyod kyi ming la ci zer zhes 'dri ba dang 'dra bas mi 'thad la/ des na mchod brjod rtsom pas bya ba 'ga' zhig la 'jug par mthong ba na/ khyod kyis bstan bcos shig rtsom par 'dug pas gzhi gnyen rnam 299

/gsum gang brjod byar bsdus nas rtsom zhes khong na gnas pa'i dogs pa bsu bar gsungs pa'i mkhas pa'i bshad tshul mi 'dra ba ngo mtshar ba zhig yin gsung / lan gyi skabs su pha rol po'i shes 'dod ni chos gsum la rmongs pa tsamabazlog pa'i ched du gzhi gnyen rnam gsum re re tsam bsdus pa mi 'thad ces rtsod pa yin pas shes 'dod de gzhir bzhag nas re re tsam ston pa min gye gsum ga ston pas zlos skyon med ces bshad bya la sbyar te lan ci tsam btab kyang don mthun mi thebs pa ni/ gser phreng las/ de gsum la kho na'i sgra sbyar ba tsam la re bas ni rtsod lan 'di dag bskal pa'i bar du'ang mi shod ces gsungs pa ltar yin gsung / des na dgos pa dang 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas lan 'debs tshul ni/ khyod kyi shes 'dod ltar phung khams skye mched kyi rnam grangs dang phan tshun bsdus tshul sogs la rmongs pa bzlog pa'i ched du re re tsam brjod byar bsdus pa de ni ma yin te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ yul gzhi gnyen rnam pa gsum char gyis yul can mkhyen gsum mtshon pa'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i phyir/ rigs can gsum gyi lam mtha' dag shes par bya ba'i phyir du mkhyen gsum gtan la phab pa la dgos pa yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ / bsdus par gang las shes she na/ rgyal ba'i yum rnam pa gsum char las zhes shes byed 'god pa yin gsung /de'ang 'dir mkhyen pa snga ma gnyis rnam gzhag gi rten nyan rang dang byang sems kyi yum du bshad pa'i don/ dper na rgyud dus 'khor gyi grwa tshang lta bu la mtshon na/ de dang de'i grwa pa zhig byed pa la nges par bslab dgos la de las lhag mi dgos pa zhig la de dang de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'don cha zer yang /'don cha de yod pa la grwa tshang de dang de'i grwa pa zhig yin mi dgos pa de bzhin 300

da / /zizug bye (sgo 'du nyan rang gi nyer zhi tsam don du gnyer bas gzhi shes nges par dgos la gzhan gnyis mi dgos/ byang sems kyis rigs can gsum gyi don sgrub pas lam shes nges par dgos pas rten gye gang zag de dang de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bgo skal lta bur rnam par bzhag kyang / de gang rung rgyud ldan la rten de gnyis gang rung gis khyab pa yod mi dgos gsung / de'i phyir zhes pa nas shes pa nyid ces bya'o zhes pa'i bar 'dis mkhyen pa dang po ldan pa la phyi ma gnyis yod dgos pa gcod kyi phyi ma gnyis ldan pa la dang po yod pa mi gcod pa ni/ dper na dge bsnyen gyi spang bya lnga tsam spong ba dang / bsten gnas la spang bya brgyad/ dge tshul la sbang bya bcu sogs spong bar bshad pa snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma'i spang bya spong dgos pa gcod kyang phyi mas snga ma'i spang bya spong ba mi gcod pa de bzhin yin gsung / rnam gabashad sogs las rong ṭīka pas zhing sbyong tshad bshad pa bkag pa la/'di'i slob ma skyed tshal mkhan pos/ 'o na mi gsal ba'ang gsal ba yin par thal/ sangs rgyas la gsal bar snang ba'i phyir zhes dgag lan mdzad kyang sangs rgyas la mi gsal ba gsal ba yin par ma snang bas dgag pa mi 'gro'ang rigs pa nyams mtshar ba 'ga' re 'dug ste/ rang re rnams kyis bstan bcos la chos 'khor gyis khyab ces pa la/ 'o na 'grel ba don gsal chos can/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor yin par thal/ zhes 'phangs pa 'di la chos 'khor gyi don tshang yang mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor gyi don ma tshang zer dgos sam/sa sde lnga'ang legs phyi'i chos 'khor yin par thal/ sogs 'phang na dka' se ba zhig red gsung / sems can smin tshul du ma yod de/ smin lam zhes pa spyor lam la byas te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ je ltar rma dang zas la de dag gi/zhes sogs ltar sbyor lam gye tshe zag med kyi chos skye ba la nye bas shing thog 301

/ /smin pa longs spyad rung lta bu dang / spang bya mthong spang kha bri ba la nye bas rma smin pa brdol ran pa lta bu yin la/ mthong lam skyes pa na zag med kyi chos la longs spyod pa'i thog ma dang / mthong spang spangs pa na rnag brdol ba la kha btod pa ltar spang bya la kha dod pa yin zhing gos rgyu spun gnyis kyi gcig zad pa dang 'dra bas sgom spang gos trul lta bur gsungs pa yin gsung /de'ang smin pa brgyad yod de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ lus can bral bar smin byed de bzhin du/ / yongs smin rab smin mthun par smin byed gzhan/legs par smin byed rtogs par smin byed dang / / rtag smin gong du smin byed bshad par 'dod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ lus can bral bar smin pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis mgo mnan pa lta bu ma yin par spang bya'i sa bon dang bral ba ste/ phyogs gcig spang ba mthong lam nas kyang 'joga'adi'i yongs su zhes pa ma tshang ba med pa ste phyogs re tsam ma yin par sems can ma lus par smin par byed pa yongs smin dang / phyi rol pa rnams khams 'og ma las chags bral byas te srid rtse'i bar du song yang slar ltung ba'i chos can yin la/ 'dir de lta bu ma yin par rab tu smin pa dang / rang rang gi blo dang 'tsham par chos bstan nas smin pa ni mthun par smin pa dang /rang don gtso bo dang gzhan don zhar byung lta bu ma yin par gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus gnyis kyi sgo nas gzhan don gtso bor byed pa'i legs smin dang / gshegs pa rtogs pa'i don phyir dang / / zhes pa ltar lam gong ma thob pa la rtogs pa'i sgras bshad pas/ 'dir yang rang nyid lam gong mar gshegs nas gzhan der 'god pa ni rtogs par smin pa dang /res 'ga' tsam ma yin par phyin ci ma log pa'i lam la rtag tu 'khrid par byed pa'i rtag smin dang / tshogs lam nas sbyor lam de nas mthong sgom lam 302

༄ zihrūl rim gyis 'god pa ni gong nas gong du spin par byed pa ste brgyad do/ /rnam pa rtags mtshan ma zhes pa'i me'i ngo bo tsha ba dang dmar lam pa lta bu rnam pa/ 'bras bu du ba lta bu rtags rgyu bud shing lta bu mtshan ma la byed de/rnam thar sgo gsum nang gi mtshan ma med pa'ang rgyu la sbyar nas 'jog dgos pas mtshan ma'i skad dod shes na 'di la go rgyu zhig yod rgyu red gsung /mdor bsdus pa las/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang sher phyin la bslab par bya zhes pa'i sher phyin ni spyi tsam yin pas/ de'i nang na nyan thos sogs kyis slob rgyu zhig kyang yod pas 'di shes byed du song ba yin gsung / bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba nyid spang ba can yin no/ / zhes pa 'di la 'khrul nas 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' ngo bo nyid sku yin zer mkhan yang mang po byung gsung / bstan bcos rtsom pa dgos med kyi rtsod lan 'di slob dpon sogs kyis kha bskangs pa yin la/ mdo dang zlos pa'i rtsod lan rje btsun rang gis dngos su gsungs pa yin no/gnyis pa mdo dang zlos skyon spangs te dgos pa yod par sgrub pa ni/skye bo blo gros dman pa zhes sogs byung / 'dir dogs pa khong na gnas pa bsus te zlas skyon med pa'i lan 'debs pa yin la/ dogs pa bsu tshul ni rje btsun byams pas dngos brgyad bstan pa la dgos pa med de/ rnam 'grel las/ thugs brtse ldan phyir rtsom kun yang / / gzhan gyi don du sbyor bar byed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa thugs rje can nyid kyis gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa mi mkhyen pa'ang med la mkhyen bzhin du btang stoms su mdzad pa'ang mi srid pas/ / rno 'bring rtul gsum gang gi dbang du byas kyang yum de dang de las dngos brgyad don bdun cu gsal bar mdzad zin pa ma yin nam ste mdzad zin pa'i phyir/ / des na gdul bya de gsum 303

/ /gang gi don du'ang rtsom mi dgos zhes pa'i dogs pa khong nas bsus te lan gyi don mdor bsdus na skyon med de/ de dus kyi gdul bya rnams kyi don mdzad zin kyang dus dbang gis de tsam gyis rtogs par mi nus pa'i phyi rabs kyi gdul bya blo dman pa rnams kyi don du rje btsun byams pa dang 'grel byed rnams kyis 'di ltar gsal bar byed pa de sangs rgyas rang nyid kyis mkhyen nas gsal bar ma mdzad pa yin pa dang / yum gsum gyi sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa rgyan 'dir gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i nyams len du dril te gsal bar bstan pas bde blag tu rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod ces lan mdzad dgos gsung / spyir bstan bcos la dgos pa yod pa dang / de sgrub nus pa dang / de'ang skye bo mchog gi 'dod bya yin pa dang / brjod bya 'brelabogs pa zhig dgos kyi/ dgos pa med pa bya rog so rtog gi gzhung dang / sgrub mi nus pa 'jog po'i gtsug rgyan len pa'i gzhung dang / dam pa'i 'dod bya min pa ma bag mar len pa gzhon nu ma len gyi gzhung /'brel med pa se'u bcu pa lta bu yin pas de dag mi rung ba'i phyir/ se'u bcu pa ni brjod bya mi 'dra ba bcu bshad pas phal cher drang srong rnams kyis rangagi gsang tshig gzhan gyis shes dogs nas de ltar byas pa yin nam snyam gsung / ma bag mar len pa'i gzhung ni rig sngags shig yin pa 'dra ste/bsgrubs nas rdzas la btab ste me la gtor bas me'i nang nas rung zhes pa'i sgra 'byung ba dang / yang sa cha 'dir mi rung zhes pa'i sgra 'byung ba lta bu zhig yin gsung / bye smras ming tshig gi spyi zhes pa'i ming ni ṭīka chen le'u gsum pa ltar sgra spyi dang / ming brjod bya la zhugs pa'i cha la zer bas/ tshig sogs kun btags dngos med la/ / zhes sogs dang don 'dra la/'dis ni gzhan sde la/ tshig sogs chos can/ brjod bya la 'jug pa'i cha 3yo

ra / /zizug ge bsgo dzadangos po yi ni 'brel ba de ji lta bur na 'jug par 'gyur te mi 'jug par thal/ kun btags pa'i cha de dngos med yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa yin no/theg chen gyi sa lam gyi rim pa ni phyi rol pa dang de'i zlas drangs pa'i gcig shos nang ba'i nyan thos la sogs pa rnams kyis rim gyis nyams su ma myang ste/rjod par byed pa yum dang brjod par bya ba theg pa chen po'i lam zab cing rgya che ba dag thabs dang thabs kyis sgrub par bya ba'i tshul gyes 'brel bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ phyi rol pa theg chen la sdang ba dang nyan rang rnams kyis theg chen gyi sde snod sangs rgyas la nyan nas gzhan la sgogs pa tsam byed kyi/ de dag la dmigs te yun ring por thos bsam sogs mi byed pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po zhes pa'i che tshul la'ang / rgyan las/dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ / zhes sogs ltar dmigs pa che ba sogs bdun dang / theg bsdus las kyang / shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug dang / / de yi rgyu 'bras de rab dbye ba dang / / bslab pa gsum dang de 'bras spangs pa dang / / ye shes theg pa mchog gyur khyad par 'phags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar shes bya'i gnas kun gzhi sogs chen po bcu sogs bshad la/ snga ma'i dmigs pa che ba'ang shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod la dmigs tshul gyi sgo nas yin gsung / ci la'ang ma reg pa zhes pa gzhan dring mi 'jog pa ste/ de'ang gzhan don byed pa'i tshe gzhan la khegs 'gel ba'am/ gzhan gyes bskul dgos pa lta bu ma yin par bsgul ma nang nas byas te gzhan don du chas pa'o/ / chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi/ / zhes pa la/ spyir chos spyod bcu la/ dbus mtha' las/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / / nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / / 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / / de sems pa dang sgom pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi tshas ma5

/spyod bcu dang / rje sa paṇa gyi bstan pa spyi'i rnam gzhag las yan lag bdun pa'i steng du skyabs 'gro dang smon 'jug gi sems skyed gnyis dang bcu la chos spyod bcur gsungs pa sogs yod kyang / 'dir ni byang chub kyi sems dang sbyin pa la sogs pa'i sgrub pa'i spyod pa zhes pa 'di la brten nas rnam bshad kyis sems skyed sogs chos bcu la gsungs pa dang / gser phreng dang phar phyin rtog dka'i snang ba gnyis kyis sbyin sogs phar phyin bcu la gsungs pas/rnam bshad ltar na/ byang chub kyi sems zhes pas chos spyod dang po dang /sprun pa la sogs pa zhes pas go sgrub sogs chos phyi ma bzhi bstan pas bar gyi gdams ngag sogs kyang bstan par bzhed/ gser phreng sogs ltar na byang chub kyi sems dang zhes pas spyod pa'i rten sems skyed dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa zhes pas spyod pa phar phyin bcu bstan par bzhed gsung / chos spyod rab gsal zhes pa'i chos spyod de'ang skyabs 'gro nas spyan 'dren khrus gsol sogs mjug bsngo sgon shis brjod kyi bar cha tshang ba la zer bas gsol 'debs re re tsam la chos spyod zer ba ni/ phyogs gcig la phyogs can gyi ming gis btags pa yin gsung / chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba rtogs pas/ zhes pa la/ sa dang por chos can re re'i steng du chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rang stobs kyis rang gzhan la bden rlom zhi bas/ rjes thob tu sbyin pa gtong ba na lag pa g.yas nas g.yon du spo ba ltar ser sna mi 'byung ba'i sbyin pa'i phar phyin lhag pa dang / sa gnyis par tshul khrims dang /tshul 'chal gnyis bden stong mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i stobs kyis/rjes thob tu spyod pa bag med du mi 'gro bas tshul khrims kyi phar phyin lhag pa dang / mchog gi don du rtogs pa sogs mnyam gzhag gi rtogs tshul dang /rjes thob tu phar phyin lhag tshul la sbyar te phyi ma rnams la'ang 'jog tshul re 306

༄/ /zinasayod gsung /gnyis pa bsdus don ni/ de ltar 'brel ba la sogs pa bstad nas zhes sogs byung / 'di'i skabs su ma 'dzings pa zhes pa'i 'phul can du 'dug pas 'khrugs mi 'gro ba ste/ de'ang skabs brgyad kyi bstan don dngosapo brgyad kyi grangs dang so so'i mtshon byed kyi chos kyi grangs sogs du zhig yod thog mar ma bstan par lu gu rgyud du bshad na/ dngos po brgyad so so'i mgo gang nas tshugs mjug gang du rdzogs pa sogs mi shes par gong 'og 'khrugs par 'gyur bas de sel ba'i phyir dang / don tshan so so'i sa mtshams sogs ma 'dzings pa'am ma 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas rtogs par bya ba'i phyir du sa bcad ltar thog mar lus mdor bstan gsungs pa yin la/de'ang shes rab pha rol/ nas/ de rnams brgyad/ ces pa'i bar gyes dngos po brgyad rkang grangs kyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang / sems skyed pa dang nas bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ ces pa'i bar gyis don bdun cu rkang grangs kyi sgo nas rgyas par bstan pa yin la/ 'di ni gzhung snga ma la ltos te rgyas par bshad pa dang / sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don zhes sogs la lhos te mdor bstan yin gsung / thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ / ces pa'i tshig 'di bstan bshad sbyor ba'i tshig yin la/ bstan bshad sbyor tshul ni/ tshig rkang 'dis/ sems bskyed pa dang zhes pa nas/ nges par 'byung bcas rnams/ zhes pa'i bar gye rgyas bshad 'di rnam kun mkhyen nyid ces pa'i rgyas bshad yin par ngo sbyor byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ mthar gyis pa sogs 'ga' zhig gi bstan bshad spyor ba'i tshig thog ma na yod gsung /chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ / zhes pa'i chos sku ni slob dpon ltar na ye shes chos sku la byed dgos shing / chos sku tsam smos pa ni bstan bshad sbyor 307

da / / 'babasag jalaba'i ched dang sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis yin par gsungs la/ 'phags pa ltar na mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi'i gcig la 'phrin las 'dren dgos pas/de ni mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ zhes pas bstan par 'dod la/ chos sku zhes pa'i tshig 'di bstan bshad sbyor ba'i tshig tu 'jog pa yin gsung /rnam mkhyen rgyu'i sgo nas mtshon tshul ni/ sgrub pa rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu yin la/de'ang rten dmigs pa ched du bya ba sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo ste khyad par bzhi ldan yin pa dang / rten de'ang bsam pa'i khyad par sems bskyed pa/ de gong du 'phel ba'i khyad par gdams ngag sbyor ba'i khyad par nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa/ rigs kyi khyad par chos dbyings te/ khyad par bzhi ldan dang / sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la'ang go sgrub sogs bzhi yod pas/ de ltar na mtshon byed gzhan rnams sgrub pa'i khyad chos dang / theg chen sgrub pa rang nyid rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu yin pas rgyus 'bras bu mtshon pa yin la/ yul gyis yul can mtshon tshul ni/ spyir sa'i rdul dang srin bu'i grangs sogs mkhyen yang rung mi mkhyen yang de'i sgo nas rnam mkhyen du mi 'jog par/thar pa don gnyer rnams kyi thar pa thob pa'i thabs cha tshang zhig mkhyen na de tsam gyis rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa yin pas/ 'dir mtshon byed kyi chos bcu'i rnam mkhyen du bgrod pa'i lam cha tshang zhig bstan pa yin la/ rnam mkhyen gyis de mngon sum du gzigs pas yul gyis yul can mtshon par byed pa yin gsung /gsum pa tshig don la mkhyen gsum/ sbyor bzhi rgyas bshad do/ dang po la rnam mkhyen/ lam shes/ gzhi shes gsum/ dang po bsam pa sems bskyed dang / de'i don ston pa'i gdams ngag dang / gdams don ji ltar sgrub pa'i sgrub pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sems bskyed pa ni zhes 308

rasna / //je (117sogs byung / de'ang spyir dang por gdams ngag nyan/ de nas rigs sad/de nas sems bskyed dgos gsung / 'dir sems bskyed thog mar bstan pa ni/ dper na lha ris mkhan gyis lha sku la ya yo sogs kyi skyon mi 'byung ba'i ched du tshangs thig 'debs pa ltar/ mi rtag pa sgom pa sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba gang byas pa gol sa gzhan du mi 'gro bar sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyur 'gro bal thog mar kun slong ma mtha' sems bskyed bcos ma re tshun chad gsal 'debs dgos par shes pa'i ched du yin par yongs 'dzin rin po che nas thos pa'i man ngag yin gsung / sdud pa dang sbyor ba'i tshe sems bskyed nas spyor ba yin pas/ de'ang 'phags pa sdud pa zhes pa'i 'phags pa ni mdo gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa dang / sdud pa ni dbang 'byor ba'i don yinagasung / 'dir 'khor rnam bzhi tsam gsungs pa ni de dag brtan pa'i 'khoradang / byang sems rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas byon pa sogs yin pas mi brtan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par bshad gsung / dga' dang gus dang zhes pa nas/ mnyan par gyes/ zhes pa'i bar gyi blo ka gcig gis sems bskyed bstan pa yin la/ budha shrīs rkang pa dang po gnyis snod ldan nyan par bskul ba dang / phyi ma gnyis sems bskyed la sbyar yang / slob dpon gyis bzhi ga sems bskyed ston byed kyi gzhung du byas 'dug pas/ dga' dang zhes pas theg pa chen po'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa la dang ba'i dad pa dang / gus dang zhes pas bla med byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i mngon 'dod kyi dad pa/ dad pa'i mchog ces pas bla med byang chub de'ang sher phyin nyams su blangs pa las thob par 'gyur ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba nges pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa bstan la/ sgrib pa nyon mongs bsal nas dri ma las 'das pa/ zhes pas/ lam 'bras thob pa la 309

/gegs byed pas sgrib pa/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag sdug bsngal bar byed pas nyon mongs/ gzhom bya yin pas dri ma zhes so sor bstan la/ 'dis chos sku bstan par byas na rung ngam snyam/ de ltar na dang pos byang chub don gnyer gye 'dun pa dang / 'gro don mngon zhugs zhes pas byang chub 'dod pa de'ang gzhan don du yin pa dang / dpa' rnams zhes pas byang chub sems dpa' dang / spyod pa zhes pas lam la slob tshul bstan pa yin pas/rten gyi gang zag gang gis/ dgos pa gang gi phyir/ yul gang la/ tshul ji ltar bslab par bya ba rnams bstan pa yin gsung / nyi khri'i sems bskyed ston pa'i tshig ni shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' nas/ sher phyin la bslab par bya'o zhes pa 'di dang /brgyad stong pa las rab 'byor khyod byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las bcoms te spobs par byos shig ces pa'i tshig 'di yin la/ 'di'i sher phyin la phyin zin dang phyin byed gnyis byas nas/ gang gis/ gang gi ched du/ gang la/ ji ltar bslab na/ thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas slob tshul sogs theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa cha tshang ba zhig bstan yod pas 'di dag gis sems bskyed bstan gsungs pa yin la/ sems bskyed ston pa la de 'dra zhig dgos te/rang re'i yig cha'i sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid ston skabs su sa bon dang sdom lta bur gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin gsung / sems yul khyad par du 'phags pa snang ba can 'byung ba ma yin nam zhes pas sems bskyed kyi sgra bshad pas slob dpon sogs sems bskyed sems su 'dod mkhan rnams kyis sems dang bskyed pa gnyis so sor mi byed par/ sngar rang don kho na bsam pa de las bzlog ste sems dmigs pa rgya chen por gyur pas na bskyed ces bya ste/ dper na 'jig rten na 'di sngar las sems rgya je cher song yod zer ba 310

༄ zir+sālta bu yin gsung / sems bskyed la 'dod pa'i ming gis 'dogs tshul la gnyis yod pas/ rgyu ming 'bras bu la btags pa'i 'dod pa ni gser phreng ltar na byang chub la dmigs pa dang / rnam bshad ltar na gzhan don la dmigs pa'i 'dod par bshad pas 'di ltar na/ gzhan don phyir 'dod ces tshig gong 'og sbrel nas bstan pa yin nam snyam ste/ skabs 'di 'dra la 'di gnyis kyi don yang mi mthun pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug gsung / de dang de ni mdo bzhin du/ zhes sogs kyi don ni/ yum bar ma'i mdo bzhin du/gzhan gnyis las kyang bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas bshad ces pa'o/ /bsdus pa dang rgyas par bshad pa'i ngag la yum gsum ga 'jog pa 'di slob dpon gyi dgongs pa yin te/ kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar ni/ / zhes pa ltar yum gsum ga'i rgyan du 'grel pa'i phyir/ phyogs glang gis/ de ltar ji skad bshad rnams kyi/ brgyad stong 'dir don ma tshang med/ / 'dir gzhung bsdus pa yin par 'dod/ / don ni ji skad gsung de nyid/ / ces gsungs pa ltar brgyad stong pa gcig pus rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi sgo nas ma bstan kyang / yum gsum ga bsdoms na de ltar bstan byas na chog gsung /sdud pa las/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir nas mthus ma yin/ zhes pa'i bar 'di sems bskyed ston pa'i gzhung de'i zhar byung lta bu yin la/ de'ang gling 'dir chu klung dang me tog sogs ji snyed cig skye ba thams cad mtsho ma dros pa'i mthus 'byung ba bzhin du nyan thos rnams kyis sher phyin la thos sogs byed pa gdul bya gzhan la ston pa de dag gis kyang nyams su blangs nas 'bras bu 'thob pa sogs thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mthus yin par bstan pas/'di'i ston dang 'chad dang rigs pa dag dang / zhes pa'i tshig 'di gsum/brgyad stong pa las/ smra ba dang ston pa dang / nye bar ston pa dang /311

/ /gsal ba dang / brjod pa dang / yang dag par gsal bar byed pa zhes gsungs pa dang don 'dra zhing / de'ang thos byung gi shes rab skye ba'i phyir du tshig 'dzin pa dang / kha ton byed pa sogs kyi sgo nas smra ba dang / bsam byung gi shes rab bskyed pa'i phyir du tshig de'i don 'di dang 'di zhes ston pa dang / sgom byung gi shes rab skyed pa'i phyir du gegs sel bogs 'don gyi sgo nas nye bar ston pa yin la/ gsal ba sogs gsum gyis de gsum bshad pa yin pas don 'dra gsung / gzhung 'di sems bskyed ston pa'i gzhung de'i zhar byung du 'gro tshul ni nyan thos rnams kyis sher phyin gyi mdo sde sogs rang dbang du ston ma nus pa de slob lam du theg chen gye sde snod la dmigs te thos bsam sogs rgya chen po ma byas pa'i dbang gis yin la/ sangs 'phags kyis rang dbang du ston nus pa de rgyu'i dus su sher phyin la thos bsam rgya cher byas pa'i lag rjes yin pas/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas rgyu sgrub pa yin nam gsung /tsha ba 'joms par byed pas ma dros pa dang / gtso bo yin pas klu dbang /bye tshan gyi 'jigs pa med pas klu bdag ces bshad gsung / sbyor lam gong mar 'phos tshad sogs spang bya nyams smad tshul sogs kyis go sla'ang /tshogs lam gsum gyi gong mar 'phos tshad dka' bar snang bas/ 'di la sa paṇa gyi bstan pa spyi'i rnam bzhag tu sbyor lam du 'pho bar ma nges pa dang /nges pa dang myur du 'pho bar nges pa zhes gsungs 'dug cing / rang re'i skabs bzhi par dran pa nyer bzhag sogs gsum gyi gtso bo'i sa mtshams 'dzin tshul sogs la dpag na/ dper na/ nad pa lta bu zhig la mtshon na/sman ngos blangs kyang nad sos mi sos da dung thag mi chod pa dang / sos par thag chod kyang / myur du sos dka' ba dang / myur du sos sla ba'i skabs gsum yod pa ltar/ tshogs lam chung ngu'i tshe nyams mi nyams ma nges 312

da / /zizug bye /smyo 'apa dang / 'bring gi tshe mi dge ba ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa/ skyes pa spong ba sogs gnyen pos mi mthun phyogs kyi dpal gcag pas gser sa 'og tu yun ring por bzhag kyang mi rul ba dang gzhan du mi 'gyur ba ltar nyams pa mi srid kyang myur du 'pho mi nus pa dang / chen po'i tshe chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzinal brten nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi drung du rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nas gdams ngag nyan pas zla tshes nyin re bzhin 'phel ba ltar yon tan gonga'aphel du 'gro bas sbyor lam du myur du 'pho bar nges pa yin gsung /'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed chos can/ sa lta bu yin te/rtsi bcud thams cad sa la brten nas 'byung ba bzhin du/ theg chen gyi yon tan che skyes chung skyes thams cad sems bskyed la brten nas 'byung ba'i phyir/'di'i 'dun pa byang chub thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa la bya zhing / blo gros mi zad pa'i mdor/ dang po 'di sems bskyed la gsungs kyang 'dir 'dod pa'i ming gis btags pas don mi 'gal lo/ / bsam pa dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ gser lta bu yin te/ gser de sa 'og tu ci tsam bzhag kyang mi rul ba dang ngo bo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba ltar/ 'di nas bzung nam yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ lhag bsam dang ldan pa'i de tshas can/zla tshes lta bu yin te/ zla tshes de nyin re bzhin gong 'phel du 'gro ba ltar/'di nas chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas gdams ngag nyan te/dge ba'i chos mtha' dag 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ me lta bu yin te/ mes bud shing bsreg pa ltar/mkhyen gsum gyis sgrib pa'i bud shing mngon gyur pa bsreg pa'i phyir/ mdo sde rgyan las lhag bsam dang ldan pa sbyor lam dang / sbyor ba dang ldan pa tshogs lam la sbyar ba ni/ gser phreng las/ gnyis ga'ang tshogs sbyor 313

/ /gnyis gar 'byung ba shes par byed pa'o/ / zhes pa ltar yin gsung / sbyin pa dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ gter lta bu yin te/ gter gyes gang 'dod ltar tshim par byed kyang mi zad pa bzhin du/ 'di nas sbyin pa'i phar phyin lhag pa dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas chos dang zang zing gis thams cad tshim par byed pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ rin po che'i 'byung gnas lta bu yin te/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs nas rin po che'i rigs gzhan dang gzhan mang po 'byung ba ltar/tshul khrims las ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab sogs yon tan gyi rigs thams cad 'byung ba'i phyir/ bzod pa dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ rgya mtsho lta bu yin te/ rgya mtsho chen po de rlung gis 'dom bdun tsam du g.yo nus kyang gting dkrugs mi nus pa bzhin/ 'di ni mi 'dod pa thams cad thog tu babs pas mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i de chos can/rdo rje lta bu yin te/ rdo rje rin po che de tshur gang gis kyang gzhig mi nus shing phar thams cad la thogs pa med pa ltar/ go cha'i brtson 'grus kyis da lta yan chad kyi dus thams cad nyin zhag gcig tu byas pa'i bskal pa mang por sems can gcig gi don du dmyal bar gnas dgos kyang mi skyo zhing gzhan gyes de las mi phyed pa'i phyir/ 'di'i rdo rje ni rdo dril gyi rdo rje la mi bya bar rdo rje rin po che la byed gsung / bsam gtan dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ri'i rgyal po lta bu yin te/ ri'i rgyal po g.yo mi nus pa bzhin du 'di ni bying rgod dang gtso bor dman pa'i yid byed kyis g.yo mi nus pa'i phyir/ shes rab dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ sman lta bu yin te/ lam gzhan gyis kyang sgrib pa sel yang / sgrib gnyis kyi nad sel pa'i sman gyi dngos gzhi ni shes rab yin pa'i phyir/ thabs mkhas dang ldan pa sogs lnga la blo gros mi zad 314

༄/ /zinabripa'i mdo las/ tshad med bzhi/ mngon shes lnga'am drug bsdu dngos bzhi/ so so yang dag rigs bzhi/ rton pa bzhi dang ldan pa zhes gsungs la mi zad pa gzhan dang sbyor tshul 'di dang 'dra zhing thabs mkhas sogs dang sbyar ba rang ldog dang / tshad med bzhi sogs dang sbyar ba gzhi ldog nas yin pas don gcig tu 'gro zhing / gser phreng nas mi zad pa 'di dag dang gsal bar ma sbyar yang rnam bshad kyis sbyar gsung / mi zad ba brgyad cu ni/ngag ldan las/ sems bskyed bsam spyor lhag bsam dang / / pha rol phyin drug tshad med dag / mngon par shes dang bsdu dngos bzhi/ / so so rig ston tshogs gnyis dang / / byang chub phyogs mthun zhi gnas sogs/ /gzungs bzhi chos kyi mdo bshad dang / / bgrod gcig thabs la mkhas pa'o/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ thabs mkhas dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu yin te/ mdza' bshes kyis rang gi grogs nam yang mi 'dor ba ltar 'dis kyang tshad med bzhi'i sgo nas sems can nam yang mi 'dor ba'i phyir/ smon lam dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ nor bu lta bu yin te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu la mchod na gang 'dod pa 'byung ba bzhin du/gang byas na sems can gyi don du 'gyur/ gang zhig gis phan thogs pa mngon shes kyis gzigs te smon lam btab na gang smon pa 'grub pa'i phyir/stobs dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ nyi ma lta bu yin te/ nyi mas lo tog smin par byed pa bzhin du/ 'dis kyang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas sems can smin par byed pa'i phyir/ de'ang skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis 'jig rten gyephyogs rgya bskyed de rgya chen po byed mdog kha bo dang / phyug po la mdzes mdzes byed pa sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad byas pa min gyi/ gdul bya gang yin tshad 'dul ba la thog ma nas chos bshad na de'i don du 'gyur mi 'gyur 315

/ /du ma zhig yod pas/ dang por/ nga rgyal can la bstod ra dang / / ser sna can la zas nor sbyin/ / zhes pa ltar rang rang gi blo dang 'tsham par byed dgos pas/ skyes bu dam pas de ltar thabs mkhas byas pa de rgyal sras kyi nyams len gyi gtso bo zhig tu go dgos gsung / ye shes dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ glu dbyangs lta bu yin te/ glu dbyangs snyan pos thams cad kyi yid 'dun par byed pa ltar chos don nges tshig spobs pa so so yang dag pa rig pa bzhi'i sgo nas khams dang bsam pa phal cher dang / tshig gang gi sgo nas don gang bstan na don du 'gyur snyam du shes par byas te so so'i skad kyis chos bstan nas 'dun par byed pa'i phyir/ de'ang 'di'i shes rab dngaye shes kyi phar phyin gnyis kyi khyad par ni snga ma ji lta ba rtogs pa dang /phyi ma ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i blor byed pa rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal nas gsungs pa ltar yin gsung / sa bcu pa'i khyad par lam la lnga ni/ mngon shes dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ rgyal po lta bu yin te/ rgyal po chen po des gzhan gyi tshig gi rjes su mi 'brang bar rang gi 'khor tshul bzhin byed mkhan rnams gzengs bstod pa dang / tshul bzhin mi byed mkhan rnams btang snyoms su mi 'jog par tshar gcod cing de lta bu'i tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi sgo nas yul 'khor skyong bar byed pa ltar 'dis kyang 'jam pa dang tsub pa'i nan tur gye sgo nas 'dul bya 'dul ba la thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i phyir/ tshogs gnyis dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ bang mdzod lta bu yin te/ rgyal po'i bang mdzod las/ zas 'dod pa la zas/ gos 'dod pa la gos/ g.yul 'gyed pa la mtshon cha sogs yo byad thams cad 'byung ba ltar/ tshogs gnyis las ye shes chos sku dang mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu/ gsungs dbyangs yan lag drug cu sogs yon tan 316

༄ / /zinasathams cad 'byung ba'i phyir/ byang phyogs so bdun dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ lam po che lta bu yin te/ lam po che'i nang du 'grul ba bzang ngan thams cad 'gro ba ltar/ zeg pa gsum gye 'phags pa thams cad gshegs pa'i shul yin pa'i phyir/ 'di ni byang phyogs spyi la byed gsungs/ snying rje lhag mthong dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ bzhon pa lta bu yin te/ bzhon pa bzangapo zhon te song na g.yan g.yon gyi g.yang sar mi ltung bar 'dod pa'i gnas su skyel ba ltar snying rje dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis kyis srid zhi'i mthar mi ltung bar mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su bgrod par byed pa'i phyir/ gzungs spobs dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ bkod ma'i chu lta bu yin te/ bkod ma'i chu snga ma mang du byung zhing de'i steng du phyi ma mang po gsar du 'byung ba bzhin du/ gzungs kyis sngar mang du thos pa rnams mi brjed par bzung ba'i steng du spobs pas phyi ma skad cig re re la'ang bloka 'bum phrag sogs gsar du 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir/ de'ang bkod ma'i chu ni thang gi dkyil nas yar gyen du 'byung ba'i chu dang / chu mig ni ri'i ngos nas tshur 'byung ba'i chu yin gsung / dga' ston dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ sgra snyan lta bu yin te/ de rna bar snyan pa ltar/ 'dis gdul bya la 'dus byas mi rtag pa sogs snyan par sgrogs pa'i phyir/ de'ang gzhung rgya chen po ci 'dra zhig la bltas kyang / go rgyu cher mi snang ba ni rang gi sems na 'byar rtsi zhig med pa'i rtags yin te/ rgyud smin pa zhig la tshig bzhi 'dis kyang chog pa'i phyir/ des na 'dus byas zhes pa'i tshig 'dis kyang mi rtag par 'grub kyang / rang re rnams la dpal 'byor longs spyod sogs byung bas rtag par snang 'gro/ sdug bsngal zhes pa'ang nyin mo 'gag nas de'i rjes su mtshan mo 'byung ba ltar/ bde ba 'gag pa'i shul du sdug bsngal 3/7

/ /gzhan dang gzhan zhig 'ong ba min gyi/ da ltar sems 'di'i steng na me dong thal bas g.yogs pa ltar bag la nyal ba'i tshul du yod pa de nam zhig rkyen dang 'phrad tshe mngon du gyur 'ongs pa de yin gsung / bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra ste/ chu bo'i rgyun de gzhan du rang gi ngang gis rgyun mi 'chad par 'jug pa'i phyir/ chos sku dang ldan pa'i de chos can/ sprin lta bu yin te/ sprin nas char gyis lo tog smin par byed pa ltar/ mchog gi sprul sku ma dag pa'i gdul bya la dngos su snang nas don mdzad pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'grel bar/ chos thams cad kyi gzhi'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ nas/ kun tu ston par rung ba nyid kyis so zhes pa'i bar gyis dpe don chos mthun sbyor tshul dngos su bstan pa yin gsung /gnyis pa gdams ngag la/ dngos dang / gdams ngag gi don/ sgom pa'i stong nyid la sgom byung skyes pa'i thog ma bshad pa'o/ / dang po la brten pasgrub pa la gdams pa/ sgrub pa'i rten la gdams pa/ sgrub pa'i khyad par gyi chos la gdams pa gsum/ dang po la/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo la 'doms pa/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa la 'doms pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'grel par/dbye ba zhar la brjod nas zhes sogs byung / de ltar sems bskyed pa tsam gyis mi chog par dam bca'i don sgrub pa la 'bad dgos pa dang / de sgrub pa'i thabs shes dgos/ de'ang rang stobs kyis shes mi nus pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyis mnyes par byas te yon tan sngar med gsar du bskyed pa'i rjes bstan dang / skyes zin gong 'phel du byed pa'i gdams ngag nyan pa las rang rgyud smin byed phar phyin drug dang / gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu dngos bzhi la bslab dgos pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'ang yin te/ dper na mi zhig mya ngam gyi thang du lus pa la mi gzhan zhig 'ong 318

༄ ziḥnas ngas khyod bde ba'i gnas su skyel bar bya'o zhes dam bcas pa de'i tshe skyel ba'i gnas dang skyel rgyu'i mi gnyis tsam zhig gi spyi shar bas mi chog par bar na lam ji 'dra zhig yod pa'i spyi 'char dgos pa bzhin du/ sems bskyed kyis kyang dmigs yul byang chub dang gzhan don gnyis tsam zhig la dmigs pasami chog par byang chub der bgrod pa'i lam gyi rim pa gzhan rnams yan lag gi tshul du bsdus te/ zeg pa chen po'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa thams cad dmigs yul du tshud pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/dkar po'i chos thams cad la dmigs pa ni de la srid pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar min na theg chen sems bskyed lam gyi sdoms su 'jog dka' gsung / yongs su bsrung ba'i don ni/ dran shes bzhin gyis bya ra byas te bag la zha ru ma bcug pa'i don yin no/ / sgrub pa'i ngo bo la 'doms pa ni sgrub pa la 'doms pa ste/ 'di ni bcu ga'i chings lta bu yin pas khyad gzhi 'am spyi ldog dang / dmigs yul la 'doms pa sogs ni khyad chos sam bye brag yin la/ de'ang rgyas pa'i sde snod las slob tshul mtha' yas paragasungs pa thams cad bsdus na kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis las mi 'da' zhing / mi 'da' ba'i tshul ni shes rab kyi cha thams cad donadam der bsdus nas shes rab kyi gtso bo stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos pas don dam las mi 'da' ba dang / don dam par med kyang tha snyad sgyu ma tsam du las rgyu 'bras kyi dbang gis mar gyur sems can rnams rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas 'khor bar 'khyam tshul sogs thams cad bston med du 'jog shes pa zhig dgos pas kun rdzob kyi bden pa las mi 'da' ba yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar rigs pa drug cu pa las/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ / zhes sogs ltar 319

/ /gzhi la bden pa gnyis las mi 'da' bas lam la tshogs gnyis las mi 'da' zhing / 'bras bu la'ang sku gnyis las mi 'da' ba'i phyir na/ ngo bo bden gnyis la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag ni gdams ngag thams cad 'dus pa'i sdoms lta bur bzhag pa yin gsung / nyan thos sogs ni rang kho na'i ched du thar pa tsam dang / de la bden zhen gyi sgo nas 'jug pa yin la/ byang sems kyis ni thabs shes kyi cha yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas ched du bya ba chen po gsum gyi don du mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis slob pas na nyan thos sogs dang thun mong ma yin par 'jug pa yin gsung / sems bskyed kyi mdor chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas sher phyin la bslab par bya zhes gsungs pa la ji ltar bslab par bya dris pa'ilan du/ byang chen nyid yod bzhin du byang chen gye ming yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes sogs kyis byang chen dang / de'i ming dang / sher phyin dang / rdzogs byang bzhi ste/ gang gis/ gang gi phyir/ gang la/tshul ji ltar bslab tshul rnams don dam par med kyang tha skad du nyams su longs shig ces ngo bo la 'doms pa yin la/ kha cig 'di'i ming la ming gzhi'i phung po 'jog zer ba yod kyang skabs don min pa 'dra gsung /brgyad stong pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'am byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyang bdag gis ma 'tshal ma dmigs yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes sogs 'di sgrub pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin zhing / ma 'tshal ba sogs ni thos bsam sgom gsum la sbyor ba dang / dbang shes kyis ma mthong bas ma 'tshal ba dang / rtog bcas kyis ma dmigs pa dang / de gnyis gas yang dag par rjes su ma mthong zhes pa'i don no/ / sdud pa las/gang la shes rab pha rol phyin mchog nas/ bde gshegs shes rab spyod/ /320

ra / /zizug ge bsgo dzaces pa'i bar gyis blo gcig sgrub pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag ste/'di'i sher phyin la bslab par bya/ zhes pa'i sher phyin de yin la/ de'ang byang sems kyi gdags gzhi sems bskyed de rten du byas te tha stad tsam du sher phyin nyams su len pa la mi rmongs shing / don dam par med pa la mi skrag pa'i byang chen de ni rgyal bas bsngags pa'i sher phyin la spyod pa yin zhes pa'i don no/ / sh+lau ka 'di gdams ngag la sbyor ba'i khungs dngos su ni/ de skad thos nas zhes pa'i tshig 'di yin gsung / 'bras mchog gam dang po zhes pa ni bskal pa dang por ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sa lu byung ba de la byas na rung zhing / 'od ma bcad dka' ba zhes pa'i 'od ma ni shing gzhu byed pa'i shing gcod dka' ba zhig yod pa de yin no/ / nyi snang las/skabs 'di dag las 'phros te myang 'das brgyad gsungs pa ni/ rtse mo nas dge rtsa chad pa'i myang 'das dang / bzod pa nas ngan 'gro'i myang 'das dang / bsam gdan thob pa rnams kyis yan lag las 'das pa ste/mdzod las/ yan lag snga snga spangs pa yi/ / zhes pa ltar yan lag snga ma snga ma la chags zal bras pa lta bu dang / rgyun zhugs pas srid pa nyer brgyad las 'das pa dang / phyir 'ong gis rigs mthun pa'i srid pa gnyis las 'das pa dang / phyir mi 'ong gis 'dod pa las 'das pa dang / lhag bcas lhag med kyi myang 'das dang brgyad do/ / brgyad po 'di dag mdo las kyang gsungs la/ myang 'das dngos min pa la'ang myang 'das su gsungs pa du ma zhig yod pas na dgongs pa can gye myang 'das kyang myang 'das yin mi dgos shing / rang re'i yig char dgos pa can gye myang 'das dang / zhes pa dang sgra sbyar ba ma dag pa yin nam snyam gsung / dmigs yul bden bzhi la 'doms pa ni/ sdug bsngal la zhes gnas gzhi dang 321

/'bras bu'i cha nas dang gzugs sogs kyi stong nyid dang de rtogs pa'i sher phyin dag don dam par med do zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas tha snyad du sdug bsngal nad ltar shes par zhes 'doms so/ / kun 'byung la rgyur gyur pa zhes pas rgyu'i cha nas dang / gzugs sogs nas don dam par ma yin no/zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas tha snyad du las nyon las skyes pa'i skye ba dang / de nas rim gyis rga ba dang na ba sogs sdug bsngal gsum gyis 'joms par byed pas 'gag pa dang da lta kun nas nyon mongs par byed pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na dag pa'i tshe rnam par byang ba yin pas kun 'byung spang bar bya zhes 'doms so/ / 'gog pa la 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid skye 'gag gnas skabs kyi khyad par du ma gcig tu song ba'i nyams pa gcig du mar song ba'i 'phel ba/ spang gnyen gyi mtshan nyid kun byang sogs dang bral ba'i phyir don dam par gzugs nas byang chub kyi bar gang du'ang ma grub bo zhes pas tha snyad du mngon du bya bar 'doms so/ / lam la don dam par sbyin sogs drug dang stong nyid nyi shu dang sngon gyi mtha' 'das pa dang phyi ma'i mtha' ma 'ongs pa sogs phan tshun ldan pa dang mi ldan pa ma yin pa nyid du sgrub pa'o zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas tha snyad du lam bsgom par bya zhes 'doms so/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i rten la 'doms pa ni/ sangs rgyas la zhes sogs byung /de'ang rnam mkhyen de sangs rgyas su byed pa'i byed chos kyi gtso bo yin pas de la 'doms pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag tu 'jog dgos la/ don dam par rnam mkhyen dang gzugs sogs phan tshun mi sbyor zhes pa'i tshig gis tha snyad du chos thams cad sgyu ru ra ltar rtogs pas yul yul can du sbyor bar bya zhes 'doms so/ / 'dir kha cig gzugs sogs la rnam mkhyen mi sbyor bar gsungs pa'i don/ rnam mkhyen gyis de 322

ra / /14da bsgo khyedag la bden par mi zhen pa la byed pa yod kyang / de ltar na 'grel ba 'dir rnam mkhyen la gzugs sogs mi sbyor bar gsungs pa bshad thabs mi rnyed pas mi 'thad gsung / mkhyen gsum chos dkon mchog gi gtso bo yin pas de la 'doms pa chos dkon mchog la 'doms pa yin gsung /gsum pa sgrub pa'i khyad par gyi chos la 'doms pa ni/ 'grel bar/brtson 'grus brtsams pa nyid kyis zhes gsungs/ mi mthun phyogs mngon gyur sel bar 'doms pa'i mi mthun phyogs ni/ spyod 'jug las/ le lo ngan la zhen pa dang / / sgyid lug bdag nyid brnyas pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'jig rten gye bya ba ngan pa la sdug rus byed pa ni brtson 'grus min la bya ba ngan zhen gyi le lo yin pas chos la 'jug pa'i gegs kyi gtso bo yin zhing spang dgos te/ tshe 'di'i mtho grags dpal 'byor sogs phun tshogs thams cad rdo bdar ba'i dpe ltar gru bzhi lam me byas tshar ba dang shul du cam gyis bzhag ste rang gcig pu 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro dgos pas bslu bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na tshe 'di'i bya ba ngan pa la mi zhen par dam pa'i chos la bag chags ci nus su 'jog rigs te/ 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang tshe rabs gzhan du chud zos par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ sa skya paṇa chen gyes/ tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / / skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/nor la rang nyid len dang mtshungs/ / zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas/de nyid shes pas gal te 'dir/ / mya ngan 'das pa ma thob kyang / / skye ba gzhan du 'bad med par/ / thob 'gyur nges pa'i las bzhin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyi ma 'di'i don la rje sa paṇa gyis/ dper na las de skye ba phyi mar rang gis brjed kyang / las kyis gang zag rang mi gtong bar rnamaspen la sbyor bar byed pa bzhin du/ stong nyid sogs la tshe 'dir thos 323
