/dang / byang chub sems dpa' ni nyan thos la sogs pa'i gtam smra ba dang yid la byed pa skyed par byed pa de lta bu'i nang du gnas mi rung bar gsungs paltar/ grong gi dur khrod la dga' bar gyur na 'og ma dang 'grogs pas gong mar 'gro ba shin tu dka' la 'og ma dang 'grogs pas nyams par 'gyur ba la tshegs med pas de dag gi shan zhugs nas rang gi spyod pa las nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na grong gi dur khrod la dga' bar mi rigs te/spyod 'jug las/ rus gong 'ga' zhig mthong nas ni/ / dur khrod du ni yid 'byung na/ / g.yo ba'i rus gong gis khyab pa'i/ / grong gi dur khrod la dga' 'am/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan dad par byed pa dang /tshul khrims la 'god pa sogs kyi ched du min par rang gis rnyed bkur thob tu re nas rang gi yon tan spyom pa'i sgo nas gzhan la sgog par byed pa dang /gzhan la de mkhas kyang de'i tshul khrims sogs kha ral sna ral du song zhes smod par byed pa dang / bdag la bstod pa dang gzhan la smod pa sogs la dga' bar byed mi rigs te/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag la smod pa gzhan yod na/ / bstod pas bdag dgar ci zhig yod/ / bdag la bstod pa gzhan yod na/ / smad pas mi dgar ci zhig yod/ / sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ / rgyal bas kyang ni mi mgu na/ / bdag 'dra ngan pas smos ci dgos/ / de bas 'jig rten bsam pa gtang / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / mi dge ba'i las lam bcus bde 'gro tsam yang thob par mi nus na sangs rgyas thob par ga la nus te mi nus pa'i phyir na spang rigs pa yin te/'jug pa las/ rmi lam du yang 'chal khrims dri ma spangs/ / lus ngag yid kyi rgyu ba dag gyur pas/ / dam pa'i las lam bcu char sog par byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshe 'dir rnyed pa dang thos pa la sogs pas gzhan 370

da / /—slon 'ibasgo sdesu la'ang 'jigs mi dgos pa lta bu rlom sems byas na/ phyi mar sus kyang mi rtsi zhing thams cad la 'jigs dgos pa zhig 'ong bas/ nga rgyal ni rnam pa thams cad du spang dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag ni rnyed mang bkur ste bcas/ / bdag la mang po dga' 'o zhes/ / de 'dra'i snyems pa 'chang gyur na/ / shi ba'i 'og tu 'jigs pa skye/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/dge ba dang mi dge ba la bzlog ste/ zhes pa ni mdo las dge mi dge la bden par zhen pa la gsungs shing / 'dir go sla ba'i dbang du byas te dge ba la mi dge bar 'du shes pa dang / mi dge ba la dge bar 'du shes pa la gsungs la/ rtsa bar phyin ce log ces gsungs pas de'i gnyen por 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / log par lta ba la sogs pa/ / zhes pa la rgyan snang las/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba zhes sogs 'byung bas/ kha cig log lta mthong spang yin pas 'di'i log lta phung po'i gnas lugs la phyin ci log tu lta ba'i 'jig lta la byas nas sogs khongs nas mthar lta 'don zer ba yod kyang / de ltar na 'di'i mdo las the tshom zhes 'byung ba mi 'thad dgos te mthong spang yin pa'i phyir ro/ / des na 'di'i sogs khongs nas lta ba bzhi bton nas lnga ga la gsungs te/ skabs 'dir sa lnga pa'i ngos skal byas te dngos gnyen gyis sgong dgos par gsungs pa min yang sngar spangs zin pa thag bsring pa'i gnyen po'i sgo nas gsungs pas skyon med do/ / thon mongs bzod ces pa ni / dper na bzod pa ni gnod pa byas pa la lan mi byed par bag yangs su 'jog pa la zer ba ltar/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa byung ba'i tshe kho rang gi gang 'dod ltar bag yangs su 'jog pa ste/ mdo las nyams rengs su byed pa zhes pa'ang de yin la/ bag yangs su btang bas nyes pa thams cad la sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir/ de'i gnyen po chags 37/

/ /sogs mi dmigs par sgom par byed do/ / de ltar na rnyed bkur sogs kyi rgyu las rnam g.yeng 'byung la/ de'i steng du lta ba lnga dang / chags sogs nyon mongs thams cad kyis rub brgyab nas 'ong zhing 'du bar 'gyur bas/de rnams kyi gnyen po sgo gsum bag yod la brtson par rigs te/ spyod 'jug las/ sems ni rnam par g.yeng ba'i mi/ / nyon mongs mche ba'i phrag na gnas/ / lus dang sems ni dben pa yis/ / rnam par g.yeng ba mi 'byung ngo / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na sa lnga pa'i yongs spyong gi skabs 'di dang / spyod 'jug gi bsam gtan gyi skabs 'di gnyis rtsa 'grel lta bur snang la/ rang re'i yig char spyod 'jug gi bsam gtan gyi le'u'i skabs su 'jug sdom cho gas blangs te bdag gzhan mnyam rje'i sgo nas byang chub kyi sems sbyong tshul bstan par gsungs pa'ang skabs 'di dag yin zhing / gong du bshad pa'i rang gi rnyed pa 'dod pa dang / gzhan gyi rnyed pa 'gog pa sogs go bzlog na bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sems sbyong tshul du 'gro ba dang / 'grel pa 'dir yang bsam gtan gyi mi mthun phyogs la zeg pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa bzhag pa sogs gzhung gong 'og bsgrigs nas dpyad na go ba chen po zhig chags par snang gsung / snga ma bzhin du yongs spyong bcus sa lnga pa zhes pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar mi dmigs pas rgyas 'debs dgos par gsungs pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang mdo las thabs kyi cha gang gsungs pa'i tshe mi dmigs par yid la bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / shes rab kyi cha gang gsungs pa'i tshe rnam mkhyen dang ldan pas yid la bya'o zhes gsungs pa de/ thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas nyams su len dgos par shes pa'i ched yin gsung / sa drug pa la yongs sbyong bcu gnyis yod pas phyi ma drug snga ma drug gi lag rjes yin la/ de'ang 372

ra / /:sgo ji /sgo 'arnam bshad ltar na nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi sa mi 'dod pa tshul khrims dang bsam gtan gyi lag rjes dang / mi dmigs pa la mi skrag pa chos la nges sems kyi bzod pa'i lag rjes dang / bslang na mi zhum pa dang / btang yang mi dga' med pa gnyis sbyin pa brtson 'grus kyi lag rjes dang / dbul yang slong ba mi spong ba shes rab kyi lag rjes yin la/ gser 'phreng ltar na go rim thar chags su sbyor dgos shing / tha ma shes rab kyi lag rjes su 'gyur tshul longs spyod med nas sbyin pa gtong ma nus pa min gyi/ shes rab med pas sbyin pa gtong ma nus pa yin te/ shes rab yod na bdag pos ma bzung ba'i phyir/ ri rab dang tshal la sogs pa gtang chog pa dang / skyes rabs su'ang bdud kyis bar chad brtsams pas yo byad thams cad mi snang bar byas kyang rtswa btus te sbyin par btang ba dang / rtag ngus chos 'phags bsten pa'i tshe bdud kyis chu'ang mi snang bar byas kyang rang gi rtsa bo che la sogs pa gtar nas khrag gis chag chag btab par gsungs pa lta bu yin pas longs spyod dang ldan pas sbyin pa gtong ba shes rab la mi ltos kyang longs sbyod med par sbyin pa gtong ba shes rab la ltos dgos pas/ bkren yang slong ba mi spong ba shes rab kyi lag rjes su bzhag pa yin gsung / 'di shes rab kyi phar phyin lhag thob dang sbyor dgos par shes rab rdzogs pas zhes pa 'dis bstan pa yin nam snyam ste/ spyir rdzogs pa tsam 'di nas ma thob pas rdzogs zhes pa lhag thob dang phar phyin drug ga'i mtha'i gsal byed du byas nas sa 'dir drug pa dang / sa lnga bar lnga lhag pa nas sa dang por gcig lhag pa'i bar bstan pa dang / brgyad stong pa las kyang theg pa chen po la ji tsam gyis zhugs pa yin dris pa'i lan du phar phyin drug gi sgo nas 'jug par gsungs pas phar phyin lhag thob la sbyar ba 'di mdo dang rtsa ba'i dgongs pa yin nam 373

/snyamagasung / yang na spyod 'jug las/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni/snardo rdo ༵hā~X rno la na dadī diXng ༷ba/ kyi pha/ sdi dhi/ ༵nga ni ༷ ṭ+wāṃde/sa paX dī /rdo pa la byed gsung / shes rab la dbye na ji snyed pa rtogs pa/ ji lta ba rtogs pa/ gzhan don sgrub byed kyi thabs rig gnas shes pa'i shes rab dang gsum/ yang na rgya che ba'i lam rtogs pa'i shes rab/ zab mo'i lam rim rtogs pa'i shes rab/ gzhan don sgrub tshul rtogs pa'i shes rab dang gsum yod la/ theg chen pa zab mo lta ba'i sgo nas ma yin par gtso bor thabasakyi sgo nas nyan rang las khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas dga' dang zhes pa yan chad kyis rgya che ba'i lam rim rtogs pa'i shes rab dang gsum skrag pa'i sems spangs pa zhes pas zab mo'i lam rim rtogs pa'i shes rab bstan la/ phyi ma gsum gyis spyor dngos mjug gsum gye sgo nas gzhan don sgrub tshul gyi shes rab bstan pas spyor ba'i dus su phangs pa med par gtong ba la spro bas mi zhum pa dang / dngos gzhi'i dus su yid 'gyur nas rtse gnyis su 'gro ba lta bu ma yin par sems mi 'gyur zhing rtse gcig tu gnas pas mi dga' ba med pa dang / thams cad btang tshar ba'i rjes su'ang nga la yo byad mi 'dug snyam du 'gyod pa sogs mi bskyed pa ste/ mdor na gzhan don sgrub pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gang gi skabs su'ang ma rmongs pa'i shes rab cig dgos pa yin gsung / sa bdun pa'i yongs spyong ni spang bya nyi shu dang gnyen po nyi shu yod pa 'grel pa gzhan rnams kyis go rim dkrugs nas sbyar yang /rgyan snang dang sher sgon las go rim thar chags su sbyar ba ltar 'grel chung 'dir yang sbyar bas/ de'ang bdag gi ngo bo bden par lta ba'i gnyen por rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma bcu la mtshan mar 374

das / /13 /blo rnyegasungs shing sems can gye ris so sor 'byed pa'ang de 'dra zhig gi steng nas 'jog dgos pas/ sems can gyi mtshan ma'am ris so sor don dam par zhen pa'i gnyen por mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / smon pa ni khams gsum la smon pa zhes gsungs pas da lta'i phung po la mi 'bral bar sred pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i phung po la thob 'dod kyi sred pa ste lus sems rten brten pa'i 'brel ba ma chad pa srog yin la/ de la zhen pa ni da lta'i phung po dang mi 'bral bar sred pa'i rnam par lta ba yin pas/ de'i gnyen por smon med kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / las gsog pa po'i bdag tshugs thub hring de ba med pas cha med pa'i gcig pu'i bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen por bsad bya dang bsod pa po dang gsad pa sogs dang / sbyin pa dang tshul khrims sogs kyis 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa dang / chad par lta ba'i gnyen por snying brtse ba ste/ chad par lta ba'ang gser 'phreng nas sems can tshe 'phos nas rgyun chad par 'dzin pa la gsungs shing / spyir rnam bshad dang /gser 'phreng gnyis kyi tshig gi nus pa 'don lugs kyang rnam bshad kyis nyams len la sbyar nas gsungs pa dang / gser 'phreng gis bshad pa mtha' chod par byed te zhar la dogs pa chung ngu re yod pa'ang bcad nas gsungs pa yin la/ rnam bshad ltar na sems can 'khor ba thog med nas da lta'i bar rgyun ma chad par byung ba dang / sdug bsngal bar ma chad du myong bas de la snying rje skye tshul bstan pa yin no/ / bden grub kyis rtag par lta ba'i gnyen por rlom med dang / tha snyad du bzang ngan yod kyang grib ma la mi 'dra ba med pa ltar/ tha snyad du 'khor 'das la blang dor so sor 'byed kyang chos dbyings su ro gcig pas don dam par blang dor gyi mtshan ma so sor 'dzin pa'i gnyen por srid zhi mnyam nyid du rtogs pa dang / theg gsum la 375

/ /rgyu tha dad pa gsum yod pas mthar thug theg pa gsum du 'dzin pa'i gnyen por nyan rang gnyis kyang mthar 'tshang rgya bas mthar thug gi rgyu gcig tu rtogs pa dang / phung po bden par 'dzin pa'i gnyen por ming gzugs don dam par mi skye bar rtogs pa dang / khams bco brgyad la bden par zhen pa'i gnyen por bzod shes dang / skye mched rnams don dam par yul yul can du zhen pa'i gnyen por yul dang yul can phan tshun ltos par rtogs pa dang / khams gsum don dam par gnas par 'dzin pa'i gnyen por rtog pa kun tu 'joms pa dang / ras gsher ba la rdul chags pa ltar chags pa'i rlan dang bcas pas mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dang / lta ba lnga dang nyon mongs thams cad 'dren par byed pas de'i gnyen por 'du shes lta dang nyon mongs spong bar byed pa dang / sems can grangs mang ba dang /de'i don du thob rgyu sangs rgyas de'ang khyad par 'phags pas rgyu'i ngo bo sogs gang gi dbang du byas kyang mi nus snyam du zhum pa'i dman pa'i yid byed kyi gnyen por theg pa chen po las mi phyed pa'i sems rtse gcig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i tshe'ang 'bras bu sangs rgyas la bden zhen 'gog dgos shing / bden zhen bkag pas chos sku dang /bsod nams bsags pas gzugs sku ste thabs shes zung du 'brel bas 'bras bu chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis zung du 'brel ba 'thob pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog la lta ba'i gnyen por lhag mthong dang thabs la mkhas par byed pa yin la/ sngags kye skabs chos gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa la rgyu'i dus su'ang de gnyis dang cha 'dra ba'i stong pa nyid dang lha sku bsgom pa gnyis ka yod dgos pa yin gsung / chos su lta ba'i gnyen por sems nye bar zhi ba dang /dge 'dun la lta ba'i gnyen por thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang / tshul 376

sa / /zin byes ltadza 11stegokhyems la lta ba'i gnyen por thams cad la mngon par ma zhen pa dang / sher phyin gye don phyin drug la slob pa dang bden par med pa gnyis 'gal bar rtsod pa de yum don la thos ba rgya chen por byas te bzlog dgos pas de'i gnyen por zhing khams du mar sangs rgyas las gdams ngag rgya chen po nyan pa dang /de la bden gnyis 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i gnyen po rang gis shes nas bden gnyis mi 'gal ba'i tshul gzhan la ston par byed pa de yin gsung / sa brgyad pa'i yongs sbyong la bzhi tshan gnyis yod cing / de'ang sa 'dir sgon lam gyi phar phyin rdzogs pa yin la/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las kyang sa 'dir mngon shes dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed gsungs shing / gang gi don dusgon lam 'debs yul gyi gdul bya dang smon lam 'debs tshul sogs mi shes par smon lam btab kyang mun nag nang du rdo 'phang ba ltar 'gyur bas/gzhan don sgrub tshul la ma rmongs pa'i mngon shes kyi steng nas smon lam gye phar phyin rdzogs dgos pas na/ 'dir yang mngon shes kyis gdul bya zhing khams gang na yod pa'i sems kyi spyod pa sogs rab tu shes pa dang / zhing khams der rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba dang / zhing sbyong ba la rten dang brten pa sbyong ba gnyis yong bas/ mdo sde rgyan las/ zhing dang ye shes las dag la/dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar zhing dag sbyor ba thob pas rten zhing sbyong ba dang / yum don thos bsam gyis brtag par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas mnyes par byed pa rtsa ba dang / sangs rgyas mnyes par bya ba'i phyir yum don la thos bsam sgom gsum byed par 'grel pas gsungs pa ltar gnyis ga'ang phan tshun rgyu can yin pas de dang / gdul bya'i dbang po mchog dman shes pa dang / brten pa bcud sbyong ba dang / sgyu ma ltar gnas pa dang / bsam bzhin skye ba len pa dang brgyad do/ / sa dgu pa'i 377

/yongs sbyong ni sa brgyad par smon lam gyi phar phyin lhag pa'i stobs kyis sa 'dir yang yon tan 'di dag thob pa yin nam snyam ste/ de'ang blo gsal gling bas sa dgu par so sor yang dag rig pa bzhi mtshan nyid pa thob par 'dod la/ rang lugs la rjes mthun pa yin zhing / nges tshig dang spobs pa yang dag rig pa gnyis dngos su bstan pas chos don yang dag rig pa gnyis shugs la bstan pa yin gsung / de'ang lha klu gnod sbyin sogs kyi skad shes shing de dag gi skad kyis chos ston pa'i nges tshig so so yang dag rig pa dang / gzhan la chos ston pa la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar mi zad pa'i spobs pa so so yang dag rig pa dang / 'di 'dra zhig gi steng nas stobs kyi phar phyin rdzogs par 'jog gsung / bud med kyi skyon lnga dang bral ba'i yum sgyu ma lhum mdzes lta bu'i mngal du 'jug pa dang / rgya gar pa rigs la gtso bor byed pas rgyal po la sogs pa'i rigs su skyes pa dang / de'ang rgyal rigs dang bram ze'i rigs gnyis gtso bo yin la/bdag cag gi ston pa'i dus su kun gyis rgyal rigs la mchog tu brtsi bas rgyal rigs su skyes pa dang / byams pa'i dus su bram ze'i rigs la mchog tu brtsi bas bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pa yin gsung / rus phun sum tshogs par skyes pa ni bur shing gi tshal du go ta ma'i khu khrag gi thigs pa gnyis sa la lhung ba drangasrong mdog nag gis bskyangs pa nyi 'od kyis smin par byas pa las skyes pas na bu ram shing pa dang nyi ma'i gnyen zer ba lta bu yin gsung / cho 'brang ni rang gi ma'i bdun brgyud tshun chad dang 'brel ba'i gnyen dang /rang dbang ba'i 'khor ni dgos don rang gi 'dod pa ltar sgrub pa'i 'khor dang / brgya byin sogs kyis bstod par skye ba ni bdag cag gi ston pa 'di sku bltams pa'i tshe brgya byen gyis ka shi ga'i ras kyi nang du blangs te ched du 378

ra / /zizug ge /sgo sdebarjod pa dang / khrus mdzad pa lta bu yin gsung / nges par 'byung ba ni gnas gtsang ma'i lha dge slong gi cha byad du 'ong ba dge slong dngos yin min rtsod pa yod kyang de gzigs pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis 'khor ba las yid 'byung ste rab tu byung ba dang / byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs pa ni bdag cag gi ston pa'i a shād tha dang / byams pa'i klu shing sogs yin pas/ 'di dag rjes mthun pa sa dgu pa 'di nas thob pa'am/ yang na 'grub byed kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu sa 'di nas thob pa la bya ste/ gser 'phreng las kyang 'di dag rjes mthun pa ma byas par dngos gnas par bshad 'dug pas sa dgu par 'di dag 'grub byed kyi thon mong ma yin pa'i rgyu thob pa byas na legs gsung / /sa bcu pa ni/ sgrub pa'i rten/ dmigs pa/ ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo dang bzhi yod pa'i nang nas sgrub pa'i ngo bo la'ang bsam pa rgya che ba go sgrub/ spyor ba rgya che ba 'jug sgrub/ tshogs gnyis rgya che ba tshogs sgrub/ rnam mkhyen gdon mi za bar nges par 'byin pa'i nges 'byung sgrub pa dang bzhi yod pas/ tshogs sgrub la'ang snying rje nas gnyen po'i tshogs kyi bar bcu bdun yod pa'i nang nas rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa la'ang sa dang gnyen tshogs gnyis rtsa bar gsungs shing / ye shes kyi tshogs 'grel pas kha bskang ba dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa las rgyu'i sa yongs sbyong gi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa yan chad song zin nas/ sa bcu pa de slob lam la ltos te khyad par du 'gror med cing mthar thug pas na 'bras bu'i sa dang yongs sbyong rnams kyang dri ma sel ba dang byi dor byed pa la sbyong zer ba ltar/ skyon sel ba dang yon tan rdzogs pa'i sgo nas sa gong mar bgrod par byed pa la 'jog pas slob lam gyi dbang du byas nas khyad par du 379

/'gror med pas sa 'di la yongs sbyong ma gsungs kyang / mi slob lam la ltos te gong du 'gror yod cing rgyu'i sa rnams kyi yongs sbyong bshad pa thams cad sa 'di la yar ldan du yod pa'i sgo nas sa 'dis mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod par byed pa'i phyir na/ yongs sbyong don gyis 'phangs pa yin pas sa 'di la yongs spyong chad pa'i skyon du'ang mi 'gyur gsung / sa dgu 'das nas zhes pa'i 'da' bya sa dgu ni/ dman pa sa brgyad dang / sa dang po rab dga' nas/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros kyi bar dgu la byang chub sems dpa'i sa zhes gcig tu bgrang bas dgu po de 'in la/ de'ang gsung rab gzhan las dman pa sa brgyad kyi dang po la dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa 'jog par gsungs shing de tshogs lam dang / rigs kyi sa spyor lam nas 'jog pa dang / sprir dkar chos dge ba thams cad la dkar po zhes gsungs kyang / 'dir nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'i thar lam la byas nasade thog mar mthong ba'am thob bas na dkar po rnam par mthong ba zhes bya'o/ / de ltar na 'da' bya sa bcu yod par 'gyur ba dang / 'di'i bshad bya'i yum gyi mdo nas rigs kyi sa dman pa sa brgyad kyi dang po la gsungs pa dang mthun par 'grel pa 'dir yang rigs kyi sa dang por gsungs la/ de'ang nyan thos la sogs pa'i rigs dang zhes sogs brgyad kyis ming de dag gang la 'jug pa'i gzhi'i don brgyad po ngos bzung nas/rigs dang / brgyad pa dang / zhes sogs kyis ming gi sgo nas bshad pa yin gsung / rigs kyi sa sbyor lam nas 'jog ste/ spyir rigs nges pa tsam tshogs lam nas yod kyang / rang gis rtogs pa'i sgo nas rigs nges pa sbyor lam nas thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin la/ bshad tshul gzhan yang mdzod las/ gnyis slob rigs las bzlog nas ni/ / sangs rgyas su 380

ra / /zizug ge /sgo sde'agyur gzhan gsum yang / / zhes drod rtse gnyis las theg chen lam du 'jug pa dang / bzod pa nas rang rgyal lam du 'jug pa yod par bshad pas/ bzod pa nas dman lam du nges pa dang / bzod chen nas rang lam du rigs nges pa yin no/ / 'on kyang rang rgyud pas spyor lam nas rang lam du rigs nges par 'dod/ zhugs 'bras brgyad kyi dgra bcom nas yar bgrang ba'i brgyad pa yin pas brgyad pa'i sa dang / bden pa mngon sum du thog mar mthong bas mthong ba'i sa dang / srab pa dang mthug pa zer ba ltar 'dod nyon drug spangs nas gsum tsam lus pa'i srab par byas pas srab pa'i sa dang / 'dod nyon skor dgu spangs pas 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang / dgra bcom thob tshe 'di ltar bya ba byas so/ / 'di las srid pa gzhan mi shes so zhes sogs gsungs par 'gyur ba dang / gong du bshad pa'i slob lam rnams kyi sgrub pa'i bya ba myang 'das thob pas byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang / tshul dang lam dang lugs rnams don gcig pa ltar 'dir yang zeg pa'i tshul gsum rnam par bzhag par rje btsun byams pa sogs kyis dgongasanas sam/ theg gsum gye rab dbye shes pa'i ched dang / zhugs pa phyi ma gsum mthar gyis pa'i dbang du byas nas 'bras gnas su 'du'ang mtha' gcig tu 'dra ba'i nges pa med pas de'i dbang du byas te phyi ma gsum la nyan thos kyi sa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / sa dang po rab dga' nas dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros dang dgu la byang chub sems dpa'i sa zhes gcig tu byas pa'i sa dgu las 'das pa ste/ 'da' tshul la bltas nas 'da' ba dang / gnas nas 'da' ba gnyis yod pas/ nyan rang gi spangs rtogs thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi byed par 'dus shing /gdul bya nyan rang gi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i ched du gang zag gi bdag 381

/ /med phyi rol don stong mngon sum du mthong zhing ngo bo tsam rdzogs kyang gtso bo sgom par mi byed pa shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' ba dang / sa dang por yongs sbyong gi sgo nas gtso bor nyams su blangs te yongs su rdzogs pa na sa gnyis par 'phos pa sogs yongs sbyong gi sgo nas gtso bor nyams su blangs te yongs su rdzogs pa nas gong ma gong mar 'phos pa ni gnas nas 'da' ba'i don yin pas byang chub sems dpa'i sa las gnas nas 'da' ba yin gsung /sa dgu las 'das nas sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i de la 'bad la rags pa zhi bas mdzad pa lhun grub sangs rgyas dang cha 'dra bar yod cing 'od zer chen po'i dbang bsgur sogs thob nas sangs rgyas zhes brjod la/ spangs rtogs sangs rgyas dang mi mnyam pa dang / gong du 'gror yod pa de shes pa'i ched du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes ma brjod pa yin gsung / gnyen po'i tshogs ni spyir gzung 'dzin rtog pa 'dzin tshul dang / dmigs yul gyi sgo nas 'jog dgos pa sogs yod kyang /'dir ni yul gzung ba la kun nyon gzung rtog dang / rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis dang / yul can 'dzin pa la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis dang bzhi yod cing kun btags bzhi'i gnyen por mthong lam bzhi dang / lhan skyes bzhi'i gnyen por sgom lam bzhi 'byung bas gnyen po tshogs sgrub brgyad yod pa yin gsung / /nges 'byung sgrub pa ni gong du bshad pa'i ched du bya ba chen po gsum dang / byang sems kyi don gtso bo la rang don dang gzhan don gnyis yod pa'i rang don gyi rgyu'i dbang du byas nas chos thams cad bden stong mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dang / ngo bo'i dbang du byas nas sems can gyi don byed pa dang / mtshan ma med par lhun gyis grub pa gnyis dang / rang don 382

ra / /lnga'i ji 3sgo sdela'ang spangs rtogs gnyis las rtogs pa la'ang ji lta ba rtogs pa dang / ji snyed pa rtogs pa gnyis las rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbus rtogs pa'i ye shes ni ji lta ba rtogs pa dang / nyon sgrib dang chos kyi bdag 'dzin phra rags gnyis sogs theg gsum gyi spang bya thams cad spangs pa thob pa ni spangs pa dang / ji skad bshad pa'i chos thams cad mkhyen pa ni ji snyed pa rtogs pa ste de rnams 'bras bu'i dbang du byas pa dang / khyad par gyi lam ni de dag gi nye rgyu rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang bcas brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ mdo nas 'di dag khyad gzhi dang / stong pa nyid khyad chos sgo nas gsungs la/ 'dir yang mgo mjug kun tu mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos par shes pa'i ched du mi dmigs pa nyid kyis nges par 'byung ba yin gsung / burta shrī ltar na/ gang zhig zhon nas zhes pa man chad nges 'byung sgrub pa dang spyor zhing / de'ang 'khor ba nas myang 'das su 'gro bar gsungs pa de 'khor ba bden grub nas myang 'das bden grub cig tu 'gro bar byed pa min gye/ 'khor 'das gnyis dmigs su med pas 'khor ba zad tsam gye cha la myang 'das thob par 'jog dgos te/dper na me 'gag tsam gyi cha la me shi ba zhes zer ba bzhin yin gsung / mi shi zhes pa ma dag pa yin gsung / sh+lau ka 'dis gzhan don gyi rgyu mnyam nyid dngos su bstan nas gzhan don ngo bo shugs la bstan pa yin no/ / de nas sh+lau ka gcig ni/ sngon mtha' byang sems so skyes kyi skabs dang / phyi mtha' sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / da ltar byung ba byang 'phags kyi gnas skabs te dus gsumag dmigs su med pas sa gong mar bgrod pa sogs 'thad pa yin la/ da ltar dmigs su med par spyod pa de ni sher phyin rnal mar spyod ces pa'i don no/ / slob dpon ltar na byang chub sems mkhas rig pa/ zhes sogs 383

/ /man chad nges 'byung sgrub pa dang sbyor ba yin la/ de'ang dus kyi tshe zhes pas dus rtag pa 'gog par gsungs pa'i don ni/ dper na 'jig rten na nga sngar de 'dra zhig gi thad sor zhes brjod pa'i tshe da lta sngar gyi skabs de las 'gyur song bar go ba bzhin du/ dus kyi tshe zhes pas dus 'gyur bar go bas dus rtag pa 'gog gsung / snying rje chen po skyed kyang sems can 'du shes zhes sogs 'di dag gis nges 'byung sgrub pa'i gzhan don rang gi ngo bo bstan nam snyam ste/ sems can dang de'i sdug bsngal sogs bden par grub na de sel thabs med cing / de ltar spyod pa ni sher phyin rnal mar spyod pa ma yin no/ / de'ang sems can dang sems can gyi sdug bsngal sogs bden par dmigs su med pas gzhan don byas te sdug bsngal las grol pa sogs 'thad la/ bden med de'ang chos dang gang zag gnyis las gang zag dang /rangagazhan gnyis las kyang thog mar rang gi blo'i 'char tshul 'di la ltos na dgag bya ngos 'dzin sla zhing / de'i gnad kyis dgag bya de bkag pa'i med dgag stong nyid kyang nges sla bas thog mar rang dang / de nas sems can gzhan dang / de nas chos kun la sbyar bar bya ba yin gsung / ye shes 'chi med dam pa zhes sogs 'di dag gis nges 'byung sgrub pa'i rang don spangs rtogs gnyis bstan te/ 'di'i 'chi ba ni/ skye rga na 'chi'i 'chi ba tsam la mi byed par rgud pa dang nyer 'tshe spyi la byas nas 'chi med ni nyer 'tshe ma lus pa dang bral ba'i spangs pa dang / dam pa ni ye shes dam pa rtogs pa la byed gsung / skabs dang le'u dang / rab byed dang sarga rnams ming gi rnam grangs yin pas/ le'u'i don ni 'grel pa sgon gsal gye mchan las paṭa la zhes pa sha sbrang dang grang ba sogs las skyob par byed pas gos dang snam bu sogs la 'jug par gsungs zhing / la la ti bsnan pas la ti zhes pa 'dzin 3༅

ris / //sgo /spro bapa la byas nas brjod bya rnams der 'dzin par byed pa'am len par byed pas na le'u ste/ de'ang skyob byed dngos ni brjod bya yin pas brjod bya'i ming rjod byed la btags pa dang / chos mngon pa'i mdzod ces bshad pa lta bu yin gsung / 'di yan chad du mdo'i dbang du byas na rab 'byor gyi le'u dang / mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dbang du byas na shes bya rnam mkhyen mtshon byed chos bcu'i sgo nas yongs su rdzogs pa yin gsungs so/ /shes bya mkhyen gsum gyi nang nas rnam mkhyen shes nas don gnyer bskyed dgos pas thog mar rnam mkhyen bshad zin nas/ rnam mkhyen de thob par byed pa la de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu lam shes la slob dgos pa yin pas de'i rjes su lam shes gsungs pa yin la/ 'dir de lta bu'i rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba de rgyu mtshan du bkod nas mtshams sbyar ba yin zhing /rtogs pa zhes pa rnam mkhyen shes pa la mi byed par rnam mkhyen thob pa la byed dgos gsung / spyir skabs dang por yang rab dga' la sogs pa sa bcu dang / zeg dman gyi spyor mthong sgom gsum sogs rgyas par bshad pas lam shes rgyas par dngos su ma bstan zer mi rung ba yin la/ de'ang ji lta ji snyed kyi rnam pa ma lus pa'am/ thar pa don gnyer gyi thar lam cha tshang ba mngon sum du mkhyen pa zhig rnam mkhyen yin no zhes yul gyis yul can mtshon par byed pas skabs dang por lam shes yul gyi ldog cha nas bstan pa dang /'dir ma 'ongs pa na rigs can gsum gyi don mtha' dag sgrub par byed pa la rgyu'i dus su'ang 'bras bu de dang mthun pa'i theg pa gsum gye lam shes pa'i lam shes cha tshang bar nyams su len dgos pa yin zhes lam shes rgyu'i ldog cha nas ston pas na/ skabs dang po gnyis su lam shes rgyas par dngos su bstan par 'dra'ang ston tshul mi 'dra ba yin gsung / de'ang lam shes 385

/ /mtshonabyed kyi chos bcu gcig yod pas dang po lam shes kyi yan lag la'ang rten gegs nga rgyal mngon gyur dang bral ba sogs lnga yod pa las/ dang po ni/sangs rgyas kyis sher phyin gyi mdo gsungs pa'i 'khor du rgyal chen ris bzhi sogs 'dod lha rigs drug dang / tshangs ris pa sogs gzugs khams kyi lha rnams 'dus pa'i tshe de dag rten gegs nga rgyal mngon gyur dang bral te lam shes skye ba'i snod rung du byas pa yin la/ spyir bden pa la gdul bya nyon mongs gang la spyod pa shes nas 'dod chags shas che ba la de'i gnyen po dang /zhe sdang shas che ba la rdzu 'phrul sogs kyis de'i gnyen po bstan nas zhi bar byas te snod rung du byed pa zhig nges can du dgos pas/ 'dir yang lha de dag la rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan rgyal chen ris bzhi 'jig rten skyong ba'i khur dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa longs spyod dang / 'thab bral ba lha ma yin dang 'thab mi dgos par sos bde ba dang / dga' ldan rnams byams pa bzhugs yod pa dang / 'phrul dga' ba dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa gnyis rang gi sprul pa dang / gzhan gyi sprul pa la longs spyod pa sogs kyis nga rgyal skye ba dang / thams cad la thun mong du yod pa gzugs bzang ba dang / lus 'od kyi rang bzhin yin pas de dag ngoms chos su byed pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal shas che ba yin la/ sangs rgyas kyis lha de dag gi bsam pa mkhyen nas/ gser btso sbyangs byas pas lcags g.ya' dag pa zil gyis gnon pa bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis lha de dag gi 'od zil gyis mnan pas mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhi nas lam shes skye ba'i snod rung du byas gsung / de'i tshe de dag lam shes dngos skye ba'i snod yin na sbyor lam pa yin dgos pas/ skye ba'i gegs de dag dang ldan pa'i nges pa med la sems skyed gsar du skye ba'i snod la byas na de dag zhi bar byed dgos 386

༄/ /zinabrigasung / spyir nga rgyal la'ang mngon pa'i nga rgyal sogs du ma yod pas/yon tan chung ngu zhig la dmigs nas chen por rloms sems byed pa lta bu mngon pa'i nga rgyal te 'di la yon tan zhig la dmigs pa dgos gsung /srogagacod dang rku 'phrog byed pa sogs yon tan gtan nas min pa zhig la dmigs te rlom sems byed pa lta bu zhig la log pa'i nga rgyal dang / rang las mchog tu gyur pa zhig la dmigs te bdag de dang khog cha 'dra'ang 'di 'dra zhig gi cha nas bdag cung zad mi mnyam zhes gnas skabs zhum pa'i rnam pa lta bu zhig yin kyang phal cher mnyam par 'dzin pa'i zhum pa'i nga rgyal dang /rang las cung zad dma' ba zhig la dmigs te 'di las bdag ches khyad par du 'phags so zhes 'dzin pa lta bu lhag pa'i nga rgyal du 'jog pa sogs yin gsung / spyir lam shes skye ba dang / byang chub kyi sems skye ba dang / chos nyan pa sogs kyi tshe'ang chos la gus pa dang / mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang bral ba zhig nges can du dgos pas 'dir mtshan gzhi tsam bstan pa dang / chos nyan pa'i kun slong sogs bstan par bla ma snga ma rnams kyis gsungs shing /nyams len la spyor shes pa zhig dgos gsung / chos nyan pa'i tshe de la gus pa dang bkur ste sogs dgos pa ni sngon sangs rgyas kyis mdo zhig gsungs pa'i tshe rgyal po'i btsun mo zhig mi mang po'i nang du 'ong ma nus par g.yog mo zhigabatang te sangs rgyas las chos nyan nas/ de shes rab che ba zhig yin pas gang gsungs pa thams cad bzung ste slar 'ong nas btsun mo la gang gsungs thams cad bshad kyang btsun mo de'i rgyud la rtogs pa gang yang ma skyes/ phyi nyin yang g.yog mo de 'ong bas/ btsun mo la 'phrin nas bshad pa de sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen te g.yog mo la/ khyim pas de ltar bshad pa mi chog / gal te shod zer na sangs rgyas kyis nga'i chos 'di sngon bskal ba 387

/mang por dka' ba spyad nas rnyed pa'i chos yin pas ngas kyang bkur ste sogs bya dgos na/ khyod kyi chos la bkur ste sogs med par nyan mi chog par sangs rgyas kyis smras pa yin zhes btsun mo la shod cig gsungs pas/ des kyang btsun mo la de ltar bshad pas gdan bshams pa sogs chos la bkur ste byas nas nyan pas bden pa mthong ba'i lo rgyus dang / rgyal po zas gtsang la sems zhum pa dang nga rgyal gnyis yod pas re zhig bar du bden pa mthong ma nus pa yin la/ zhum pa ni gnas skabs der sangs rgyas la lha rnams kyis bsnyen bkur sogs med pas sems zhum pa dang / rang gi sras sangs rgyas ni rdzu 'phrul sogs che bar mthong nas sems khengs pa yin pas sangs rgyas kyis de'i bsam pa bcos nas thabs mkhas kyis grol bar mdzad pa sogs kyis shes gsung / sems bskyed rgyud la skyes te thabs shes zung 'brel nyams su len pa zhig la lam shes skye yi/ thabs shes nyi tshe ba tsam la mi skye bas gnas skabs yul so sor nges pa dang / skye rung tsam gye dbang du byas na sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas rung gi rigs kyis khyab pa dang /de'ang mdo las/ gang yang dag pa'i nas mthu med do zhes pa 'di lhan cig byed rkyen sems bskyed pa yod med kyis gnas skabs so sor nges pa dang /dedag gi dge ba'i phyogs la bar chad mi byed do/ / zhes pa 'dis sems can thams cad rgyu rigs kyis khyab pa bstan pa yin pas/ kha cig snga mas zhi ba bgrod pa gcig bu ba dang / phyi mas byang chub yongs 'gyur bstan par 'dod pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ de dag gi zhes pa/ mthu med do zhes pa de la snyegs rigs pas gzhi gcig yin pa dang / bar chad mi byed do zhes pas snga ma drang don du bkral pa'i phyir ro/ / byang sems sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi byed par rgyun zhugs nas dgra bcom bar gyi spangs rtogs thams 388

ra rdo / /sbyo /spro sacad 'du zhing gzhan don thabs shes zung 'brel byed kin mi 'dug par bdag med sgom pa de dag tsam la gtsor 'don byas te rang nyid kyis nyon mongs tsam spong thabs byas na de'i tshe spong nus mod/ tshogs gnyis kyi thabs mkhas kyis rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed cing / rang nyid zhi bde la mi gzhol bas na/ 'khor ba mi 'dor ba'i rang bzhin dang / de'i tshe gdul bya 'khor du ma bsdus pa bsdus panas smin pa grol ba'i bar byed pa'i byed las dang lnga yod pa yin gsung /sdud par yang / gang gzhi gzugs la zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis lam shes kyi yan lag bstan pa yin la/ ye shes zhabs kyi sdud 'grel ltar na/ blo ka gcig po 'di lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun la sbyar zhing / de'ang drod rtse gnyis la sbyar/ rtag dang mi rtag ces sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bzod pa dang / 'bras bu thob dang zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis chos mchog la sbyar zhing /lam shes kyi yan lag 'di dag gi shugs la bstan par byas na rung gsung /de'ang rtsa bar/ gzugs la sogs la stong pa'i phyir/ / zhes sogs sgra sbyar zhing / sdud par phung po lnga ka tshig zin la thon pa dang / rtsa bar/ de la rtag la sogs zhes sogs sgra sbyar zhing / sdud par rtag mi rtag bde sdug bdag yod med sogs tshig zin la thon pa dang / rtsa bar/ sa bcu dag las zhes sogs gsungs pa/ sdud par 'bras bu thob ces sogs 'di dang yang 'grigs bsdad yod pas/ gang ltar yang mkhas pa'i bshad tshul 'di 'thad la 'di mi 'thad ces kha tshon chod dka' zhing / 'dir gtso bor slob dpon gyi sdud 'grel de gzhir bzhag pa yin pas de'i dbang du byas na sngar blo ka gcig po de lam shes kyi yan lag dang sbyar la/ de'ang 'di'i 'grel par/gnas te rnam pa lnga/ zhes pa tsam las mi 'dug pas gsal kha cher med kyang 389

/ /gsung lugs la bltas na/ gnas zhes pas phung po lnga'i chos nyid la gnas te sher phyin la spyod pa dang yon tan thos pa de tsam gyes chog shes dang /rlom sems mi byed par gong mar slob dgos par ston pas rten gegs dang bral ba bstan/ shes rab kyi cha la gnas pa de tsam gyis mi chog bar thabs kye cha'ang de'i steng du snon dgos par gnas te zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas ston pas na/ thabs shes cha tshang ba nyams su len par byed pa zhig la lam shes skyeyi/ gzhan la mi skye ba'i gnas skabs so sor nges pa de bstan/ yang gnas zhes pa chos nyid 'dzin stangs su byas te sgom pa la'ang byed mod de/rang bzhin gnas rigs la byas te rgyu rigs kyis khyab pa dang / rang bzhin dang / byed las rnams bstan pa yin gsung / nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ni/ bden bzhi'i dang po gnyis la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos bzhi bzhi dang / thun mong gi rnam pa bdun te mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med bzhi sbas don dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa ni mdo'i tshig gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ gser 'phreng ltar na/ 'gyur 'di la stong pa'i mtshan nyid bdag med pa zhes gcig tu byas te zhi ba'i rnam pa dang bzhir byed dgos shing rtogs dkar de ltar bshad pa 'thad phyogs su mdzad gsung / kun 'byung gi rnam pa ni yongs grags ltar dang / thun mong gi bdun ni/ sdug kun gnyis nad lta bu yin te / dper na/ nad de zas 'dod pa bsten mi chog pa dang / mi 'dod bzhin du za dgos pa sogs sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa bzhin du/ 'di gnyis kyang mi 'dod pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas/'bras kyis sdug bsngal phyi ma 'dren par byed pa bzhin du 'di gnyis kyis kyang ma 'ongs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad 'dren par byed pa'i phyir/ 'di ni gro 'bras kyi 'bras min gyi/ rma 'bras la byed gsung / zug jus mi 'dod pa 3༅

da / /zizug ge /sgo sde'aphral du bskyed pa ltar 'dis kyang sdug bsngal 'phral du bskyed pa'i phyir/sdug bsngal gcig tsam gyis thag chod song ba lta bu ma yin par sdug bsngal brgyud mar 'byung bas na sdig pa'i rnam pa ste bzhi dang / yid 'byung ba/'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa ste bdun yin la/ zhugs zhes pa phyi ma gsum ga'i mtha'i gsal byed yin gsung / phyi ma gsum la'ang nang gses kyis dang po gnyis la gnyis dang / gsum pa la gnyis te bzhi yod la/ de'ang nyer len gyi phung po 'di 'tsho skyong gi don du ji tsam 'bad na'ang mthar bsrus te 'di'i don du bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las rang gi rjes su zhugs nas 'ong zhing gnod par byed pas na dgra bo lta bu yin te/ dper na/ 'jig rten na gang gnod pa byed pa la dgrar 'dzin pa bzhin no/ / yang 'di 'tsho skyong la ci tsam 'bad kyang yid brtan med par myur du 'jig pas 'jig pa'i chos can te/ de'ang 'jig rten na zas gos bzang ba dang yun ring du gnas pa zhig la yid mi 'byung bar 'tsho skyong byed pa yin gyi/ ngan pa dang myur du 'jig pa zhig la de ltar mi byed pa bzhin du 'di'ang ngo bo skyon dang bcas pa dang / yid brtan med par mthong nas yid 'byung ba yin no/ / sdug kun gnyis po 'di ni dgra bcom gyes spangs pas g.yo ba dang / gnyen pos 'joms par byed pas rab tu 'jig pa ste gnyis dang / 'di gnyis kyis tshe 'di dang phyi mar mi 'dod pa thams cad la sbyor bar byed pas 'jigs pa'am skrag pa'i gnas yin pa dang / 'di bdag tu bzung bas srin po sogs sems yod kyis nyer 'tshe'i gnas su gyur pas 'go nad lta bu dang / bdag tu bzung bas 'byung ba 'khrugs pa sogs sems med kyi gnod pa thams cad kyi sna drangs 'ongs pas 'tshe ba'i rnam pa ste gsum mo/ / de'ang bdag 'dzin 'di la bka' gdams pa rnams kyis phung 391

/ /byed 'ug pa'i mgo can zhes gsungs te/ 'jig rten na 'ug pa bgad na ltas ngan du rtsi'ang de rim gro sogs kyis bzlog kyang nus la bdag 'dzin lhang lhang ba zhig mngon du gyur na de'i rjes su phung krol chen po zhig la mi sbyor ba mi srid pa lta bu yin pas 'ug pa'i mgo can zhes gsungs/ yang na kun 'byung gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa brgyad dang / yid 'byung ba sogs gsum gyis dang po gnyis la gnyis gnyis phye bas bzhi dang / gsum pa la gsum du phye ba'i bdun ni sdug kun thun mong gi rnam par byed gsung / lam la rnam pa bzhi dang / 'gog pa la dang po gsum dang / nges 'byung la rnam pa bzhir phye bas bdun te/ dang po gsum sbas don dang / dben pa ni mdo'i tshig gi dbang du byas pa dang / rnam thar sgo bzhi gsungs pa'i mngon par 'du byed med pa ni rgyus 'bras bu bskyed pa'i bya byed kyi cha don dam par med pa la byed gsung / sdud par yang / rtag dang mi rtag ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes bstan pa yin la/ de'ang rtag mi rtag bde sdug sogs kyis bden pa dang po gnyis kyi rnam pa dang /'bras bu thob dang dgra bcom sa la zhes sogs kyis 'gog lam gyi rnam pa bstananam snyam gsung / 'grel chen las/ rgyu tsam zhig logs su drangs nas zhes gsungs pa ni/ skabs dang por gsungs pa'i lam shes la rnam mkhyen gye rgyur 'gro mi 'gro gnyis yod pa'i nang nas rgyu yin pa de logs su drangs nas 'chad ces pa sogs min gyi/ dang por yul gyi ldog cha nas bstan pa de las logs su 'dir rgyu'i ldog cha bstan no zhes pa'i don yin gsung / nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun ni zin byed kyi sgo nas bstan pa yin la/ de'ang gzugs sogs bden pas stong pa drod kyi dmigs pa dang / gzugs sogs rang gi ngo bo la bden par 392

sa / /zin byes sasamado ༄skyodamazhen nas mi gnas pa rtse mo'i dmigs pa dang / de'i khyad chos mi chug sogs la bden par zhen nas mi gnas pa bzod pa'i dmigs pa dang / sa bcu sogs la brten nas mi gnas pa de chos mchog gi dmigs par bstan la/de'ang stong pa nyid rnams dbyer med pas/ zhes pa 'di yul gzung ba bden par med pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / sangs rgyas kyis/ mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir zhes pa 'di yul can 'dzin pa bden par med pa'i rgyu mtshan du sbyor dgos pas/ sbyor lam yul gzugs sogs bden par med de/ de dag gi stong pa nyid rnams phan tshun dbyer med pa'i phyir zhes pa dang / de dag ni bden par med de/ gal te bden par grub pa yod na bden gnyis thugs su chud pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi gzigs ngor yod dgos pa la desasgyu ma lta bur gzigs pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don no/ / 'dis ni sangs rgyas kyis ji snyed pa mi mkhyen par 'dod pa sogs bkag pa yin nam gsung /skabs dang por sbyor lam rgyas par bshad pas 'dir bstan mi dgos so zhe na/dang po gtan la dbab bya rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas gsungs pa/ 'dir gtan la dbab bya theg dman gye rtogs rigs yin kyang byang sems kyis mi rtag sogs bsgom pa'i tshe bden stong sgyu ma lta bu'i skye 'jig can du sgom dgos pa shes pa'i ched du zin byed kyi sgo nas bstan pa yin pas zlos skyon med gsung /sdud par yang / ji ltar 'dren pa zhes sogs blo ka gcig gis nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu spyor lam bstan pa yin la/ de'ang 'khor 'das gnyis sam 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos gang la'ang bden par zhen nas mi gnas par spyod pa 'di ni rgyal bas bstan pa yin par gsungs zhes pa'i don no/ / ye shes zhabs kyi sdud 'grel ltar na sh+lau ka 'di rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang sbyar zhing / 'grig par yod kyang 393

da / / / steḥslob dpon gye sbyor tshul 'di nyi snang dang brgyad stong ba dang mthun gsung /rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ni/ nyan rang gnyis rang kho na'i don du byang chub tsam don du gnyer ba sogs 'dra bas/ nyan thos las logs su rang rgyal gyi lam ston pa mi rigs so zhe na/ re zhig rang rgyal de nyan thos las khyad zhugs par bstan na de'i theg pa'i rnam gzhag dpog nus pas/de'ang nyan thos ni/ nyan thos rnams kyi rnam grol sgra spyir 'gro/ zhes pa ltar/ srid pa tha ma'i tshe gzhan la gdams ngag nyan nas rang gi byang chub thob pa dang / 'bras bu thob nas gzhan la'ang sgra bcas su ston pa'i khyad par gnyis dang ldan la/ srid pa tha ma'i tshe ring gi byang chub thob pa de grogs dge 'dun la nges par brten dgos pas dge 'dun dkon mchog nyan thos la bzhag pa dang / de ltar mi dgos pas chos dkon mchog rang rgyal la bzhag pa dang / sangs rgyas dkon mchog theg chen la bzhag pa yin gsung / sangs rgyas dang rang rgyal gnyis ka la rang byung zer yang / rang rgyal ni srid pa tha ma'i tshe sangs rgyas sogs kyis dngos su bstan pa la mi ltos par rang stobs kyis byang chub mngon du byed pas na rang byung zhes bya la 'di ni nyan thos las khyad zhugs pa dang po yin no/ / bstan yang mi dgos zhes pa'i yang sgras bsdus pa/ gzhan la chos ston pa'i tshe ngag gi sgo nas ston pa gtso bor mi byed par lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas gzhan dad pa sogs la 'god pa ni 'grel pas kha bskang ba yin la 'di ni khyad zhugs pa gnyis pa yin gsung / sgra med par chos ston pa mi rigs so zhes pa'i dogs pa 'grel pas khong nas bsus te/ lan ni/ ngag gis ston pa la de'i kun slong rtog dpyod sngon du 'gro dgos pas rnam par g.yeng bar 'gyur la/ rang rgyal ni rang bzhin gyis rnam g.yeng la mi dga' ba yin pas/ rnam par g.yeng bar 394

ra / /zizug bye bsgo sde'agyur du dogs nas srid pa tha ma'i tshe sgra med par chos ston par gyur cig ces sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis sgra med par chos ston pa'i phyir/ 'di la mkhasagrub rin po che'i rtog ge snang bar/ kun slong dgos pa lus kyi ston pa'ang mtshungs pas mi 'thad gsungs la/ mkhas grub rin po che'i rang gi lugasani lus kyis chos ma bstan kyang sngon gyi smon lam gyis gdul bya la de ltar snang nas dad pa sogs la 'god nus par gsungs la/ lus kyi sgo nas bdag med ston mi nus par 'dod pa'i mkhas pa'i bshad tshul yang yod gsung / 'on kyang rnam bshad las/ rang rgyal gyis sngon gye smon lam gyi dbangagis de ltar chos ston pa'i tshe kun slong mi dgos pa lta bu zhig gsung 'dug cing / 'dir sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar gsungs pa'ang sgra med par chos ston pa sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar gsungs don med pas/ sangs rgyas kyis kun slong mi dgos par chos ston pa dang / rang rgyal gyis kun slong rags pa mi dgos par sngon gyi smon lam gyis chos ston nus pa gnyis dpe don sbyar ba yin nam snyam gsung / des na sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis gdul bya la de ltar snang nas dad pa dang 'dun pa dang lam la zhugs pa sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyud la skrun par byed pas sgra med kyang chos ston pa mi 'gal zhes pa'i don yin gsung / de ltar khyad zhugs pa brjod nas/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa la de'i ngo bo ston dgos pas de'i ngo bo ni/ gzung ba phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong ba dang / 'dzin pa bden zhen mi spong bar gsungs pas dgag bya'i sgo nas khyad par 'byed pa yin gyi stong gzhi'i sgo nas khyad 'byed pa min gsung / rang rgyal gyi lam de dag byang sems kyis shes mthongagis bltas nas 'da' bar byed pa yin gyi/ theg chen gyi lam ltar gtan la dbab bya'i gtso bor byed pa min gsung / sdud par yang / gang 395

/ /dag bde gshegs zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis theg pa gsum gyi byang chub thob pal yum la slob dgos par gsungs pa'i nang na rang rgyal la'ang yod pas rang rgyal gyi lam bstan pa yin la/ 'di'i yum thal 'gyur pa ltar na bshad sla'ang / rang rgyud pa'i skabs 'dir yum spyi ldog tsam la byed gsung /brgyad stong pa las/ de nas 'khor de'i nang nas lha'i bu kha cig 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ gang gnod sbyin rnams kyi bshad pa zhes pa nas/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor 'di ni ring ba bas kyang ches ring bar 'jug / phra ba ba4 kyang ches phra bar 'jug ces sogs kyi dngos zin la/ rab 'byor gyis sgra med par chos ston pa de lha'i bu dag gis shes mi nus par bstan pa des sbas don rang rgyal gyis sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyes chos ston pa de mtshon pa yin gsung / chos 'chad pa zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum ni/ gang dag bde gshegs zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig po de'i zhar byung yin la/ de'ang chos 'chad pa dang nyan pa dang / bsgoms nas 'bras bu thob pa'i bar yang tha snyad sgyu ma tsam yin gyi don dam par de dag med par gsungs shing /brgyad stong pa las kyang / de nas yang lha'i bu dag 'di snyam du sems te/gnas brtan rab 'byor 'di la chos nyan pa ji lta bu zhig btsal bar bya snyam pa / zhes pa nas/ 'di ltar sgyu ma dag btsal bar bya snyam pa/ zhes pa nas/ 'di ltar sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu dang / mya ngan las 'das pa ni gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med ces pa'i bar gyis bstan pa yin la/'di la brgyad stong pa shin tu gsal gsung / gang zag bzhi po zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis/ rgyal sras bden mkhas rang rgyal tshogs spyod tsam dang /phyir mi ldog sbyor lam pa dang / dgra bcom dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa dang bzhi ste rang rgyal dngos gnas pa yin pas rten rang rgyal dngos su 396

sa / /zi gabres khang ༄rtestegobastan pa yin la/ brgyad stong par gang zag gsum dang / nyi khri las lnga gsungs pa yin gsung / rgyal sras sam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' zhes gsungs pa ni/ rang don du byang chub thob pas byang chub sems dpa' dang / sgra med par chos ston pas byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhes bshad pa yin gsung / byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rig ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis/ byang sems kyis rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la slob pa de dgra bcom dang / rkyen rtogs rang rgyal gyi byang chub thob pa'i ched du yin nam zhe na min te/ rigs can gsum gyis don ma tshang ba med pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob pa'i ched du yin pas dman pa'i yid byed dang bden zhen gnyis bkag ste/ rnam mkhyen yid byed dang mi dmigs pa'isgo nas slob ces pa'i don no/ / rang rgyal gye lam shes pa'i lam shes de'ang rgyu med rkyen med du mi 'byung bas de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun ni don dam par med kyang tha snyad du thams cad rung bas bden gnyis mi 'gal ba'i tshul dang / don dam par 'phel 'grib med pa dang / stong pa nyid sogs la bden par zhen pas mi 'dzin pa dang / don dam par skye 'gag med pa rnams kyis de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bstan la/ 'di dag phyi rol don stong ngam/ yang na dngos zin la sbyar yang rung gsung / sdud par yang /gzugs 'phel zhes sogs blo ka gcig gis de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bstan pa yin la/ gzugs 'phel yongs su nyams zhes pa 'phel 'grib med pa dang / gzung phyir min zhes pa/ mi 'dzin phyir bzod pa zhes pa gnyis dang 'grigs gsung / thob byed lam shes la lam shes kyi yan lag dang yan lag can gyi lam shes gnyis las/ phyi ma la nyan rang byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes gsum dang / byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes 397

/ /la'ang mthong sgom gnyis bshad nas/ nyan rang gi de la sbyor mthong gnyis bshad kyang sgom lam ma bshad pa ni shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' ba dang gnas nas 'da' ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin gsung / mthong lam ni/ bden dang bden la zhes sogs kyis skad cig ma'i sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang /de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dang / zhes sogs kyis rnam pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa yin la/ de'ang bden dang bden zhes pas khams gong 'og gi sgo nas phye ba min gyi/zag bcas zag med kyi sgo nas phye bas/ zag bcas sdug kun rgyu 'bras gnyis dang / zag med 'gog lam rgyu 'bras gnyis te bzhir phye nas de dag la dmigs pa'i bzod shes skad cig ma bzhi yin no/ / mdo las mthong lam phan yon gyi sgo nas gsungs pas de'i dbang du byas nas/ 'dir yang phan yon bcas pa zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas gsungs pa yin la/ mdo las phan yon gyi sgos gsungs tshul ni/ mthong lam nas phyir mi ldog pa tshe 'di'i phan yon dang / mthong lam thob pa na ma 'ongs par rang gang du sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas dang / de'i zhing la sogs pa dran par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyis lung ston par 'gyur ba sogs tshe phyi ma'i phan yon gyi sgo nas bstan pa yin gsung / rnam pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa ni/ yul gzugs sogs kyi de bzhin nyid dang / yul can rnam mkhyen gnyis tha snyad du yul yul can dang / gdags gzhi btags chos su rung yang don dam par yul yul can dang gdags gzhi btags chos kyirnam grangs su khas mi len pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid yin pas chen po dang / rtogs bya gzugs sogs dang / 'jal byed tshad ma gnyis don dam par dmigs su med pa dang / sdug bden gyi gtso bo gzugs sogs nyer len gyi phung po la don dam par rdul phra rab sogs 398

༄/ /zinasagazugs can gyi tshad med pa ste cha shas med par gsungs pa dang / tshas thams cad don dam par cha dang cha can du mi rung bar bstan pa'i shugs kyis sdug bsngal gyi bden pa tha snyad du cha dang cha can sogs rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas shes par bya zhes 'phangs pa yin pas de lta bu'i rnam pa bzhi ni sdug bden gyi rnam pa dang / der gnas gzugs la sogs pa la/ / sangs rgyas nyid du nges 'dzin dang / / zhes pa 'di la bshad tshul gnyis yod de/sangs rgyas bkur ba'i 'os yin pa bzhin du/ sher phyin rnal ma mthong lam la gnas pa'i byang sems de'ang bkur ba'i 'os su 'dzin zhes bshad tshul gcig dang / gzugs sogs dgag bya gang du ma grub pa der sangs rgyas kyang ma grub pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi steng du dgag bya gang 'gog dgos pa de gzugs sogs kyi steng du'ang dgos pa'i bshad tshul gcig ste 'di gnyis ka khas blangs chog cing / de lta bu'i rnam pa sogs kun 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi dang / nyam nga ba dang nad kun sel/ / zhes pas phyi'i mi dang mi min gyis 'tshe ba dang 'byung ba 'khrug pa dang / nang gi nad khams sogs kyi 'tshe ba rab tu zhi ba'i rnam pa sogs 'gog pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas rnamasakyis mi dang mi min gyi gnod pa las srung skyob sba gsum mdzad pa'am yang na mthong chos dang / skyes nas dang / lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gye mi dge ba'i las las srung skyob sba gsum mdzad pa'i rnam pa sogs lam gyi rnam pa bzhi ste bcu drug yod pa yin gsung / kha cig bshad pa skabs dang po'i sbyor lam dang / ma bshad pa skabs bzhi pa'i spyor lam gyi skabs su lag rjes kyi sgo nas mtshon pa yin la/ rnam pa ma bstan pa de bzhin du 'dir yang lag rjes kyi sgo nas mtshon pa min gyi/ rnam pa ma bstan par 'dod pa la/ slob dpon gyis de ltar na bsgom bya'i rnam pa ma bstan 3༅

ga 4pas ji ltar sgom tshul gyi rim pa sogs mi shes shing / rnam pa med pa'i gzhi tsam zhig bstan pa'i skyon gcig dang / dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang /zhes dmigs rnam gnyis ka 'chad par mdor bstan pas gzhung gi don dang dngos su 'gal ba'i skyon gnyis 'jug pa yin pas mi 'thad ces pa'i don no/ / gzugs ni shes rab ma yin zhes sogs blo ka gcig gis bden bzhi'i nang nas sdug bden gyi rnam pa dmigs kyis bkar nas bstan pa yin la/ de'ang gzugs sogs yul dang / yul can shes rab gnyis don dam par yul yul can du med pa'i don no/ / dmigs pa rnams kyi zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bden bzhi'i rnam pa spyir bstan pa yin la/ de'ang pha mtha' ni slob dpon gyi sdud 'grel las/ rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin ni pha mtha' ste zhes 'byung bas dgag bya'i bdag la byed dgos gsung /rkang pa dang pos shes par bya rgyu'i sdug bden gyi ngo bo de ni bdag tu med pa dang / gnyis pas sems can zhes pa sems can dngos yin mi dgos shing /las nyon gyis bsdus pa'i kun 'byung bden pa'ang bdag tu med pa dang /gsum pas 'khor ba rgyun chad tsam gyi 'gog bden ni thog reg bkag tsam la nam mkha' 'jog pa dang 'dra bas/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i chos dbyings bdag tu med pa dang / rkang pa bzhi pas 'jig rten kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis mkhyen pa'i shes rab lam gyi bden pa'ang bdag tu ma grub par bstan gsung / budha shrī'i sdud 'grel ltar na/ rkang pa dang pos gzung ba bden med/ gnyis pas 'dzin pa bden med/gsum pas gzung 'dzin bden med nam mkha' dang 'dra ba/ bzhi pas bden med de mkhyen pa'i shes rab kyang don dam par med par bstan pa yin la/ pha mtha' med pa ni 'dus byas kyi thog ma'i pha mtha' med pa la bya 400

da / /zicad gri ——rtetshogasung / 'du shes tshu rol zhes sogs blo ka gsum ni de'i 'phros don yin la/de'ang bdag tu 'du shes pas tshu rol 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir lus pa yin par 'dren pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs la/bdag tu 'du shes rnam par bshig nas spong ba de ni 'khor ba'i pha rol tu 'gro zhing / bden zhen bkag pa'i lta ba rjes su thob pa'i mthong lam pa de dag tshe 'dir phyir mi ldog pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba dran pa dang /sangs rgyas 'di 'dra zhig tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur zhes sangs rgyas kyis lung ston pa sogs ston pa'i bka' la gnas pa ni sh+lau ka dang po'i don no/ /brgyad stong pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan zhes sogs kyis sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis bdag cag gi ston pa lung bstan tshul la'ang gsungs pas de'i don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni rtogs pa phun tshogs/ / dgra bcom pa ni spang ba phun tshogs la sbyor dgos pas/ rnam 'grel las/ gshegs patogs pa'i don phyir dang / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ legs par mkhyen pa/ nyan rang ltar ma yin par mkhyen pa brtan pa chos nyid rig pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pas gtan la phab ste rtogs pa mthar phyin nas gong du 'gror med pas ma lus par mkhyen pas de bzhin gshegs pa dang / sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas dgra bcom pa/ thar pa dang der bgrod pa'i lam gyi rim pa shes pa'i mig lta bu yin pas shes rab kyi bslab pa rig pa dang / de mthar phyin pas rig par ldan pa/ tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa gnyis thar bar bgrod pa'i rkang pa lta bu yin pas zhabs su ldan pa/ gzhan sgrol pa la thog mar rang nyid kyis brtsan sa zin dgos pas bde bar gshegs pa/ sems can gyi don byed pa la de'i 401

/ /khams dang bsam pa shes dgos pas 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ sla ba 'dul la 'dul dka' ba mi 'dul ba ma yin par 'dul dka' ba kun tu rgyu rab bzang dang / gcung dga' po lta bu'ang 'dul bas skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ rnam 'grel las/ thugs brtse ldan phyir brtson kun yang / zhes pa ltar/ thugs rje chen pos gzhan don yal bar mi 'dor bas bla na med pa ste/spyir sems can thams cad kyi ston pa yin kyang 'bras bu bzhi dang sdom pa gsum la 'god pa'i gtso bo ni lha dang mi gnyis yin pas de'i dbang du byas te lha dang mi'i ston pa zhes gsungs pa yin gsung / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes pas khyad gzhi bstan pa yin gsung / gal te zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis ni sngar gyi de'i rgyas bshad yin la/ gang tshe ston pa shākya thub pa nga ni sher phyin 'di la gnas pa'i tshe sngon gyi skyes mchog mar me mdzad kyis ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes nga lung bstan pa ltar sangs rgyas pas na/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams kyis kyang sher phyin 'di la gnas na sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa ltar sangs rgyas par 'gyur zhes pa'i don yin gsung / brgyad stong pa'i 'di yan chad kyis brgya byin gyi le'u rdzogs pa yin la / sdud pa'i'ang / rgyal pa de skad gsung zhes pa 'di yan chad kyis brgya byin gyi le'u'i thad rdzogs pa yin gsung / ༈/'bras bu mthong na don gnyer skye bas mthong lam lam gyi mjug thogs su sgom lam ma brjod par de'i byed pa gsungs la/ de'ang sems rang dbang du byas te ma dul ba dul bar byed pa dang / spyir rang gi bshes gnyen la'ang gus par byed dgos mod/der ma zad byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can thams cad la dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bzung nas gus pa'am 'dud par byed pa dang / dug gsum gyis gnod pa mi nus par ma zad phar zil gyis gnon pa dang / nang 402

ra / /zizug bye /sgo 'du dug gsum mgo mnan pa'i rang mdangs phyir shar ba lta bu phyi rol gyi mi dang mi min gyis gnod mi nus shing gnod pa sgrub pa'i 'os ma yin pa dang /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa dang / sher phyin la spyod pa'i byang sems gnas pa'i sa phyogs de'ang skye bo thams cad kyis phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba dang drug yod la/ sdud par yang / shes rab pha rol phyin pa gang la mgon byed pa/ / zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis sgom lam gyi byed pa bstan la/ de'ang 'di'i sher phyin ni sgom lam la byed dgos shing /der ma zad gong 'og gang gi skabs su'ang sher phyin zhes 'byung ba ni tshogs spyor sogs skabs de dang de'i lam la go dgos la/mdo las gong 'og kun la sher phyin spyi ldog tsam gsungs pa de/ rgyan las mthong sgom sogs rang rang gi ming gis bstan pa ni spas don gsal bar byed tshul yin gsung / gus byas ni 'dud dang zhes pa dang / chub byed pa zhes pa byang chub dang zhes pa dang spyor la/ dug ni bden 'dzin dang / mtshon me chu gsum ni dug gsum la bya zhing / de de bzhis mi tshugs zhes pa kun nas zhi dang / nyon mongs las rgyal zhes pa gnyis dang / bdud kyi phyogs kyis glags mi rnyed/ces pa ni/ gnod pas badzi ba med nyid dang / zhes pa dang sbyor ba yin gsung / brgyad stong pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yongs su dul ba dang / khengs pa ma mchis par bgyi zhes sogs kyis nyon mongs zhi ba dang / skye bo thams cad la 'dud pa gnyis bstan la/g.yul 'gyed pa'i tshe zhes sogs kyis nyon mongs las rgyal ba'i byed pa de bstan la/ g.yul gyi thog mar zhes sogs gsum gyis nyon mongs chen po skor gsum spong tshul dang / gsum gyis nyon mongs 'bring skor gsum dang /gal te 'gro'am 'greng ngam 'dug pa la zhes pa gsum gyes nyon mongs chung du 403

/ /skor gsum spong tshul bstan pa yin la/ 'dir nyon mongs dang 'thab par gsungs pa de/ rgyan las nyon mongs las rgyal zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas bstan cing / byang chub sgrub pa la nyon mongs kyis gegs byed ma nus pa de srog gi bar chad du ma gyur pa'i don ma yin gsung / yang de nyid las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i rig sngags zhes sogs dang / sangs rgyas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi sems la blta bar 'gyur ro zhes sogs dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid kyis phyogs de sems can thams cad kyi mchod rten du 'gyur zhes sogs kyis rim bzhin/ gnod pas mi badzib dang / byang chub sgrub pa dang / rten mchod pa'i byed pa gsum bstan pa yin zhing / de'ang spyir rig sngags ni drangasrong bden tshig grub pa dag gis mi dang mi min gyi gnod pa sogs zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod pa tsam gyis zhi bar byed nus pa 'dra zhig la zer zhing phal pa la'ang yod kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dis ni rang gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud kyi nyon mongs zhi bar byed pas 'di ni rig sngags chen mo dang / 'di la brten nas mnyam pa med pa sangs rgyas dang mnyam par 'gyur ba'am/ sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur bas na mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i rig sngags zhes gsungs/ sgom lam la zag bcas rtog pa dang /zag med rtog bral gnyis yod pas dang po la mos bsngo rjes su yi rang sgom lamagasum dang / mos bsgom lam la'ang rang don gnyis don gzhan don gsum bshad pa ni bsam pa'i sgo nas gsum ga'ang gzhan don byed par 'dra'ang sbyor ba lag len byed tshul gyi ldog cha nas gsum du phye ba yin la/spyir de gsum ga sa bcu na yod kyang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na rang don mos pas bdun dang / gnyis don mos pa brgyad pa dgu pa gnyis dang /404

༄/ /zin gzhan don mos pa sa bcu bar 'jog la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang thal 'gyur ba ltar na sa bdun par bdag lta ma spangs la brgyad par spangs pa dang / rang rgyud pa ltar na sa brgyad pa nas bdag lta rags pa spangs pa srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba thob pa dang / sa bcu par sangs rgyas dang cha 'dra ba'i mdzad pa rjes mthun pa thob pa'i phyir ram/ mos pa sgom lam gyis ji ltar mos pa bzhin 'grub na sgom mi dgos par mos pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i rtsod pa zhig rten yin yang / zhes pa'i yang sgras bstan nas/lan la ji ltar mos pa ltar 'grub kyang rgyun bsring ste goms pa las 'grub kyi/mos pa tsam gyes de ma thag tu mi 'grub pas skyon med ces pa'i don no/ /sdud par yang / la las bde gshegs zhes sogs blo ka gsum gyis rang don mos pa sgom lam bstan pa yin la/ sgom lam 'di dag phan yon gyi sgo nas ston cing de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi mchod rten gyis gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi zhing khams bkang ste de la sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad kyis lha'i me tog sogs kyis dus shin tu ring po bskal pa mang por mchod pa bas kyang / sher phyin 'di glegs bam du bris te me tog sogs kyis mchod par byed pa ni bsod nams ches che ba yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang bde bar gshegs pa dang de'i sku gdung gi mchod rten sogs kyang sher phyin 'di la brten nas byung ba yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don no/ / rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol zhes pa nas 'gro bar 'gyur zhes pa'i blo ka bzhis gnyis don mos pa sgom lam bstan pa yin la/ de'ang rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad sa la brten nas skye ba bzhin du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad sher phyin 'di la brten nas 'byung ba dang / 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rin po che bdun dang ya ma bral ba bzhin du sher phyin 'di dang 405

da / / ga bsagabasdomaldan pa la yon tan thams cad ya ma bral bar 'du bar 'gyur ba'i don no/rgyal bas brgya byin zhes pa nas/ pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ zhes pa'i bar gyi sh+lau ka dgus gzhan don mos pa sgom lam bstan pa yin la/de'angagang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi zhing khams sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel gyis byur bur bkang ba dang sher phyin gnyis las brgya byin gyis sher phyin blangs pa de ring bsrel la ma gus pa min yang / sku gdung khams che ba de sher phyin gyi dbangagis yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin te/ dper na nor bu rin po che'i snod la phyag 'tshal ba de nor bu rin po che'i dbang gis yin pa bzhin no/ /'di ni rnam mkhyen de sangs rgyas su byed pa'i byed chos yin pa dang 'dra gsung / der ma zad sher phyin 'di yod na phar phyin gzhan lnga chud zos par mi 'gyur ba dang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi shing thams cad la grib ma kha dog gcig las med pa bzhin du phar phyin drug ga'ang rnam mkhyen gyi rgyur ro gcig pa de shes rab kyi phar phyin gye stobs kyis yin pa dang / der ma zad phung po lnga bden par zhen pa'i sgo nas mi rtag sogs su sgom pa de sher phyin bcos mal spyod pa yin la/ de las bzlog pa ni sher phyin rnal ma la spyod pa yin zhes pa'i don yin gsung / /phan yon bstod bkur bsngags gsum ni ji lta ba bzhin yin gyi gcam bu'i ngo bstod min te/ sdud pa las/ la las gang gā'i zhes pa nas/kun gyis char mi phod/ ces pa'i bar gye sh+lau ka bdun gyis bstod bkur bsngags gsum bstan la/ de'ang gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi sems can thams cad dgra bcom la bkod pa las/ byang sems gcig la sher phyin glegs bam du bris te byin na bsod nams che ste/ snga ma gang zag gcig gi don yin la/ phyi ma ni sems can thams cad kyi don du 'gyur ba'i phyir te/406

༄ / /zin des sher phyin nyams su blangs nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bstan pas thams cad byang chub gsum la reg par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ myu gu med na sdong bu sogs mi 'byung ba bzhin du byang chub kyi sems med na 'jig rten du sangs rgyas mi 'byung la/ de ma byung na tshangs pa brgya byin sogs mngon mtho'i bde 'bras phra mo tsam yang mi 'byung la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar na thams cad las byed pa la brtson pa bzhin du sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung na thams cad chos la brtson pa 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ / 'dzam bu'i gling gi chu klung dang me tog sogs thams cad mtsho ma dros pa'i ma thu las byung ba bzhin du yon tan thams cad byang chub kyi sems las 'byung ba yin zhes pa'i don yin gsung /nyi snang las bsngo ba'i khyad par/ byed las/ ngo bo gsum ste bcu gnyis gsungs la/ slob dpon gyis bcu gcig gsungs shing / che 'bring chung gsum ni mdo las rgyun zhugs la bkod pa bas 'di bsod nams che ba dang /dgrabacom la bkod pa bas kyang bsod nam sa che ba sogs dpe gsum gyi sgo nas gsungs pas phye ba yin gyi/ ngo bo'i sgo nas phye ba min gsung / sdud pa las/ nyan thos tshogs rnams zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis rjes su yi rang sgom lam bstan la/ yi rang ba bsngo ba'i sngon du gsungs pa ni/ dge rtsa gong du 'phel ba'i thabs dam pa yi rang dang / bla med byang chub tu bsgyur ba'i dam pa bsngo ba yin pas/ bsngo ba'i rjes su yi rang dang / yi rang gi sngon du bsngo ba dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin nam snyam gsung / de nas 'das dus sngon gyi nas/ zil gyes gnon/ zhes pa'i bar gyi sh+lau ka brgyad kyis bsngo ba sgom lam bstan la/ rang gzhan skye 'phags thams cad kyi dge rtsa la rjes su yi rang byas te gzhan don du byang chub thob pa'i rgyur bsngo ba byang semasakyi bsngo ba'i ngo bo ste/ thams cad bsngo zhes pa yan chad kyis bstan 407

/ /gsung / bsngo tshul ni/ gang bsngo ba rdzas/ gang du bsngo ba'i byang chub/gang gi don du bsngo ba sems can te 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas bsngo ba sogs yin gsung / 'di nas bsngo ba'i le'u rdzogs pa yin la 'di yan chad du le'u lnga song ba yin gsung / /yi rang sgom lam ni bla med byang chub tu bsngos pa'i theg chen gyi dge rtsa de gong 'phel du byed pa rjes su yi rang la rag las pas de'i 'og tu yi rang sgom lam 'chad ces mtshams sbyor ba dang / sdud pa ltar na rjes su yi rang gis mi zad par spel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de'ang bla med byang chub tu kha sgyur bar byed pa bsngo ba la rag las pa yin pas yi rang sgom lam gyi 'og tu bsngo ba sgom lam 'chad ces mtshams sbyor dgos gsung / dbus mtha'i dam pa bcu gnyis kyi tshegs med dam pa'ang rjes su yi rang la byed gsung / gzhan gyis yon tan khyad par sgrub pa la rab tu dga' ba dang gus pa'i sgo nas rjes su yi rang byed dgos pa yin gyi/ de la phrag dog byas na gzhan la cung zad kyang mi gnod par rang gi dge rtsa 'joms par 'gyur pa dang / dge ba chen po la phrag dog byas na rang nyid kyi sdig pa chen po 'thob/ 'bring la byas na sdig pa 'bring / chung ngu la byas na chung ngu 'thob par 'gyur zhing / dge rtsa 'joms pa la zhe sdang dang phrag dog gnyis shin tu sdug shos yin pas de spangs nas/ yi rang de mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas byed par gsungs pa ni yi rang sgom lam gyi ngo bo yin no/ / spyir dge rtsa bsags pa'i zhing dag pa gal che ste/zhing ma dag na lcags bsreg gi steng du sa bon btab pa dang 'dra gsung /'dir dper na gser med pa'i sa nas gser bskos kyang thob bya gang yang med pa dang / gser nyung ngu yod pa'i sa nas bskos na thob bya chen po mi 'ong pa dang / gser gyi 'byung khungs sam gser gyi gter yod pa zhig nas 408

༄ zigaser brkos na thob bya shin tu chen po 'byung ba de bzhin du/ yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung khungs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la brten nas/yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i mos pa sgom lam gyi dge rtsa mang du bsags pa 'byung khungs nas blangs pa'i gser gyi gar bu lta bu ste/nyan thos sam/ rang rgyal lam/ bla med byang chub gang du bsgyur ba bsngo ba la rag las te/ 'byung khungs dag nas blangs pa'i gser gyi gar bu de rna rgyan dang gdu bu sogs gang du sgyur bar byed pa gser bzo mkhas pa la rag las pa bzhin yin gsung / byang sems mnyam pas mnyam pa la yi rang byas na dge rtsa mnyam pa thob la/ chen pos chung ngu la yi rang byas na chung ngu las lhag pa'am chen po thob cing / byang sems dang nyan rang gi yi rang la khyad par chen po yod de/ nyan rang gis yi rang byas pa ni phrag dog gi nyes pa 'gog pa tsam gyi ched yin la/ byang sems kyis sems can thams cad kyi don sgrub dgos pas/ pha rol po rang nyid kyis dang du blangs nas sgrub pa de la byang chub sems dpa' shin tu dga' ba yin te/ dper na mu ge byung ba'i tshe pha zhig rang gi bu mang po gso ba'i khur babs tshe/ bu gcig rang nyid kyis zas btsal te za na de la pha de rang gis byin pa pas kyang shin tu dga' ba yin zhes yongs 'dzin rin po che nas yang yang gsung gi yod gsung / byang sems kyi yi rang gis gzhan gyi dge rtsa tshegs chung dus skad cig ma gcig la sdud par byed pas tshegs med pa dam pa zhes dbus mtha' nas bshad pa yin gsung / zag med sgom lam la sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gnyis yod pas/ kha cig sgrub pa sgom lam spangs pa dang / rnam dag sgom lam rtogs par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ spangs pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig dang po gzhan dbang gi yul can gnyis pa yongs grub kyi yul can du khu9

/ /bshad pa mnyam rjes gnyis la sbyor 'dod pa yin yang mi 'thad/ kha cig dang po bar chad med lam dang / gnyis pa rnam grol lam la sbyar ba'ang mi 'thad de/ gnyis ka nyon mongs skor dgu'i gnyen por gsungs pa'i phyir/rang lugs la spangs rtogs kyi lag rjes kyi ldog cha nas so sor phye bas ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad yin gsung / sgrub pa sgom lam la lnga yod de/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i dbus mthong bas ngo bo nyid dang phar phyin gzhan lnga'ang sangs rgyas su bgrod pa'i lam yin yang / lam gyi dngos gzhi dang /lus ni sher phyin yin pas mchog nyid dang / de dag gi steng du skye 'jig sogs kyang bden med du bsgom pa ni mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang /bdenagrub kyi dbang du byas te bden med du dmigs pa gtod par byed pa dang / don chen po dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ sdud par yang / dmus long dmigs bu zhes sogs blo ka bzhis sgrub pa sgom lam lnga'i nang gi mchog nyid ces pa de bstan pa yin la/ de'ang dper na/ dmus long mang po grong khyer du 'gro bar 'dod cing rkang pa yod kyang mig med na lam mi mthong bas grong khyer du 'gro mi nus pa bzhin du phar phyin gzhan lnga lam yin yang /sher phyin gyi mig dang bral na bla med byang chub tu 'gro mi nus pa dang / ri mo mkhan gyis lha'i mig ma bris par gla rngan mi 'thob pa ltar ro/ / dkar po sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i dge ba dang / nag po nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi dge ba man chad rnams la dmigs pa bral tshe sher phyin grangs su 'gro la/dmigs pa'i 'du shes dang bcas bzhin du bdag ni byang chub sems dpa' chen por rlom zhing sems can mang po sgrol bar khas 'ches kyang sher phyin rnal ma la spyod pa min zhes pa'i don yin gsung / brgyad stong pa las kyang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni snang bar bgyid pa lags so zhes sogs kyis 410

༄ zingo bo nyid dang / rka shi ka 'di lta ste/ dmus long brgya 'am/ stong ngam/brgya stong ngam zhes sogs kyis mchog nyid dang / shā ri'i bu gzugs mngon par mi sgrub ces sogs kyis mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang / ci ltar dmigs pa de lta bur gtod par mi byed pa/ zhes sogs kyis gtod par byed pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chen po lags so/ / zhes sogs kyis don chen po dang lnga gsungs pa yin la/ gtod pa ni mi dmigs pa la dmigs pa gtod pa dang / chen po ni dgos don mchog la byed dgos gsung / rnam dag sgom lam ni/ yon tan bzung ba ste nyams su blangs pa dang / gegs bor ba ste bsal bar ma byas par de mi thob pas de'i sngon du skye dang mi skye ba'i rgyu gsungs la/ skye ba'i rgyu ni sangs rgyas dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byed pa dang / sbyin sogs rdzogs par byed pa dang /dman pa'i yid byed dang ma 'dres pa'i theg chen gyi sems rtse gcig pa rnams yin la/ rnam dag sgom lam rang gi ngo bo ni dmigs med la dmigs pa yin pas med mi rung du thabs khyad par can gyis rtsis zin dgos par bzhed nas 'di rnams gsungs pa yin gsung / spyir na'ang sher mdo'i sgras zin tsam la brten nas spyod phyogs la rtsis su mi byed pa'i rgya nag ha shang dang de dngos min yang/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i bod mang pos spyod pa nyams len gyi phyogs nyams par byas pa'i tshe rje rin po che phebs te spyod phyogs rtsal du bton nas gsungs shing / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la zhus pa'i tshe'ang spyod phyogs la rtsis su byed dgos gsungs pa ltar dgos gsung / mi skye ba'i bdud ni/ bdud kyi thibs kyis non pa dang / zab mo'i chos la ma mos pa sogs bzhi yin la/ bdud kyi thibs kyis non zhes pa ni/ dper na/'jig rten na khang pa dib pa'i 'og tu chud pa la thibs 'og tu chud zer ba 411

/ /ltar/ bdud kyis rgyud brlams te dge ba'i phyogs su 'phar dbang mi 'jug pa la byed de/ byin ni sku gsung thugs kyi gzi byin la byas nas rlob ces pa 'phrin las kyis rgyud khebs nas 'phar gi mi 'jug par 'phrin las dang dgongs pa'i dbang du gyur pa la byed pa'i phyir/ rnam dag sgom lam skye ba'i rgyu de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe / byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis gsungs la/ de'ang sher phyin la spyod pa'i tshe mkhas pa som nyi med par thos ma thag tu 'du shes skyed pa des ni byang chub myur du rtogs par 'gyur zhes pa'i don no/ / mi skye ba'i rgyu 'chad par sngon spyod tshe na zhes sogs blo ka gnyis byung / sngon sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas shing da lta mi lus kyang thob/ sher phyin ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir rang nyid kyis sher phyin nyan mi 'dod cing /gzhan 'chad pa dang nyan pa la mi dga' bar byed pa des sher phyin 'di spangs pas skyabs med par gyur nas mnar med du 'gro ba'i don yin la/ skyabs med par gyur tshul ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis de ma gzigs pa dang /thugs rje chung ba min yang skyob byed kyi thabs dngos ni sher phyin yin la/ de spangs pas skyob thabs ma rnyed pa yin te/ dper na nad pas sman ma 'thung na sman pas kyang thabs mi rnyed pa dang / mi zhig g.yang du lhung ba'i tshe thag pa byin kyang ma bzung na 'dren thabs med pa bzhin yin gsung / des na sangs rgyas thob par mi 'dod na phar zhog / 'dod phyin dal 'byor kyang thob/ mjal dka' ba sher phyin dang mjal/ de ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa'i dus 'dir sher phyin la dad par byas te spyir 'khor ba dang /khyad par ngan song gi gnas su mi 'gro ba'i gdeng thob pa zhig dgos kyi/'dir snying po zhig ma lon par slar yang 'khor ba'i gnas su gar 'gro 'dir 412

ra / /:sgo ji /sgo khye'agro mi shes par 'khyam dgos pa byung na de las lhag pa'i ngo tsha ba dang smad pa'iganas su bya ba ci zhig yod de/ dper na rin po che'i gling du'ang phyin/rin po che dang 'phrad kyang gzhan rnams kyis rin po che khyer 'ong ba'i tshe/rang nyid lag pa stong par rang khyim du 'ong na de 'jig rten na shin tu ngo tsha ba dang smad pa'i gnas su byed pa bzhin yin gsung / rnam dag sgom lam dngos ni 'bras bu dag pa nas/ dag par brjod ces pa'i bar gyis rnam dag spyir bstan la/ de'ang dri ma gnas lugs la ma zhugs pas gzugs sogs gdod nas rnam par dag pa dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba sogs yin kyang bden 'dzin gyis phyin ci log tu bzung nas nyon mongs sogs skyes pa de la dri ma glo bur ba zer zhing / des bsgribs nas sdod lugs gnyis 'dres par snang zhing gnas lugs gsal bar mthong ma nus kyi bar du gzugs sogs rnam par ma dag pa zhes brjod la/ sgrib byed kyi dri ma dag nas gsal bar mthong ba'i tshe gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs gdod nas rnam par dag yod pa de dang / rang gi mthong tshul gnyis mthun song ba'i gnad kyis gzugs dag pa dang / de dag spyong tshul gyi 'bras bu nas sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi 'bras bu dag pa gnyis don gcig tu song ba yin la/gzugasasogs dag pa de las logs shig na 'bras bu dag pa 'jog rgyu med pas so sor gcad du med pa'am ris su ma chad pa zhes bya zhing / 'bras bu dag tshul de la ltos te de'i tshe gzugs sogs dag pa zhes brjod pa yin te/dper na gzugs kyi steng na skra shad 'bab par snang ba de'i tshe gzugs mi gsal zhes brjod la/ 'khrul rgyu log pa'i tshe gzugs gsal zhes brjod pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar min par gzugs kyi steng na dang po nas skra shad yod na gcig gis gsal bar mthong tshe thams cad kyis mthong dgos 413

/ /pas gsal bar mi mthong ba su'ang med par 'gyur ro/ / 'di dag thal 'gyur pa la 'grigs gsung / rnam dag bye brag tu 'chad pa la/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi/ / zhes sogs byung la/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la rgya che chung la sbyar na 'char bde bas/ dper na/ mkhris nad kyis gangs ri ser por snang ba'i mi zhig gru nang du zhugs pa'i tshe gangs ri 'gro bar yang snang la/ chu'i phar 'gram su sleb tshe gangs ri 'gro bar snang ba log nga / da dung ser po snang ba'i cha ma log pa bzhin du/ nyan rang gis thar pa thob pa'i tshe nyon sgrib tsam spangs pas rnam dag phyogs re ba dang /sangs rgyas kyis sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas rnam dag shin tu ba zhes brjod pa yin gsung / de'i rgyu mtshan ni nyan rang gi thar pa thob pa la sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags spong mi dgos shing nyan rang gi lam gyes de spong mi nus pa'i gnad kyis kyang rnam dag kyang nyi tshe ba yin la/ rnam mkhyen thob pa la sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spong dgos shing bskal ba du mar thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas sgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogasapa dgus sgom spang chen po'i chen po la sogs pa dgu spong bar 'gyur bas rgyu ci tsam stobs che ba de dang mtshungs pa'i 'bras bu'ang 'byung bas sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu bar bzhag pa yin gsung / de ltar bshad pa laganyen po chung ngus spang bya chen po spong ba sogs mi 'thad de/ spang bya chen po spong ba la gnyen po chen po dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ dgra stobs ldan gyi kha ya byed pa la tshur ngos ma'ang stobs ldan dgos pa bzhin no zhes pa'i dogs pa khong nas bsus te/ lan ni de dang 'di gnyis mtshungs pa ma yin te/ 'dir ni gos kyi dri ma rags pa de lan gcig bkrus na nag ldur gyis dag 'gro ba dang / gos kyi gseb na zhugs pa'i dri ma phra mo de yang 414

༄ zasadang yang du bkrus te 'bad pa chen pos 'dag dgos pa ltar/ spang bya rags pa spong sla zhing phra mo spong dka' bas klan ka de ni mi 'byung ngo / /'dis ni spong dka' ba de spong bar gsungs pas don gyes rnam dag shin tu ba de sgrub pa yin gsung / de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ gzugs kyi dag pa/ zhes sogs blo ka gcig byung / dang pos rnam dag spyi dang / phyi ma gsum gyis bye brag tu bshad pa yin gsung / ༈/gsum pa lam shes rnam par dang / byed kyi gzhi shes ni/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis lam shes kyi gol sa shes pa'i ched du gzhi shes bstan pas 'dir mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes gtso bor bstan par bzhed kyang / rang lugs la gol sa'ang shes dgos mod/ gtso bor lam shes kyi grogs su gyur pa'i mi rtag sogs rtogs pa'i gzhi shes byang sems rang rgyud la skyed par byed pa de 'dir bshad pa yin te / skabs dang po gnyis su lam shes mtha' gnyis rnam dag tu bstan pa la/ dag byed kyi lag rjes gang gis byed 'dir 'chad pa'i phyir/ de la shes pas srid la mi gnas pa/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i lam shes/'bras yum la nye ring gi de dang / gnyen po dang / mi mthun phyogs kyi de dang / spyor ba/ 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid/ mthong lam dang dgu yod la/dang po gnyis ni/ skyon mthong phyir na srid par min/ / zhes pa ltar 'khor ba'i skyon mthong bas srid mtha' 'gog pa'i gzhi shes dang / gzhan don nam yang mi 'dor bas zhi mtha' 'gog pa'i snying rje ste 'di gnyis kun rdzob la ltos pas de gnyis 'gog byed yin gsung / skye ba du mar brgyud de 'ong bas 'khor ba la rtag mtha' dang / 'khor ba zad tsam gyi cha yin pas myang 'das la chad mthar gsungs pa yin no/ / spyir byang sems de gnyis kyi bar na gnas kyang bden zhen gyis gnas pa 'gog dgos pas don dam par de 415

/ /gnyis kyi bar na'ang mi gnas pa ste 'dis don dam la ltos pa'i de gnyis 'gogagasung / kun shes pa'i skabs las bzlog ces pa ni/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi de gtso bor dngos su bstan pa las bzlog ste shugs la mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes bstan pa la byed/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du ma rtogs pas nyan thos 'jigs sred kyi sgrib pa dang / rang rgyal brtse med kyi sgrib pa dang ldan zhing / des srid zhi'i mthar ltung bar bshad pa la/ nyan rang gis dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du ma rtogs pas srid zhi'i mthar lhung bar bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ des dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir te/ klu sgrub kyi bstod tshogs las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang / / de nyid khyod ni stong par bzhed/ / ces stong pa rten 'byung gi don du gsungs pa gang zhig / nyan rang gis rten 'byung rtogs pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtsod pa zhig bkod la/ 'god mkhan ni thal 'gyur pa zhig yin pa 'dra ste/ thal 'gyur pas kyang rten 'byung rtogs na stong nyid rtogs pas khyab pa zhal gyis mi bzhes kyang / rten 'byung ji lta ba bzhin rtogs na stong pa nyid myur du rtogs nus par 'dod pa yin gsung / 'di'i gzhi ni rten 'byung la byed/ lan dngos su ma gsungs kyang / 'dis rten 'byung rtogs na stong nyid rtogs pas khyab pa bstan pa min gyi/ stong nyid yin na rten 'byung yin pas khyab pa bstan pa yin pas skyon med ces pa'i lan zhig don gyis thob gsung / de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe dpa' bo gar spyod/ ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / bden 'dzin dang rang gces 'dzin gyis g.yo bar mi nus pa'i dpa' bo rnams 'khor ba'i gnas gang du spyod kyang 'khor ba'i skyon mthong ba'i sher phyin gyis khams gsum gang du'ang mi chags par de las 'das kyang 416
