༄/ /ziḥyogayozhiba'i bde ba la gzhol bar mi 'gyur bas srid mtha' la mi gnas pa dang /las nyon gyi dbang gis min par gzhan don yal bar mi 'dor ba'i steng rjes 'khor ba'i gnas su skye rga na 'chi sogs dus 'tsham par ston par 'gyur bas zhi mthar mi gnas pa ste/ srid zhi'i mthar mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes gnyis dngos su bstan nas 'bras yum la nye ring gi gzhi shes gnyis shugs la bstan pa yin gsung / rnam bshad las kyang 'di gnyis snga ma gnyis kyi rgyu mtshan du gsungs la/ nye ring du 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis rta glang sprul tshe 'di sprul pa yin zhes ston mkhan kyang med rang gis kyang ma shes pas rta glang dngos su zhen pa ltar stong nyid ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ma 'phrad pa dang / phrad kyang de ston pa'i snod du ma rung bas bden par snang ba ltar zhen pa'i dbang gis 'bras yum las ring bar gyur pa dang / byang sems ni phyi nang gi rkyen thams cad tshogs pa'i sgo nas sher phyin la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa'i stobs kyis snga ma las brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyis khyad zhugs nas bla med byang chub myur du 'thob par 'gyur bas na 'bras yum la nye ba yin gsung / brgyad stong pa las kyang / bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshu rol gyi 'gram na yang mi gnas pha rol gyi 'gram na yang mi gnas/ gnyis ga'i bar rgyang ring po na yang mi gnas zhes sogs kyis gsungs la/ gong du lam shes rnam par dag par gsungs pas/ rnam par dag byed gang yin dris pa'i lan du gsungs pa yin no/ / gnyen po dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes la/ gzhi lam dang / 'bras bu'i dbang du byas pa gnyis yod pas/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang dus gsum pa'i chos rnams la bden par zhen pa dang / sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la bden par zhen pa gnyis ni gzhi dang lam la dmigs pa'i mi mthun 417

/ /phyogs te/ rnam pa thams cad du blang bya ma yin pas byang sems kyi lam gye mi mthun phyogs yin la/ thal 'gyur pa ltar na bden par zhen nas mi rtag pa sogs su bsgom pas mi rtag pa sgom par mi 'gro zhing thar pa thob mi nus/rang rgyud pas thag khra la sbrul du bzung ba'i tshe gzhan gyis 'di shing gi lbug ma phra mo yin no zhes bstan pa na thag khra dngos su ma bzung yang / shing gi lbug ma yin par bzung bas kyang sbrul du bzung ba'i 'jigs pa sel nus pa bzhin du chos kyi gnas lugs ma rtogs kyang bdag med rags pas kyang nyon sgrib spong nus par 'dod pa yin gsung / 'bras bu'i dbang du byas pa'i gnyis ni / sbyin pa gtong ba'i tshe sbyin pa'i 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa dang gtong yul phung po lnga'ang mi dmigs par shes dgos pas gzhi lam gnyis ka la dmigs pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs te/ 'di ni thabs shes gang gi cha nas kyangawad du mi rung bas rnam pa thams cad du blang bar bya ba'am gnyen po yin no/ / rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra/ / zhes pa 'di tshig gong ma gsum gye mjug tu sbyar ba ni sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis yin gsung / de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ 'gro ba 'di zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / 'gro ba 'di dag brgal bar dka' ba 'dam dang 'dra ba'i ming gzugs kyi phung po lnga la bden par zhen te/ tshul min yid byed kyi rlung gis g.yo bas srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar du 'khyams pa yin la/ 'gro ba 'khrul ba rnams 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir ri dwags rgyar chud pa dang 'dra bar shes nas/ shes rab dang ldan pa rnams bya nam mkhar rgyu'ang nam mkha' la mi gnas pa bzhin du 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir chags pa'i dbang gis mi gnas pa yin gsung /'bras bu'i dbang du byas pa'i de gnyis ni/ mi mthun phyogs dngos dang /de'i rgyu mtshan/ gnyen po'i phyogs dngos dang / de'i 'phros don dang bzhi 418

༄ zasayod la/ 'bras bu mchog sangs rgyas la bden par zhen pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba sogs kyang bsod nams bsags pa yin mod kyi shes rab kyi cha nas ma dag pas byang sems la ltos te mi mthun phyogs yin no/ / 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i de dgos don thams cad kyi mchog yin pas de la bden par zhen pa'ang spong dka' ba'i gnad kyis gzhi lam gnyis las logs su gsungs pa yin/ de mi mthun phyogs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ chos kyi lam ste 'khor 'das kyi chos kyi rigs rnams bden pas stong pa yin pas na zab pa yin pa la/ zab pa yin pa de'i phyir sangs rgyas la zhen pa ni mi mthun phyogs yin no/ / gnyen po dngos ni/ tha snyad du 'bras bu la mchog dman sogs yod kyang / don dam par de dag thams cad mnyam nyid ngo bo gcig tu shes pas sangs rgyas sogs 'bras bu la bden zhen spong nus pa yin gsung /'phros don ni/ zab pa'i rgyu mtshan rtogs dka' ba dang / rtogs dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan du bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin par gsungs la/ rtogs dka' tshul ni/ mig shes sogs kyis gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs ma mthong ba de gzugs sogs las logs shig na yod pas ma mthong ba yin na rigs mod kyi/ gnas lugs de gzugs sogs kyi steng na yod bzhin du gzugs sogs mthong yang de'i gnas lugs mi mthong ba 'di rtogs dka' ba'i tshul yin la/ 'di lta mgur 'grel pa na rgyas par yod gsung / bsam gyis mi khyab tshul ni / mnyam gzhag gi gnas skabs su bden par med pa dang med pa'i khyad par gtan nas mi phyed pas rjes kyi nges pa 'dren tshul la lhos te 'byed dgos la / rjes kyi skabs sngar gyi blo de cung zad skog tu gyur pa'i tshe 'di dag thams cad med do snyam du las 'bras sogs la rtsis med du song yod na sngar gyi lta ba de chad ltar song ba'i rtags yin gsung / gzhi shes 419

/ /sbyor ba ni/ de la dbye na yul gyi sgo nas bzhi/ ngo bo'i sgo nas gsum/byed pa'i sgo nas gnyis/ shes byed dpe'i sgo nas gcig rnams su yod la/gzugs sogs zhes pas khyad gzhi gzugs sogs la bden zhen bkag pa'i de/ de mi rtag sogs zhes pas khyad chos mi rtag sogs la bden zhen bkag pa'ide/ de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang / / zhes pa de la dmigs te sgrib pa dag nus pa dang mi nus pa dang / chags pa med nyid la zhes pas/donadam par chags pa med pa la'ang bden zhen bkag pa'i sbyor ba bzhi ni yul gyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba zhes pa 'di grangs la mi 'dren par/ gzugs sogs la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba/mi rtag pa sogs la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba zhes sogs bcu po re re'i mjug tu spyor dgos kyang 'dir dang po bzhi'i mthar sbyar ba ni 'og ma rnams la'angadon gyis go ba dang mdo'i tshig gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'grel par yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i sgo nas zhes thams cad kyi mthar sbyar ba ni don thob kyi dbang du byas pa yin gsung / mi 'gyur zhes pas gcig /byed po med ces pas gcig / bya dka' rnam gsum zhes pas gcig ste gsum ni ngo bo'i sgo nas bzhag pa yin la/ ched du bya ba rnam mkhyen de grangs med gsum gyi tshogs la ltos pa dang / de la bden par zhen na chags pa phra mor 'gyur bas mi rung la/ des na ched du bya ba bya dka' ba dang /lam shes de nyams su len dgos kyang bden par zhen na mi rung bas sbyor ba bya dka' ba dang / gzhi shes kyi rtog rigs byang sems kyis ma tshang ba med par shes dgos kyang gtsor 'don byas nas sam gtso bor de la gzhol du mi rung bas las bya dka' ba yin/ skal ba ji bzhin 'bras thob pas/ /'bras yod 'dod pa zhes pas gcig / gzhan la rag las med gang zhes 420

sa / /pas gcig ste de gnyis byed pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa yin la/ rigs can gsum gyi yon tan thams cad yar ldan du 'dus pas skal ba ji lta ba bzhin 'bras bu 'thob pa dang / rkyen gzhan la rag ma las par rang stobs kyis thob pa'o/ / snang ba rnam bdun shes byed do/ / zhes pas gcig ste de ni shes byed dpe'i sgo nas bzhag pa yin la/ dpe bdun ni/ nyin par gang 'dod pa de phal cher rmi lam du'ang bag chags yongs su smin pa'i dbang gis snang bar 'gyur ba bzhin du chos thams cad bden par med kyang bag chags yongs su smin pa'i dbang gis snang bar 'gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam na/ / bu pho byung zhing shi ba des mthong na/ / byung nas dga' zhing shi na mi dga' ltar/ / chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sgyu ma'i rta glangade sprul gzhi dang sngags rdzas dang sprul mkhan te rkyen de gsum tshogs pa tsam gyes rta glang snang bar 'gyur gye de gsum gyi gcig ma tshang na'ang mi snang ba bzhin du dngos po rnams bden par med kyang rgyu ngo bo cha shas gsum tshogs pa tsam gyis snang ba'i phyir/ bden par grub na bum pa dang khang pa sogs kyi cha shas so sor bsal ba dang / gzugs can ma yin pa rnams kyi rgyun so sor bsal ba'i shul na yod dgos pa la tshugs mi thub par zhig 'gro ba de bden par med pa'i rtags yin gsung / de nyid las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ / rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas/ / de la ji ltar snang bzhin gang yang med/ / chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyes/ / zhes gsungs/ smig rgyu des chur snang ba bskyed kyang chur ma grub pas snang tshul dang gnas tshul 'gal ba bzhin du/ 'di dag kyang snang tshul dngaganas tshul 'gal ba'i phyir/ smig rgyu ni chos kun tu 'gro ba'i mdor 421

/dpyid dus dang nyi ma'i 'od zer dang bye ma skya bo gsum tshogs pa'i gzhir snang b.ragasungs pas/ gnas tshod rlan tsam yang med pa'i shin tu skam sa de 'dra zhig la chu dwangs shing bsil bar snang bas snang tshul dang gnas tshul shin tu 'gal ba zhig yin gsung / de nyid las smig rgyu la ni chu de yong med na/ / sems can rmongs pa de ni 'thung 'dod de/ / mi bden chu ni 'thung bar yong mi nus/ / chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ / zhes gsungs/ brag cha ni brag ngos la thal mo brdab na de'i rkyen gyis brag ngos na'ang de 'dra'i sgra 'byung ba dang / thal mo brdab pa sogs ma byas na brag ngosanas kyang tshur sgra mi 'byung ba bzhin du/ rnam rtog gi phar sgo btags pas de'i rang mdangs tshur shar ba yin gyi/ rnam rtog gis phar sgro ma btagasan/ phyi rol na tshur bde sdug sogs kyi rnam pa gtod byed yod pa min gsung / de nyid las/ ji ltar mi dag nags kyi khrod 'dug ste/ /glu len smra zhing gad mo rgod pa las/ / brag cha snang yang snang ba gang yang med/chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ / zhes gsungs/ / mig yor la/ theg bsdus las me'i rtsed mo zhes 'gal me'i 'khor lo la bshad pa dang / yang kha cig nas grib ma la bshad pa sogs yod kyang don gcig tu 'grobs/ gzugs yod tshe de rtsig ngos la 'phos pa min kyang de'i grib ma rtsig pa'i ngos la 'byung ba dang / zla ba mkha' la shar tshe de chu'i nang du ma 'phos kyang zla ba'i gzugs brnyan chu'i nang du 'char ba bzhin du/ bag chags yod na de yul der 'phos pa'am gyur pa min kyang bag chags de'i dbang gis de dang cha 'dra ba'i snang ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ de nyid las/ ji ltar nam mkha' dwangs par zla shar ba/ / de yi gzugs brnyan dwangs pa'i mtshor snang yang / / zla ba chu yi nang du 'phos pa med/ / chos rnams thams 422

das / /13 /spro sacad de ltar shes par gyis/ / zhes gsungs/ dri za'i grong khyer ni dri za de dgagang du song ba'i gnas der las kyi dbang gis sdod sa'i grong khyer grub yod pa'i snang ba 'byung yang / de grong khyer dngos min la dri za de dag gzhan du song ba na de'i grong khyer yang 'gag 'gro ba dang / gzhan du song na de na'ang rang gi gnas grong khyer sogs yod yod 'dra ba'i snang ba 'char ba bzhin du chos thams cad gzhi gcig tu bden par grub nas gnas sdod pa gang yang med gsung / sprul pa po la ma ltos par sprul pa'i ngag smra ba sogs mi nus pa bzhin du/ las gsog pa po don dam par med pa'i phyir/sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa la gang zag yang yod pas/ sprul pas smra ba la sprul pa pos smra mi dgos gsung / de gnyis ston par de nyid las/ ji ltar sprul pa dri za'i grong khyer dang / / rmi lam ji bzhin sgyu ma ji bzhin du/ / mtshan ma bsgom pa ngo bo nyid kyis stong / / chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ / zhes gsungs/ gzhi shes spyor ba bcu po 'di phar phyin rtog ge snang bar spyor lam dngos yin par gsungs la/ rnam bshad las kyang dngos yin pa'i phyogs su gsungs shing / gser phreng las/ 'di la sbyor lam zhesabashad pa ni/ de la sbyor bar byed pa'i lam mam/ de sgom par byed pa'ilam yin pas na sbyor lam zhes bar gyi tshig bsdus pa yin gyi sbyor lam dngos yin mi dgos par gsungs pa dang mthun par rang re'i yig char yang tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du bzhag pa yin gsung / 'on kyang rtog ge snang bar yang / skabs bzhi pa'i khyad mtshan gyi yul gzhi shes kyi rnam pa ma gsungs pa sngar gzhi shes sbyor ba'i skabs su bshad zin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par gsungs pas/ de la dpag na dngos ma yin par spyi ldog tsam la bzhed pa yin nam snyam gsung / 'dir byang sems kyi rgyud kyi de gtso bor 423

/bstan pa'i shugs la nyan rang gi de ston pa yin/ sbyor ba'i 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid la/ gzugs sogs ngo bo dang / sngon po sogs mtshan ma dang /spros pa dang / yul can rtog pa'i rlom pa 'gog pa bzhi yod gsung / gzhi shes spyor ba dang / sbyor ba'i 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid gnyis sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ spyod pa yongs dag ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / 'di la dbri snon mi dgos gsung / mthong lam ni skad cig ma'i sgo nas mdor bstan nas/ rnam pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa ni/ zin bya zin byed gnyis sbrags te gsung bas/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min/ zhes pas don dam par mi rtag par med kyang / tha snyad du gzugs mi rtag par bsgom par bya ba dang / mtha' las 'das dang zhes pas gcig ste mtha' 'khor ba rgyun chags pa'i rtag mtha' dang / 'khor ba chad tsam gyi dman pa'i myang 'das ni chad mtha' ste nyan thos kyi myang 'das de rang kho na'i don du don dam par thob byar zhen kyang / byang sems kyis de 'gog par byed gsung /rnam dag ces pa gcig dang / ma skyes ma 'gag la sogs zhes pas bdag med pa'i ste sdug bden gye rnam pa bzhi dang / mkha' 'dra zhes pas rgyu ste/nam mkhas sprin gyi rgyu'ang mi byed/ sprin 'byung ba'i go'ang mi 'gog pa ltar kun 'byung gis tha snyad du sdug bden gyi rgyu byed kyang don dam par mi byed pas nam mkha' dang 'dra la/ nam mkha' gzugs su grub na gzugs can gzhan la go mi 'byed pa ltar/ kun 'byung bden par grub na gsung /chags pa spangs pa dang zhes pas kun 'byung dang / yongs su 'dzin las grol ba zhes pas rab skye dang / ngo bo nyid kyis brjod med ces pas rkyen te kun 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi dang / gzhan la sbyin du med pa zhes pas 'gog pa dang / dmigs pa med par byed pa zhes pas zhi ba dang / shin tu rnam 424

sa / /zin gris kha' ༄ stegodag ces pas gya nom dang / nad mi 'byung zhes pas nges 'byung ste 'gog pa'i rnam pa bzhi yin la/ kha cig 'di'i nad de bden 'dzin la byed pa yod kyang / 'di'i mdo las nad kyi rnam grangs mang po gsungs pas spyir gyi nad la byed gsung / ngan song chad dang zhes pas lam ste 'di'ang ngan song dngosal byed/ 'bras bu ni/ mngon du bya la mi rtog ces pas rigs pa dang / mtshan ma dag dang ma 'brel dang zhes pas sgrub pa dang / dngos dang zhes sogs kyis nges 'byin gye ste lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi bstan pa yin gsung / nyan thos kyi lam ni byang chub sems dpas yongs su shes par bya ba yin gyi/ mngon du bya ba ni ma yin pas zhes pas nyan thos kyi lam zhes gsungs kyang nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i lam yin gyi lam dngos ni min gsung / mthong lam de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ de ltar spyod pa'i zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / spyor lam du stong nyid sgom pa las mes nags tshal sogs bsregs pa ltar sgrib pa'i nags tshal sogs bsreg pa'i lam gyi thog ma mthong lam skyes pa'i don yin gsung / slob dpon ltar na sreg pa bzhin zhes pa'i mtshams 'di nas skabs gcig 'byed dgos kyi/chos rnams thams cad ces pa'i sh+lau ka gcig po 'di rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mdor bstan la mar sbyar ba yin gsung / ye shes zhabs kyi sdud 'grel ltar na sh+lau ka gcig po 'di mthong lam la yar sbyar nas/ rgyal ba la ni lha rgyal zhes pa man chad rnam rdzogs spyor ba la sbyor ba yin pas/ rgyal ba la ni zhes pa'i mgor skabs gcig byas la sdud pa phal cher na'ang 'di ltar byas snang gsung / mjug bsdu ni/ rtsa ba ltar na rab 'byor yum 'di ni chos yang thob par byed pa ma yin zhes sogs gzhi shes kyi mjug bsdu ba'i tshig bcu dgu po 'di dang / yang lam shes kyi mjug bsdu ba'i mdo tshig 'di dang / yang 425

/ /rnam mkhyen gyi mjug bsdu ba'i mdo tshig gsum po 'dis sngar mkhyen gsum rgyas par bshad zin par bstan pa yin no/ / 'grel pa ltar na mdo tshan gsum po des rnam mkhyen 'di dang / yang lam shes 'di dang / yang gzhi shes 'di ste rab 'byor dang mtha' gnyis rnam dag dang / spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'u gsum gye brjod don rnam pa gsum po de'ang rgyas par bshad zin par ston pa'i sgo nas mjug bsdus pa yin/ le'u gsum gyis zhes byed tshig mi bya bar/ le'u gsum gyi zhes drug sgra sbyor dgos gsung / rtsa bas gzhi shes sogs mas rim nas bsdus pa nyi khri ltar dang / 'grel pas rnam mkhyen sogs yas rim nas bsdus pa brgyad stong pa ltar yin no/ / mdo las mkhyen gsum la mjug bsdu mdzad nas gzhan la ma mdzad pa ni mkhyen gsum gyis mngon rtogs thams cad bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin gsung /gnyis pa ni shes bya mkhyen pa gsum gtan la phab pa la/ 'o na de nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba ji lta bu yod ce na/ sbyor ba la dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras dang brtan pa rgyu 'bras gnyis las/ dang po la dbang du byed pa'i rgyu rnam rdzogs sbyor b.rang / 'bras bu rtse spyor gnyis/ dang po la mtshams sbyar ba/ le'u'i gzhung bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni 'grel pa las/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum yongs su shes pa ni dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ yang rnam pa thams cad dang lam thams cad dang gzhi shes pa bsdu ba'i sgo nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum sgom par byed pas/rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa zhes byung / gzhung 'dis skabs dang po gsum du mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa mtha' dag bshad zin pas zlos par 'gyur zhes pa'i rtsod pa khong nas bsus te/ dang po gsum dang rnam rdzogs kyi skabs gnyis rnam pa dang / ngo bo dang / byed las gsum gyi 426

༄ zasasgo nas ston tshul dang dgos pa mi 'dra bas zlos skyon med ces pa'i lan dngos su mdzad de mtshams sbyar ba yin la/ de'ang zlos skyon med tshul ni/skabs dang po gsum du 'di'i mjug thogs su 'di sgom zhes go rim mthar chags su ma gsungs par/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa thor bu thor bur gsungs la/ de tsam gyis las dang po pa rnams kyis go rim mthar chags su bsdus nas nyams su len tshul shes mi nus pas so sor thos bsam gyis yongs su shes pa ni/ 'dir dbang du bya ba'i phyir yang go rim mthar chags su rnam pa ma lus pa sbyor ba'i yul du bsdus nas bstan pas rnam pa'i sgo nas zlos skyon med ces pa'i dbri snon byed lugs gcig dang / yang skabs dang po gsum du bsgom bya'i yul gye ldog chas bstan la/ 'dir sgom byed kyi spyor ba'i ldog cha nas bstan pas ngo bo'i sgo nas zlos spong gi dbri snon byed lugs dang / yang skabs dang po gsum du rnam mkhyen gyis chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa dang mi mthun phyogs ma lus pa dang bral ba dang / lam shes srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis dang bral ba dang / gzhi shes kyis gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa dang / 'bras yum la nye ring sogs bshad pas rang gi mi mthun phyogs dang bral tshul gyi sgo nas rim bzhin ston la/'dir mi mthun phyogs de dag spong tshul dang / gnyen po'i ldog cha nas bstan pas byed las kyi bshad tshul dang dgos pa mi 'dra bas zlos skyon med pa'i dbri snon byed lugs gcig dang gsum yod gsung / rnam pa thams cad dang lam dang gzhi shes pa bsdu ba'i sgo nas zhes sogs mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom gyi don la snga rabs pa kha cig rnam pa thams cad stong pa nyid du bsdus nas sgom par 'dod pa dang / tshan pa gnyis byas te sgom par 'dod pa dang / der ma zad bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis 'ded pa ltar/ phyag rgya 427

/ chen po gcig pu bsgom pas chog gi lam gyi grangs nges sogs mang po byed pa ni mtshan nyid pas gzhan grangs 'dren sogs ma nges pa ar ra gtod ched tsam yin zer ro/ / de mi 'thad de/ stong nyid sgom pa mi rtag sogs sgom pa ma yin pas/ 'dir ni mi rtag pa sogs sgom tshul ma gsungs par 'gyur la skabs gzhan du'ang ma gsungs pas de dag sgom tshul mi shes par 'gyur ba dang / gcig sgom pas chog na sangs rgyas kyis don slab gcig po de gdul bya la ston dgos pa la ma bstan par lam gyi grangs nges sogs gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rje rin po che nas kyang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la zhus pa'i tshe lam gyi ngo bo nges pa grangs nges pa go rim nges pa sogs shin tu gal che bar gsungs pa dang / grangs nges med na gal che ba dag lus nas chung ngu re tsam gye steng du mgo 'khor bar 'gyur ba dang / go rim ma nges na mgo mjug dkrug nas gang zab zab de kha mkho la thug nas sngon la blangs te bsgom pas rtogs pa bogs gang yang thon rgyu med de/ dper na skas tshigs 'og ma la ma spos par gong mar cer bltas byas bsdad pas khang thog tu 'gro mi nus pa bzhin yin gsung / des na mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom gyi don ni/ rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum dkyus thog gcig la go rim thar chags su sgom pa la byed gsung / gnyis pa gzhung don la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba spyi'i rnam bzhag dang / thar pa cha mthun nas bzung rgyud la skye rim bshad pa gnyis/dang po la rnam pa dang / de sgom byed kyi sbyor ba dang / spyor ba sgom pa la spro babaskyed pa'i yon tan dang / gegs sel dgos pas sbyor ba'i skyon dang /yul shes tshul/ gzhan don gyi byed pa/ theg dman las khyad par 'phags pa/ rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i mtshan nyid bzhi dang bcas pa rnams suyod pa las/ dang po rnam pa ni/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams/ /428

ra / /zizug ge rteste/'arnam pa zhes bya/ zhes pas gzhi shes pas gzhi shes/ lam shes pas lam shes/ rnam pa shes pas rnam mkhyen bstan par tshig gsal nas gsungs kyang / rang lugs la/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams/ / zhes pas gnyen po shes rnam bstan pa yin la/ de yang gdul bya'i rgyud kyi phyin ci log gi rtog pa mtha' yas pas de dag re re nas gnyen po bstan na blor mi shong la gcig tsam gyis go mi nus pas 'dir bsdus nas de dag spong byed kyi gnyen po shesarnam kun la bye brag rnams zhes bstan/ rnam pa zhes bya zhes pas mdo las shes rnam de dag la rnam pa zhes bya bar bshad ces pa dang / mtshan nyid de zhes pas mdo las rnam pa zhes bshad pa de dag ni gong du bstan pa'i gnyen po shes rnam de dag yin zhes bshad pa la phyi ma snga ma'i 'jog byed du bstan zhes pa yin gsung / 'di dag la mdo dang bstan bcos las rnam pa zhes yang dang yang du gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir bden 'dzin dang rnam mkhyen gnyis dmigs pa'i sgo nas 'byed dgos pa dang / de'ang bden 'dzin gyi dmigs pa la phyin ci log tu sgo btags nas 'khor bar skye ba sogs yin la/ rnam mkhyen gyis de'i ldog phyogs kyi rnam par bzung nas 'khor ba las grol bar 'gyur ba sogs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin nam snyam gsung / rnam pa de la dbye na/ mkhyen gsum gyi dbye bas gsum yod/mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa de sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ chos rnams thams cad ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / 'dis zin byed kyi cha nas bstan pa yin gsung / 'dir gzhi shes la med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ / mi g.yo ba yi rnam pa'i bar/ / zhes ya mtha'i sa mtshams dang rnam mkhyen la/ dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung ste/ zhes ma mtha'i sa mtshams bzung ba'i bar gyi de dag lam shes kyi rnam par go nus gsung / 'o na mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam pa 429

/ /gsum yod na de dag gang zhe na/ dang po gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun ni/med pa dang zhes pas sdug bsngal rtag par med pa'i rnam pa bstan la/de'ang dbus mtha' las/ mi rtag don ni med don dang / / skye zhing 'jig pa'i mtshan nyid dang / / dri bcas dri ma med don dang / / rtsa ba'i kho nar go rim bzhin/ / zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las kyang chos kyi sdom bzhi bshad pa'i skabs su/ brtan pa rnams kyi bzhi po ni/ / med pa'i don dang rnam rtog don/ / kun tu rtog don kho na dang / / rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba'i don/ / zhes dang 'dir yang med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ zhes sogs 'di dag gi skabs su mi rtag pa med pa'i don can du bshad pa ni/ yongs 'dzin rin po che nas nges med drug la sbyar nas gsungs la/ de'ang che 'di'i gnyen nye du sogs la yid brtan cung zad kyang med par mthar bsru bar 'gyur ba dang / snga dro gson pa'ang phyi dro de'i steng na med pa dang /snga dro dar ba'ang phyi dro de'i steng na med pa sogs skad cig re re la 'gyur nas 'gro ba de 'dra zhig gi steng nas mi rtag pa de med pa'i don can du bshad pa red gsung / sdug bsngal rtag par med pa'i rnam pa 'di ni/ brgyad stong pa las/ bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' ma mchis pa'i slad du 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ / zhes pas bstan la 'dir don dam par ma mchis pa zhes zin byed kyi dbang du byas shing / bstan bcos las mi rtag pa'i rnam pa zhes gsungs pa sbas don yin gsung / mi skye ba zhes pa nyi khri'i tshig gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ brgyad stong par bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad dmigs su ma mchis par mnyam pa'i slad du 'di ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes bstan/ don gzhan gyi bdag gis dbe+en pa ni/ brgyad stong par bcom ldan 'das shin tu stong pa'i slad 4༅

༄/ /zin sasbasadodu 'di ni dben pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes pas bstan/ rang gi ngo bo bdag gis mi badzi ba ni/ brgyad stong par/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i slad du 'di ni mi badzi ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ zhes pas bstan/ bzhi po 'di sdug bden gyi rnam pa'o/ / gnas med pa zhes pa ni/ spyir sred len srid pa gsum ka sdug bden gyi rgyu yin kyang / rnam 'grel las/ srid ba'i sred las rnam brgal bas/ / las gzhan 'phen nus ma yin te/zhes gsungs pa ltar sred len gnyis med na 'khor bar mi skye la/ phung po 'jig gis dogs nas da lta'i phung po la mi 'bral bar sred pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i phung po la smon pa'i sred pa gnyis yod na srid par nying mtshams spyor bas na de gnyis tha snyad du sdug bden gyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin yang don dam par gnas med pa ste/ brgyad stong par/ bcom ldan 'das ming ma mchis shing lus ma mchis pa'i slad du 'di ni gnas ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ / zhes so/ 'dir ming dang lus smos pa ni sred pa'i yul gyi dbang du byas pa yin gsung / nam mkha' dang zhes pa nyi khri'i tshig gi dbang du byas la/ brgyad stong par/ bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba dang 'ong ba ma mchis pa'i slad du 'di ni ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ / zhes pa ste nam mkha'i ngo bo la 'gro 'ong gi bya ba bzhag tu med pa ltar kun 'byung gis don dam par sdug bden gyi rgyu byas te skye ba snga ma nas 'dir 'ong ba dang / 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba med pa'i don no/ / brjod du med pa zhes pa ni/ brgyad stong par/bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad rtog pa ma mchis pa'i slad du 'di ni brjod du ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes pas bstan/ rtog dpyod ces 'byung yang / don dam par sgra rtogagis brjod du med pa la byas na chog gsung / ming med pa zhes pa ni/431

/brgyad stong par/ bcom ldan 'das phung po lnga dmigs su ma mchis pa'i slad du 'di ni ming ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ / zhes pas bstan/sred pa'i rkyen gyi gtso bo tshor ba sogs ming bzhi'i phung po tha snyad du yod kyang don dam par med pa ste bzhi po 'di kun 'byung gi rnam pa yin no/ / 'gro ba med pa zhes pa ni/ brgyad stong par/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad 'gro ba ma mchis pa'i slad du 'di ni 'gro ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes pas bstan/ 'gog pa rgyud gcig nas gcig tu 'gro zhing thob par byar med pa'i don no/ / mi 'phrog pa zhes pa ni/ brgyad stong par/bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad gzung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du 'di ni mi 'phrog pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes pas bstan/ 'di la gser 'phreng las blo'i yul du don dam par gzung du med pa la bshad pas/ brgyad stong pa'i tshig 'di la 'bru bsnan pa e yin snyam gsung / rnam bshad las rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa zhes rkyen gyi stobs kyis mi nyams pa la bshad gsung / mi zad pa zhes pa ni/ brgyad stong par bcom ldan 'das mi bas pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i slad du 'di ni mi bas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ / zhes pas bstan/zad do zhes pa la bas so zhes pa'ang yod pas 'di'i mi bas pa zhes pa ni brda gsar rnying gi khyad ma gtogs mi zad pa zhes pa yin gsung / skye ba med pa zhes pa ni/ brgyad stong par/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad mngon par ma grub pa'i slad du 'di ni mi skye ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes pas bstan te/ bzhi po 'di 'gog pa'i rnam pa'o/ / lam ni bgrod pa po'i gang zag gi byed pa la ltos nas 'jog dgos pas don dam par byed pa po med kyang tha snyad du yod dgos pa dang / rig pa ni bdag med rig pa'am shes pa'i sgo nas 'jog dgos pas don dam par shes pa po med kyang tha snyad du yod dgos 432

sa / /zi ga sa g.yo 11gagopa dang / don dam par sgrub pa byas te lam gong mar 'pho ba po med kyang tha snyad du yod dgos pa dang / don dam par nyon mongs 'dul ba po med kyang / tha snyad du nyon mongs drungs nas 'byin par byed pa'i 'dul ba po yod dgos pas lam bden gyi rnam pa mthong lam zag med bzhi dang /mnyam bzhag tu gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i stobs kyis rjes thob tu phyi don gyes stong pa rmi lam lta bu'i rnam pa can sogs sgom lam zag bcas lnga dang / nyon mongs med pa sogs sgom lam zag med drug ste lam gyi rnam pa bco lnga dang bcas pa'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun yin no/ / lam gyi rnam pa bco lnga ni/ brgyad stong bar/bcom ldan 'das byed pa po ma mchis pa'i slad du zhes pa nas mi g.yo ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyisabastan/ rmi lam sogs dper bzung ba thams cad bden med kyi dpe yin dgos pa'i nges pa med gsung /kha cig slob dpon gyis gzhi shes kyis rang rgyal gyi mngon rtogs bsdus par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ de shes rnam gyi dbang du byas pa yin na bden pa dang po gsum der ma 'dus pa dang / don rnam 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas skabs don las nyams pa'i skyon gnyis yod la/ don rnam gyi dbang du byas pa yin na nyan rang byang sems sangs rgyas kyi lam sogs thams cad gzhi shes kyi dmigs par 'dus pa'i phyir zhe na/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa ston pa'i skabs 'dir bshad pa'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa la gzhi shes su 'du dgos pas ma khyab kyang lam bden gyi rnam pa dag der 'du dgos te/ dper na rgyu nor sogs gcig pa'i mi gsum gyi re res kyang nga'i rgyu nor zas gsum lus longs spyod cesaspras pa'i tshe/ rgyu nor zas gsum gsum ga'i thun mong du yod pa yin kyang lus de rang rang kho na dang 'brel bar go dgos pa de bzhin du/ mkhyen 433

/ /pa gsum so so'i skabs su bden pa bzhi bshad pa na bden pa dang po gsum mkhyen pa gsum ga la thun mong du yod pas bden pa spyi tsam la byed kyang /lam bden ni mkhyen pa rang rang la 'jog dgos pa yin nam snyam gsung /lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug yod pa las khyad gzhi bden pa bzhi'i go rim ni / rgyu la kun nyon phyogs kyi rgyu kun 'byung bden pa dang / rnam byang phyogs kyi rgyu lam bden dang / dang po'i 'bras bu sdug bden dang /gnyis pa'i bral 'bras 'gog bden rnams rim par bstan pa 'di ni rgyu 'bras don gyi rim pa yin la/ snga ma gnyis la rgyu zhes dngos su bstan pa na phyi ma gnyis la 'bras bu zhes dngos su ma bstan kyang don gyes go gsung /spyir rgyud bla ma las/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la/ / bder gnas thob bya sman ni bsten par bya ba ste/ / sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam/ / shes bya spang bya reg par bya zhing bsten par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin shes nas kun 'byung la spong 'dod skye dgos pa yin te/ dper na zug rngu nyams su ma myong na rgyu nad la spong 'dod mi skye bas/ nad kyi 'bras bu zug rngu phyong ba na nad la spong 'dod dang / de las grol ba'i bde ba don du gnyer zhing / nad sel pa'i thabs sman pa dang / des byin pa'i sman sogs sten par byed pa de bzhin du/ sdug bden gyi rang bzhin shes par byas te kun 'byung la spong 'dod dang / de las grol ba'i 'gog pa la mngon du bya 'dod skye zhing / de thob byed kyi rgyu lam bden la bsten byar byed pa ni/ yul can mngon rtogs skye rim mam nyams len gye go rim yin pas phan tshun kha bskang ste nyams su len par byed dgos gsung / khyad gzhi bden pa bzhi po de'i khyad chos kye rnam pa ni/ kun 'byung la brgyad dang lam la bdun dang / sdug bden la 4ma

/ /zinabrilnga dang / 'gog bden la bcu drug yod ces mdo las gsungs pa'am bsgrags so/ / kun 'byung spong gnyen gyi sgo nas dang / lam bden dam bca' dang 'thad pa'i sgo nas dang / sdug bden rang spyi'i sgo nas dang /'gog bden gser 'phreng ltar na stong nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / rnam bshad ltar na phan yon gyi sgo nas bstan pa yin gsung / kun 'byung la mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad phyin ci ma log pa de bzhin nyid kyi slad du 'di ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ / zhes sogs kyis gnyen po brgyad dngos su bstan nas spang bya brgyad shugs la bstan pa yin pas mdo'i sgras zin ltar gyi gnyen po brgyad ni 'dod chags dang bral ba sogs brgyad po de yin la don gyis bstan pa'i spang bya brgyad ni kun 'byung gi rnam pa dang po'i 'dun pa sogs brgyad po 'di yin gsung /'dod chags dang bral ba'i ldog phyogs kyi spang bya ni yul ma 'ongs pa la 'dun pa'i 'dun pa dang sred pa gnyis las mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i 'dod chags 'byung bas 'bras bu med pa'i rtags kyis rgyu med par sgrub pa yin rte/ spyir du ba'i rtags kyis me yod par sgrub dgos kyang / rgyu tshogs tshang ba'i rgyu 'bras gnyis phan tshun med na mi 'byung ba'i 'brel ba grub par 'dra bas na de ltar sgrub nus gsung / yul la mngon zhen gyi dga' bas gnas pa dang /yangasred la dga' ba gsum ni rgyu'i rnam pa ste/ mi gnas pa zhes pa 'di la mdo las ldang ba ma mchis pa zhes gsungs pa ni 'gyur khyad cig yin pa 'dra gsung / 'dod chags sogs gsum ni kun 'byung gi rnam pa ste/ kha cig grub mtha' 'og ma ltar/ 'dod na 'jig tshogs lta ba dang / zhes sogs la brten nas gang zag gi bdag 'dzin la 'dod chags sogs med par bshad kyang / 'og ma'i skabs su bdag 'dzin la mi dge ba med par ma zad/435

/ /'dzin tshul can gyi spang bya la sgom spang med cing mthong spang kho nas khyab pa dang / de'i zhen yul med pas spang bya gzhi med yin pa dang / zhen prel de med par mngon sum du rtogs phyin chad de yod dam med snyam pa'i the tshom skye mi srid pas de spang ba las nyams pa mi srid pa yin la/ chags sogs sgom spang gi dmigs pa yod pas spang bya gzhi bcas yin pa dang / de la sred pa spang ba'i sgo nas de spangs kyang yul dang 'phrad na slar skye bar 'gyur bas/de spangs pa las nyams srid par 'dod la/ gong ma'i skabs su de ltar mi 'dod pas/ rang lugs la gang zag gi bdag 'dzin la chags sogs bzhag chog pa'i phyogs su mdzad gsung / rab skye'i rnam pa ni/ gtsang bde rtag bdag bzhi ru 'dzin pa'i gnyen por mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med du rtogs pa bzhi so sor sbyar te gtsang ba ni stong pa'i ldog phyogs yin te/migatsang ba'i rdzas so gnyis sogs la phar nga zhes btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyirazer mkhan yod kyang mi 'thad la/ de bzhi la sbyor ba'i tshe gtsang bde gnyis kyi gnyen por sdug bsngal bar rtogs pa dang / rtag pa'i gnyen por mi rtag par rtogs pa dang / bdag la cha gnyis byas te de'i gnyen por stong bdag med sbyor dgos te/ de ltar gzhi bsdu ba na rgyas par 'dug gsung /thog mar kun 'byung spang byar shes nas gnyen po'i sgo nas spang dgos pas kun 'byang spang gnyen gyi sgo nas dang / lam bden rgyu mtshan dang rigs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud la bsgrubs te bsten byar shes dgos pas lam bden dam bca' dang 'thad pa'i sgo nas dang / sdug bden gyi don dam dang kun rdzob kyi sdod lugs rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas shes par bya dgos pas sdug bden rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dang / 'gog bden gser 'phreng las stong nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / rnam bshad las phan yon gyi sgo 436

das / //je te//sanas bstan par gsungs pa ni don 'dra'ang dngos bstan dang sbas don gye sgo nas yin gsung / lam bden gyi rnam pa brgyad ni/ skabs 'di'i lam bden gyi rnam pa chos can/ sems can thams cad la thar pa'i go skabs 'byed pa'i lam yin te/ sems can tshad med pa la thar pa'i sgo skabs 'byed pa'i phyir/ ji ltar go skabs 'byed ce na/ sems can tshad med pa la thar pa'i go skabs 'byed pa yin te/ srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel bar go skabs 'byed pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rig pa gang yin pa'i rnam pa yin te/ 'khor 'das gnyis dang chos thams cad don dam par tha mi dad par rtogs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar rig pa yin zhe na/ don dam par tha mi dad par rtogs te/ don dam par nyan rang la dman pa dang theg chen la mchog tu 'dzin pa med par rtogs pa'i phyir dang / 'khor ba don dam par dor bya dang / myang 'das don dam par blang byar med par rtogs pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sgrub pa gang yin pa'i rnam pa yin te/chos thams cad bden par rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir/ ji ltar sgrub pa yin zhe na/ bden par rnam par mi rtog ste/ bden med de'ang yul can gyis phar bcos pa tsam ma yin par yul rang ngos nas bden par med pas/don dam par tshad mas gzhal du med pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ nges par 'byung ba'i rnam pa yin te/ 'ching byed kyi gtso bo bden 'dzin las nges par 'byung nus na gzhan rnams las nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / phar phyin rtog gi snang bar/ sems can thams cad la go skabs 'byed pa'i lam dang / ཿzhes sogs 'di rnams rtags la sbyar nas gsungs pas khyad par de tsam zhig ma gtogs 'dra gsung / nges 'byung gi rnam pa 'thad pa'i sgo nas ma gsungs pa ni gdul bya nye ba'i bsam pa'am/ yang na 437

/snga ma gsum gyis de'i 'thad pa bstan pa yin gsung / sdug bden gye rnam pa lngani/ mi rtag pa sogs bzhi ni rang gi mtshan nyid dang / lnga pa ni spyi'i mtshan nyid yin la/ spyir chos thams cad stong pa dang bdag med pa yin kyang 'jig ltas sdug bden gyi gtso bo zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po 'di la dmigs te/ de la ma ltos pa'i rang rkya thub pa'i bdag yod par 'dzin cing de'i zhen yul med pa phung po 'di'i steng du gtan la 'bebs dgos pas/de gnyis sdug bden gyi rang gi mtshan nyid dang / mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal la phyi nang gi snod bcud du ma yod kyang / sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/zhes pa ltar nyer len gyi phung po 'di gtso bo yin pas/ de gnyis sdug bden gye rang gi mtshan nyid du bzhag pa yin gsung / 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bcu drug ni/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa la phyi dang nang dang gnyis ka stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa ste gsum mo/ / zhi ba'i rnam pa ni/ btags pa'i bdag stong pa nas/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi bar brgyad do/ / gya nom gyi rnam pa la rang bzhin stong pa nyid nas mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i bar bzhi ste/ de'ang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi stong gzhi dus gsum po de ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i tshe mnyam du yod yod 'dra'ang / brtags shing dpyad pa'i tshe ma 'ongs pa na 'das da lta gnyis mi dmigs la/ da ltar gyi dus su 'das ma 'ongs gnyis mi dmigs pa sogs yin pas mi dmigs pa zhes bshad pa yin gsung / nges 'byung gi rnam pa ni/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa gcig ste stong gzhi gzhan rnams sngar bshad zin to/ / rnam mkhyen gye rnam pa brgya rtsa bcu ni rnam mkhyen gyi skabs su mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bshad mi rigs te/ gzhi shes dang lam shes gnyis kye rnam pa sngar bshad zin pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ de la ldog chas 438

sa / /zigs sa g.yo 11gagosam rgyun gyi sgo nas rigs 'dra snga ma nyan thos la yod pa dang / byang sems la yod pa dang / sangs rgyas kho na la yod pa gsum yod pa dang / theg pa gsum gyi yon tan thams cad sangs rgyas la yar ldan du yod pa'i stobs kyis nyan thos la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa sogs gsum bstan pa yin la/der ma zad dang po gnyis kyi skabs su gzhi shes dang lam shes kyi yul du bstan pa yin zhing / 'dir de gsum gyi rnam pa'ang rnam mkhyen gyi yul du ston pa yin pas zlos skyon med pa yin gsung / dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ni/dbus mtha' las/ gnas ngan len phyir sred rgyu'i phyir/ / gzhi yi phyir dang ma rmongs phyir/ / bden pa bzhi la 'jug bya bas/ / dran pa nyer bzhag bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sdug bden gyi gtso bo lus mi gtsang pa'i rdzas so gnyis 'dus par shes nas lus dran pa nyer bzhag gis sdug bden la 'jug / / sred pa'i rkyen gyi gtso bo tshor bas nyon mongs thams cad kyi rtsa ba sred pa 'dren par mthong nas tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag gis kun 'byung la 'jug lhag med kyi tshe zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po ma lus pa 'gag par 'gyur bas bdag chad kyis dogs nas 'jigs pa na/sems dran pa nyer bzhag gis gang zag gi gdags gzhi sems skad cig gis skye 'jig byed par mthong nas de'i tshe'ang bdag tu 'jog pa'i gzhi ma stor bar 'dug snyam du mngon du bya ba la 'jug / sems de kun nyon phyogs nas rnam byangaphyogs su bcos pa la lam zer bas chos dran pa nyer bzhag gis lam bden la 'jug gsung / yang dag spong ba ni/ rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs kyis mi dge ba skyes zin spong ba dang / nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs kyis mi dge ba ma skyes pa mi skyed pa da nga/ rten gyi stobs kyis dge ba skyes zin spel ba dang / gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs kyis dge 439

/ /ba ma skyes pa bskyed pa ste stobs bzhi la sbyar ba yod gsung / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la sgra bshad tshul du ma yod la / dbus mtha' sogs nas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i skabs zhi gnas sgrub tshul rgyas par bshad la/ spyir sde tshan bdun gyes bye smras tshogs lam du gcig sbyor lam bzhi'i skabs su bzhi/mthong lam du gcig sgom lam du gcig rnams rim bzhin thob par 'dod cing / gong ma'i lugs la spyir tshogs lam chung du na dang po gsum ga yod kyang / gtso che ba'i sgo nas tshogs lam gsum la dang po gsum dang / drod rtse gnyis la bzhi pa dang / bzod mchog gnyis la lnga pa rnams rim bzhin dang / mthong sgom gnyis la drug pa bdun pa gnyis lhan cig thob par 'dod pa yin gsung / stobs ni dbang po'i skabs kyi dad sogs lnga stobs kyingo bor gyur pa yin kyang sgom byung gis dbang thob pa'i sgo nas dbang po dang / mi mthun phyogs gang 'dod du zil gyis gnon pa'i sgo nas stobs su bshad la/ rgyan snang las snga ma mi mthun phyogs dang 'dres par spyod pa dang /phyi ma mi mthun phyogs dang ma 'dres par gnyen po 'ba' zhig spyod pa la'ang gsungs/ dad sogs lnga po 'di'i nang du lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa gcig 'dus pas na/ sems byung gzhan ma gsungs par 'di lnga gsungs pa yin la/ 'du tshul stong nyid sgom pa lta bu la mtshon na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs par 'dod pa de'i tshe thog mar yid ches kyi dad pa'i sgo nas de ston pa'i mdo sogs la 'jug dgos pas dad pa dang / de'ang gzhan gyis nan gyes bskul dgos pa lta bu ma yin par bskul ma nang nas byas te spro ba skyed dgos pas brtson 'grus dang / don rags rim tsam rtogs pa des chog shes byas te dran pas ma bskyang bar bzhag na bogs gang yang mi thon pas/dran pas rgyun bsrings te don spyi'i gsal snang dang / de nas mngon sum du 446

༄ zasartogs pa dang / de nas mthong zin goms par byed pa dang / mi slob lam gyi bar dran pas gzhung bsrings dgos pas dran pa dang / lam gyi dngos gzhi lta bu la sems dmigs pa la gnas pa'i gzhi ting nge 'dzin dang / rab tu rtogs pa'i ngo bo shes rab ste lnga dgos pa'i phyir/ sa sder 'di lnga la mi'i lus lta bur yang gsungs te/ dad pa ni rus pa lta bu dang / brtson 'grus ni sha lta bu dang / dran pa ni rgyus pa dang 'dra ste/ rtsas sha 'dzin par byed pa de bzhin du dran pas dmigs rnam mi brjed par 'dzin par byed pa dang /ting nge 'dzin ni pags pa dang 'dra ste/ pags pas sha sdud par byed pa bzhin du ting nge 'dzin gyis sems nang du sdud par byed pa dang / shes rab ni snying lta bu yin pas lus yongs rdzogs shig la rus pa la sogs pa lnga ga tshang dgos pa bzhin du lam gye lus yongs rdzogs shig la dad sogs lnga ga tshang dgosapar bstan pa yin gsung / byang chub yan lag bdun ni/ dbus mtha' las/ rang bzhin yan lag gnas yan lag / gsum pa nges 'byung yan lag ste/ / bzhi pa phan yon yan lag yin/ / rnam gsum nyon mongs med yan lag / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes rab rang bzhin yan lag dran pa gnas kyi yan lag brtson 'grus nges 'byung gi yan lagadaga' ba phan yon gyi yan lag shin sbyangs ting nge 'dzin/ btang snyoms gsum nyon mongs med pa'i yan lag tu 'du bar gsungs pa yin la/ mdo sde rgyan las/ shes bya ma rgyal rgyal ba'i phyir/ / zhes sogs kyis rgyal srid sna bdun lta bur gsungs pa yin te/ 'khor lo rin po che'i stobs kyis 'khorabasgyur des thog mar rang gi g.yul las rgyal bar byas te/de nas yul khams gzhan la'ang dbang sgyur bar byed pa ltar dran pa byang chub yan lag gis snga ma togs zin pa rnams ma brjed pa'i steng du phyi ma gsar du rtogs 441

/par 'gyur bas na/ dran pa yang dag 'khor lo rin po che dang 'dra/ glang po rin po ches pha rol gyi dgra sogs 'joms par byed pa bzhin du/ rab tu rnam 'byed yan lag gis mi mthun phyogs 'joms par byed pa dang / nor bu rin po che'i 'od kyis gzugs sogs snang bar byed pa bzhin du/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyis yon tan thams cad snang bar byed pa dang / rta mchog gi shugs myur ba bzhin du yon tan snga ma thob pa la dga' ba skyes te gong ma la myur du 'jug pa dang / btsun mo rin po ches dga' bde ster ba ltar shin sbyangs kyis lus sems dga' bde rgyas par byed pa dang / khyim bdag rin po ches gang 'dod kyi mkho dgu ster bar byed pa bzhin du ting nge 'dzin gyis mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs yon tan thams cad 'byor bar byed pa dang /blonapo rin po ches rgyal po'i rgyal khrims sogs nye ring med par rtogs par byed pa bzhin du/ btang snyoms kyis chags sdang sogs kyis nye ring med par lam drang por srong ba dang / bdun pa la khyim bdag drangs pa ni gser gyi 'khor bsgyur gye dbang du byas la/ 'khor bsgyur gzhan gnyis la khyim bdag gi tshab tu dmag dpon drangs nas khyim bdag dang blon po bya ba gcig pas gcig tu byed pa yin gsung / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad ni/dbus mtha' las/ yongs su gcod dang go byed dang / / rnam gsum gzhanayid ches par byed/ / mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po ni/ / lam gyi yan lag de brgyad do/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ni yul yongs su gcod byed dngos yin pas gcod pa'i yan lag dang / rang gis rtogs pa de gzhan la mtshon par byed pa de dag kun nas slong pa'i rtog pa la rag las pas yang dag pa'i rtogs pa go byed dang / spyod pa rnam par dag pas gzhan yid ches par byed pa de dag las mtha' 'tsho ba gsum gye lag 442

da / /sbyo na /sgo khyerjes yin pas de gsum gzhan yid ches par byed pa'i yan lag dang / rtsol ba sgom spang dang / dran pa nye nyon bying rgod dang / ting nge 'dzin de yon tanakhyad par can la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa'i gnyen po yin pas gnyen po'i yan lag dang bzhir 'du ba yin gsung / lam shes kyi rnam pa so bzhi'i drug ni/ rnam thar sgo gsum bye smras mdzod las/ mtshan med zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / / stong nyid bdag med stong nyid du/ / 'jug pa'o smon pa med pa ni/de las gzhan bden rnam pa can/ / zhes gsungs pa sdug bden gyi stong pa bdag med gnyis rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / 'gog bden gyi bzhi mtshan med dang / rnam pa gzhan rnams smon med la sbyar zhing / mdo sde rgyan las/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi spyod yul ni/ / zhes sogs kyi skabs su chos kyi sdom bzhi la sbyar nas gsungs pa dang / thal 'gyur pas chos rnams kyi bya byed las gsum rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum gye stong nyid la sbyar nas gsungs pa sogs yin la/ 'dir slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mngon pa kun bsdus su gsungs pa ltar 'phags pa grol sde'i nyi snang dang / slob dpon gye rgyan snang dang / 'grel pa 'di rnams su skad cig ma bcu drug gi nang nas sdug bden gyi stong bdag med gnyis/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / 'gog lam gye brgyad mtshan med dang / sdug bden gyi rnam pa lhag ma gnyis dang / kun 'byung gi bzhi ste drug smon med la sbyar nas gsungs pas/ bye smras lam bden gyi bzhi'ang smon med la sbyar ba dang /'dir mtshan med la sbyar ba'i khyad par tsam ma gtogs 'dra gsung / thar pa'i grong khyer du 'gro ba la sgo 'di nas ma zhugs par 'gro tshul med pas na rnam par thar pa'i sgo zhes bya ste/ thal 'gyur pas stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa na 'phags lam thob par 'jog pa dang / gzhan rnams kyis yo3

/ /bden bzhi mngon sum du rtogs pa na 'phags lam thob par 'jog pa'i phyir/des na thal 'gyur pas stong nyid la sbyor ba dang / gzhan rnams kyis gtso bor bden bzhi la sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin gsung / rnam thar brgyad kyis byed rgyu'i gtso bo ni sprul bsgyur sna tshogs byed pa de yin la/ de'i dgos pa ni gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du yin pas/ gzugs can gzugs la blta ba dang / gzugs med gzugs la blta ba gnyis ni/ gdul bya 'ga' zhig la 'dis sprul pa 'di bstan song zhes sprul pa dang sprul pa po gnyis ka snang bar byas na don du 'gyur ba'ang yod pas dang po dang / 'ga' zhig la sprul pa po mi snang bar des sprul pa'i khang bzang sogs snang bar byas na don du 'gyur ba'ang yod pas phyi ma sgom la/ 'bras dus na'ang rnam pa 'di dag yod pa de dang rnam pa mthun pa rgyu'i dus nas slob dgos pas 'di dag bstan pa yin gsung / snyoms 'jug dgu dang / spong lam bzhi dang /phar phyin bcu ste so bzhi'o/ / 'di dag brgyad stong pa las/ bcom ldan 'dasabyang chub kyi phyogs de rnams dmigs su ma mchis pa'i slad du 'di ni dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi pha rol tu phyinapa'o/ / zhes pa nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ / 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las bstod pa'i le'u zhes bya ste dgu pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis 'chad la/ de'ang byang phyogs so bdun la mdo gcig rnam thar sgo gsum la mdo gcig rnam thar brgyad la mdo gcig snyoms 'jug dgu la mdo gcig spong lam bzhi rang ming nas ma smos par yul bden bzhi'i sgo nas ston pa'i mdo gcig phar phyin bcu la mdo gcig stobs bcu la mdo gcig mi 'jigs pa bzhi la mdo gcig so so yang dag rig bzhi la zhepha

༄ sgosamado gcig ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la mdo gcig de bzhin nyid la mdo gcig rang byung la mdo gcig sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa la mdo gcig go/stobs bcu ni rgyud bla ma las/ stobs sogs rnams las stobs drug dang / / gsum dang gcig gis rim pa bzhin/ / shes bya snyoms par 'jug pa dang / / bag chags bcas pa kun bsal bas/ go cha rtsig pa shing bzhin du/ / phug dang bshig dang bcas phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnas dang gnas min mkhyen stobs nas/ kun byang mkhyen pa'i bar drug gis/ shes sgrib go cha lta bu 'joms/ / sngon gnas mkhyen pa sogs gsum gyes snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa rtsig pa lta bu 'joms/ zag zad mkhyen pa'i stobs gcig gis nyon sgrib shing lta bu 'joms par byed pas/sgrib pa 'di gsum go cha sogs dang 'dra tshul ni/ dper na shes sgrib ni shes bya thams cad la blo thogs med du 'jug pa la gegs byed pa yin la/ go chas lus btum pa'am bsdams nas sdod pa ltar/ shes sgrib kyis shes bya thams cad la blo rgyas pa la gegs byed pas na de go cha brtan po lta bu dang /rtsig pas phan tshun gyi khang ba'i bar mtshams chod par byed pa ltar/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pas gong 'og gi mtshams chod pas na de rtsig pa lta bu dang /mdzod las/ klu bzhin rtsa bzhin ljon shing bzhin/ / zhes sogs ltar/nyon mongs kyi sdong po las sdug bden gyi yal ga dang rwa lag thams cad rgyas par 'gyur bas na shing lta bur gsungs pa yin nam snyam ste dpyod dgos pa'i gnas yin gsung / mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi/chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad yod pa'i nang nas/ spyod pa ma 'dres pa sogs 'di dag ni byang 'phags la'ang yod na sangs rgyas la yod pa lta smos kyang ci/nyan thos la med de dgra bcom pa zhig gis ma brtags par sbrul nag po rkang yo5

/ /bas brdzis te sku lus la gnod pa'i lo rgyus dang / bag chags goms pa'i dbang gis nags tshal du ca co bton pa sogs yod par gsungs la/ byang 'phags la lus ngag gi gnas ngan len de 'dra med gsung / ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing zhes pa ni/ sangs rgyas la kun slong mi dgos la/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' 'ang / chos kyi rnam grangs de 'chad pa'i tshe thog mar zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so zhes pa lta bu'i mdo de dang de'i brjod bya rtogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i thugs mngon du byas pa ltar mdzad pa/ de'ang chos bshad pa dang nyan pa'i tshe kun slong khyad par can gyis zin dgos par shes pa'i ched yin pas/ rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len la tshur spyor dgos par yongs 'dzin rin po ches kyang gsungs la/de'i khungs su ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing zhes pa 'di drang gi 'dug gsung /debazhin nyid la slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pas de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa dang / slob dpon la ma ltos par chos thams cad la mnga' bsgyur bas rang byung gi rnam pa dang mnyam rjes ngo bo gcig tu song ba'i sangs rgyasakyi rnam pa ste so dgu'o/ / bsdoms na med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa'i bar brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum yod do/ / zag bcas zag med kyi don ni/ kun btus nas zag pa'i sgo drug dang 'brel ma 'brel dang / mdzod nas dmigs dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas dang / sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'i skabs su blang dang dor bya'i sgo nas bzhag pa sogs yod kyang 'dir ni nyan rang gis nyon mongs spang byar byed pas de dag gi gzhi shes zag med dang / byang sems kyis nyon mongs gtso bor spang byar mi byed pas de'i lam rnam grangs pa'i zag bcas su bshad do/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba ni/ sbyor ba ni/ sbyor ba khyad par can dag gis 446

ra / /zizug bye /sgo 'arnam pa rnams sgom dgos na zhes sogs byung / sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ / zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis sbyor ba'i rten khyad par can sher phyin nyan pa'i snod bshad nas/ nyan pa tsam la de ltar dgos na sgom pa'i rten la lta ci smos zhes zhar la sangs rgyas bsten dang zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis sher phyin 'di len pa dang / don mi brjed par 'dzin pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod kyang bshad la/ dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa/ / zhes pa 'di rtsa bar nyan pa'i snod la sbyar yang bzhi ga la'ang sbyor dgos par yongs 'dzin rin po che gsungs shing / 'grel par yang thams cad kyi mjug tu sbyar bas/ sangs rgyas bsten dang / dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa/ / len pa'i snod yin no zhes pa dang / kun 'dri dang / dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa/ /'dzin pa'i snod yin no zhes pa dang / sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod dang/ / dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa/ / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod/ / ces sbyor dgos gsung / bskal pa mang por sangs rgyas rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun zhing sbyangs pas yum nyan pa'i snod dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur gyis mnyes par byas pas 'dzin pa'i snod dang / the tshom gyi don yongs su dris pas don mi brjed pa'i snod dang / phar phyin bcu sgrub pas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod ces spyor ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyibyin rlabs thams cad la dgos gsung / brgyad stong pa las/ de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gi rna lam du snang ba zhes sogs kyis nyan pa'i snod dang / gang dag shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dzin par 'gyur zhes sogs kyi len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /yo7

/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod gsung la/ slob pa dang / sgrub pa dang /rnal 'byor du byed/ ces pa gsum yang de gsum la sbyar dgos sam snyam gsung / sher phyin gyi snod de sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba la ni lha rgyal nas/ rkyen rtogs sa la min/ zhes pa'i bar gye blo ka bzhi byung / ye shes zhabs kyi sdud 'grel ltar na/ rgyal ba la ni/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis sbyor ba'i rten dang / de nas rkang pa gnyis kyes sbyor ba bkag pa'i sbyor bdang / gang zhig chos 'di sprul dang sgyu ma 'drar thos nas/ / zhes pa 'dil/ sems can de ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis yar sbyar nas rkang pa gsum po 'dis lung bstan thob pa'i sbyor pa dang / som nyi zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyes phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba dang / dgon pa'i gnas ni / zhes sogs kyis nges 'byung gi sbyor ba bstan par 'dod la/ 'on kyang slob dpon gyi sbyor tshul de nyi snang sogs dang mthun pas slob dpon 'di la chags bzhag byed dgos sam snyam ste/ som nyi med cing zhes sogs kyis sher phyin thos nas de la mi skrag par ma zad/ spro shugs kyis 'jug par 'gyur ba de ni/ sngon sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig la dge ba bskrun pa'i rtags yin par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / dbye gzhi'i sbyor ba lnga ni yul gyi sgo nas phye ba yin te/yul dang yul can la bden zhen bkag pa'i gnyis dang / mkhyen gsum la bden zhen bkag pa'i zab dka' tshad med kyi sbyor ba gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sbyor ba nyi shu'i nang nas/ slob dpon dang sangs rgyas ye shes gnyis sa mthun par sdud pa dang sbyor rgyu yod pa ni/ bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba de 'chad pa la/ mi zhig rgya mtsho'i/ nas/ bdag reg 'gyur/zhes pa'i bar gyi sh+lau ka gnyis byung / byang chub nye ba'i sbyor ba de 'chad par/dbyid dus bzang la zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / byang chub myur ba'i de pha8

༄ sgosa'achad par/ dper na bud med ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / 'phel 'grib med pa'i de 'chad par/ shes rab pha rol phyin mchog sogs rkang pa gnyis byung / chos dang chos min sogs mi mthong ba'i de 'chad par/gang zhig chos dang chos min zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis byung / ye shes zhabs kyis gang zhig 'dir spyod ces sogs rkang pa gsum gyis rnam par mi stog pa'i sbyor ba dang / 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ / zhes pa'i rkang pa gcig po 'dis spyor ba'i yon tan bstan par 'dod la/ slob dponagang zhig 'dir spyod ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis sbyor ba'i yon tan bstan par bzhed pa yin gsung / /gsum pa sbyor ba'i yon tan ni/ yon tan mthong ba sngon du 'gro ba zhes sogs byung / kha cig sbyor ba'i skyon de sbyor ba mi skye ba'i rgyu yin pa ltar/sbyor ba'i yon tan de sbyor ba skye ba'i rgyu yin pas sngon du 'gro dgos zer ba dang / yang kha cig spyor ba'i yon tan dang / spyor ba gnyis nus pa dang nus pa can yin pas dus mnyam yin zer ba sogs yod kyang / nyi snang dang rgyan snang gnyis gar sbyor ba'i phan yon du gsungs pa dang / 'grel pa 'dir yon tan du gsungs pas 'bras bu'i sgo nas bstan pa yin la/de'angabacu bzhi ba tshan pa gnyis gsungs pa'i dang po bcu bzhi ni grangs su 'dren rgyu dngos yin pas rgyu mtshan can dang / phyi ma bcu ni yon tan de dag 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan du byed dgos la/ 'on kyang byang chub nye ba la snga phyiganyis gar gsungs tshul khyad mi snang bas khyad par phyed dka' se ba zhig 'dugagasung / spyor ba'i yon tan de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ gang zhig 'dir spyod ces sogs blo ka gcig byung / 'dis sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs sher phyin nyams su len pa sogs la spyod par gsungs pas/ yon yo9

sa / /tan bcu bzhi po so sor ma phye bar spyir bstan pa yin gsung / yon tan de dag ni brgyad stong pa las/ bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ / bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / nas/ bdud sdig can bar chad kyi las bgyi bar spro ba rnams mang po skyes nas brtson pa bgyid par 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyis sbyor ba sgom pa'i gang zag la bdud dag gis bar chad kyi las shin tu mang po brtson kyang de la byang sems dang dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis dgongs pas bdud de dag gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing mthu bcom pa'i yon tan dang / shā ri'i bu 'di ni chos rnams kyi chos nyid de gang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhal du med/ nas/ yi ger 'bri ba la dgongs par 'gyur yongs su gzung bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyis sbyor bsgom pa la sangs rgyas kyis dngos su byin gyis ma brlabs kyang byin rlabs zhugs pas dgongs shing mkhyen pa'i yon tan dang / shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag / nas/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen te/ zhes sogs kyis sbyor ba sgom pa la sangs rgyas kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i mngon sum du mdzad pa'i yon tan te/'digasum sangs rgyas kyis dgongs par 'dra zhing / sangs rgyas rang ngos nas byin rlabs nus mthu che chung med na'ang / gdul bya'i rgyud tshod kyi dbang gis byin rlabs kyi 'jug tshul chung 'bring che gsum gyi sgo nas mas rim nas 'jog ste/ dper na rang gi nye du dgra la 'thab pa'i tshe dgra'i mtshon cha thabasakyis len pa dang / nye du la go cha sbyin pa dang / de nas mtshon cha gtad de dpa' skyed pa lta bu yin gsung / thos nas kyang bzung ba dang bcangs pa dang / nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 4ma

༄ /tu nye bar 'gyur te/ zhes sogs kyis/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye bar 'gyur ba'i yon tan dang / shā ri'i bu de dag gi 'bad pa dang yongs su g.yo ba de'ang don chen po dang / phan yon chen po dang /'bras bu chen po dang / rnam par smin pa chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyis don chen po nyid la sogs pa'i yon tan te sogs khongs nas drangs ma thag gi phan yon chen po sogs gsum 'don/ de'ang tshe 'dir sher phyin nyams su blangs pa'i rgyu mthun la skye ba phyi ma rnams su sher phyin dang mi 'bral ba'i rten bzang brgyud mar thob ste de'i tshe'ang sher phyin nyams su len pa 'ong bas phan yon chen po dang / de ltar nyams su blangs nas sangs rgyas 'thob pas 'bras bu chen po dang / 'bras bu de thob nas kyang nyan rang ltar zhi bde la mi gzhol bar sems can gye don rlabs po che byed pas rnam par smin pa chen po zhes bya'o/ / shā ri'i bu yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i mdo sde 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos 'jig pa'i dus kyi tshe/ chos 'dul ba snying po gsar pa thob pa nas lho phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ / lho phyogs nas kyang bar ta nir 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / bar ta ni nas kyang byang phyogs su 'byung ste/ nas/zab mo 'di'ang 'di ltar phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na/ byang gi yul dang byang gi phyogs kyi char rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes sogs kyis yul dpyad pa'i yon tan te de'ang ston pa 'das nas/ rgya gar lho phyogs su slob dpon klu sgrub sogs kyis sher phyin dar bar byas pa dang / bar ta ni zhes pa lho byang gnyis kyi bar/ rgya gar gyi yul yul dbus su slar yang dar ba dang / de nas rgya gar gyisang bod phyogs su dar ba yin la/ byang phyogs su dus nam gyi tshe dar bar 'gyur zhe na/ brgyad stong pa 'dir phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe zhes pa tsam 451

/las mi 'byung la/ mdo gzhan las lnga brgya tha mar sleb pa'i tshe/ zhes byung bas/ spyir bstan pa'i tshad la/ 'phags yul du mngon pa la dgra lan gsum byung ba'i dbang gis lo stong dang phyed dang stong du gnas par 'dod pa sogs yod kyang / rang lugs la bstan pa lo lnga stong bar du gnas par 'dod pas/ de la lnga brgya pa phrag bcu yod la/ bcu po de dag la le'u bcur byas pa'i dgra bcom phyir mi 'ong / rgyun zhugs kyi le'u gsum ni khong du chud pa'i le'u dang / lhag mthong / zhi gnas/ tshul khrims kyi le'u gsum ni sgrub pa'i le'u dang / mdo mngon 'dul ba'i le'u gsum ni lung gi le'u dang / rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i le'u rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ des na kha cig lnga brgya tha ma zhes pa rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i le'u la zer ba mi 'thad de/de dus su lung tsam yang med par rab tu byung ba'i rtags tsam dang ming tsam gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra ma nub pa tsam la bstan pa gnas pa'i tha snyadabatags pa yin la/ lnga brgya tha ma'i dus su sher phyin sogs dar bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ des na lnga brgya tha ma ni le'u tha ma tsam la mi byed par/lnga brgya pa phrag bcu po de cha gnyis su byas pa'i phyi ma la byed dgos te/ lnga brgya dang po lnga'i dus bstan pa sogs kyi bzang sgang yin pas lnga brgya tha ma zhes mi zer la/ lnga brgya phyi ma lnga bstan pa sogs 'grib pa'i dus yin pas na lnga brgya tha ma zhes dman pa la tha ma'i sgras brjod pa yin pa'i phyir/dper na tshe lo brgya thub pa'i mi zhig la mtshon na lo lnga bcu phrag gnyis thub pa'i lnga bcu dang po stobs dang shes rab sogs 'phel ba'i skabs/ lnga bcu phyi ma'i skabs su de dag 'grib par 'gyur bas lnga bcu pa tha ma zhes zer ba bzhin yin gsung / des na de ltar lnga brgya tha ma'i mgo tshugs nas cher ma song ba dang / tshul khrims le'u'i dkyil tsam du slebs yod la/ byang nas 452

da / /zizug gri /sgo 'byang du dar bar gsungs pa'i byang phyi ma la rang re'i dgon pa 'di tsho'ang 'jog ces rwa stod rin po ches gsung gin 'dug gsung / shā ri'i bu byang gi yul dang byang gi phyogs kyi char byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mang zhing shin tu mang du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / shā ri'i bu de dag mang mod kyi/ mang po de dag las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyan pa nas/de dag ni ches nyung bar 'gyur te/ zhes sogs kyi don/ gser 'phreng las/ yum 'dri ba sogs mang yang der bshad pa'i skye 'gag med pa la sogs pa'i spros bral la mos pa nyung bar 'chad pa ni shin tu mad par snang ngo /zhes gsungs pa ltar don la gnas gsung / de dag ni tshul khrims yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyis sbyor ba bsgom pas tshul khrims kyi phung po sogs zag med kyi yon tan thams cad rang rgyud la yongs su rdzogs pa'i yon tan dang / de ni 'di ltar nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i gtam byas so/ / zhes sogs kyis rang rgyud la zag med kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des gzhan don byed pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtam gyis gdul bya dman lam du 'gror mi 'jug par theg pa chen po'i lam du 'khrid par byed pa'i smra ba'i skyes bu'i yon tan dang / de dag la legs par gnas shing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la mnyam par bzhag par 'gyur te/ bdud kyis kyang dbye bar byed mi nus na zhes sogs kyis/ sbyor ba ba nyams len byed pa'i byang sems 'di la mi min gyi sngags sogs kyis lta ci/— dga' rab dbang phyug ces bya ba thams cad kyi snying la zhugs te gnod par byed pa des kyang mi tshugs te/ de las nus mthu brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyis lhag pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad rangagi rgyab rten du bzhugs pa dang / rang gi bsam pa brtan pas na mi 453

/ /phyed pa'i yon tan dang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo dag gis de thos nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la dga' ba dang / dad pa dang /rab tu dang ba rgya chen po 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyis da lta sher phyin sgom pa la dga' ba rgya chen po thob ste skye bo mang po la dga' ba rgya chen po 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyis da lta sher phyin sgom pa la dga' ba rgya chen po thob ste skye po mang po la bla med byang chub kyi rgyu'i dge rtsa skrun par byed pas nyan rang dang thun mong min pa'i yon tan dang / 'di ltar rigs kyi bu nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na bdag gis srog chags brgya phrag mang po dang / zhes sogs kyis spyor ba sgom pa'i byang sems de rang gi dam bca' brtan pa'i mthus/ sems can brgya phrag mang po bsgral yang da dung je nyung tsam du'ang ma song bar mthong nas mi nus snyam du phyi ma la spyid lug par mi 'gyur bar ma zad/ sems la sems kyis rjes su bltas nas rjes su yi rang bar byas so/ / zhes sngar drangs pa rnams la rjes su yi rang bar byas te/ phyi ma'i sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i dam bca' je brtan du song nas rang gis sngar ji ltar dam bcas pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin sgrub pa'i yon tan dang / de ltar rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni mos pa rgya chen po dang ldan pa yin no/ zhes sogs kyis sbyor ba sgom pa'i byang sems de ched du bya ba sems can dang / thob bya byang chub dang / de'i phyir lam la slob tshul sogs gang gi cha nas kyang nyi tshe ba tsam ma yin par rgya chen po mngon par 'dod pas na 'bras bu rgya chen po yongs su 'dzin pa'i yon tan dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu'ang / de dag gis srog chags brgya phrag mang po dang / zhes sogs kyis sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i yon tan dang / 'di dang snga ma gnyis la khyad cher med pa ltar 'dug kyang / zhib tu dpyad na 454

ra / /zizug bye bsgo 'khyad cig 'byed rgyu yod rgyu red gsung / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i chos kyi bar rnams la ma gzigs pa'am/ma gsan pa'am/ mngon par mi mkhyen pa'am/ rnam par mi mkhyen pa gang yang ma mchis shing / nas/ 'dzin pa'i yon tan yongs su brjod pa'i le'u zhes bya ste bcu pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyes sher phyin tshang bar rnyed pa'i yon tan 'chad pa yin te/ de'ang 'di'i skabs su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di kha cig gis btsal yang mi rnyed/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di kha cig gis ma btsal yang rnyed par 'gyur ba bcom ldan 'das 'di'i rgyu gang lags/ zhes sogs kyi don ni/ shā ri'i bus sangs rgyas la 'di rgyu 'bras go 'dzol pa lta bu zhig tu 'dug pas 'di'i rgyu mtshan gangalags zhes dris pa'i lan du/ rgyu 'bras go 'chol ba mi srid de/ tshe rabs snga ma rnams su sher phyin 'di la brtson pa ma dor bas na kha cig gis da lta ma btsal yang rnyed pa yin la/ tshe rabs snga ma rnams su sher phyin 'di spangs pa'i las sgrib dang ldan pa dag gis da lta btsal yang mi rnyed par 'gyur bas na byang chub sems dpa' chen po gang gis tshe 'dir sher phyin 'di la brtson pa ma nor bar 'tshol ba dang / yongs su 'tshol bar sems na tshe rabs phyi ma rnams su'ang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshang bar rnyed par gsungs shing / de lta bu'i las 'bras kyi 'brel ba phra mo de sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan gyi spyod yul min la/ 'di'i thad kyi 'grel chen las/sangs rgyas kyi mig gi dbang pos kyang chos thams cad mkhyen pa dang /gtsug tor dang mdzod spu sogs kyis kyang chos thams cad gzigs tshul rgyas 455

/ /par bshad 'dug gsung / kha cig yon tan bcu bzhi'i bzhi ni sbyor lam dang / bcu ni sa bcu la 'jog par 'dod pa ni / gser 'phreng las bcu bzhi'i grangs 'grigs pa tsam shes pa la the tshom mi snang ngo gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ rang lugs la tshig gsal ltar tshogs lam nas bzhag chog gsung / /bzhi pa sbyor ba skye ba'i gegs sam skyon ni/ de'i 'og tu yang gang zhig yongs su spangs pas zhes sogs byung / de'ang spyor ba'i 'gal rkyen rang la brten pa nyi shu/ rang gzhan gnyis ka la brten pa mthun rkyen ma tshang ba nyer gsum/ 'gal rkyen gzhan la brten pa gsum mo/ / brgyad stong par 'di dag rgyas par gsungs pas re re la'ang mdo spyor rgyu yod la/ sdud par bdun brgyad tsam las sbyor rgyu med gsung / brgyad stong pa las/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa/ bam po bcu gcig pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ / nas/ 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyes dri ba'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar nas/ de nas/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nas/ 'di ni bdud kyi las dang por rig par bya'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis tshegs chen pos 'thob pa'i de dang / rab 'byor spobs pa de skyes na yang / yid g.yeng ba nyid du 'gyur te/ 'di yang bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ / zhes pas spobs pa ha cang myur ba'i de dang / rab 'byor de glal ba dang / rgod pa dang / steg cing yi ger 'dri bar gyur na 'di yang bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ / zhes pas lus kyi gnas ngan len gye de dang / rab 'byor sems rnam par g.yeng bas kun chub par byed na 'di yang bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ / zhes pas sems kyi gnas 456

da / /lnga na /sgo khyengan len gyi de dang rab 'byor rnam par shes pa phan tshun dang ldan pas yi ger 'dri na 'di yang bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ / zhes sogs kyis rigs pa ma yin pas bskyed pa'i kha ton byed pa sogs kyi de rnams gsungs pa yin la/ spyir yi ger 'bri ba sogs rig gnas la slob pa ni yon tan tsam yin na'ang / nyams len gyi gtso bo sher phyin la thos bsam byed pa'i gegs su 'gro na de'ang bdud kyi las su gsungs pa yin pas na spang dgos la/rang re'i bca' yig rin po che nas/ slob gnyer gyi skabs sgra dang snyan dngags sogs rig gnas gzhan la brtson pa'i ngal ba mi byed/ ces gsungs pa'ang sher phyin gyi mdo na gsungs yod pa 'di nyid yin gsung /'di dag sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ smra ba'i zla ba zhes sogs blo ka gcig gis/smra ba'i zla ba sangs rgyas la rab 'byor gyis sbyor ba sgom pa la bar du gcod pa gang lags zhus pa'i lan du/ ston pas bka' stsal pa bar du gcod par 'gyur ba mang ste/ de las re zhig cung zad tsam brjod par bya zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ spobs pa myur ba'i de 'chad par/ rgyal ba'i zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / de'ang dang po rig pa bzang mdog kha bo dang yod yod 'dra ba la don zhig la dpyad pa'i tshe sgro 'dogs gang yang mi chod par yang gzhan zhig la blo kha phyogs te 'gro ba de'ang bdud kyi las yin par gsungs so/ / phyir phyogs pa'i rgyu mtshan 'dzin pa'i de 'chad par/ 'di bshad tshe na/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / bdag gis sher phyin nyams su blangs pa la sangs rgyas kyis ming dang rigs sogs lung ston dgos pa'ang ma bstan to snyam du sherasbyin spong bar 'gyur ba de'ang bdud kyi las so/ / rgyu la zhen pa'i de 'chad par/ de ltar mi shes/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis byung / don ni rtsa ba sher phyin bor nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'thob tu re ba ni/ dper na 457

/ /shing gi rtsa ba bor nas yal ga tshol ba dang 'dra gsung / theg pa'i mchog kun tu 'dzin pa nyams pa'i de 'chad par/ glang po rnyed kyang / zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis byung / don ni sher phyin dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir de bor nas nyan rang rnams sangs rgyas las 'khrungs shing de'i yon tan gyi cha shas tsam yin kyang de 'tshol ba ni/ dper na/ glang po rnyed nas glang rjes tshol ba 'dra'o/ / gya nom pa'i ro myang ba nyams pa'i de 'chad par/ dper na la las zhes sogs blo ka gcig byung / don ni sangs rgyas ni 'thob par dka' zhing sgrub mi nus la/ nyan rang gi byang chub ni rang gi gor du 'du zhing sgrub sla bar 'dug snyam/ de 'tshol ba ni/ dper na zas mchog rnyed nas zas ngan tshol ba dang 'dra ste/ jo bo la zan slong ba dor nas las mi la slong ba'i khyi dang 'dra bar gsungs pa ltar yin gsung / 'grel par snga ma dang 'di gnyis go rim bzlog ste gsungs pa ni nyi khri dang bstun pa yin no/ / bcu tshan gnyis pa'i rnyed bkur dang tshigs su bcad pa'i ro myang ba'i de 'chad par/ bste stang 'dod par zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis byung /bste stang ni phyag 'tshal ba dang sngon du ldang ba sogs yin la/ rnyed pa ni gser dngul dar zab 'bul ba sogs yin pas/ de dag gi ched du khyim pa sogs dang 'dris 'grogs byed pa ni bdud kyi las so/ / lam ma yin pas thabs mkhas 'tshol ba'i de 'chad par/ chos btang nas ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis/ chos btang nas chos min gyi bya bas spyod pa de'ang bdud kyi las so/ / 'dun pa dang snyoms las kyis nyams pa sogs phyi ma rnams bsdoms te 'chad par/ gang dag de yi tshe na/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / sher phyin 'di nyan pa la 'dun cing dad par gyur nas nyan du song ba las bla ma de mi khom par rig nas slar log ste mi dga' zhing yid mi bde 458

da / /zizug ge bas 'bar 'gyur ba dang / yang bla mas 'chad 'dod kyang slob mas nyan mi 'dod pa sogs de dag thams cad bdud kyi las su gsungs pa yin no/ / de dag gi don bsdu ba'i/ de yi tshe na/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka bzhi byung / 'di lta bu'i sher phyin ni 'chad nyan byed pa de'ang dge 'dun thugs mthun pa la nges par ltos kyang de'i tshe dge 'dun rnams dkrugs pa sogs sher phyin 'di la bar du gcod pa rnam mang 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ / bar gcod mang ba'i dpe'ang ji lta bu zhe na/ nor bu rin po che de rnyed dka' zhing rnyed kyang dgra mang bar 'jig rten na'ang grags pa ltar yum 'di 'byung bar dkon la 'tshe ba mang ba yin gsung / 'o na mthar phyin pa dka' 'am zhe na/ bdud kyis bar chad de ltar brtson yang des gang gi nus mthu la cha tsam yang 'gran par mi bzod pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis 'di la srung skyob sba gsum mdzad pa'i phyir te / dper na bu mang po yod pa'i ma de na bar gyur pa la bu rnamasastel gzhung dang ldan pa yin na de kun yid mi bde bar gyur te/ la las rim gro dang / la las sman pa 'tshol ba sogs byed pa bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang rang gang nas 'byung ba'i rtsa ba sems skyed sogs kyi yum 'di la dgongs par mdzad pa yin gsung / /lnga pa spyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ go rim bzhin du/ zhes sogs byung /rnam rdzogs spyor ba spyi'i rnam bzhag dang / thar pa cha mthun nas bzung rgyud la skye rim bshad pa gnyis yod pas/ dang po la'ang bsgom bya yul gyi rnam pa dang / sgom byed yul can spyor ba dang / sbyor ba de rgyud la skye ba'i gegs sam skyon zhe drug dang / rgyud la skyes pa'i phan yon bcu bzhi dang bcas bshadazin nas de'i spyor ba sgom par byed pa la spyor ba rang gi ngo bo ji lta ba bzhin shes par byed dgos pas/ de'i 'og tu sbyor ba'i mas nyid 459

/ /gsungs la/ mdo'i 'brel ni/ sher phyin nyams su len pa'i byang sems la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis dgongs par gsungs pa la/ 'o na de ltar dgongs pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ de nas yum 'di skyed pa'o/ / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ston pa'o/ / 'jig rten kun tu ston pa'o/ / zhes sogs kyis de ltar dgongs pa'i rgyu mtshan gsungs la/ de ltar dgongs pa'i rgyu mtshan dngos su ma gsungs so/ / de'ang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi spangs rtogs thams cad dang / 'jig rten kun tu ston par mdzad pa thams cad yum 'di la brten nas 'byung bas na/ yum 'di sangs rgyas rnams la drin che ba yin la/ rgyu mtshan des na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis yum de la drin gzo ba'i phyir du de nyams su len pa'i byang sems la gus pa dang / rim gro byed pa sogs bsrung ba dang bskyab par mdzad pa'i phyir/ des na 'jig rten kun tu ston pa zhes sogs man chad/de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang / zhes sogs kyi mtshan nyid la spyor dgos pa yin gsung / de'ang shes khyad byed pa'i mtshan nyid gsum gyis spyorab byed sgrub kyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa dang / ngo bo nyid mtshan gyi sbyorab gnyis don gcig yin kyang brjod tshul gyi sgo nas sbyor ba mtshon par byed pas na/ mtshan nyid yin par ma zad/ las su bya ba mtshon bya'ang yin zhes ston par/ / ngo bo nyid gang mtshon bya yang / zhes gsungs te/dper na lto ldir zhabs zhum chu skyor gyi don byed nus pa dang / bum pa gnyis don khyad par med kyang tha snyad 'dogs tshul gyi sgo nas de bum pa'i mtshon byed yin pa bzhin no/ / byang sems rnams kyi don du gnyer bya'i gtso bo ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyi nang nas thams cad mkhyen pa yin la/ de'ang rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs dang / gzhan 4gru

༄ zidon 'phrin las phun tshogs gnyis su yod cing / 'bras bu de dag dang cha 'dra ba re rgyu'i dus na'ang yod dgos pas na/ ji lta ji snyed kyi rnam pa ma lus pa mkhyen pa de dang cha 'dra ba zhig kyang rgyu'i dus su yod la/ de mtshon par mkhyen gsum gye yul shes pa'i shes mtshan dang / de ltar shes pa de'ang gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu 'gro dgos pas byed mtshan dang / de ltar shes pa'i sgo nas gzhan don byed pa de nyan rang la'ang yod na nyan rang gi lam de yun thung bas sgrub sla zhing / byang sems kyi de yun ring bas dka' bar 'dug snyam nas/ 'di ni nyan rang la med kyi byang sems kho na la yod par ston pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid de / des na sngon ma dag snga ma gnyis la mi ldan rnam gcod dang / phyi ma 'di la gzhan ldan rnam gcod ces gsungs pa yod do/ / shes mtshan la gsum las/ gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan gyi/ 'jig rten 'jig med bdag nyid dang / zhes pa 'di don dam par 'jig pa med pa la gsungs pas gzhi'i bsgom bya dngos la mi rung bas zin byed la sbyor dgos kyi/ mdo las kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang / mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis zhes gsungs/ byang sems kyi nyams len gyi skabs thams cad gsungs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang / zhes pa 'dis kun slong sems skyed dang / 'jig rten 'jig med bdag nyid dang / / zhes pa 'dis mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyes slob par bstan pa yin nam snyam gsung / sems can sems kyi spyod pa dang /zhes sogs kyis sems kyi gnas lugs 'tshol tshul bstan la/ de'ang phyir byang sems kyis khams bco brgyad dang / rang rgyal gyis skye mched bcu gnyis dang / nyan thos kyis phung po lnga la dmigs pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / nyan thos kyis bdag 'dzin tsam spong ba yin zhing / bdag 461

/ /'dzin gyes phung po lnga la bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / de las kyang sems la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i phyir dang / phung po lnga po de'ang gtso bo sems 'khor bcas la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ / kha cig sems de dbyibs dang kha dog gang du grub ma grub 'tshol ba sogs rang lugs la bkag kyang / bka' gdams pa gong ma dang / mdo 'ga' zhig las de ltar 'tshol bar gsungs shing /'dir yang sems de dbang po'i yul du bstan du yod med dang / dbang pos blta bar yod med sogs su tshol bar bstan gsung / g.yo ba dang bsdus pa dang / bkram pa dang / bcum pa ste/ bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' dang ldan pa sogs bzhi rtag lta dang / mtha' dang mi ldan pa sogs bzhi chad lta dang / ldan mi ldan gnyis gar lta ba ni gnyis gar lta ba dang /gnyis ka min pa ni gnyis min du lta ba ste bcu gnyis dang / lus srog rdzas gcig dang tha dad du lta ba gnyis bsnan pas lung ma bstan gye lta ba bcu bzhi yin la/ dang po grangs can/ gnyis pa rgyang 'phen/ gsum pa gcer bu ba/ bzhi pa gnas ma bu pa la sbyor dgos gsung / rtag par lta ba de ltar rigs mod/ bdag dang 'jig rten mi rtag par lta ba chad lta ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'di la bdag ni rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyi bdag gzhir bzhag yin pas/ de 'jig rten rgyun chad par 'gyur ba'am/ yang na rang lugs kyi mi rtag pa zhes pa skad cig re re la 'bras bu'i ngo bor gyur pa byed cing /'di dag gis rgyun chad pa la 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin gsung / mtha' nizad dang mjug cha dang / / zhes sogs ltar zad pa la byas nas mtha' dang ldan par lta ba chad ltar bshad tshul gcig dang / mtha' ni rigs 'dra tha ma la byas nas rigs 'dra phyi ma dang ldan pas mtha' ldan du bshad tshul gcig dang gnyis yod pas phyi ma ltar byas pa yin la/ 'di'i de bzhin 462

ra ji/ /zizug gri bsgo sdegashegs pa ni grol ba'i bdag dang / rdzas yod kyi bdag la bshad tshul gnyis yod gsung / gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/gang dag 'das dang / zhes sogs blo ka gnyis byung / don ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas yum 'di la brten nas byung zhing / kha cig sangs rgyas rnams yum 'di 'jig rten na ston pa dang / rgyal ba rnams kyi zag med kyi phung po skyed byed dang / sangs rgyas rnams la sems can gzhan gyi sems kyi spyod pa'ang yum 'dis ston par byed/ der ma zad/ nyan thos rang rgyal rgyal sras kyi/ de bzhin nyid gcig pa nyid dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen nas gzhan la bstan kyang btags pa zhes bya ba yin no/ / lam shes kyi shes mtshan de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/mkhas pa 'jig rten zhes sogs blo ka gsum byung / de'ang byang sems rang gis rnam thar sgo gsum gyi tshul rdzogs nas/ sems can rnams ngan song gi sdug bsngal las 'don kyang / don dam par sdug bsngal dang sems can du 'du shes mi 'byung bas/ kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa dang / dngos po med pa dang / ngo bo nyid nga / rten med pa sogs bstan pa yin gsungs so/ / rnam mkhyen gyi shes mtshan gyi skabs su lam gyi lus yongs rdzogs shig bstan par 'dug snyam ste/ yongs 'dzin rin po ches/ de bzhin nyid kyi chos brten nas zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin nyid kyi zhes pa'i de sgra sangs rgyas la snyeg dgos/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus pa/ bla mar bya ba dang / mnyes par byed pa dang / mchod par byed pa sogs dang / thams cad du 'gro ba zhes pa kun rdzob dang ma mthong zhes pas don dam bden pa'i chos nyid gzigs tshul gyi dbang du byas la/ de'ang theg gsum gyi rtogs rigs thams cad yar ldan du 'dus shing yo3
