/ /gzhan thams cad la'ang khyab byed du 'gro bas na thams cad du 'gro ba dang /rigs shes kyis gnas lugs kyi don btsal ba'i mthar ma rnyed pa de gnas lugs mthong ba'i don yin pas/ de ltar mthong ba'i don gzhan la ston par byed pas/ ma mthong ston par mdzad pa dang / zhes gsungs/'jigarten stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa zhes pas spyir bstan nas/ nyan thos kyi dbang du byas te stong nyid brjod pa dang / byang sems kyi dbang du byas te shes par mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi dbang du byas te mthong bar mdzad pa zhes bshad tshul gcig dang / yang na thos bsam gyis brjod pa/ sbyor lam gyes sgom byung rnyed nas smin par byas pas shes pa dang / mthong lam gyis mngon sum du mthong nas grol bar byed pas/ 'jig rten stong pa nyid mthong bar mdzad pa zhes bshad tshul gcig kyang yod gsung / rnam mkhyen gyi shes mtshan de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ dper na nam mkhar gnas pa'i zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum byung / don bsdus na/ sher phyin 'di ni srid pa chu klung gi gzugs su bkod de/ srid sogs nyes pa'i tshogs skem par byed pa dang / yon tan thams cad mngon du 'gyur ba'i byed las gnyis dang ldan pa yin te/ dper na nyi ma'i 'od zer des sa'i rlan skem par byed pa dang / gzugs rnams ston par byed pa'i las gnyis dang ldan pa bzhin no/ / rigs shes kyis phung po lnga'i gnas lugs btsal ba'i mthar de lnga ma mthong ba de de lnga'i gnas lugs mthong ba yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan te/ dper na thog reg ma mthong ba la nam mkha' mthong ba 'jig rten na brjod pa ltar yin gyi/ des gzhan gyis bsnyad par bya ba min gsung /budha shrīs gzugs rnams mi mthong zhes sogs khyad mtshan la mar sbyar yang /slob dpon gyis shes mtshan la sbyar ba 'di nyid nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa sogs 4yo

ra / /〉〉na bsgo dzadang shin tu mthun par gsung / shes mtshan la mkhyen pa gsum ga'i mtshan nyid yod pas spyi'i mtshan nyid ces gsungs/ khyad mtshan la gzhi shes kyis de ma gsungs pas spyi'i mtshan nyid ces ma brjod/ khyad mtshan gyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mi mnyam pa/ gzhal ba las 'das pa sogs sdug bden dang / 'phags pa kun sdud sogs kun 'byung bden pa dang / de nas bzhi 'gog bden dang / bzhi lam bden la sbyor dgos gsung / khyad mtshan de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ gang gis de ltar mthong ba/ zhes pa nas/ de la de skad bstan par bya/ / zhes pa'i bar gyi blo ka bcu bzhi byung / mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis bsnyad par/ zhes sogs 'di dag gis bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs bstan/ rang gi yul nas 'du ba thams cad sdud pa ltar nas/thams cad sdud pa gnyis shin tu 'das te zhes sogs 'phags kun sdud pa'i khyad mtshan sogs bstan la/ 'di dag gi don bsdus na nyan rang thabs shes phyogs re ba dang / nyi tshe ba yin pas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su 'gro mi nus par ma zad/ srid zhi'i mthar ltung ba yinal/ byang sems kyi thabs shes ya ma bral bar gzhi la bden pa gnyis dang / lam la tshogs gnyis zung du 'brel bar nyams su blangs pa'i stobs kyis srid zhi gang gi'ang mthar mi ltung bar 'bras bu sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa thob par 'gyur ba yin pas nyan thos dang thun mong ma yin par khyad par 'phags pa yin te/ des ni/ thabs shes nyi tshe ba ni rdza so ma btang bar chu blug pa dang / gru tshags legs par ma byas par rgya mtshor zhugs pa dang /lo brgya lon pa'i mi g.yas g.yon nas ma brten par 'gro mi nus par sa la 'gyel pa gsum dang 'dra la/ byang sems kyi thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i srid zhi'i mthar mi ltung ba ni/ rdza so legs par btang ba sogs dang 'dra/465

/ /de la slob ma bzang po zhes sogs kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen gye thabs kyis yongs su zin pa de bstan la/ de ltar 'byung ba de'ang zeg pa chen po'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs par ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyes rjes su 'dzin pa dang / rang gis bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin bsten pa la rag las te/ yon tan de dag thams cad rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen lasabyung ba'i phyir/ de'ang blo bzo min gyi rgyal ba rang nyid kyis sngon tshul bzhin bsten pa las lam de dag thams cad thugs nyams su bstar bas myong thog nas de skad gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / sbyin dang zhes sogs blo ka gcig gis ro myang med pa'i de bstan te/ phyin drug lta bu nyams su blangs pa la 'di ltar nyams su blangs so/ / zhes rlom sems dang mchog tu 'dzin pa ni ro myang ba yin pas de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i tshe'ang mngon zhen dang mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa'i ro myang med pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan nyid la byed sgrub kyi sgras bstan pa'i shes khyad byed gsum dang / las sgrub kyi sgras bstan pa'i ngo bo nyid mtshan dang bzhi yod pas/ byed sgrub de la gsum du nges pa'i rgyu mtshan byang sems kyis rtog rigs gsum mkhyen gsum gyi yul shesadagos pas de shes tshul sbyor ba 'di la tshang bar mtshon pas shes mtshan dang / de shes pa'ang dgos pa gang gi phyir yin na gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu 'khyer dgos pas sbyor ba 'di la gzhan don 'phrin las phun tshogs 'byung bar mtshon pas byed mtshan dang / shes nas gzhan don byed pa de theg pa gsum ga la yod dam zhe na/ gzhan la med kyi/ zeg chen kho na'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos su mtshon pas khyad mtshan gsum du grangs nges pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid mtshan mtshon bya'ang yin yang / mtshan nyid kyi skad dod li dra zhes pa mtshon bya dang mtshon byed gnyis gar 'jug pa ni/ dper 466

das / /sbyo rwaspros na bsreg pa zhes pa sreg byed me dang bsreg bya bud shing gnyis gar 'jug pa bzhin yin gsung / byed mtshan bcu gcig yod pas 'di la bshad tshul du ma yod de/ kha cig dang po brgyad mkhyen gsum thun mong gi byed pa dang /phyi ma gsum ga thun mong ma yin pa'i byed pa yin zer/ nyi snang dang rgyan snang sogs su dang po dgu gzhi shes dang / tha ma gnyis lam shes dang /rnam mkhyen gyi byed par sbyar la/ 'grel chung 'dir dang po gsum gzhi shes rang ldog gis sgrub nus pas gzhi shes kyi byed pa dang / dang po dgu gzhi shes kyi byed par 'dod pa dag gis kyang gtan du phan pa sogs phyi ma rnams 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes kyis sgrub mi nus shing / 'di kha cig gzhi shes kyi byed par 'dod kyang / slob dpon gyis de ni lam shes kyi nang du 'dus pas phyi ma bdun lam shes kyi byed pa dang / gcig rnam mkhyen gye byed par gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'ang sdig spong dge sgrub kyis tshe phyi mar bde 'gro la 'god pas phan pa dang / tshe 'dir nad sogs zhi bar byed pas bde ba dang / tshe 'di phyi'i gnas skabs kyi bde ba de'ang sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa la bde bar snang ba tsam yin gyi/ mthar rang gi ngo bo sdug bsngal du snang zhing sdug bsngal phyi ma 'dren par byed pas/ de lta bu'i rnam smin gyi bde ba ma yin pas/ gtan gyi bde ba myang 'das su 'god pa'i skyob pa dang gsum gzhi shes kyi byed pa dang / sgrib gnyis bag chags sogs skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs kyi gtsang ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i skyabs dag dang /sdug bsngal gyi rgyu bden zhen gye ma rig pa bzlog pas gnas dang / srid zhi mnyam nyid du rtogs pas dpung gnyen dang / gling bzhi ri rab sogs rtsa ba gser dkyil la thug cing chus mtshams bcad pa'i mtsho'i nang nas yar thon pa'i skam sa de la gling zer ba bzhin du/ srid zhis mtha' bskor ba'i dkyil yo7

/ /gyi mi gnas pa'i myang 'das der 'god pa'i gling dang / rang gi blo dang 'tshams par don sgrub pas yongs 'dren dang / rgyu dus su yun ring por de ltar nyams su blangs pas 'bras dus su'ang gzhan don 'bad med lhun 'grub tu 'byung bas lhun gyis grub pa dang / rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas bar du 'bras bu mngon du mi byed pa bdun lam shes kyi byed pa dang /rten gyi mdzad pa gcig ni rnam mkhyen gyi byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ byed mtshan de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ de ltar spyod pa/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / de'ang 'gro ba'i skyabs zhes pas gzhi shes kyi byed mtshan dang dpung gnyen zhes sogs kyis lam shes kyi de sogs bstan pa yin gsung / brgyad stong pa las/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'jig rten la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa dang / 'jig rten la bde ba'i phyir dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba'i phyir zhugs pa dang / zhes sogs kyis phan bde skyob pa sogs kyi byed pa dang po dgu mnyam du mdor bstan nas/rab 'byor ji ltar na/ zhes sogs kyis so sor rgyas par bstan pas/'di la brten nas/ dang po 'grel chen dang nyi snang gis gzhi shes la sbyar ba yinano/ / 'dir gling du gyur pa dang / snang bar gyur pa gnyis so sor gsungs kyang / brgyad stong 'grel chen las de gnyis gcig tu byas te/de la snang ba'i gling sogs gsum du phye ba yin gsung / ngo bo nyid mtshan ni/dbon dang zhes pa mtha'i gsal byed yin pas chags sogs nyon mongs kyis dben pa dang / 'bras bu lus gnas ngan len gyis dben pa dang / rgyu tshul min yid byed kyi rnam rtog gis dben pa/ nyon sgrib kyis dbang du byas pa gsum ni gzhi shes kyi dmigs pa dngos dang / byang sems kyis de nyams su len pa'i tshe mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po la don dam par blang dor du 44

༄ zisazhen pa 'gog dgos pas/ des dben pa ste shes sgrib kyi dbang du byas pa gcig dang bzhi ni gzhi shes kyi ngo bo nyid mtshan bzhi ste phyi ma 'di zin byed la sbyor dgos gsung / bden gnyis kyi rnam dbye la mkhas pa'i byang sems kyisasgyu ma'i glang po sogs snang ba ltar dmigs yul sems can de dag kyang don dam par med kyang tha snyad du phan gnod sogs la rtsis su byas te/ de dag mya ngan las zlo bar byed cing gdags gzhi sems can dang / de bden grub gnyis gcig tu snang ba'i skye bo mi mkhas pa dag gis yang na bden par bzung ste 'jigs sred kyis dman lam du ltung ba'am/ yang na sems can gtan med du bzung ste gzhan don yal bar 'dor ba gang rung zhig tu 'gyur bsade'i snang tshul la ltos te/ don dam par med pa'i sems can mya ngan las bzla bar dka' ba dang / rang gi bsam pa brtan pas theg pa gzhan du bkri bar mi rung bar theg pa chen por mtha' gcig tu nges pa dang / rgyu'i skabs su yun ring por sgrub dgos pa de 'bras bu 'gang che song ba'i rtags yin pas/ srid pa gsum gyi mthar thon pa'i byang chub kyis de'i cha tsam la'ang 'gran mi nus pas ched du bya ba dang / 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa dang / mngon zhen bkag pa lnga lam shes kyi de dang / mkhyen pa snga ma gnyis kyisagang la dmigs pa de la rnam mkhyen gyis dmigs pa dgos pas dngos po'i khyad par la dmigs pa dang / 'jig rten pa la thams cad bden par snang ba yin la/ sangs rgyas kyis thams cad bden med du rtogs nas de ltar ston pas 'jig rten dang mi mthun pa dang / gzugs sogs thogs med du shes pa dang / ngo bo bden par med pas gzhi med pa dang / 'bras bu'i ngo bor bden par mi 'pho bas 'gro ba med pa dang / don dam par rgyu las ma skyes pas skye ba med pa dang / de bzhin nyid mi dmigs pa ste bdun 469

/ni rnam mkhyen gyi ngo bo nyid mtshan yin gsung / brgyad stong par rab 'byor gyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa zab mo 'di su dag gis 'tshal bar 'gyur/ zhes pa nas/ 'dul ba las 'byung /dben pa'i rang bzhin can yin no/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis gzhi shes kyi ngo bo nyid mtshan bzhi bstan la/ 'dir dbon pa tsam las ma byung yang / nyon mongs dang rtags dang mtshan ma shes sgrib dang bzhis dben par rgyan 'dir gsungs pa ni zab don gsal bar byed tshul yin gsung / rab 'byor gyes gsol ba/ nas/ dka' ba bgyid pa lags so/ / zhes sogs myang 'das las bzla ba de bstan/ de ltar spyod pa de gnas tshul gsum la re bar mi bgyi ste/ zhes sogs kyis mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i de bstan/ sangs rgyas kyis nyid la re bar bya'o/ / zhes pas ched du bya ba snga ma dang 'brel bar bstan/ rab 'byor gyis gsol ba nas/ gang gis bsgoms par ma gyur/zhes sogs kyis 'khor gsum dag pa'i de bstan/ bcom ldan 'das chos 'di ni 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun par bstan te/ nas/ lha'i le'u zhes bya ste bco lnga pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis mi mthun pa'i de bstan/'diyan chad du le'u bco lnga dang bam po bco lnga yod pa yin gsung / de nas bcom ldan 'das/ nas/ thogs pa ma mchis so/ / zhes sogs kyis thogs pa med par shes pa'i de bstan/ bcom ldan 'das gnyis su ma mchis pa'i slad du/ zhes sogs kyes lhag ma bstan yin gsung / ngo bo nyid mtshan de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ grags chen ldan rnams zhes sogs slo ka drug byung / de'ang bya dka' go cha spyon zhes sogs kyis dka' dang zhes pa'i de bstan te/ don dam par mi zhen kyang tha snyad du sems can la snying brtse ba sogs thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i bya dka' ba'i go cha sogs 470

ris / /13 〈spro/sagasungs pa'i phyir/ dpen dang zhes pa'i de bzhi sdud pa 'dir dngos su ma bstan/ the tshom som nyi yid bral zhes sogs kyis nges dang zhes pa'i de bstan te/ theg chen la som nyi med par mtha' gcig tu nges pas theg pa gzhan du drangs par mi nus par gsungs pa'i phyir/ sus kyang rtogs pa med cing / zhes sogs kyis mi dmigs pa'i de mngon zhen bkag pa'i de sogs bstan/ sems can rnams ni/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis 'jig rten dang mi mthun pa'i de bstan te/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi snang tshul ni bya byed las gsum gang gi tshe'ang bden grub gzhir bzhag yin la/ chos rnams kyi gnas tshul ni bden med du gnas pa yin pas sangs rgyas kyis gang bstan pa de chos rnams kyi gnas tshul dang mthun par song bas na 'jig rten gyi snang tshul dang mi mthun par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa thar pa cha mthun nas bzung spyor ba'i bar rgyud la skye rim bshad pa la du ma zhig yod pas dang po thar pa cha mthun ni/ theg bsdus las/ bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dang / / 'dun brtan zhes sogs ltar dge ba dang 'dun pa gnyis brtan pa'i stobs kyis theg dman du nyams pa mi srid cing / gong nas gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i mtshams shig nas grangs med gsum gyi tshogs kyi mgo rtsom par gsungs pas/ sems bskyed ma thag nas ma yin par gser lta bu'i sems bskyed thob pa nas 'jog gsung /mtshan ma med pa'i shes rab kyis zin pas bzang ba dang / thabs khyad par can gyis zin pas 'dun pa brtan pa ste mdor na thabs shes ya ma bral bar nyams su len nus pa nas sbyin sogs rnam mkhyen gyi bar rang rgyud la bskyed par mkhas pa yin gsung / thar pa cha mthun de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe bde gshegs shes rab/ ces sogs sh+lau ka gsum byung / bde bar gshegs 471

/pa'i byang chub de'ang srid zhi gnyis la bden zhen zad pa zhig la 'jog dgos pas/ de thob pa'i rgyu'i dus na'ang thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin pas mtshan ma med pa'i shes rab la slob dgos pa dang / shes rab khyad par can rgyas thabs cha ma tshang ba med pa la slob pa ni skabs 'di'i sbyin sogs rang rgyud la sgrub par mkhas pa dang / gshog pa gnyis ldan gyi bya nam mkhar 'phur nus pa dang 'dra ba yin zhing / gzhan du thabs shes re re tsam gyis ni 'dab gshog ma tshang ba'i bya nam mkhar 'phur mi nus pa sa la ltung ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod mi nus par dman lam du ltung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ / dpe 'di brgyad stong pa dang nyi khri sogs su 'byung zhing /sdud pa 'dir yang dag par sgrub pa la mkhas pa 'di la 'phros nas gsungs la/brgyad stong pa dang / nyi khri las/ ngo bo nyid mtshan gyi dka' dang zhes sems can mya ngan las bzla bar dka' ba de la yar sbyar nas gsungs/thar pa cha mthun de nyid brgyad stong par 'chad pa'i tshe/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta ba/zhes sogs nas mtshan ma'i tshul gyis zhes sogs gsungs so/ / dad sogs yul lnga la mkhas dgos te/ lam spyi'i lus yongs rdzogs shig dad sogs yul lnga'i nang du 'du ba'i phyir/ de ltar yin te/ gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam cha tshang ba gcig skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim du 'dus pa gang zhigaskyabs 'gro gtso bo dang / chung 'bring gi lam gzhan rnams skyabs 'gro'i yan lag yin pas/ skyes bu chung 'bring gnyis kyi lam dad pa'i dbang po dang / skyes bu chen po'i lam dbang po phyi ma bzhi'i nang du 'dus pa'i phyir/de'angayin te bstan pa spyi la 'jug pa'i sgo skyabs 'gro ni sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bye brag theg chen gyi 'jug sgo 472

༄/ /sems bskyed ni/ bsam pa phun tshogs dran pa/ zhes pas bstan/zhugs nas phyin drug spyi la slob tshul/ sbyin sogs spyod yul brtson 'grus zhes pas bstan/ bye brag tha ma gnyis la slob tshul/ rnam par mi rtog ces sogs gsum gyes bstan pa'i phyir/ dad sogs yul lnga la mkhas tshad ni/sangs rgyas la dad pa de'ang blun dad du ma song bar sku gsung thugs kyi yon tanas shes nas dad pa thob pa zhig dgos te/ spangs pa khyad par gsum ldan/ rtogs pa khyad par gsum ldan sogs 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa 'di dag rgyu med rkyen med las byung ba ma yin par rgyu brtse ba snying rje chen po dang / bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs bsam sbyor phun tshogs las 'khrungs par 'dug snyam du bden gnyis kyi rnam dbye dpyis phyin par shes pa de / 'di'i dad pa la mkhas pa'i tshad dang / gang nyams su len pa'i tshe'ang thabs shes ya ma bral bar phar phyin re re'i nang du drug drug tshang bar nyams su len shes pa de brtson 'grus la mkhas pa'i tshad dang / dang po kun slong gi skabs sems gsal 'debs khul byas kyang / dngos gzhi dang mjug gi skabs rtsis med du byed pa lta bu ma yin par/ dang po gsal btab pa de dran pas rgyun bskyangs te sbyor dngos mjug gsum gang gi skabs su dran 'dun du re ba yod dgos pa'i gnad yongs su shes pa ni dran pa la mkhas tshad dang / theg chen gyi ting nge 'dzin ni bying rgod dang bral ba tsam ma yin par dman pa'i yid byed dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa'i thabs khyad par can la byas nas de stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ya ma bral bar nyams su len shes pa 'di'i ting nge 'dzin la mkhas tshad dang / stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab de'ang thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyams su len shes pa de shes rab kyi dbang po la mkhas pa'i tshad yin pa'i phyir/473

/de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rnam par mi rtog ting nge 'dzin zhes rnam par mi rtog pa la gsungs/ chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du/ / shes pa'i shes rab/ces kun rdzob pa'i yul can du gsungs pa yin gsung / thar par bgrod pa'i lam gyi mgo tshugs pa nas thar pa cha mthun dang / mthong lam la phan 'dogs pa'i nye rgyu yin pas nges 'byed cha mthun zhes gsungs/ nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ / zhes pa mtha'i gsalabyed yin la/ 'dir zhes pa nye tshig smos pa ni skabs bzhi pa 'dir zhes bshad dgos pas/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngar skabs dang po der/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ / zhes sogs kyi skabs su sbyor lam shes rab kyi cha rnams chos nyid kyi steng nas gtsor 'don byas nas bshad zin pas slar yang zlos nas bshad mi dgos la/ sbyor lam kun rdzob pa'i cha rnams skabs bzhi pa 'dir gtsor 'don byas nas 'chad byas pa'i don no/ / de'ang byams sogs bsgom pa la dang po chags sdang gis ris su ma chad pa'i mnyam pa sgrub dgos pas mnyam pa'i sems dang / bde ba sgrub pa'i byams pa dang /sdug bsngal sel pa'i phan pa dang / khong khro ba med pa dang / rnam par mi 'tshe pa'i sems kyi rnam pa lnga dang / 'dir lnga tshan gnyis su byas pa ni phyi ma gnyis re sdom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin la/ rang las na tshod rgan pa rnams la pha ma'i sems dang / na tshod mnyam pa rnams la spun dang sring mo'i sems dang / rang las chung ba rnams la bu dang bu mo'i sems dang / phan pa'i bshes dang / yid brtan pa'i grogs dang / rang gi ris su gtogs pa'i spun sogs kyi bdun brgyud tshun chad gnyen dang / rigs su mi gtogs kyang zhang po sogs kyi bdun brgyud tshun chad ni snag gi gnyen mtshamasadang lnga ste bcu po de drod kyi dmigs pa yin no/ / rang nyid sdug 474

༄/ /zinabrispong dge sgrub la gnas te gzhan de la 'god pa dang / de la'ang rjes su yi rang byas nas bsngags pa brjod pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed de gong 'phel du byed pa ni rtse mo'i dmigs pa dang /rang gis bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog shes par byas te gzhan de la 'god pa dang 'god pa de tsam gyis mi tshim par khyod kyis de byas pa legs da dung yang sgrub cig ces pa bskyed de gong 'phel du byed pa ni bzod pa'i dmigs pa dang / rang gzhan gyi rten can smin pa dang / grol par byed pa ni chos mchog gi dmigs pa yin gsung / sbyor lam de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas theg pa 'di la nges par 'byung 'dod gang /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / de'ang rkang pa dang po de burto shrīs/ thar pa cha mthun la yar sbyar pa dang / slob dpon gyis sbyor lam la mar sbyar ba 'di blo ngor bde zhing / gnyis ka ltar yang 'grig ste/ brgyad stong par/thar pa cha mthun gyi mjug rdzogs mtshams su sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa dang / sbyor lam gyi mgo na nges par 'byung bar 'tshal bas/ zhes gsungs pas slob dpon gyi de la'ang shin tu 'grig pa'i phyir/ sems snyoms zhes pas lnga tshan dang po'i thog ma dang / pha ma'i 'du shes zhes pas lnga tshan gnyis pa'i thog ma de smos payin la/ yang phan pa'i sems zhes sogs 'byung ba ni dka' se ba zhig 'dug ste dpyad dgos gsung / brgyad stong pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa/ nas byang chub tu nges par 'byung bar 'tshal bas ji ltar gnas par bgyi/ ji ltar bslab par gye/ zhes sogs drod kyi dmigs pa dang / bdag nyid kyang sdig pa thams cad las ldog pa la gnas par bya'o zhes sogs kyis rtse mo'i dmigs pa dang / de bzhin du bden pa nas byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med pa la 'jug pa'i bar dang / zhes pa'i 475

/tshig 'dis bzod pa dang / sems can rnams yongs su smin pa la gnas/zhes pa nas/ gzhan dag kyang de la yang dag par bskul ba dang / de'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / de la rjes su yi rang bas dga' bar bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ de bzhin nyid kyi le'u zhes bya ste bcu drug pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis chos mchog gi dmigs pa bstan pa yin gsung / sbyor lam rang gi ngo bo dang / de la log rtog 'gog tshul gye sa bcad gnyis yod pas/ de la log rtog 'gog tshul ni/ spyir 'bras bu chos sku sangs rgyas kyi sa dang /skad cig spyor rgyun mthar 'jog pa la mkhas pa rnams mi mthun pa med kyang /mngon rtogs dang po drug la dngos btags dang sa mtshams sogs mi mthun pa du ma zhig gsungs so/ / skabs dang por rnam mkhyen nas/ brgyad par 'bras bu chos sku'i bar bshad pa'i go rim 'di ltar du rgyud la skye ba'i tshe dang por skabs dang po'i rnam mkhyen/ de nas gnyis pas lam shes/ de nas gsum pas gzhi shes sogs chos sku'i bang rim gyis thob par 'gyur ba ni/lam rkyang par 'dod pa'i lugs dang / dang po gsum gyi rnam mkhyen sogs gsum dngos gnas pa yin zhing / 'bras bu sngon dang rgyu phyis su bshad pas rgyud la skye ba'i tshe go rim bzlog dgos pa da nga/ skabs phyi ma gsum du rgyu sngon dang / 'bras bu phyis bstan pa ni lam khug par 'dod pa'i lugs yin te/ dang po gsum dang phyi ma gsum gyi bshad tshul 'di gzugs su grub na khug pa byas yod pa 'dra ba zhig yin gsung / mthar gyis sbyor ba'i skabs su sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi tha snyad ma gsungs kyang / dran pa nyer bzhag sogs gsungs pas de dang de'i skabs kyi de yod par 'gyur/ skabs dang po drug re re'i nang du sbyor mthong sgom gsum yang yang bstan to/ / 'di la gol sar ltung ba'i nyen che bas/ de'i zlos skyon med tshul ni skabs dang po 476

ra ji/ /zizug ge /sgo dzagasum du shes bya mkhyen gsum gyi rang bzhin gtan la phab pa de/ thos bsam gyis shes nas sgom byung gis nges pa dang / de goms pa las mngon sum du mthong ba dang / mthong zin goms par byed pa gsum dgos pa dang /gtan la dbab bya'i gzhi gsum so so yin pas zlos skyon med la spong sla/skabs phyi ma gsum ni spyir sangs rgyas pa la lam sgom tshul mi 'dra ba du ma zhig dgos pas/ skabs phyi ma gsum gyis kyang bsdus nas bsgom pa dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyang pa'i ched du go rim dkrugs te thod rgal lam spel nas sgom pa dang / go rim thar chags su sgom pa sogs sgom tshul du ma zhig gsungs pas/ sgom tshul de dag kyang snga ma dor nas phyi ma sgom pa lta bu ma yin par rang rang sgom pa nas rgyun mtha'i snga log bar du sgom dgos pa shes pa'iched du re re'i nang du'ang sbyor mthong sgom gsum ga bstan pa yin pas zlos skyon med gsung / bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang / / sogs gsungs pas skabs bzhi pa'i spyor lam sa brgyad pa'i ye shes su 'dod pa sogs mi 'thad de/ de ltar na skabs dang po'i sbyor lam yang dngos ma yin par 'gyur te/ ting 'dzin rnam par mi rtog pa/ zhes sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin de dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin te sa brgyad pa nas yod par 'di'i bshad bya'i mdo na gsungs pa dang / lung ston pa dang rlom pa zad/ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir dang / der ma zad/ kha cig ji ltar bzod chen skad cig ma/ / gcig yin de bzhin chos kyi mchog / ces gsungs pas chos mchog la che 'bring chung gsum gyi dbye ba byas pa mi 'thad par brtsad pa'i lan du khyod ltar na chos mchog dngos ma yin gyi/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes yin pas skyon med ces gsung dgos pa la de ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ chos mchog yin gzhir bzhag gi steng nas lung des theg dman gyi grub mtha' smra 477

/ /ba'i 'dod tshul ston la/ 'di theg chen gye sbyor lam chos mchog yin pas skyon med ces lan btab pa dang / der ma zad bzhi pa 'dir thar pa cha mthun rgyud la skye tshul bshad nas de'i 'og tu sbyor mthong sogs mi bshad par brgal te sa brgyad pa bshad pa ni 'brel med du 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyon 'ong gsung / grangs med gsum gye mgo ngos bzung ba'i sgo nas rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya ngos bzung / sbyor lam dang phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dang /sku tswa nyis 'grub tshul sogs yod pa las/ dang po sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags mdor bstan ni/ mthong dang goms pa'i lam dgaces sogs blo ka gcig gis spyir mdor bstan nas/ bye brag sbyor lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ gzugs la zhes sogs kyis gzugs sogs la bden zhen ldog pa sogs rtags nyi shu po mdo las brjod pa de dag sbyor lam la gnas pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid yin zhes mdo na spyor lam kyi skabs yulagazugs sogs la gtso bor bden zhen bkag pa dang / mthong lam gyi skabs su yul can la gtso bo bden zhen bkag pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gsung / gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang / / nas/ sangs rgyas dges pa'i spyod pa zhes pa'i bar gyis rtags nyi shu po grangs kyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad nas/ rtags ni nyi shu zheyosogs kyi sh+lau ka gcig gis rtags nyi shu drod rtse bzod mchog bzhi'i skabs su rim bzhin 'jog tshul bstan pa yin la/de'ang gzugs sogs yul la bden zhen bkag pa'i de dang / bden bzhi la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i stobs kyis dkon mchog gsum la je tshom zad pa ste/ de'ang mdzod las/ bden gsum mthong na tshul khrims dang / /chos la shes nas dad pa 'thob/ / lam mngon rtogs na sangs rgyas dang / /de yi dge 'dun dag la yang / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sdug 478

rardo / / (117kun gnyis dang 'gog bden shes pas chos la yid ches dad pa dang / lam bden la shes nas dad pa thob pas/ de sgrub pa po dge 'dun dang /sangs rgyas la yid ches thob pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan chos dkon mchog ni 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog ces pa ltar 'gog bden la 'jog dgos pas/ 'gog bden la don gnyer skye ba la sdug kun gyi nyes dmigs mthong dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / spyir mngon pa kun btus sogs su mngon rtogs bdun gyi sa bcad byas pa'i steng nas gsungs la/ mdzod kyi gnas drug pa 'dir yang tshogs spyor mthong sgom mi slob lam rim gyes bstan pas mngon rtogs lnga dang / gong gi de'i mjug tu/ rdzas su gnyis de dad pa dang / / tshul khrims dri ma med pa yin/ / zhes gsungs shing / dkon mchog mngon rtogs ni ngo bo nyid dkon mchog gsum la yid ches pa'i dad pa la 'jog pas de dang / kun tu mi 'byung ba'i mngon rtogs ni tshul khrims la 'jog cing / tshul khrims la yid ches pa'i stobs kyis tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs nam yang mi 'byung bas kun tu mi 'byung ba'i mngon rtogs te mngon rtogs bdun gye rnam gzhag bstan pa yin gsung / ngan song gsum dang lha tshe ring po ste mi ma yin pa'i mi khom pa bzhi dang / rgyal ba'i bka' med pa sogs mi'i mi khom pa bzhi ste mi dal pa brgyad zad pa dang / zad pa ni mtha'i gsal byed yin pas the tshom la'ang sbyor gsung / snying rjes gzhan chosa'i spyor ba la rang nyid kyis de dang mthun par spyod dgos pas/ rang sdeg spong dge sgrub la gnas te gzhan de la 'god pa dang / bdog pa thams cad 'bras bcas te/ / zhes sogs ltar sbyin sogs 'bras bu dang bcas gzhan la gtong bar byed pa'i gzhan gyi rten can te/ de yin tshul ni/nyan rang gis zang zing sogs kyi dngos po gzhan la gtong yang / rnam smin 479

/ /la re zhing rang kho na'i don gzhir bzhag pa'i steng nas tshur sgrub pa yin pas rang gi rten can dang / byang sems kyis zang zing sogs kyi dngos po gtong bar ma zad/ btang ba'i 'bras bu rnams kyang gzhan grol par gyur cig ces gzhan don kho na gzhir bzhag pa'i steng nas sgrub pas gzhan gyi rten can no/ / stong nyid ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i stobs kyis nyi tshe ba dang phyogs re tsam ma yin par rtag chad kyi mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i dbus de las mi phyed pa dang / mgon po khyod kyi zhal gyi dbugs tsam yang / / mtha' dag 'gro la sman pa'i rgyur 'gyur na/ / zhes sogs ltar sgo gsum gyi bya ba thams cad dang tha na dbugs 'byung rngub tshun chad gzhan don du goms par byas pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas pa'i tshe'ang gang byas pa thams cad gzhan don du 'gyur ba zhig 'ong ba ni/ byams lus sogs dang zhes pa'i de yin la/'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / gnod sems dang / gnyid dang / rmugs pa dang / rgod pa dang / 'gyod pa dang / the tshom dang lnga sgong ba ste rmugs gnyid gnyis gcig dang / 'gyod rgod gnyis gcig tu bya ste/mdzod las/ 'dod na sgrib rnams mi mthun dang / / zas dang bya ba gcig pa'i phyir/ / gnyis gcig / ces gsungs pa ltar gnyen po dang zas dang bya ba gsum gcig pa'i phyir ro/ / mi mthun pa ni gnyen po ste rmugs gnyid gnyis kyi gnyen por snang ba'i 'du shes sgom dgos pas gnyen po gcig pa dang / rmugs gnyid gang las 'byung ba'i gzhi de la de gnyis kyi zas su 'jog cing / de gnyis lus thang chad pa sogs las byung bas de gnyis zas gcig pa dang / de gnyis kyis sems dge ba'i phyogs la 'phror mi 'jug par zhum par byed pas bya ba gcig pa yin no/ / 'gyod rgod gnyis kyi gnyen po ni/ dbu ma snying po las/ rgod pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ / yid 4༅

༄/ /zin la byed pas zhi bar byed/ / ces kyang gsungs la/ gtso bo zhi gnas kyis sel par byed pas de gnyis gnyen po gcig pa dang / sngon gyi nye du dran pa dang / tshul min yid byed sogs las byung bas de gnyis zas gcig pa dang /sems ma zhi bar byed pas de gnyis bya ba gcig pa yin gsung / bag la nyal thams cad bcom pa ma yin yang / 'joms pa'i nus pa khyad par ba zhig thob pa dang / 'gro ba'i tshe na'ang srog chags phra mo yod med la brtag dpyad byas te gom pa 'dor ba sogs sgo gsum gyi spyod lam gang gi skabs su'ang dge mi dge sogs don dang ldan mi ldan gang du 'dug snyam du dran shes kyis bya ra byed pa dang / gtsang sbra mi byed pa ni shes rab 'chal ba'i rgyu yin par yongs 'dzin rin po che nas gsungs shing / sga dang lham gyis sngas byed pa lta bu sogs gtan nas mi rung bas gtsang sbra dang ldan pa ste/ rgyal bas spyod lam gyes 'dul dgos par gzigs pa la 'phags pa lta thul gtong bar gsungs pa lta bu'i lo rgyus sogs kyang yod pas gtsang sbra byed pa 'di la dgos pa chen po zhig yod pa red gsung / lus la srin bu'i rigs mi 'byung ba dang / gzhan 'khor du bsdu ba sogs drang po ma yin pa'i sems gya gyu med pa dang / rnyed bkur ches cher mi byed par sbyangs pa'i yon tan yang dag par len pa dang / sbyin sogs la slob pa'i tshe ser sna sogs 'gog pa dang /blo ngor bden pa gnyis 'gal 'du lta bur song na chos thams cad blo ngor ma 'dus pa yin pas/ stong nyid legs par dpyad pa'i tshe rten 'byung la nges pa 'dren nus pa dang / rten 'byung la dpyad pa'i tshe stong nyid la nges pa drangs te gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i tshe chos nyid dang ldan par 'gro ba'am chos thams cad yang dag par sdud pa yin la/ sems can gcig gi don du'ang bskal pa mang por dmyal bar gnas dgos pa la'ang mi 'jigs 481

da / / / b.lapa dang / rang rgyud kyi rtogs pa la yid ches rnyed pa'i stobs kyis sus kyang lam gzhan du kha drangs par mi nus pa ste/ rang lam du rigs nges zer ba de'ang 'di 'dra zhig gi steng nas bzhag pa yin te/ dang po sgra spyi'i sgo nas rtogs/ de nas don spyi'i gsal snang thob ste nyon mongs pa mgo mnan pa'i mtshams shig nas nyon mongs pa spong nus pa dang / chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs nus par yid ches rnyed pas rang lam du rigs nges su 'gyur ba'i phyir/dper na yang dag pa'i skyon med pa la zhugs zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu yin gsung / bdud sdig can gyis dmyal ba sogs sprul te slu bar byed kyang phyir ldog mi nus pa dang / spyod lam thams cad don dang ldan pas sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dges pa ni brda rnying dang / dgyes pa ni brda gsar yin pas don gcig yin gsung /spyor lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten mgon la/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang rkang pa gsum byung / de'ang sh+lau ka dang po'i skabs su spyor lam pa mthu che dag nyon mongs spong ba las mi nyams pa'i tshul dang / yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro ba las slar mi ldog pa'i rtags bstan tu gsol/ zhes dri ba dang / mdor bstan nas/ thams cad 'du shes bral zhes pas 'khor 'das gnyis sam chos thams cad la bden zhen bkag ste/ chos dbyings ro gcig pa'i rtags dang po dang /dge sbyong dag dang nas/ rten gyi rab byed ces pas dkon mchog la yid ches pas dge sbyong sogs gzhan gyi zer zer gyi rjes su mi 'brangs shing rigs pa dang ldan par gzhan la'ang smra bar byed pa the tshom zad pa'i de dang /ngan song gsum spong zhes pas/ de gsum gyis mtshon pa'i mi khom brgyad spong pa'i de dang / dge bcu'i nas brtson zhes pas dge bcu la 'god pa'i 482

༄/ /de dang / zang zing med par nas ston zhes pas gzhan gyi rten can gyi de dang / chos la gcig tu dga' zhes pas zab mo'i don la som nyi'am rtse gnyis mi byed par rtse gcig pa'i gnyen po dngos su bstan pa'i shugs la spang bya sgrib pa lnga dang bag la nyal 'joms pa'i de gnyis go bas rtags gsum dang / rtag tu tshig 'jam ldan zhes pas 'dir ngag gi dbang du byas te byams lus sogs kyi de dang / 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug nas/ 'khril med/ces pas thag ring por brkyangs te 'gro bas 'gro ba dang / thag ring ma yin par rang gi khang pa'i nang lta bur phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa'i 'chag pa sogs spyod lam bzhi gang gi tshe'ang dran shes dang ldan pas chos 'dul ba ltar gnya' shing gang tsam lta ba sogs kyi de dang / gtsang byas nas/ gsum po dben zhing dag / ces pas zas gos gnas mal la longs spyod pa'i tshe gtsang ma'i gos 'chang shing lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa dag pas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i de bstan la lus dag pas srin bu mi 'byung ba'i de dang / yid dag pas gya gyu med pa'i de dang rtags gsum bstan no/ / rnyed 'dod ma yin/ zhes pas rnyed bkur la mi lta bar sbyangs pa'i yon tan len pa'i de dang / rjes thams cad kyi nang nas ba glang gi rjes mchog ces zer ba ltar khyu mchog gi rjes su zhugs te song na gnod 'tshe sogs mi 'byung zhing rtswa chu sogs dang legs par 'phrad 'ong ba ltar mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam drang po nas 'gro ba'i de dang / rtag tu chos 'dod pa zhes pa'i chos ni rnam par mi 'che ba la byas nas gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa la sdug bsngal sel dgos pas/ de'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshab tu rang nyid bskal par dmyal ba'i me nang du gnas dgos kyang mi 'jigs pa'i de dang / bdud kyi nas/ mi 'jog ces pas bdud la bdud du rtogs pa/ gzhan dring mi 483

/ /'jog pa dang / sangs rgyas dges pa'i de gsum bsdoms nas bstan gsung / rtags de dag brgyad stong par 'chad pa'i tshe/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la nas/ rnam pa gang dag lags/ rtags gang dag lags/mtshan ma gang dag lags/ zhes sogs kyis gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa'i de 'chad/ de bzhin nyid de dang / nas/ nem nur mi byed/yid gnyis mi byed zhes sogs kyis the tshom med pa'i de dang / rab 'byor yang phyir mi ldog pa'i nas/ ngan song du mi skye zhing / bud med kyi dngos po/zhes sogs kyis mi khom pa zad pa'i de dang / rab 'byor nas dge ba bcu'i las zhes sogs kyis dge bar 'god pa'i de dang / rab 'byor gzhan yang nas/ chos bstan pa 'dis kyang zhes sogs kyis gzhan gyi rten can gyi de dang / rab 'byor nas/ chos zab mo bshad pa la rnam nur mi byed/ces sogs kyis don la som nyi med pa'i de dang / de phan pa'i nas/ tshig 'jam par 'gyur zhes pas byams lus sogs kyi de dang / rmugs pa dang gnyid chung / zhes sogs kyis sgrib pa lnga'i de dang / bag la nyal med par 'gyur zhes pas bag la nyal med pa'i de dang / de dran pa nye bar bzhag ces sogs kyis dran shes ldan pa'i de dang / rab 'byor nas/ chos gos yongs su zhes sogs kyis gtsang ba'i de dang / sems can nas srin bu zhes sogs kyis srin bu med pa'i de dang / rab 'byor nas sems yongs su dag pa zhes sogs kyis gya gyu med pa'i de dang / rab 'byor gzhan yang nas/rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / zhes sogs kyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan yang dag par len pa'i de dang / phrag dog dang ser sna mang ba ma yin no zhes pa 'dis ser sna med pa sogs kyi de bstan te phrag dog ni rang rgyud kyi dge ba gong 'phel du 'gro ba sogs nyams par byed pa'i rgyu sdug shos shig yin pas 4yo

༄ zi'adir phrag dog thog mar smos pa yin gsung / chos zab mo dag bshad na nas/ 'jig rten gyi bzo'i gnas zhes sogs kyis chos nyid ldan par 'gro ba'i de dang / rab 'byor gal te bdud sdig can des sems can dmyal ba chen po brgyad mngon par sprul te/ zhes sogs kyis gzhan don du dmyal ba 'tshol ba'i de dang / bam po bcu drug pa/ rab 'byor nas/ 'khor ba'i spyod pa yin te zhes sogs kyis gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i de sogs bstan pa yin te/ bdud sdig can gyis dang por chos las ldog e nus bltas/de ma nus par theg chen las ldog e nus bltas kyang ldog par mi nus pa sogs ni phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags mtshan yin gsung / mthong lam gyi rtags bcu drug ni/ sbrang rtsi ro gcig pa bzhin no/ / zhes sogs ltar mnyam bzhag tu ro gcig kyang mnyam bzhag tu chos nyid sgom stobs kyis lag rjes bcu drug yod pa'i sgo nas bzhag la/ de'ang gzugs sogs kyi 'du shes yul can la bden zhen bkag pa'i de dang / nyer len nang na yod kyang phyi'i rkyen sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlab pa la'ang nges par ltos pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan pa dang / rgyu snyoms 'jug sogs spyir sgom spang yin kyang byang chub sems dpa'i dbang du byas na mthong spang yin pas yan lag yongs su zad pa'i de sogs bzhi ni/ sdug bden gyi rnam pa'i rtags dang / 'dod paraspyod pa'i tshe'ang 'dod pa'i yon tan la mi chags par lam gyi grogs su 'khyer ba sogs kun 'byung gi rnam pa dang / yul phung khams skye mched dang /yul can dbang po sogs la bden zhen bkag pa'i 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bzhi dang / sbyin sogs rnam byang la bden zhen bkag pa'i lam gyi rnam pa bzhi ste bcu drug yod pa yin gsung / mthong lam gyi rtags de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan bzhi la zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang rkang pa 485

/gcigabyung / de'ang bsam gtan zhes sogs rkang pa gcig gis yan lag yongs su zad pa'i de bstan par ye shes zhabs kyis gsungs la/ slob dpon gyis rkang pa dang po 'di sbyor lam gyi rtags kyi mjug la yar sbyar yang brgyad stong pa nyi khri sogs na spyor lam gyi mjug tu de 'dra'i tshig mi snang bas 'di la dpyad rgyu zhig yod tshod red gsung / grags pa zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis 'dod par thabs mkhas kyi spyod pa'i de bstan/ 'tsho ba'i phyir ni zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa'i de dang / rab tu dbon pa'i zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis/ dbang po dang grong khyer sogs la bden zhen bkag pa'i de dang / kun mkhyen 'dod cing zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis rang gi sa la gnas pa'i de dang / sa gsum la gnas pa'i de dang / chos phyir srog kyang 'dor zhes bas chos kyi don du srog gtong ba'i mthong lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags de bstan pa yin gsung /mthong lam gyi rtags de dag brgyad stong par 'chad pa'i tshe/ rab 'byor gzhan yang nas/ 'dod pa na bsam gtan dang po la stoms par 'jugaces sogs kyis yan lag yongs su zad pa'i de dang / rab 'byor nas/ming ched cher byed pa ma yin/ grags pa dang sgra dang tshigs su bcad pa ched cher byed pa ma yin zhes sogs kyis mi dge ba dang bral ba nyid kyis lus dang sems yang ba'i de sogs bstan la/ ming la ched cher byed pa ma yin zhes pa 'di lus dang sems yang ba la zhes pa 'di'i mdo yin kyang go dka' ba zhig 'dug gsung / sgom lam gye phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dang po ni/ skye ba dang ni 'gag pa zhes sogs zab mo brgyad kyis bshad la/ khyad chos phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nges pa la khyad gzhi sgom lam nges pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas/sgom lam gyi zab khyad dang / ngo bo dang / grangs dang / grangs kyi rtsod pa 486

ras / /1sgo des/sadang / byed pa la rtsod pa dang / kun rdzob la ltos pa'i rtsod lan sogs yod la / stong pa nyid la sogs pa la yang gzugs med la zhes ma brtags mang dpyad pa'i blo lhan skyes kyi ngor yod yod 'dra ba la/ don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs shes kyis gzugs can la cha shas so sor dang / de ma yin pa rnams la skad cig gis cha so sor bsal ba'i shul tu lus yod pa zhig mi rnyed pas rtag mtha' las grol ba dang / stong bzhin du snang ba tsam gyis bya byed thams cad rung bas skur ba'i mtha' las grol zhing snang stong gnyis gcig grogs su gcig 'gro bas na stong pa nyid zab pa yin la/ yul stong pa nyid de zab pas/ de rtogs pa'i yul can ye shes de'ang zab pa yin zhes yul zab pas zab par 'jog pa gcig dang / dang por chos nyid thos bsam gyis nges pa rnyed nas don spyi'i snang ba je chung dang chos nyid kyi snang ba je gsal du song ba nas rim gyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i don de bskal chen grangs med gnyis sogs yun ring por goms par byas pa'i stobs kyis 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa na'angabasam kyis mi khyab pa'i khyad chos thon pa zhig 'ongs pas na sgom lam 'di zab pa yin zhes yun ring por goms tshul gyi sgo nas zab par 'jog tshul gcig dang gnyis 'grel chen nas gsungs pas phyi ma 'di gtso bo yin gsung /sgom lam gyi zab khyad bshad nas sgom lam gyi ngo bo ni/ thos pas yang dang yang du sems pa dang / bsam pas 'jal ba dang / sgom pas nges par rtogs pa zhes bshad tshul gcig dang / spyor ba las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs pa bzhi'i yang yang sems pa dang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su mtshan nyid ji lta ba bzhin 'jal ba dang / mngon sum du rtogs pa'i don mthong zin goms par byed pas nges par rtogs pa zhes bshad tshul gcig dngaganyis mdo las 'byung gsung / 'dir sgom lam tsam goms par byed 47

/tshul bshad pas chog mod/ nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i zhes sogs sbyor mthong gnyis kyi skabs su goms par byed tshul bshad pas ci bya zhe na / skyon med de/ dang por thos bsam gyis nges pa rnyed pa nas rim gyis don spyi'i gsal snang dang / de nas mngon sum du mthong de nas mthong zin goms par byed tshul sogs bshad nas yun ring por goms par byas tshul la nges pa lhag par skye ba yin gye/ sgom lam gcig pu goms par bshad pas de tsam go mi nus pa'i phyir te/ dper na thag ring po nas 'ong ba'i mi zhig gis nga de ring 'dir slebs pa yin zhes smras na yun ring por 'ong ba la nges pa de tsam skyed mi nus la/ nga dang por yul de nas lam du zhugs/ de nas yul che ge mo zhig tu slebs/ de nas rim gyis da lta 'dir slebs ces smras na thag ring nas 'ong tshul la nges pa 'dren lugs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i phyir dang / ba stong gi 'o ma bsdus pa rim gyis bsdus tshul bshad na nges pa skye ba bzhin yin gsung / sgom lam gye zab khyad de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ gzugs dang tshor ba nas/ thob par 'gyur zhes sogs blo ka gsum byung / de'ang sh+lau ka dang pos bum pa sogs kyi btags don btsal na don dam par mi rnyed pas chos nyid zab pa dang / don dam par med kyang snang tsam gyis sgyu ma ltar rang rang gi bya ba byed nus pas chos can zab tshul bstan nas/ blo ka gnyis pas/ dang por thos byung rnyed nas don spyi'i gsal snang thob ste mngon sum du rtogs pa de tsam gyis chog mod/ mthong zin goms par byas pas ci zhig bya zhes dri ba cig bstan nas/ sh+lau ka gsum pas lan du skyes bu chags can zhig la zag bcas kyi bde ba chung du tsam gyi ched du nyinagacig la bud med kyi rnam rtog mang po skye na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bla na med pa'i zag med kyi bde ba nam yang mi 'gyur ba de lta bu 488

༄ /mthong na de'i ched du yun ring po'i bar du ci'i phyir goms par mi byed ces bstanagasung / zab khyad de brgyad stong par/ rab 'byor gyis gsol ba nas rab 'byor khyod gnas zab mo zhes sogs dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa dang nas thabs zhib mos gzugs las kyang bzlog la mya ngan las 'das pa zhes sogs kyis bstan la/ 'di'i rnam thar sgo gsum gtso bo sgom lam gyi bya byed las gsum la sbyor zhing / thabs zhib mo ni don dam par med kyang tha snyad du bya byed thams cad rung ba la byed gsung / sgom lam gyi ngo bo bshad zin nas de la dbye ba du yod ce na/ spang bya'i sgo nas dgu yod de/ spang bya rnam rtog la che 'bring chung gsum dang / de re re la'ang che 'bring chung gsum gyi dbye bas dgu yod pa'i phyir/ sgom lam chen pos chen po spong ba nas chung ngus chung ngu spong ba'i bar yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ sngar skabs gnyis par dri ma 'khrud tshul gyi sgo nas gsungs la/'dir yang mun nag shin tu 'thib po de snang ba chung du tsam gyis sel nus/spu nyag ma tshun chad mthong ba la sgrib pa'i mun pa srab mo de snang ba chen pos sel dgos pa bzhin du sgom spang rags pa chen po de sgom lam chung dus spong nus/ 'bring 'bring gis sgong ba 'dra zhing / bden 'dzin phra mo'i chung du spong ba la yun ring por goms pa'i sgom lam skye dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / sgom lam gyi dbye ba de sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ byang chub nas/ char mi phod/ces sogs blo gcig gis nyan rang gi sbyin sogs kyis byang sems kyi de'i char mi phod par bstan pas sgom lam chung du dang / byang chub nas 'jig rten gsum na med ces pa'i sh+lau ka gcig gis 'bring dang / bsod nams nas/yongs su 'dzin zhes pa'i sh+lau ka gcig gis sgom lam chen po bstan la/ gso ba dang / ya ma brla dang / snying po med gsum rnam thar sgo gsum la sbyar 489

/zhing / ya ma brla ni/ snying po med pa'i brda snying du gsungs pa'ang yod gsung / grangs gyi rtsod lan ni/ de ltar sgom lam gyi grangs dgur bshad pa mi 'thad de/ grangs med pa yod pa'i phyir/ de'i 'bras bu bsod nams la grangs med/ gzhal med tshad med gsum mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'bras bu ni rgyu yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/zhes rtsod pa 'god tshul ni/ yongs grags ltar dang / yang phar phyin rtog ge snang bar rgyu gcig las 'bras bu du ma mi 'byung bar khas len pa'i grub mtha' smra ba su'ang med pas rtsod pa de ltar 'god pa mi 'thad la 'on ji ltar 'god na/ 'bras bu grangs med pa yod na rgyu sgom lam gyes spang bya rnam rtog grangs med pa spong dgos pas spang bya'ang grangs med pa yod dgos la/ de ltar na sgom lam grangs med yod par 'gyur bas dgur bshad pa mi 'thad ces rtsod tshul cig gsungs la/ 'on kyang gser 'phreng rnam bshad sogs kyis snga ma ltar byas gsung / de ltar dogs pa khongs nas bsus te/ lan ni/ grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams/ / zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung /'di'i don dang kun rdzob ni dbu ma'i lugs kyi rigs shes kyi dpyad bzod la don dam dang / tha snyad la kun rdzob tu byas tshul gcig dang / bye smra sogs kyis rdzas la rang mtshan dang / ldog pa la spyi mtshan du byas pa'i bshad tshul gcig dang gnyis yod pas snga ma'ang gtan nas mi 'thad pa ma yin yang gtso bo phyi ma dang / rang spyi'i dbang du byas pa de yin pas 'bras bu grangs med sogs skyed byed kyi rgyu sgom lam re yod kyang / de dag log pa'am ldog pa tha dad pa tsam yin gye/ ngo bo tha dad pa'am rdzas tha dad pa med pas grangs mang bar thal ba'i skyon med de/ sgra rtog sel 'jug yin pas/ mi rtag pa zhes brjod pas log pa rgyu rkyen gyis 'du ma byas bkag nas 'dus byas pa sgrub 4ga

ra / /zizug ge /sgo khyemi dgos pa dang / 'du byas zhes brjod pas log pa rtag pa bkag nas mi rtag par sgrub don med la/ des na log pa tha dad dam ldog pa tha dad tsam yin pas bum pa gcig gi go sar mi rtag par gyur pa'i bum pa dang / byas par gyur pa'i bum pa sogs yod kyang / de'i go sar bum pa mang po yod mi dgos pa bzhin yin gsung / grangs med/ gzhal med/ tshad med gsum gyi don gser 'phreng las 'du byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi khams su grangs med pa dang / dus gsum du gzhal du med pa dang / gang zag sus kyang 'di tsam las sgra med ces bzung bar mi nus par gsungs pas dang po gnyis kyi don cung dka' bar snang bas/ 'khor 'das gnyis 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas su bshad pa gsung rab spyi'i tha snyad du 'dug pas 'dir yang mngon mtho dang nges legs kyis bsdus pa'i 'bras bu 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas su grangs med pa dang / sgom lam gyi 'bras bu 'di tshun chad du byung la de phan chad du ma byung / ma 'ongs pa na'ang de phan chad du mi 'byung zhes tshad gzung bar mi nus pas dus gsum du gzhal du med pa zhes dgos sam snyam gsung / gsum pa ni sor bzhag ltar go sla/ 'o na grangs med pa sogs bstan pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ byes pa'i skye bo rnams la 'bras bu de ltar bstan pas de la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / sgom lam gyi byed pa'i rtsod lan la don dam dang kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis las dang po'i rtsod pa ni/ dngos po brjod du med pa/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis don dam par byed na sgyu ma'i glang po gsod mi nus pa bzhin du mi mthun phyogs nyams pa dang gnyen po gong 'phel du 'gro ba mi 'thad ces brtsad ba'i lan du/ byang chub ji lta zhes sogs kyi blo ka gcig gis don dam par nyams pa dang 'phel du mi rung bar kho bo yang 'dod la/ kun rdzob tu 49/

/ /rgyu tshogs gnyis las tha snyad pas 'bras bu sku gnyis tha snyad pa thob nas/gzhan gyi don tha snyad pa byed par 'thad pas na khyab med kyi lan btab pa yin gsung / don dam gyi dbang du byas pa'i byed pa'i rtsod lan de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyis bshad/ ces sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / de'ang sh+lau ka dang pos/ don dam par na nyams 'phel mi rung ba'i rtsod pa bkod nas/ blo ka gcig gis bden par grub na snga phyi 'brel med don gzhan du 'gro bas byang chub thob pa sogs mi 'thad la/ don dam par med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis snga ma'i shugs phyi ma la brgyab ste bla med byang chub thob par nus pas kun rdzob tu khyab pa med par ma zad 'gal khyab kyi lan btab bo/ / kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas pa'i rtsod lan ni/ sems ni snga mas zhes sogs nga pa gnyis kyis da ltar kun rdzob tu 'bras bu skyed pa mi 'thad de/sems skad cig snga phyi re res kyang ma yin/ gsum ga dus mnyam du tshogs pasakyang ma yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtsod pa bkod nas/ lan du mar me'i dpeyis zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis dper na mar me skad cig snga ma kho nas kyang sdong bu rdzogs par mi bsregs dus mnyam du tshogs pas kyang mi bsregs la/ skad cig gsum phan tshun ltos pa'i sgo nas bsreg pa bzhin du re re kho na dang dus mnyam du tshogs pas mi thob kyang / snga phyi phan tshul ltos pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos nyid kyis 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas pa'i byed pa'i lan de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/'bru mar snying po zhes sogs blo ka lnga byung / mar me'i dpe la/ sa bon dang / chu thigs kyi dpe gnyis kyas kha bskang ste bstan la/ dper na sil sdong lta bu'i dang po me tog la gnod par ma byas na rjes su 'gag kyang 'bras bu skye la/ dang po me tog la gnod pa byas nas 'gag kyang 'bras bu mi skye ba 492

༄ / /zin byes g.yo 11 gede rgyu la ltos pa'i rtags yin gsung / thal 'gyur pa'i lugs la skad cig snga mas skyed dam phyi mas skyed ces pa'i dpyad pa tsam gyes kyang don dam gyi dpyad par 'gro la/ der ma zad rang las skye'am gzhan las skye/ rang la lta'am gzhana'i blta ba sogs mi 'thad pas rgyu mtshan gyes rang rig med de/ de med pas gzhan rig kyang med pa yin gsung / mar me'i dpe zab mo brgyad la sbyar ba shin tu 'thad la de yan chad kyis khyad gzhi sgom lam bshad nas/khyad chos sgom lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags ni/ skye ba dang ni 'gag pa dang / / zhes sogs zab mo brgyad kyis bstan pa yin gsung / zab mo brgyad po de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ stong nyid mtshan med ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / 'dis rnam thar sgo gsum gyi sgo nas bstan/ /sku gsum 'grub byed kyi sbyor ba gsum las/ dang po srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba ni/ sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bshad zin pa'i 'og tu mi slob pa'i lam bshad pa de 'bad rtsol rags pa zhi bas mi slob lam rjes mthun pa yin na/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sgom lam chung du skor gsum du 'dus pas mi 'thad do zhe na skyon med de/ snga ma slob tshul gye sgonas bshad/ phyi ma 'di sku gsum gyi 'bras bu'i ldog cha nas bstan pas 'gal mi dgos zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ chos longs sprul gsum gyi chos sku la ye shes dang / ngo bo nyid sku gnyis yod pas/ ye shes chos sku ni srid zhi mnyam nyid du mngon sum du gzigs pa mthar thug pa zhig la 'jog cing /de thob pa de dang rigs 'dra ba rgyu'i dus nas sgom dgos pa dang / ngo bo nyid sku ni srid zhi gnyis la bden zhen zad pa la 'jog cing / bden zhen de spong ba la de'i zhen yul med par mngon sum rtogs dgos pas sku de gnyis dang rnam pa mthun pa'i rgyu'i dbang du byas te srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi spyor ba 493

/bzhag pa yin gsung / chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin na/ rmi lam bzhin du dge mi dge'i las lam rdzogs pa med par thal ba dang / sems ni dmigs pa dang bcas par skye zhes gsungs pa'i lung dang 'gal bar thal ba dang / rmi lam na'ang las lam rdzogs pa yod par thal ba'i rtsod pa gsum po de'i lan la/ don dam du yin na de dang de med par 'dod lan dang /kunadzob tu yin na khyab med kyi lan btab pas/ mngon zhen gyis gsos btab na rmi lam du'ang las lam rdzogs pa yod par 'dod pa la/ 'o na ha cang thal lo zhes pa'i lan byams pa la kha 'phangs shing / don gyis lan btab pa'ang yin gsung / 'dir las med pa'i rtsod pa dngos su bstan pas de'i dbang du byas nas mgo mtshungs kyi rigs pas bkag pa yin la/skad cig ma nyid kyi rgyu med par 'jig pa yin la zhes pa'i rigs pas bkag pa dang / rgyu ni 'jig pa phyis 'byung gi rgyu la byed gsung / 'jig rten sna tshogasalas las skye/ / zhes pa'i lung gis bkag pa yin no/ / don dam par sus kyang su'ang bsad pa med ces pa 'di dang / rgyun 'jig pa dang 'gal ba'i dngos po skye ba la zhes pa 'di cung go dka' bar 'dug pas/'di'i don dam ni bden grub la 'ong don med cing / de'ang 'di yin te/bye brag smra ba khyod kyi lugs la'ang las med par thal/ 'chi ba ni de dang mi mthun pa'i rkyen sogs du ma zhig 'dus pa'i steng nas 'jog dgos pas/gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan/ / zhes sogs ltar khyod kyis 'dod pa'i cha med kyi rdul phran yan gar ba lta bu'i don dam der ma grub pa'i phyir dang /yang mdo sde pa khyod kyi lugs la'ang las med par thal/ shi ba ni lus sems rten brten ba'i 'brel ba chad pa'i steng nas 'jog pas/ tshig sogs kun btags dngos med ni/zhes sogs ltar khyod kyis 'brel ba dngos med du khas 494

༄ / /zin byes sgos rde dgeblangs shing rang gi grub mtha' yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dag la dpyad dgos gsung / srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ de ltaraspyod pa'i/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / nyan rang gi 'jigs sred ltar 'khor ba la bden zhen gyes 'jigs nas skrag pa med pa dang / byang chub tu lung bstan pa la bden zhen gyis rlom sems med par spyod pa ni sher phyin la spyod pa yin zhes pa'i don no/ / zhing dag spyor ba ni snod bcud gnyis ka dag par sgrub pa yin la/ de'ang gser 'phreng las/ zhing spyong ba ni rang gi sems spyong ba yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs zhing dag pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin zhing / longs sku ni gnas 'og min kho nar bzhugs shing / bkres skom dang rdo ba tsher ma sogs kyi ming tsam yang mi 'byung ba'i zhing gi 'byor pa phun tshogs la longs spyod pa dang / mthun snang du'ang mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa'i sku'i rnam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur bas na zhing dag sbyor ba longs sku 'grub byed kyi rgyur bzhag sprul sku ni dag ma dag thams cad du gdul bya'i don mdzad pas de 'grub byed du ma bzhag pa yin la/ sngags kyi skabs su theg pa chen po'i chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i sgo nas longs skur bzhag pa yin gsung / zhing dag sbyor ba de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i 'tshe/'jig rten dgon pa'i zhes sogs blo ka gcig byung / spyir dgon pa ni grong las rgyang grags 'das pa dang / mya ngam gyi thang chu sogs med pa'i phyogs la 'jog tshul gnyis yod pa las 'di ni phyi ma ste/ de lta bu'i 'brog dgon bar mu gas mnar ba dang / nad kyis gdungs pa sogs mthong nas skrag pa med cing rang nyid sangs rgyas pa'i zhing du 'di lta bu'i ming tsam yang med par shog cig ces smon lam 'debs pa dang / snying rjes de dag gi nang du phyi ma'i mu 495

/ /mtharalang gnas pa la mi skyo bar rkyen ngan lam du 'khyer shes pa'i don no/bka' gdams pa rnams kyis rkyen ngan lam du 'khyer gsungs pa de sher phyin gyi mdo 'di dag nas gsungs pa 'di ka yin gyi gzhan gcig ma yin gsung / brgyad stong par shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gcan gzan gyi dgon pa'i nang du song na dngangs par mi bya/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ thabs mkhas sbyor ba ni/ yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni/ / zhes pa gnyis thabs mkhas sbyor ba bcu'i grangs la mi 'dren par spyi ldog la byed dgos shing / yul la bcu yod pas kha cig dran pa nyer bzhag sogs sde tshan bdun gyi steng du rnam thar sgo gsum bsnan nas bcu la byed pa dang / kha cig snyoms 'jug dgu'i steng du stobs ma 'dres pa sogs sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan bsnan pas bcur byed pa'ang yod gsung /rigs pa'i gnas lnga sogs dag ma dag gi gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi don mtha' dag sgrub tshul la mkhas pa ni yul dang / de ltar shes nas kyang rdzogs sminasbyangs gsum ma byas par bar ma dor yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i spyor ba ni snying rje'i lag rjes la 'ong zhing / rgyu mtshan des na thabs mkhas sbyor ba ni dag ma dag gi gdul bya'i don byed pa'i sprul sku 'grub byed kyi rgyu la bzhag pa yin gsung / thabs mkhas spyor ba spyi de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyal ba'i zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / gdod nas stong par shes kyang snying rje'i dbang gis gdul bya'i don la 'jug pas rang nyid zhi bde la zhugs nas gzhan don rgyun chad pa med pas sangs rgyas kyi chos las nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i don no/ / thabs mkhas sbyor ba bcu'i dang po bdud las 'das pa'i de yin la/ de'ang spyir bdud bzhi po de ni 'chi bdag gi bdud kyi nang du 'du ba yin te/ 'chi ba de la 496

༄/ /zinasagang du 'chi ba/ gang gis 'chi ba/ gang 'chi ba/ 'chi ba las mi 'da' b.rabyed pa bzhir byas nas/ nyer len gyi phung po zhig blang phyin chad der rang dbang med par 'chi bas gang du 'chi ba phung po'i bdud dang / las nyon gyi dbang gis srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar du 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor te rang dbang med par 'khyam par 'gyur bas gang gis 'chi ba nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / 'chi ba gang yin pa 'chi bdag gi bdud/ 'chi ba las mi 'da' bar byed pa'i rgyu lha'i bu'i bdud dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/'chi ba ni rgud pa spyi la byas na de las grol ba la 'chi ba med pa zhes bya ste/mdo las myang 'das thob pa la bdud rtsi brnyes/ zhes gsungs pa de/bdud rtsi'i skad dod a mṛ ta'i/ mṛ ta 'chi ba dang / a dgag tshig yin pas 'chi ba med pa brnyes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ dgra las 'das pa'i de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ dper na skyes bu/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum byung / gzhan phyogs pham par byed pa dang / rang phyogs bsrung ba'i thabs mkhas pa'i skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa zhig gis rang gi nye du rnams dgra'i phyogs su khrid de 'gro ba'i tshe lam skabs su yal bar mi 'dor bar bde ba'i gnas su skyel ba ltar/ byang chub sems dpas kyang sems can rnams 'khor ba'i gnas su yal bar mi 'dor bar bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal bar byed pa'i don no/ / gnyis pa mi gnas pa'i de 'chad par/ mkha' la rlung brten/ zhes sogs blo ka gnyis byung / nam mkha' la rlung dang chu dang gser gye dkyil 'khor gsum dang / de la 'gro ba rnams brten pa dang /mthar nam mkha' stong par 'jig pa bzhin du/ sems kyi chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu la tshul min yid byed kyi rlung dang / las nyon gyi chu dkyil ming gzugs kyi phung po'i sa dkyil chags pa dang / mthar rga na 'chi ba'i me 497

/gsum gyis chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu de'i ngang la zhig par 'gyur ba'i sems can gyi don byed cing / zhi bde la thugs mi gzhol yang bden zhen gyis gnas pa'ang min no/ / shugs kyis 'phangs pa'i de 'chad par/ gang gi tshe na'ang / zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / dper na bya gshog pa gnyis ldananam mkha' la 'phur ba der mi gnas pa dang / sa la mi ltung ba ltar/thabs shes gnyis dang ldan pa'i de bden zhen gyis mi gnas kyang / theg dman gyi sa la'ang mi ltung ngo / / thun mong ma yin pa'i de 'chad par/dper na 'phong bslab/ ces sogs blo ka gnyis byung / dper na 'phong bslab pa'i skyes bu'i mda' bzhin du rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' sngon du mi byed do/ / 'di dag la khyad par cung zad re ma gtogs don 'dra gsung / 'dzin pa med pa'i de 'chad par/ dper na dge slong zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / dper na dge slong rdzu 'phrul can gyis nam mkhar gnas bzhin du spyod lam bzhi ston pa ltar/ 'di stong par gnas pas 'gro ba'i don byed kyang / ngal dub med pa'i phyir ro / / mi dmigs pa'i de 'chad par/ dper na mi 'ga'/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / gdugs gnyis bzung ste mchongs na g.yang sar ltung bar mi 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ thabs shes gnyis kyi gdugs bzung bas theg dman gye g.yang sar ltung bar mi 'gyur ba'i don no/ / mtshan ma med pa'i de 'chad par/ dper na rin chen zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung /ded dpon bzhin du rang nyid zhi bde la dga' nas sems can sdug bsngal gyi gnas su mi 'jog pa'i don no/ / smon med kyi de 'chad par/ dper na don gnyer zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / tshong ba gzhan la lam rgyus ston par byed kyang mi gnas pa de bzhin du/ theg gsum gyi rtogs rigs kyi tshul thams cad shes 498

༄ /kyang de la mi gnas pa'i don ni/ / phyir mi ldog pa'i de dang / tshad med pa'i de gnyis 'chad par/ gang tshe 'gro la nas/ rig bya/ skabs bzhi pa'o/ / zhes pa'i blo ka gsum byung / gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa sogs mi shes pa dang / shes kyang de la stong pa nyid ston par mi byed na phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags ma thob pa yin zhes ldog phyogs sgos tshad med pa'i de dang /de ltar shes shing blo dang 'tsham par ston pa la mkhas pa ni phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa yin zhes mi ldog pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i de bstan pa yin gsung ngo / /nyams len sbyor bzhi la dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras dang brtan pa rgyu 'bras gnyis yod pas/ dbang du byed pa'i rgyu rnam rdzogs spyor ba bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa 'bras bu rtse sbyor 'chad pa la/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa thob pa la/ zhes sogs byung / de'ang mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa thos bsam gyis gtan la phab ste sgom byung gis nyams su blangs pa de thor bu thor bur 'brel med lta bur ma song bar gcig grogs su gcig 'gro bar byas te mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam pa dang / bden pa bzhi'i 'jug ldog gi sgo nas rnam pa ma lus pa rdzogs par sgom bas togs pa gong 'phel du song ba'i rab gyi mthar phyin pa'am rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa 'byung bas na de'i 'og tu rtse sbyor bshad la/ rtse sbyor la'ang sbyor mthong sgom gsum dang bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang bzhi yod pa'i dang po la'ang drod rtse bzod mchog gi rtse sbyor bzhi las/ dang po drod rtse sbyor ni/ rtags sngon du bshad nas de'i rjes su rtse sbyor rang gi ngo bo ston pa min yang gdul byas go sla bas rtags de dang de 'byung ba'i rtags can rtse sbyor rang gi ngo bo mtshon nas 'phangs pa yin gsung / drod rtse spyor la rtags bcu gnyis yod la/ rnam 4khu

/ /bshad ltar na dang po lnga mi lam dang / de nas gnyis sad rmi gnyis ka dang /de nas lnga sad pa'i skabs dang sbyar la budha shrīs dang po drug rmi lam dang /de nas gnyis sad rmi gnyis ka dang / de nas bzhi sad pa'i skabs la sbyar/mdo las dang po drug rmi lam dang / bdun pa sad rmi gnyis ka dang sbyar la lhagam la khyad par ma sbyar ro/ / nyin par chos thams cad ming gis phar btags tsam ma gtogs rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang med par goms pas/ rmi lam na'ang chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur blta zhing bden zhen drag po mi 'byung ba ste 'di ni shes rab kyi rtogs pa brtan pa'i lag rjes dang /nyin par yang thabs la goms pas rmi lam na'ang dman pa'i yid byed mi 'byung ba ste 'di ni thabs kyi togs pa brtan pa'i rtags yin la/ rmi lam du yang 'chal khrims dri ma spangs/ / zhes sogs ltar/ theg chen gyi tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs kyi gtso bo dman pa'i yid byed la 'jog dgos shing /thabs shes kyi rtags gnyis gtso bo yin gsung / skyabs kyi ngo bo la yid ches brtan pas rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor brgya stong gis bskor ba mthong ba dang / skyabs kyi yon tan la yid ches brtan pas rmi lam na sangs rgyas de dag gis rang la chos ston pa mthong ba dang / snying rje goms pas rmi lam na gzhan sdug bsngal las bsgral ba'i chos ston pa dang / rmi lam na dmyal ba sogs mthong bas mi skrag cing rang sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'di lta bu'i ming tsam yang mi grags par shog cig ces smon lam 'debs shing sad pa'i tshe na rjes su dran te/ snod bcud dag pa'i rgyu la 'bad pa'o/ / rtags gnyis pa thabs kyi rtogs pa brtan pa'i de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ dgra bcom pa dag / ces sogs rkang pa gnyis byung /nyan thos dgra bcom dang rkyen rtogs rang rgyal gyi sa la rmi lam du 'dod pa mi 5

sa / /zig byes༄khang zla stegobaskyed na khams gsum gyi yon tan lta ci smos zhes pa'i don no/ / sangs rgyas mthong ba'i de dang chos ston pa'i de gnyis 'chad par/ sangs rgyas rnams mthong zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis byung / ngan song spong ba rjes su dran pa'i de 'chad par/ rmi lam ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis byung / rtags dang po brgyad ni/ brgyad stong par 'chad pa'i tshe/ rab 'byor yang gal tekhyang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rmi lam gyi nang na yang chos thams cad rmi lamalta bur yang dag par lta zhing / zhes pa nas/ le'u nyi shu pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyas par bstan la/ 'dir rang la 'khor brgya stong gis bskor ba sogs 'grel chen las sngar ltar bshad gsung / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mi 'phrog pa'o/ / zhes pa yan chad kyis thabs mkhas spyor ba rdzogs kyang thabs mkhas kyi le'u'i bar du rtags 'di dag bshad 'dug pas mtshams 'byed dka' bar snang yang 'dir skabs bzhi pa dang lnga pa gnyis kyi mtshams so sor phye ste gsal bar bshad pas 'di 'dra re'i steng nas sbas don gsal bar byas tshul 'jog dgos gsung /grong khyer mes tshig pa bden tshig brjod ma thag zhi bar byed pa'i de dang /gnod sbyin sogs kyis gzhan gyi yid brlam par byas te gnod pa byed pa bden tshig brjod ma thag zhi bar byed pa ste/ phyed ma las ma zhi ba ni byang sems rang nyid kyi sngon gyi chos spong gi las kyi lhag ma lus pa'i rnam smin du brgyad stong par gsungs la/ nyi khri las yul mi dge ba'i mthong chos kyi las kyi rnam smin du gsungs kyang gang zag gnyis ga'i las kyi rnam smin gyi cha yod pas mdo gnyis ka sgra ji bzhin du khas blangs chog gsung / snga ma sems can ma yin pa'i 'byung ba dang / phyi ma sems can gyi gnod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gsung / de gnyis sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ bden pa'i byin gyis 501

/ /zhes sogs blo ka phyed dang gnyis byung / de ltar zhi ba la'ang phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags yin min gyi mu bzhi yod de/ nga rgyal dang rlom sems med par zhi ba de phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags yin la/ bdud kyi mthus zhi ba de min pa dang /cha 'ga' re zhi/ cha 'ga' re ma zhi ba ni gnyis ka yin pa dang / ldog pa ni gnyisaka min pa'o/ / grong khyer mes tshig pa zhi ba dang gnod pa rtags de gnyis las 'phros nas mi ldog pa'i rtags ma yin pa de sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ci ste de ni/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka brgyad byung / de'ang de ltar bden tshig gis zhi ba'i tshe bdag lung bstan par 'dug snyam du rlom sems byed cing byang sems gzhan la brnyas par byed na de bdud kyi las su shes par bya ba sh+lau ka dang po'i don no/ / de 'dra'i byang sems la bdud kyis kyang glags rnyed par shes nas byang sems de'i pha ma sogs bdun brgyud tshun chad dang skye ba snga ma sogs kyi ming lung bstan nas yid ches par byas te/ ma 'ongs pa na'ang khyod sangs rgyas pa'i ming 'di yin zhes brjod pa'i tshe 'das pa'i de dag bden pas ma 'ongs pa lung bstan pa'ang bden par 'dug snyam du rlom par byed pa de ni bdud kyis bslad pa dang blo gros chung bar rig par bya'o/ /zhes pa ni sh+lau ka gnyis pa'i don no/ / spyir dben pa la phyi 'du 'dzi las dpen pa dang / nang rnam g.yeng gis dben pa gnyis yod pa'i nang nas/byang sems la theg chen las g.yeng bar byed pa'i dman pa'i yid byed kyis dben pa de gtso bo yin pas de med par nags khrod na gnas pa de grong na gnas pa'i byang sems gzhan la smod par byed pa ni bdud kyis bslad pa yin la / grong na gnas kyang dman pa'i yid byed dang ma 'dres par sems can smin par byed pa ni rgyal sras kyi dben par gsungs pa dang / rdza ri mthon por gcig pur nga rgyal gyis gnas kyang dman pa'i yid byed dang 502

das / /13 rte/skyesa'adres par gnas pa dang / 'gro don brtson pa'i byang sems gzhan la brnyas par byed pa de la rgyal ba mi dgyes par ma zad smad pa'i gnas su gsungs pa ni sh+lau ka bzhi pa'i don no/ / 'o na gcig pur bsdad pa de dben pa min na dben pa ni gang zhe na/ grong ngam dgon par gnas kyang rung dman pa'i yid byed dang ma 'dres par 'gro don byed pa de ni rgyal bas bsngags pa'i dbon par gnas pa yin gsungs pa ni blo ka gcig gi don no/rtags bdun brgyad gnyis kyi 'phros don de nyid brgyad stong par 'chad pa'i tshe/ rab 'byor yang de la byang chub sems dpa' chen po tshig 'di skad du smra bar 'gyur te/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis zhes pa nas/bdud kyi las kyi le'u zhes bya ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyes 'chad/dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i de sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ de lta bas na/zhes sogs blo ka gnyis byung / de ltar rtags dang rtags ma yin pa'i mtshams rang stobs kyis nges par 'byed mi nus pas g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya'o/ / bshes gnyen de'i yon tan ji lta bu zhe na/ rang nyid la yon tan thams cad brnyes pa'i bshes gnyen ni phyi'i yongs 'dzin dang / thabs shes khyad par can gnyis tshang ba'i phar phyin ni nang gi yongs 'dzin gyi dbang du byas la/ 'byung po dpag med 'jigs par byed/ / tses sogs ltar/ dpal 'byor thams cad sa la brten nas 'byungab bzhin du/ chos dang chos ma yin pa ston par byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen las 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'byung zhing / nang gi yongs 'dzin gyes srid zhi'i mtha' bkag ste mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su 'khrid par byed do/ / brgyad stong pa las/bam po bcu dgu pa/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas/ dang po 503

/ /nyid du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten par bya gus par bya/ zhes sogs kyis bshad/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni ston pa'o lam mo zhes pa spyor lam drod dang / snang ba'o sgron ma'o/ / 'od do zhes pa gsum ni snang ba mched pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs gsum dang / pha rol tu phyin pa skyob pa'o zhes sogs drug ni rim bzhin sa drug dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni pha'o/ /zhes pa dang rtogs pa dang sogs bzhi ni sa bdun pa sogs bzhi la spyor zhing /de'ang lam mkhan gyis khrid de bgrod byed dngos ni rang gi rkang pa yin pa ltar/phyi'i yongs 'dzin gyis lam bstan te thabs shes khyad par can gyi nang gi yongs 'dzin gyis sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod pa yin gsung / sher phyin la slob pa'i rtags de sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba 'das dang / zhes sogs blo ka gcig byung / sgron ma dang snang ba sogs brgyad stong bar bshes gnyen gyi mjug tu sbyar zhing sdud par 'di la sbyar 'dug pa 'gyur gyi khyad cig yin nam gsung / don ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams sher phyin la brten nas byung ba'o/ / brgyad stong par de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nas/ rab 'byor 'das pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa zhes sogs kyis 'chad/mngon par zhen pa med pa'i rtags de sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ de ltar shes rab pha rol zhes sogs sh+lau ka bzhi byung / don ni dug ma zos kyang zos par 'dug snyam du bden par bzung nas skran zhugs pa'i lo rgyus ltar/ bdag med bzhin du bdag dang bdag gir bzung ste las bsags te nyon mongs pa'am sdug bsngal 'byung bar 'gyur bas bdag dang bdag gi bar lta mi rung zhing mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas sher phyin la bslab par bya'o/ / de ltar na phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dgu dngos su tshig zin la bstan pa yin gsung / mngon zhen med pa'i rtags las brgyad stong pa las/ rab 'byor gyis gsol ba/5la

༄/ /zinasabacom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid gang lags zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ byang chub nye ba'i de bcom ldan 'das nas 'jig rten gyis mi brdzi bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyis 'chad gsung / rtse mo'i rtse sbyor ni rnam 'phel bcu drug gi sgo nas bshad pa yin la/ de'ang don bsdus sgron mer rtse mo'i rtse spyor rnam 'phel bcu drug po yin pas bcu drug gcig car skye bar bshad pa mi 'thad do/ / rang lugs la rnam 'phel bcu drug po sbyor lam rtse sbyor gong 'phel du song ba'i gnas skabs la 'jog pas snga phyir skye ba yin la/ 'grel pa 'dir yang gong nas gong du khyad par du 'phags pa zhes sogs kyis kyang rim can du skye bar 'grub gsung / rnam 'phel dang po sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ 'dzam bu'i gling na zhes sogs blo ka bzhi byung / burto shrī'ildud 'grel ltar/ 'jug par bya yan chad kyi sh+lau ka dang po gnyis kyis rnam 'phel dang po dang / de nas sh+lau ka gnyis kyis gnyis pa dang / yang gnyis kyis rnam 'phel gsum pa bstan par 'dod la/ 'dzam gling sogs stong gsum gyi sems can gyes sangs rgyas la mchod pa bas sher phyin la brtson pa bsod nams che ba sh+lau ka dang po gnyis kyi don dang / sher phyin gcig pus chog gam zhe na/ gzhan sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rjes zin par byas te thabs shes tshang bar slob dgos pa ni sh+lau ka phyi ma gnyis kyi don no/ / 'dzam bu'i gling na zhes sogs kyi don brgyad stong par/ rab 'byor yang gal te 'dzam bu'i gling na zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ snying rje chen po zhes sogs kyi don/ de'i snying rje chen po zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ lha mi ngan song gsum gyi zhes sogs kyi don/ dal ba chudagazon pa dag / ces sogs kyis 'chad gsung / sher phyin yid la byed pa'i de sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ mi zhig sngon chad ces sogs sh+lau ka 505

/ /gnyis byung / dbul po zhig gis yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnyed dka' bar gyur pa de rnyed ma thag bor na sdug bsngal zhing rnyed rgyu zhig e yod snyam pa las gzhan bsam rgyu med pa bzhin sher phyin min pa bsam rgyu med pa'i don no/brgyad stong par/ de ci'i phyir zhe na nas/ dper na nor bu rin po che zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa sogs kyis rnam 'phel gsum bsdoms te sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ nyi ma sprin dang bral ba'i zhes sogs blo ka gnyis byung / de'ang stong pa dang ni mtshan ma med spyod pa/zhes pas/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs par nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa'i de dang / byang chub dang chub byed mi dmigs pa'i rnam 'phel gnyis bstan la/ dgra bcom rang rgyal byang chub sems mang zil gyis gnon/ zhes pas khyad par 'phags pa'i de bstan te/ thabs shes tshang bar sgom pa'i byang sems 'dis sbyin sogs 'khor gsum mi dmigs par nyams su blangs pa las sgrib pa thams cad bcom ste mi gnas pa'i myang 'das thob par 'gyur bas na rtags dang lta bas ma zin pa'i phar phyin dang po lnga la slob pa'i byang sems rnams zil gyis gnon par gsungs pa'i phyir/ brgyad stong bar/rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pas na nas/ gang yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i bdag po chen po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba de dag thams cad zil gyis gnon cing /zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ rnam 'phel drug pa lha'i ris thams cad nye bar 'ong ba'i de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ dper na rgyal po'i bu zhig /ces sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / don ni rgyal po'i bu zhig chung ngu'i dus na'ang nor thams cad gtong bar 'dod na rgyal srid la mnga' gsol ba'i tshe smos ci 506

das / / ba//sadagos zhes thams cad dga' ba ltar/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dis kyang da lta nas sems can gyi phan bde sgrub cing don byed na sangs rgyas ma'i tshe lta ci smos snyam du dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams dga' bar 'gyur zhing /rgyal po chen po bzhi sogs 'ong nas de la bsrung bar 'gyur ba yin gsung /brgyad stong par de ci'i phyir zhe na nas 'jig rten skyong ba rgyal po chen po bzhi 'ong nas zhes pa nas/ brgya byin gye le'u zhes bya ste nyi shu gsum pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyis bshad gsung / bdud thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i de dang / ston pa dang 'dra bar skye bo la mtshungs par gnas pa'i 'di sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ de yi tshe na zhes sogs sh+lau ka drug byung / de'ang sh+lau ka dang po'i don ni/ de'i tshe bdud kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni bdag gi yul las 'da' bar 'gyur zhing / der ma zad 'di sangs rgyas nas sems can mang po yang 'da' bar byed pas bdag gi yul stong bar 'gyur snyam du the tshom za zhing 'jigs pa ston phyir phyogs su skar mda' gtong ba sogs nyer 'tshe du ma zhig sgrub par byed ces pa'o/ / yid nur 'gyur zhes pa'i yid yarabacad de/ nur 'gyur zhes pa nem nur ram the tshom za ba'i don yin gsung / bdud kyis de ltar byas kyang glags mi rnyed pa'i byang sems de gang zhe na/ gang tshe mkhas pa zhes sogs blo ka gcig gis 'chad/ de'ang dper na gshog pa gnyis ldan gyi bya ni sa'i tsher ma sogs la mi reg par mkha' la 'gro ba ltar/ thabs shes gnyis tshang ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ni bdud kyi nyes pa de dag la chags thogs med par 'gro ba yin la/ bden par zhen pas nyes na de dag gis reg pa yin gsung / 'o na glags rnyed pa'i byang sems de gang zhe na/ gang tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyis 'chad/ de'ang byang sems nang phan tshun khros te thog mar 507

/ /ngagagis mtshang 'bru ba lus kyis phan tshun rdeg pa sogs byed pa'i 'thab mo dang / rgyal po'i drung du zhal lce gcod pa tshun chad la thug pa'i rtsod pa ste/de ltar byang sems mi mthun par gyur pa de sangs rgyas kyi ye shes las ring bar 'gyur ba dang / sha za dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba dang / bdud kyi phyogs rnams dga' bar 'gyur la/ de'ang sha za ni gzhan la gnod 'tshe 'ba' zhigabyed pa yin la/ byang sems de dag kyang sems can la phan bde sgrub pa'i dam bca' las nyams pas sha za dang 'dra ba yin gsung / 'o na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes las ring tshul dang bdud kyi glags rnyed tshul ji ltar zhe na/lung bstan ma thob byang chub/ ces sogs blo ka gcig gis bshad/ khro sems kyi grangs kyis dmyal bar gnas dgos pa dang / lam la gzhi na sa slob dgos pa sogs yig cha nas gsal bar gsungs pa ltar yin la/ tha ba ni lo tog skye mi rung ba'i zhing la tha ba zer ba ltar theg pa chen po'i yon tan sems rgyud la skye mi rung bar byas pa de la tha ba skyon ldan zer gsung snyam/de dag spong tshul ji lta bu yin zhe na sangs rgyas bzod pa'i zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis 'chad/ bdud kyi bar chad de dag shes nas spong bar byed dgos te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang bzod pa'i phar phyin bsgoms nas bla med byang chub la reg pa'i phyir ro/ / 'di dang phyi mar mi 'dod pa thams cad kyi sna drangs te 'ongs pas na khro ba'i sems 'di ni bzang po min snyam du dran shes bzhin gyis bya ra byas te sngar byung ngam ma byung / byung bar 'dug na 'gyod sems drag po dang / phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam du sdom sems byed la/ bag chags ngan pa'i dbang gis byung na'ang dga' bar mi byed pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos 'dir slob pa yin gsung / sems can thams cad drin can gye mar gyur tshul dang sangs rgyas dang sems can 508

ra rdo / /13 de ste gnyis ka tshogs rdzogs pa'i zhing yin par 'dra bas na rgyu mtshan de gnyis kyi sgo nasabyang sems nang phan tshun la khro mi rigs par ma zad sems can thams cad la dge ba'i bshes gnyen du lta dgos par gsungs pas na rkang pa tha ma gsum gyis rnam 'phel brgyad pa'ang bstan pa yin gsung / 'dir jo bo rje bod du byon dus bzod pa sgom pa'i rten la a tsa ra spo can khyer 'ong ba'i lo rgyus sogs rgyas par gsungs/ brgyad stong bar/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa/ bam po nyi shu pa/ de nas yang nas/ nga rgyal gye le'u zhes bya ste nyi shu bzhi pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis rnam 'phel bdun pa dang brgyad pa gnyis so sor bstan gsung / bdag gi cha ma yin no zhes pa ni bdag gi ngang tshul ma yin no zhes pa'i don yin gsung / sangs rgyas kyi rigs can du gyur pa dang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi de gnyis sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ gang zhig slob tshe zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / tha snyad du stobs mi 'jigs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la slob kyang don dam par gang yang khas mi len pa'i don no/ / sangs rgyas kyi rigs can du 'gyur ba'i de brgyad stong par/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nas/ sangs rgyas kyis sa la slob po/ stobs dga'i slob bo/ mi 'jigs pa dag la slob bo/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad dam snyam sangs rgyas thob pa la don dam par med kyang tha snyad du de dag thams cad la slob dgos par gsungs pa yin no/ sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gye de 'chad par/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na sa chen po'i sa phyogs nas gser sa le sbram dngul dag 'byung ba de lta bu ni nyung gi zhes sogs kyis bshad/ ba tshwa sogs 'byung ba'i phyogs mang la gser sogs 'byung ba'i phyogs nyung ba ltar/ theg chen gyi rigs can nyung la theg dman 58

rirdo / brgagyi rigs can sogs mang bar gsungs pa yin no/ / mi mthun pa'i sems mi skye ba'i de sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig ces sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / nyi ma'i 'od kyis non pa'i bar snang la mun pa mi gnas pa bzhin du/ phyin drug la de ltar slob pas tshul 'chal sogs mi mthun phyogs thams cad zil gyis gnon cing mi mthun phyogs kyi sems skad cig tsam yang mi skye ba'i don no/ / brgyad stong par rab 'byor gzhan yang /nas/ tha ba dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye zhes sogs kyis bshad/ gzugs sogs dang ldan par rtog pa'i sems mi skye ba'i de dang / phar phyin sdud pa'i de gnyis sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ shes rab pha rol phyin la zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / gsung rab la grags pa'i dpe 'jig lta'i nang du lta ngan re gnyis 'du ba dang / 'jig rten la grags pa'i dpe srog gnas na dbang po gzhan 'dus pa ltar/gzugs sogs la mi dmigs par slob pa'i sher phyin nang du nyams len thams cad 'dus pa'i don no/ / brgyad stong par/rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad nang du 'dus par 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyi bar gyis gzugs sogs dang ldan par mi rtog pa'i de 'chad/'di lta ste dper na 'jig tshogs la lta zhes sogs kyis phar phyin sdud pa'i de 'chad gsung / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i de dang / byang chub nye ba'i de gnyis 'chad par/ byang chub sems mkhas zhes sogs blo ka gcig byung / byang sems kyis theg gsum gye rtogs rigs thams cad ma tshang ba med par slob kyang de dag gi 'bras bu thob phyir dang / ngoms chos lta bu ma yin par theg pa chen po'i lam gyi yan lag tu sgom pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas byang chub la nye bar 'gyur ba'i don no/ / brgyad stong par/510
