sa / /zin byes ltar 11gagorab 'byor de lta bas na/ nas rnam par rol zhes pa'i bar gyis byang chub nye ba'i rnam 'phel de bstan pa yin gsung / bzod pa dang chos mchog rtse sbyor gnyis thabs shes kyi rtogs pa brtan po dang / sems kun gnas gnyis kyis rim bzhin mtshon te ston pas dang po ni/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams zhes sogs rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis shes rab dang phyi ma gnyis kyis thabs kyi cha bstan pa yin pas/ srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod byed dngos rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes thob kyang srid pa las grol ba tsam lhur mi len par yun ring gnas pa de snying rje chen po'i dbang gis yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam par mi rtog pa thob pa'i gnas skabs na zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pa la de 'dra zhig 'ong gsung / de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ mi ldog byang chub/ ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / rjes su yi rang gis de'i yul thabs shes kyi rtogs pa brtan po mtshon par bstan pas sbas don yin gsung / sems kun gnas de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ dge ba don gnyer zhes sogs blo ka gcig byung / byang sems kyi rjes su yi rang gis sems can thams cad kyi dgertsa thams cad sdud par byed pa'i don la tshegs med pa dam pa'ang 'di 'dra zhig gi steng nas 'jog/ 'di burto shrīs sems kun gnas la sbyar zhing brgyad stong par/ brgya byin gyes yi rang gi bsod nams dris pa'i lan du sems kun gnas gsungs pas 'di gnyis mdo tshan gcig yin pas mi 'gal lam gsung / spang bya rtog pa ma bshad na de'i gnyen po rtogs par mi nus pas 'jug pa gzung rtog dgu ni spyi dang khyad par gyi dbang du byas pa gnyis las/ phyi ma ni rgyu lam 'bras bu gsum gyi sgo nas bstan la/ de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs blo ka gcig byung / rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum la rnam thar sgo gsum 'jog tshul yang yod pas 511

/ /de'i sgo nas bstan pa yin la/ shes rab gnyis kyi zhes sbrel mi rung bas/shes rab kyis bden grub bam/ gnyis snang gi tshul gyis byang chub 'tshol bar mi byed ces pa'i don yin gsung / ldog pa gzung rtog dgu la rgyu'i sgo nas lnga dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas bzhi bstan pas/ de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ nam mkha'i khams de zhes sogs kyi blo ka gcig byung / 'gal ba zhes pa de la 'grel pa dag tu phan tshun spangs te 'gal ba zhes 'byung mod kyang / nam mkha' de thogs reg bcad tsam du gnas kyi gzugs can gzhan la gegs mi byed pa ltar/ dman lam de zeg chen la ltos te tha snyad du ldog byar rung yang don dam par de gnyis gnod bya gnod byed du mi rung ba'i don yin nam snyam gsung / dmigs yul de dag kyang gser 'phreng nas gsungs pa ltar gdul bya nye ba'i bsam pas yin gyi bden gnyis dang bden bzhi lta bu'i dbang du byas te bzhag pa'i nges pa med kyang theg chen gyi lam tsha tshang re khong na len rgyu yod gsung / so skye la bden grub tu snang ba shas che ba dang / 'phags pa la sgyu ma lta bur snang ba gtso che bas rdzas 'dzin so skye dang / btags 'dzin 'phags pa'i rten du gsungs pa yin gyi/mtha' gcig tu khyab mtha' byas nas 'jog dka' gsung / rdzas 'dzin dgu bstan pa de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe skye bo'i dbus na/ zhes sogs blo ka gnyis byung / sgyu ma'i rta glang sogs don lam grub kyang spyod lam bzhi sogs kyi bya byed bsnyon med du snang ba ltar don dam par med kyang tha snyad du bya byed thams cad rung bar bstan pa'i ldog phyogs nas rdzas 'dzin bstan pa yinagasung / btags 'dzin dgu bstan pa de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/dper na sangs rgyas zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / 'dir snga ma gnyis la khyad par cher med kyang mdo las skabs la lar gnyen po dang la lar spang bya'i 512

༄/ /zin sgo nas bstan pa de bstan bcos kyis mdo'i mtshams so sor phye nas gsungs pa ni sbas don gsal bar byas tshul yin gsung / de las 'phros te byang sems kyis de ltar nyams su blang ba'i phan yon de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/de ltar spyod mkhas zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum byung / rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis lha rnams kyis bkur ste dang / de nas gnyis kyis sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa brjod tshul dang / blo ka phyi ma gnyis kyis bdud kyis mi tshugs par bstan pa yin la/ de'ang bdud bzhi'i dang po lha'i bu'i bdud kyis mi tshugs tshul/gaṅgā'i klung mnyam gyi sems can rnams bdud du gyur cing de dag gi ba spu'i khung bu re rer yang snga ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa sprul kyang mi tshugs la/ der ma zad bdud bzhi gang gis kyang thub par dka' ste/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis dgongs pa'i phyir ro/ / sdud pa'i tshig 'di yan chad kyis brgyad stong pa'i le'u nyer drug pa rdzogs pa yin gsung / de ltar spang bya rnam rtog bshad nas de'i gnyen po mthong lam ston pa la mthong lam de rgyu gang gi stobs kyis 'thob ce na byang chub chen po de'i rgyu ni rang gis gdul bya gzhan rtogs pa'i chos 'bras bu mthong lam la 'god cing ston pa dang de'i rgyu lung gi chos la 'god pa ste gzhan rgyud spyong ba dang gnyis dang / rang nyid kyis mnyam bzhag tu sgom pa sogs kyis rang rgyud sbyong ba gcig ste gsum yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir ston pa zhes pa gzhan la chos ston pa la byas na lung gi chos la 'god pa dang zlos par 'gyur la/ 'di la gser 'phreng las lung ston pa zhes gsungs pa dang / 'di dag gi bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo brgyad stong pa'i le'u nyer bdun pa me tog sil ma'am me tog bkram pa zhes bya ba'i le'ur mthong lam thob pa'i dge slong drug stong ma 'ongs par me tog bkram pa zhes bya bar ming mthun par sangs rgyas te bskal pa skar 513

ra /shā am lta bur 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i phyir na/ lung ston pa la sbyor ba nyid 'thad par mngon gsung / mthong lam gyi rgyu de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/de bzhin gshegs yum/ zhes sogs blo ka drug byung / sher phyin 'di la byang chub sems dpa' rang gis mos par byed cing bsam pa thag pas gzhan la ston par byed pa ni thabs shes ya ma bral ba yin pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la zhugs par rig par bya zhes pa'i don no/ / chu ni chos nyid kyi dpe nya chu la gnas pa ni byang sems chos nyid la gnas pa'i dpe dang nya chur gnas kyang 'tshub ste mi 'chi ba ltar byang sems kyis chos nyid khong du chud kyang mngon du byas te zhi bdes thugs phrogs nas gzhan don las nyams par 'gyur ba mi srid pa'i don yin gsung / chos kyi dbyings zhes sogs kyi rkang pa gnyis po dbus mtha'i lung yin la/ spyir nam mkha' gzugs su grub na chos gzhan la go (mi) 'byed pa dang / thogs reg bcad tsam yin pas gzugs can gzhan la gegs mi byed pa bzhin du/ grub mtha' rang rang gi lugs kyi dgag bya de grub na bcing grol sogs mi rung ba dang / dgag bya bcad tsam gye chos dbyings der bya byed thams cad 'jog thub pa tsam zhig grub mtha' spyi'i thun mong du 'dod kyang dgag bya'i phra rags kyi dbang gis nang gses kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba yin gsung / de ltar rgyu gsum gyis dri ma zad pa'i 'bras bu byang chen 'thob pa mi 'thad de/ spang bya rtog pa rnams don dam par rtog pas btags tsam yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ spang bya bden par ma grub pa'i stobs kyes gnyen po'ang blos bcos nas bsgoms pas dri ma zad pa'i byang chub chen po 'thad pa yin te/ spang bya bden 'dzin gye 'dzin tshul phyin ci log yin pas rgyab rten med la/ gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi 'dzin tshul don steng du grub pa'i rgyab rten tshad ma yod pa'i phyir/514

༄/ /zin sasbagadobaden mi bden gnyis las gang bden pa'am don la gnas pa de mthar rgyal bar 'gyur ba chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar min par dri ma zad skye bden par grub na spang gnyen gyi rnam bzhag de dag mi 'thad de/ de dag gi gzhi med pa'i phyir te/ rtsa shes las/ sngon byung da lta med ces pa/ /des na chad par thal par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar bden par grub na dri ma zad skye dri ma'i gnas lugs yin dgos la de ltar na rgyu rkyen la mi ltos par rtag tu skye ba dang / gnyen po la mi ltos par 'khor ba thog med nas zad par 'gyur bas rtag chad gnyis ga'i mthar ltung bar 'gyur ba'i don yin sung / des rigs pa dang 'gal ba bstan nas/ khas blang dang 'gal ba ni / chos thams cad bden par grub pa dang / ston pas shes sgrib spangs par khas blang pa gnyis 'gal 'du yin te/ dngos po don dam par grub na spang bya rnam rtog gi zhen yul don du grub pas de sun phyung ste spong mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ / 'di'i phyogs lnga'i gtso bo don smra sde pa yin gsung /'dir bdag med gsum bstan pa ni lta ba 'og mar blo sbyong ste gong mar 'khrid pa'i rim pa yin la/ rnam bshad snying po rgyan dang dgongs pa rab gsal gnyis gar/ sngon po sdo snang shes pa las rdzas tha dad khegs nas/ sdo snang shes pa sngon po las rdzas tha dad pa'i gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan ma khegs pa'i gang zag gi rim pa mi 'thad la/ zhes sogs dang / su dbang po rtul yang zhes sogs mthun par gsungs pas rnal 'byor gyis bzhir byed pa dpyod pa'i gnas yin la/ 'on kyang gzung 'dzin khegs pa'i rim pa gnyis gsungs pa ni/ gser 'phreng las rnam bden rdzun gyi khyad par la sbyar zhing /mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob kyi nges pa 'dren tshul la sbyar na'ang rung gsung /'di la kun btus las rjes bzod bzhi shes pa'i yul can du bshad pa sogs 515

/ /kyis dgag bya bkag shul du sems gsal rig gi cha lhag mar lus par bsam nas lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags kyis bsgrub bya la gzung 'dzin rdzas tha dad du grub pa 'jog pa mi 'thad de/ rtsa ba'i gzhung mdo sde dgongs 'grel las ngo bo nyid de kho na'i ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa nyid/ ces med dgag dgos par gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / 'dir gnyis stong dang bden med sgrub byed kyi rigs pa'i gtso bo lhan cig dmigs nges gcig tu bral mtha' bzhi skye 'gag sogs bstan pa yin la/ gnyen po dngos shes rab yin pas/ mthong lam mnyam gzhag tu de rkyang ba'i chog gam snyam pa'i log rtog bsal ba'i ched du phar phyin re re'i nang du drug drug tshang bar nyams su len pa'i drug tshan drug gi mthong rtse bstan pa yin gsung / mthong lam gyi ngo bo de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ bslab pa 'di ni zhes sogs sh+lau ka bzhi byung / sa la rtsi shing nags tshal sogs skye yang sa la zad pa sogs med pa ltar tha snyad du blang dor thams cad rung yang don dam par zad pa dang 'phel ba med pa'i don no/ / mnyam gzhag tu stong nyid bsgom pa tsam gyis mi chog par rjes thob tu'ang rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung ldog sogs la 'dris par byed dgos pas/ de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/sems can tha ma zhes sogs blo ka gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis byung / blo ka dang pos rgyu ma rig pa dang / rkyen las dang sred len sogs tshogs pa las sdug bsngal gyi nyon mongs 'phangs 'bras phyed bdun sogs 'byung ba'i kun nyon phyogs kyi rten 'brel dang / blo ka gnyis pas bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis gzhi byas te rkyen tshogs nas ma rig pa 'gag pas 'khor bar 'phen byed kyi las mi bsogs la/ de ma bsags pas sdug bsngal gyi 'khrul 'khor mi 'byung zhing / ye shes kyi 'khrul 'khor 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rnam byang gi 516

ra pa / /sbyo cad gri (11sarten 'brel dang / de nas rkang pa gnyis kyis kun byang gi rten 'brel gyi rim pa tha snyad du de ltar rung yang don dam par zad skye med par bstan to/ /'di dag burtse shrī'i sdud 'grel du byang chen la sbyar zhing / rten 'brel la sbyor ba slob dpon gyi sdud 'grel gyi tshig la mi gsal yang gsung gi bab la sbyar chog pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug gsung / sbyor mthong sgom gsum dang bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor bzhi las dang po gnyis bshad zin nas sgom lam rtse sbyor ni mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi skabs su spang bya rtog pa sngon la bshad nas spong byed gnyen po rjes su bshad pa dang / sgom lam du spong byed gnyen po sngon la bshad nas spang bya rtog pa rjes su bshad pa ni re re'i'ang spang gnyen gnyis ka mtshon pa'i ched yin gsung / sgom lam la dbye ba mang po yod kyang 'dir thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug tsam mtshan gzhir bstan pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong ba'i ched yin la / de'ang byang sems kyis sprul bsgyur sogs kyi sgo nas gzhan don mtha' yas pa byed pa la ting nge 'dzin 'di dag la gang 'dod 'dod du snyoms par 'jug thub pa zhig dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin gsung /spyor ba gnyis dang dngos gzhi gsum ste lnga gsungs pa'i sbyor ba gnyis kyang thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin yin la/ rtsa ba'i tshig zin la gcig dang gnyis gsum nas 'gog pa'i bar du zhes bsam gtan dang po nas yar brtsis pa lta bur 'dug kyang / de ltar byas na grangs kyang mi 'grigs pas dang por 'gog pa gcig bu bor nas srid rtse la zhugs/ de nas 'dod sems la dang /de nas 'gog pa dang srid rtse gnyis bor nas ci yang med la 'jug pa sogs gong nas mar rtsi dgos pa yin gsung / 'gog snyoms shin tu phra ba dang 'dod sems shin tu rags pa la dang por ldang mi nus pas 'gog pa nas srid rtser bab ste phyi nur cung zad byas pa na 'dod pa la je nyer song ba dang 'dod 517

/ /sems la ldang ba la srid rtse'i nur chung zer ro/ / mngon pa nas srid rtse dang 'dod pa gnyis ring pa rnam pa bzhis ring bar bshad kyang skabs gzhan yin pas mi gnod par 'grel chen nas bshad gsung / de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ nyi ma sprin med/ ces sogs blo ka gsum dang rkang pa gnyis byung /byang sems kyis bsam gzugs brgyad thob kyang rgyu stoms 'jug gi yan lag rnams zad pas bsam gzugs de dag gis khams gong mar skye ba'i rgyu'am rten mi byed parwa ma zad de dag ldan bzhin du 'dod par gzhan don du skye ba dang / zag pa tsam zad pa'i phyir du'ang mi gnas par bla med byang chub thob byed kyi thabs su sgyur bar byed pa yin la/ nyan rang gi bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob na de'i dbang gis phal cher gzugs su skye ba dang /gzugs med kyi de thob phyin gzugs med du skye bar 'gyur ba yin gsung /yon tan sogs pa'i zhes pa ni rgyu ba sogs zer ba ltar spang bya rnam rtog dgu bzhi so drug dang / de'ang khams kyi dbye bas brgya rtsa brgyad du phye ba thams cad spangs pas dge sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun zhes gsungs pa ltar yon tan thams cad sdud par byed pa'i don yin la/ ngo mtshar rmad byung gnyis 'grel chen las rgyu dang 'bras bu la bshad gsung / 'di dag gis spang bya rnam rtog ldog cha nas bstan pa yin kyi slob dpon gyis mdo dang zur du sbyar ba mi 'dug gsung / de nas spang bya rnam rtog la/ mdor bsdus la dga' ba'i gdul bya la chos mdor bsdus ston pa la 'jug byar bden par 'dzin pa sogs 'jug pa gzung rtog dgu yod pas dus gsum yon tan med pa zhes pa'i skabs kyi sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi yon tan don dam par med kyang tha snyad du yod par rnam bshad las gsungs pa ni phyi ma gsum dang khyad par cher med do/ / bstang bas yongs su ma bzung zhes pa'i bstang ba de bkur ste 518

༄ / /zinakhrus gdodang bste stangs byed ces pa'i bstang pa la byed dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyis rgyas bsdus gang gi'ang chos ston pa'i snod du ma gyur pas re zhig btang sgoms su bzhag pa la byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / byang chub kyi sems mi skye ba la dmigs pa sogs ldog pa gzung rtog dgu yod pas/ sgom dang sgom pa med pa zhes pa ni dman pa'i yid byed dam bden zhen gyis sgom pa dang / rnam ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ trī ༷ dī ṭ+wāṃhūṃ ṭ+wāṃrdo dī dīgadhi game dī ṭ+wāṃ /༵ ༷zuXd gipa r+sha nga du/ yi/ ṭ+wāṃ/ pa'abhe ༷༵ de 'dra mi srid ces byang yes bshad kyang / bcom ldan rig ral gyis gnyis ka tshogs pa'i steng nas 'jog par gsungs pa gser 'phreng nas rang lugs su byas gsung / 'dir sems dang sems byung / zhes pa/ sgom pa'i lam la shes par bya/ / zhes pa dang sbrel dgos la/ 'di'i yul ni ngos skal gyi spang bya dang / yul can gyi de'i gnyen po la byed dgos/ phung po lnga sems can du btags pa la dmigs pa sogs rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dgu yod pas dang po gsum ni lam bden gye ma thob pa la btags pa'i so skye dang lam bden gyi thob pa la btags pa'i 'phags pa la dmigs pa yin te/ 'dir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen la sogs pa'i chos zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/mkhyen gsum gyi sgrib pa la kun rmongs sogs la dmigs sogs btags 'dzinanog pa dgu yod pas mtshungs par ldan mi ldan gye bden gnyis ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad dang / don la sgra ji bzhin du 'dzin zhes pa ni/dbu ma pas stong nyid ston pa nges don dang kun rdzob ston pa drang don du bzhed pas 'dus byas mi rtag par ston pa'i mdo'i brjod don mi rtag pa rtogs kyang / de tsam gyis mdo de'i dgongs pa ma rdzogs shing mi rtag pa de 'dus byas kyi gnas lugs ma yin pas gnas lugs mthar thug dang mdo'i 519

/ /dgongs pa mthar thug mi rtag pa de las gzhan bden med du drangs dgos pa'i phyir/ sems tsam pa sogs kyis de tsam la nges don du 'dod pas don la sgra ji bzhin du 'dzin pa yin no/ / de ltar yams nad lta bu'i rtog pa 'di rnams gong du bshad pa'i thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin rnams la goms pa dbang du gyur pa'i stobs kyis zad pa na yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sdud ༵༵ sprasdi ༵༷ trī/ pa/ 'i rtse/ t+t+waṃrag sna /so sdi dī ༵dī ༵dī ༷ //༵ ༷ ༵ ṭ+wā/dī ༷ bstan la/ de'ang stong gsum gyi skye bo thams cad nyan rang gi rtogs pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med pa las kyang 'di bsod nams che ba yin te/rnam mkhyen gyi dngos rgyu'i tshogs pa tshang zhing skad cig ma gzhan gyis bar ma chodapar sangs rgyas thob ste 'gro ba thams cad la phan bde'i sgo brgya gcig car 'byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'di'i sangs rgyas/ kha cig gis/ gang gis sangs rgyas sar gnas pa/ / de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ zhes sogs ltar sangs rgyas btags pa rgyun mtha' pa la byas nas de'i rgyud kyi lam bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor la 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ spyir sa bcu pa sangs rgyas su gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas min pa sogs sgras brjod kyis dbye ba byas pa'i skabs yod kyang 'dir sangs rgyas dngos dang / de'i nang nas kyang ye shes chos sku dang de'ang skad cig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyes drangs pa'i rnam grol lam la byed dgos gsung / bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ dper na 'dzam gling zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung /gong du bshad pa ltar gzhan la bkod pa las sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod pa bsodanams che ba de 'god pa'i yul la mchog dman mang po zhig yod pa'i 520

༄/ /zinasastobasakyis yin la/ gang mchog yin pa de shes na gzhan la mi chags pas/'dir yang dper na lha yul du 'gro ma myong ba'i 'dzam gling gi mi zhig sngon chad rang gi gnas dang / longs spyod sogs mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar rlom yod pa las phyis lha yul du phyin te lha'i gnas dang longs spyod sogs mthong nas slar 'dir 'ong yang / rang gi gnas sogs la skyug log cing de la mi chags pa ltar/ byang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad mthong bas yon tan rnams la chags par mi byed na/'khor ba'i bde ba la mi chags pa ni lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ltar mi chags kyang 'khor ba'i gnas su gzhan don du skye ba len par byed la/'di'i 'dod pa'i khams zhes pa khams gsum gyi 'dod khams la mi byed par/byang sems gang du skye bar 'dod pa'i khams der skye zhes pa'i don yin nam gsung / bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs pa ni chos thams cad yin la de'ang bden zhen gyis min par bden stong sgyu ma lta bur dmigs pa dang rnam pa ni gdod nas chos dbyings su nye bar zhi ba dang / bdag rkyen ni mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum gtan la phab pa de ma brjed par bskal chen grangs med gsum du dran pa'i rgyun bskyangs te goms par byas pa de yin te/ des rnam mkhyen rang dbang du skyed par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gang rtogs dka' ba de rang gi blor ma shong ba na de la sdang pa dang phyin ci log tu smra ba chos nyid yin pas/ dngos smra pas bden gnyis mi 'thad pa'i klan ka 'phangs pa de 'di'i dmigs rnam shin tu zab pa'i rtags yin gsung /klan ka brgyud mar 'byung ba'i don ni/ don dam par med na ye med du go nas don dam par med ces pa la gtan med du thal zer ba dang / tha snyad du yod ces pa la 'o na bden grub tu 'gyur ro zer ba dang / bden par ma 521

ra / / thabs 5ba rdzagrub na'ang gtan med las ma 'das zhes rgol ba de yin la/ dper na rnam 'grel las/ sa bon sogs ni myug sogs la/ zhes sogs kyis gzhan dbang don dam par med pa mi 'thad par thal/ sa bon la myu gu skye ba mngon sum du mthong ba'i phyir zhe na/ sa bon las myu gu skye ba kun rdzob yin no zhes pa la/ de ltar na ci ste don dam du med de/ rang ngos nas rgyu las skyes pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ba lta bu yin la/ dngos smra ba rang gi lugs la 'di rigs pa rno shos yin kyang / yod na don dam dang don dam par med na gtan med du song ba de bden gnyis kyi tshul rang gi blo ngor ma shong ba'i dbangagis yin gyi/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la chos gang yod par snang ba tsam gyis bden med du nges pa 'dren nus pa dang / bden par med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis tha snyad du yod pa la nges pa 'dren nus pa de'i tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa dang / byang sems thabs la mkhas tshul yang de 'dra zhig gi steng nas 'jog dgos gsung / don dam bden pa rtags su bkod pa'i sgo nas kun rdzob kyi phyogs 'gog par byed pa don dam sgo can dang / kun rdzob rtags su bkod nas don dam 'gog par byed pa kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka yin la/ don dam sgo can la tha snyad du yod ces kun rdzob sgo nas lan 'debs pa dang / kun rdzob sgo can la don dam par med ces don dam gyi sgo nas lan 'debs gsung / de'ang lam sgom pa'i dmigs pa mi 'thad pa'i klan ka sogs bcu drug yod pas dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa mi 'thad par thal/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad don dam par med pa'i phyir zhes pa ste 'di ni don dam sgo can dang / chos thams cad don dam par med pa mi 'thad par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa yod pa'i phyir zhes ldog na kun rdzob sgo can du 'gyur bas bcu drug 522

ra / /:sgon bsgo 'apo re re la'ang kun rdzob dang don dam sgo can gnyis gnyis bzhag chog pa 'dra gsung / sbyin sogs kyi spyod pa mi 'thad par thal/ yul 'di la rdzas 'di sbyin par bya'o snyam du bsam mi rung ba'i phyir te/ de ltar bsam na bden zhen du 'gyur bar khyod kyis khas blangs pa'i phyir/ zhes bdun pa tshegs chung dus tshogs chen po rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi spyod pa mi 'thad pa'i klan ka dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa mi 'thad par thal/dngos po dang dngos med gang du'ang rtogs mi nus pa'i phyir/ zhes brgyad pa thub pa'i mngon rtogs mi 'thad pa'i klan ka dang / byang sems kyis lam bsgom pa mi 'thad par thal/ lam bsgom pa 'bras bu'i don du yin la khyod kyisayang dag mtha' mngon du mi bya'o zhes 'bras bu thob pa bkag ba'i phyir/zhes bcu pa lam mi 'thad pa'i klan ka dang gsum po 'di'i rtags gsal gnyis shar kun rdzob bkod pas kun rdzob rigs mthun gyi klan ka yin la/phyi ma 'di la rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum byas nas 'bras bu thob pa'i skyon med ces lan 'debs gsung / bsal bya log sgrub phal ba la thal 'gyur sogs yod kyang gtso bo blo yin la/ de la ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gsum yod pa las rgol ba la dris na mthar the tshom tsam las med pas 'dir ze tshom zhes bstanagasung / gtso bor byang sems rang rgyud kyi bden gnyis 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i log tog gi dpal gzhom dgos pa yin gyi/ kha phyir bltas kho na mi rung ngo / / 'di dag la rnam mkhyen gyi rten can zhes gsungs pa ni rgyal po'i bus nyes pa byas pa la rgyal pos byas par 'jog pa ltar/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la brgal bas rnam mkhyen la brgal bar 'jog gsung / de nyid sdud par bshad pa'i tshe/ bdag nyid chen po zhes sogs sh+lau ka lnga byung / dper na mi zhig gis rin po che rnyed kyang de tshe rang la dgra yod pa'am chud zos par 523

de / / /sgo la'agyur na mi len par phyis dgra med cing rang la dgos pa'i dus su blangs nas rangagi 'dod pa bsgrub cing mi chags pa ltar byang sems kyis zeg gsum gyi lam shes kyang dus min du 'bras bu mngon du mi byed par phyis srid zhi'i mthar ltung ba'i nyen med pa'i tshe mngon du byed do/ / gcig pur bsgrub kyang dman pa'i yid byed skyed na g.yeng ba yin la/ byang sems phyi rol tu 'dod yon lnga la g.yengs kyang / nang du dman pa'i yid byed mi skyed na mnyam par bzhag pa yin par shes par bya zhes pa'i don no/ / gnyis pa brtan pa rgyu 'bras la gnyis las/ dang po ni gong du dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras kyes mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la dbang thob kyang de tsam gyis chog shes mi byed par de brtan par byed dgos pas brtan pa rgyu 'bras gsungs so/ / so so ba dang bsdus pa'i don ni/ rnam kun tu mkhyen gsum gye rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum du phye nas sgom pa dang / rtse spyor gyi skabs su sbyor mthong sgom lam bar chad med pa'i rtse spyor bzhir bsdus nas sgom pa'i don yin no/ /mthar gyis sbyor ba la/ rjes btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje rin po che la lam gyi ngo bo nges pa grangs nges pa go rim nges pa shin tu gal che gsungs pa ltar/ lam gyi ngo bo nges pa grangs nges pa go rim nges pa shin tu gal che ste/gzhungachen mo rnams nas gsungs pa ltar ngo bo grangs nges par byas te dang por 'di sgom 'di'i rjes su 'di sgom/ de'i 'og tu 'di sgom zhes go rim thar chags su nyams su blangs na rgyud la gang skyes pa de brtan po zhig 'byung la / go rim ma nges par dang por sgom pa rjes su len pa/ rjes su sgom dgos pa dang por bsgoms kyang rgyud la mi skye ste kha cig dang por stong nyid bskyed rdzogs sogs bsgom na'ang skye skye 'dra ba de la nges 'byung spu su zer la/mthar gang yang mi skye bar dngos med du 'gro ba yin gsung ngo/ / nyi tshe ba 524

༄ / /zin byes sngas de 11gagadang sna tshogs nyid/ / ces pa'i don ni/ spang bya phyogs re tsam spangs pas nyi tshe ba dang / nyan rang thar pa thob pa la ang thung pas 'bras bu ba'i'i mtshams so sor bcad de mang po zhig bzhag pas na sna tshogs nyid ces gsungs pa yin nam snyam/ dngos po ldan dang mi ldan zhes pa ni/ bden 'dzin gtso bor spong mi spong gi lam gyis nus pa rgyun chags su 'byung ba dang mi 'byung ba'i don no/ / sbyin sogs phar phyin drug tu rgyal sras kyi lam gyi dbye ba thams cad 'du bas lam mthar gyis pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa sogs rjes dran drug gis gegs sel bogs 'don gyi sgo nas khyad par du byed pa'i lam khyad par du byed pa'i mthar gyis pa dang / de dag gi tshe'angabaden par zhen pa zas dug can ltar 'gro zhing dngos med ngo bo nyid kyis zin par byed dgos pas lam rnam par dag byed kyi mthar gyis pa gsum yod do/ yang kha cig mthar gyis ba yi bya bar bzhed/ / ces gsungs pas/mthar gyis bya ba dngos su bstan nas/ mthar gyis slob pa dang / mthar gyis sgrub pa gnyis 'dir shugs la bstan par 'dod pa mi 'thad cing /rang lugs la bya ba'i sgra spyi sgra yin pas gsum ga 'dir dngos su bsdus par gser 'phreng nas gsungs pa ltar yin gsung / lam gyi ngo bo phyin drug dang /sgrub pa'i rten sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / spang blang gi sgo nas chos dkon mchog snga ma dge 'dun nyi shu'i skabs bzhin du dge 'dun dkon mchog rjes su dran pa gsum dang / rang gis khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba'i sgo nas tshul khrims dran pa dang / dge ba thams cad sgrub pa'i gtong ba dran pa dang / rnam par dag pa'i lha sangs rgyas dang byang sems sa mthon por bzhugs pa rnams dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po rnams thugs khrel bar 'gyur bas bya ba ma yin pa byed mi rung 525

/ /snyam du de dag dpang po'i tshul du dran pa dang / dmigs med kyis zin pa'i shes rab dang bcu gsum yod pa'i phyir ro/ / yang kha cig lam gyi ngo bo phar phyin drug tu mi 'du bar thal/ sa bcur phar phyin bcu lhag tshul so sor yod pa'i phyir zhe na ma khyab ste/ phar phyin phyi ma bzhi shes rab kyi phar phyin nang du 'du ba'i phyir/ 'du tshul ni/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi dge rtsa la rjes su yi rang gi tshegs chung ngus bsod nams rlabs po che sdud par byed pa de 'dra zhigagi steng nas thabs mkhas kyi phar phyin 'jog dgos la/ dge rtsa cung zad tsam la'ang khyad du mi gsod par yi rang byed pa de dge ba'i yon tan mthong ba'i shes rab la rag las pa'i phyir te/ dper na nor bu rin po che shes mkhan zhig gis nor bu chung du zhig la'ang gces sbras su byed la/ mi shes pa zhigo gis nor bu las kyang zan gong zhig la gces par 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ / smon lam gyi phar phyin ni smon pa'i yul sogs kyi khyad par shes dgos pas shes rab tu 'du/ stobs kyi phar phyin ni mi mthun phyogs kyi gtso bo bden 'dzin gyes mi badzi ba yin la/ de'ang shes rab la rag las pas de'i nang du 'du la/ / ye shes kyi phar phyin sher phyin du 'du ba yongs su grags pa ltar ro/ / 'o na de gnyis lhag tshul khyad med du 'gyur zhe na skyon med de/shes rab ni ji lta ba rtogs tshul dang / ye shes ni ji snyed pa rtogs tshul gye steng nas 'jog par dgongs pa rab gsal dang byang sa sogs na gsal bar yod gsung / phyi ma ni 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur thob pa'i rjes su ting nge 'dzin sgo mtha' yas pa thob pa de 'dra zhig gi steng nas 'jog go/ slob dpon gyes 'du tshul de ltar gsungs pa la/ phar phyin drug re re'i nang du bzhi ga 'du bar bshad de/ thabs mkhas kyi phar phyin gtso bo la bsdu dngos bzhi 'jog cing / de'ang mkho ba sbyin pa sbyin par 'du/ snyan par smra ba 526

sa / /zi shādris ltayo 11gasketshul khrims su 'du/ don mthun pa bzod par 'du/ don spyod pa brtson 'grus su 'du ba sogs yin gsung / mthar gyis spyor ba burnyi shrīs sdud par sbyor ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yi dwags 'gro ba gcod/ /ces pa nas/ sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'gro la chos kyang ston/ / zhes pa'i bar gyi sh+lau ka bzhi dang sbyar zhing legs par snang mod/ slob dpon gyis de ltar ma sbyar bar/ sems can gang dag gzhan phyir zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang sbyar/ dper na rgyal po btsan po'i g.yog mo de gzhan du bud 'gro ba lta bu'i bya ba gang la'ang 'khyog por bya mi nus par rgyal po la rag las nas 'jug pa ltar/ byang sems kyis lam gang zin zin nas 'khyog por ༈༵ ༷༷'a yi rdo lasdi ༵ dī/ ༵ ༷ k+ka rdo ṭ+wāṃnasgo /ma pa~Xm dīng dadidī dirdo~X ༵/ ༷༷ dpyod dgos gsung / mthar gyis pa de brgyad stong par yang / seng ge'i sgrasgrogs pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par rig par bya'o/ / zhes tshig gcig po 'di las med gsung / gnyis pa skad cig sbyor ni/ gong du rnam kun tu mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa so sor bshad pa dang / rtse sbyor gyi skabs su bsdus te gtan la phab pa de mthar gyis spyor ba'i skabs su ngo bo grangs tshang ma tshang go rim rnams zhu dag byas te brtan par byas pa'i 'bras bu la gang 'ong na skad cig sbyor 'di thob pa yin la/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas rnam par smin pa ma yin pa dang / rnam par smin pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor bzhi yod pa las 'dir skad cig sbyor la rnam par smin ma smin gnyis su 'byed pa ma yin gyi/ sa drug pa man chad kyis stong nyid sogs sgom pa'i tshe mtshan bcas rtsol bcas dang / sa bdun par mtshan med rtsol bcas yin pa'i phyir na 'bad rtsol rags pa dang 527

/ /bcas pa yin pas sa bdun pa man chad rnam par ma smin pa dang / sa brgyad pa yan chad mtshan med rtsol med kyi sgo nas 'bad rtsol rags pa bzhi bas na rnam par smin pa yin pas/ skad cig sbyor la rnam par smin ma smin gyi skad cig sbyor gnyis su phye ba yin no/ / de ltar 'byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / dang por so skye'i skabs la stong nyid rtogs pa'i thabs la khrid/de nas don spyi'i sgo nas rtogs/ de nas mngon sum du rtogs te mtshan bcasapol bcas dang mtshan med rtsol bcas dang / mtshan med rtsol med kyi sgo nas rim gyis goms par byas pa thams cad kyi mthar thug pa ni lam dus kyi dbang du byas na skad cig sbyor 'di nyid yin no zhes bstan par bzhed nas de ltar phye ba yin gsung / de'i tshe sbyin sogs zag med kyi chos gcig mngon du byas pa na thams cad mngon du byed nus te/ sngar sbyin sogs re re'i nang du'ang rgyal sras kyi lam tshang bar bsdus nas goms par byas pa'i phyir/ dang po nas re re'i nang du thams cad sgom dgos na re re nas ji ltar mthar phyin par 'gyur zhe na skyon med de/ stong nyid lta bu la mtshon na/chos gcig gi steng du bkag pa'i dgag bya de chos gzhan zhig gi steng du grub yod na de 'dra'i stong nyid de'ang nyi tshe ba'i stong nyid du song la/ 'dir de ltar ma yin par chos gcig gi dgag bya bden grub khegs pa na dgag bya rigs mthun pas na chos gzhan thams cad kyi steng du'ang rigs pa'i stobs shugs kyis khegs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / lugs las zhes pa ni/ grub mtha' smra ba kun gyis thun mong du khas len pa'i lugs srol yin pas/lugasalas zhes pa grub mtha' las zhes zer te/ mngon pa mdzod lta bu de nyan thos sde pa spyi'i gzhung yin pas grub mtha' las zhes dang / bzhi brgya pa 'di'ang dbu ma pa kun gyis khas len pas lugs las zhes smos pa yin gsung /528

༄ ziḥrtsa she las/ mya ngan 'das mtha' gang yin pa/ / de ni 'khor ba'i mtha' yin te/ / zhes pa ltar myang 'das dgag bya phra mo gang du ma grub pa der 'khor ba'ang ma grub dgos par grub mtha' smra ba kun mthun la/ bod 'dir jo nang pa lta bus stong nyid bden grub dang chos gzhan thams cad bden med du khas len pa la srid zhi mnyam nyid du rtogs tshul gtan nas med pa zhig tu song bas rje rin po ches dmigs kyis bkar nas rgyas par bkag pa yinagasung / gzhan yang 'bras bu'i dus na gcig car mngon du byed nus pa'i dpe ni/ zo chun gyi 'khor lo'i yan lag dang chu len pa'i snod dang gcig nas gcig tu 'phen pa sogs gcig car byed kyang / rgyu'i dus su de thams cad gcigacar du sgrub tshul med kyang / sngon bzo legs par byas ṭ+wāṃrdo /hūṃ pa/ ༷ ṭ+wādidī rdo ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃng/ baṭ+wāṃ ngh+ru dī ṭ+wāṃ ༵ /༵ ṭ+wāṃ rdor+sha dh+riX dzhai dz+rīX gyis legs par bzos pa'i mthus/ 'bras bu'i dus su gcig car byed nus pa bzhin yin gsung / der ma zad gsang sngags rdo rje'i zeg par/skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / zhes myur bar gsung ba'ang thud tshon po mar gyi drin zhes zer ba ltar phar phyin theg pa'i lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs te tshags su tshud pa na rdo rje theg pa'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las dbang bzhi rdzogs par mnos te bshes gnyen bsten tshul sogs sngar las kyang brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyis lhag pa dang / dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba'i steng nas mtshan bcas mtshan med dam/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gang rung nyams su blang na gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa myur ba yin gyi/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam thun mong ba sdon du ma song na gsang sngagasardo rje theg pa khams che ba tsam gyis skad cig gcig la rdzogs sangs rgya 529

/ /rgya mi nus la/ lam de dag sngon du song na phar phyin zeg par yang skad cig la sangs rgya nus par bshad pa yin zhes yongs 'dzin rin po che nas yang yang thosagasung / gzhan yang lam rim lta bu'ang dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs re re'ang dang por lo dang zla ba'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pas gtan la dbab dgos pa de goms na phyis skad cig gcig la'ang 'char ba ni/ rje sgrub khang pa yin nam chibs gong du zhon pa'i bar la lam rim tshar gcig skyong thub par gsungs pa lta bu yin la/ dper na lam rgyus med pa zhig la bshad na'ang mi 'dzad pa lta bu'i lam bar de rgyus yod la skad cig la 'char ba lta bu yin gsung / rnam par smin pa'i de ni dag pa sa gsum du'ang yongs sbyangs so so'i goms pa'i mthar thug pa ni skad cig spyor dang / mtshan nyid med pa'i de ni bden stong sgyu ma lta bur yun ring du goms pa'i mthar thug pa ni skad cig sbyor dang / gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor ni rmi lam dang de'i yul gnyis 'khrul snang tsam las don du ma grub pa ltar chos thams cad sems kyi snang cha tsam ma gtogs rang ngos nas ma grub par goms pa'i byang sems kyi lam mthar thug ni skad cig spyor yin la/ de'i tshe skad cig gzhan gyi bar ma chod par 'tshang rgya ba yin no/ / skad cig sbyor de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe / burtse thi'i sdud 'grel ltar na/ chos 'di yongs rdzogs byas nas byang chub sems dpa' de/ zhes pa gcig pu dang sbyar la 'di'ang legs par 'grigs la/ yongs dag ces sogs skabs brgyad pa dang mtshams sbyor sla ba zhig yod gsung / slob dpon ltar na/ skad cig sbyor de nyid sdud par 'chad pa'i tshe/ spyo ba byas sam zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis byung / bran mo des rtag tu rje bo'i bya ba 'ba' zhig byed kyi gzhan mi byed pa ltar/ byang chub semasadapas kyang gzhan don gcig pu byed kyi bya ba gzhan mi byed pa'i phyir/530

das / /13 /sde sartswa dang shing las me byung ste de nyid sreg par byed pa ltar/ dang por stong nyid don spyi'i sgo nas rtogs dgos kyang / gsal snang thob ste goms pa las mtharaganyis snang gi dri ma thams cad sreg par byed pa yin no/ / de nyid brgyad stong par 'chad pa'i tshe/ mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par rig par bya'o/ / zhes pa'i tshig gcig po 'di las med la/ mi 'khrugasapa dang mi bskyod pa don 'dra bas/ skad cig sbyor thob pa de'i tshe dman pa'i yid byed dang / bden 'dzin sogs kyis bskyod pa'am g.yo ba mi srid pa'i don no/gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku la bzhi las/ dang po ngo bo nyid sgu ni/dran pa nyer bzhag sogs ldan pa'i khyad par dang / chos kyi dbyings sogs ngor nyid kyi khyad par dang / sho bur dri mas rnam par dag pa'i khyad par gsum dang ldan la/ rgyud bla ma las/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ / sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / / de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ / zhes pa ltar sems bden pas stong ba de la dri mas cung zad kyang ma dag pa'i gnas skabs na sems can gyi khams dang / dri ma nyi tshe bas dag pas na bde gshegs snying po dang /dri ma mtha' dag gis dben pas na chos sku zhes brjod do/ / 'dir ngo bo nyid ces pa ni/ rtsa she las/ rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang / /zhes sogs ltar rang bzhin dang don 'dra bas/ rang bzhin ni sangs rgyas pa'i tshe'ang lhag par dag rgyu med la/ thog ma med pa nas dri mas dag cing ma bslad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sems can gyi gnas skabs na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zer ba yin gsung / de ltar chos nyid kyi sku bshad pas chos can gyi sku gsum der 'dus so snyam na/ gong du chos nyid du chos can rnams 531

/bsdus nas bshad pa yod kyang / 'dir chos can gyi sku gsum chos nyid kyi sku las logs su bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ rnam mkhyen ni sangs 'phags kho na'i nang phan tshun gyi spyod yul yin pas/ de rnams kyis rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas ye shes chos sku dang / longs sku ni rang gi 'khor byang 'phags rnams kyi spyod yul yin gyi gzhan gyi spyod yul ma yin pas byang sems de dag gi mos pa'i sgo nas dang / sprul sku ni nyan rang dang so skye las dag yan chad la mngon sum du snang rgyu yod pas de dag gi snang ba dang don sgrub tshul gye sgo nas bzhag pa yin gsung / byang chub phyogs mthun nas/ mkhyen gsum gyi bar zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig la ye shes chos sku zhes brjod pa yin la phal cher gyi ngo bo skabs bzhi par brjod zin la/ rnam thar/ zil gnon/zad par gsum gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas rjes su dran tshul ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/thub pa sgrib kun nges par grol/ / 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon/ / khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab/ / thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa ltar/ rnam thar ni rang sa'i kun dkris las grol bas 'jog la/ sangs rgyas khams gsum gyi sgrib pa las grol ba dang / zil gnon gyis sprul bsgyur sna tshogs byed pa la de dag gi ldog zla zil gyis gnon pa dang / zad par gyi mkhyen pas shes bya thams cad la khyab cing gzhan don byed pas de'i sgo nas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / yongs su dag pa bzhi ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ len dang gnas dang gtong ba dang / / sprul dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang / / ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la/ / mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa ltar/ gdul bya'i ngor lus len pa dang / sku'i bkod pa gnas pa dang / chos la bskul ba'i phyir mya ngan las 'da' bar ston pas na lus sam rten dag pa dang / gzugs che chung du ma 532

ras / /13 (117sprul zhing bzang ngan sna tshogs su bsgyur ba la dbang 'byor pas na dmigs pa dag pa dang / ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa la mnga' brnyes pas na thugs dag pa dang / shes bya thams cad la chags thogs mi mnga' bas ye shes yongs su dag pas de'i sgo nas sangs rgyas dran no/ / dbang bcu ni tshe gtong 'jog la dbang bas tshe la dbang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa la dbang bas sems la dbang ba dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas sems can la sbyin pa gtong ba'i tshe longs spyod kyis nam yang phongs pa med pas yo byad la dbang ba ste 'di gsum gtso bor sbyin pa'i 'bras bu dang / las gang sgrub kyang 'grub pas las la dbang ba dang /gang du smon pa der skye bas skye ba la dbang ba ste 'di gnyis tshul khrims kyi 'bras bu dang / gdul byas gang mos pa ltar gzhan don byed nus pas mos pa'i dbang ba yin la/ de bzod pa'i 'bras bu yin te/ bzod pas ni slob lam du sems can gye bsam pa dang mthun par byas pa'i phyir ro/ /smon lam la dbang ba brtson 'grus kyi 'bras bu dang / rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba bsam gtan gyi 'bras bu dang / ye shes dang chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la dbang ba ste 'di gnyis shes rab kyi 'bras bu yin la phyi ma rnams go sla gsung / stobs bcu ni/ stobs sogs rnams las stobs drug dang /zhes sogs ltar mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa'i sgo nas stobs su bzhag pa gcig dang / bdud kyi spyod pa zil gyis gnon pa'i sgo nas stobs su bzhag pa gcig dang gnyis yod pa las phyi ma ni mdo sde rgyan las/ thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang / / zeg chen nges par 'byung ba la/ / sems can rnams la rab bslu ba'i/ / bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa ltar/ gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa'i stobs ni gang zhig byas na ngan 533

/song du skye mi srid la/ gang zhig byas na ngan song du skye ba dang / gang zhig byas na bde 'gror skye mi srid la/ gang byas na bde 'gror skye ba de bdud kyis log par ston la/ sangs rgyas kyis bdud zil gyis mnan te phyin ci ma log par ston pa dang / las dang de'i rnam spin mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ngan 'gro las gol te bde 'gro thob pa de'ang rang nyid kyis blang dor tshul bzhinabyed pa la rag las par shes te skyabs dngos chos dkon mchog la de las skyob pa'i nus pa yod par yid ches pas sangs rgyas la skyabs ston pa dang / dge 'dun la skyabs bsgrub pa'i zla grogs su go la/ de ltar na las 'bras dang / skyabs 'gro gnyis skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor gyi gtso bo yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyis bdud kyi spyod pa zil gyis mnan te gdul bya skyes bu chung du'i lam la 'god pa dang / bsam gtan rnam thar sogs mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ phyi rol pa rnams kyis/ 'dod pa las chags pa dang bral ba la thar bar 'khrul nas srid rtse las grol ba mthar thug tu rlom pa de dag nyi tshe ba dang / mthar lhung ba'i chos can yin pas bdud kyis bslus pa yin la/sangs rgyas kyis bdud kyi spyod pa de'ang zil gyes mnan te gdul bya skyes bu 'bring gi chos skor la 'god pa dang / dbang po mchog dang mchog min pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ theg dman rnams dbang po mchog min la/ theg chen rigs can rnams dbang po mchog yin pas de theg chen la nges par 'byung ba skyes bu chen po'i chos skor la 'god pas de'i sgo nas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / bsrung ba med pa gsum sogs kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas rjes su dran tshul ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' bar/'khor gyi nang na bag brkyang gsungs / / kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pa/ / 'khor sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa ltar phyi rol nas 534

ra / /zizug bye /sgo tshochos dang mthun par bcos kyang skog tu nyes pa byas na mang po'i nang du gzhan gyes shes dogs nas nongs pa de rang gi zhe phug na skyon cig yod pa'i rtags yin la/ sangs rgyas ni mngon skog mi mnga' bas gzhan gyis shes dogs nas spyod lam bsgrim mi dgos par 'khor gyi nang du bag brkyangs te gzhugs pas na/ bsrung ba med pa zhes bya yi/ bsrung bya bsrung ba med ces pa min gsung / chos ston pa'i tshe 'di ni bdag la gus par 'dug snyam du chags pa dang / 'di ni mi gus par 'dug snyam du sdang ba'i nyon mongs gnyis po spangs pas na dran pa nyer bzhag ces bya yi/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang mi 'dra gsung / gdul bya'i ngos nas rgyu rkyen tshogs na sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin dus las mi yol bas na bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba ste/'digasum mdo sde rgyan du bsdus te bstan no/ / nyan rang dgra bcom la sngon gyi nyon mongs kyi bag chags ma spangs pas nags tshal du ku co 'don pa shābhem/ pahūṃ ༷zhadig pa~X ༷di dīdi~X ༵༷ rdoX /co / pa daXng /sa sngu sdi spya/ hā dang / thugs rje chen po gnyis la bye smra'i lugs la khyad par yod kyang /'dir snying rje chen po'i nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe thugs rje chen po zhes bya ba yin no/ / byang chub phyogs mthun sogs zag med du gyur pa'i ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig ngo bo nyid sku las logs su ye shes chos sku zhes don bdun cu'i rkang grangs gcig tu brjod pa ni sku bzhir 'dod pa kha cig la'o zhes slob dpon rang gi'ang bzhed pa'o/ / gzhan dag sku bzhir 'dod pa dag na re/thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ / zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis ngo bo nyid sku mdor bstan nas/ ngo bo nyid sku gang gi rang bzhin du 'gro sa'i zag pa med pa'i chos de dag kyang gang zhe na/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang /535

/ /nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang / / zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyas par bshad cing / ngo bo nyid sku de zag med kyi chos de dag gi ngo bo nyid dam rang bzhin yin zhes ston pa la/ chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ / zhes pa 'di byung zer ro/ / de la sku bzhir 'dod pa dag na re/ 'o na rkang pa tha mas chos nyid kyi sku zhes smos rigs kyi/ chos kyi sku zhes smos mi rigs so zhe na/skyon med de/ dharma kā ya chos sku dang / / dharma ta kā ya chos nyid kyi sku yin pa las 'dir sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis ngo bo'i rkyen ta mi mngon bar byas te chos sku zhes brjod pa yin zer ro/ / nyi khri rnam 'grel las gang nyid kyi rkyen phyis pas zhes 'byung ba 'di dang don khyad par med gsung / sku'i bstan tshul la rtsod kyi grangs nges la rtsod pa min no/ / yang sku bzhi 'dod pa dag na re/ chos sku'i nang nas gal che shos khyad par gsum ldan gyi ye shes chos sku de nyid chad par 'gyur bas mi rung ba'i phyir sku'i nang nas gal che shos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ngo bo nyid sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas gdul bya la don khyad par can gzugs sku gnyis kyi snang ba skyed pa'i sgo nas chos ston pa sogs kyis don mdzad pa thams cad gang gi stobs kyis yin na ye shes chos sku de nyid kyi stobs kyis yin pas na gal che shos dang chad mi rung ba'i phyir zer ro/ / khyad par gsum ni/ ngo bo'i khyad par gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa dang / spangs pa'i khyad par slob pa'i tshe gnyis snang gi zag pa dang bcas pa las gnas gyur nas rnam par dag pa dang / byed las kyi khyad par gzugs sku gnyis su snang ba skyed pa'i sgo nas chos ston pa sogs yin no/ / de la sku gsum du 'dod pa dag na re/ ngo bo nyid ces pa nas yang dag brjod ces pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad 'di'i ngo bo nyid ces pa'i de ma thag tu chos sku zhes mi 'byung bas lus mdor bstan gyis kyang sku gsum kho nar 'grub bo zhes zer 536

༄/ /zinasriro/ / de ltar ma yin par sku bzhir bstan na/ lus mdor bstan gye ngo bo nyid ces pa'i de ma thag tu longs sku 'byung bas mdor bstan rgyas bshad go rim mi mthun pas na rtsa ba dang yang 'gal lo zhe na/ de sku bzhir 'dod pa dag na re/ dgos pa yod na bstan bshad go rim ma mthun kyang mi 'gal ba ni/ dper na/ sngar spyor lam gyi lus mdor bstan du yongs 'dzin sngon la bshad cing / rgyas bshad du khyad chos de dag yongs 'dzin gyi stobs kyis yin no zhes shes pa'i ched du mjug tu bshad pas go rim mi mthun yang 'gal ba med par khyod kyis kyang khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ / 'o na dgos pa gang zhe na/ sku gsum gyi mjug tu chos sku sbyar ba la dgos pa yod de/ gong du don khyad par can snang ba bskyed pa'i sgo nas chos ston zhes sogs kyis nye bar bstan pa'i dgos pa de'i shugs kyis sam ched dang / sdeb sbyor gye ngo dang /ye shes chos sku dang mdzad pa spyor ba gsum gyi ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ / rnam bshad ltar na rtags 'di gsum gyi phyi ma phyi ma bsgrub bya dang / snga ma snga ma sgrub byed du byas so / / ye shes mdzad pa dang bcas pa zhes sbyar na'ang sdeb sbyor legs mod 'dir sdeb sbyir legs pa'i don ni tshig gi sdeb spyor tsam min gyi ye shes dang mdzad pa sbyar bas mi go la/ chos sku dang mdzad pa sbyar bas go nus pa gcig yod de/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid ces pa 'di rnamakun mkhyen nyid ces pa la bstan bshad sbyor ba'i tshig yin pa bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang yod cing / chos sku la'ang yod dgos pas ye shes zhes sbos na bstan bshad sbyar ba med snyam du dogs pa mi sel la/ dngos po brgyad kyi rkang grangs kyi chos sku spyi ldog de'i ming nas smos pas dogs pa sel la/ bstan bshad sbyar ba'ang go ba'i phyir ro/ / nyon mongs med pa dang /smon gnas mkhyen pa gnyis rtogs dka' zhing nor sa yod pas/ nyan thos 537

/ /nyon mongs med pa'i lta/ / zhes sogs kyis rgyas par bshad gsung / nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems can dag ni thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'joms/ / nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la/ / brtse bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar/ nyan thos kyi nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom grong khyer sogs su rgyu ba'i tshe rang la dmigs te gzhan rgyud la nyon mongs skye bar mthong na byol nas 'gro zhing / rang nyid kyis gzhan gyi nyon mongs kyi dmigs rkyen byed pa de 'gog pa tsam yin la/ de'ang mdzod las/ nyon mongs med pa kun rdzob shes/ / zhes sogs ltar nyon mongs ma 'ongs pa la dmigs pa yin no/ / sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ sangs rgyas rang la dmigs te gzhan rgyud la nyon mongs skye bar mthong na byol nas mi 'gro bar ma zad/ de la brtse bas lhag par gzigasate de'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs kyi sa bon rgyun gcod par mdzad pa yin gsung / smon gnas mkhyen pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'/ / thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni/ / mnyam par bzhag cing 'dri kun gyi/ / lan ldon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes gsungs la/ sangs rgyas smon gnas zhes sogs dang khyad par med cing /de'ang sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa ni 'bad rtsol med par rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa dang / mtshan 'dzin gyi bag chags spangs pas chags spangs dang / shes bya thams cad la zhugs pas thogs pa med pa dang / rigs 'dra rgyun mi 'chad par gzhan don du rtag tu gnas pa dang / pha rol po la dogs pa ji ltar skyes pa dang / de la lan gang zhig btab pas sel ba sogs mkhyen nas dri bas lan 'debs pa yin la/ nyan thos kyi smon gnas 538

༄/ /mkhyen pa ni khyad chos lnga po de las ldog pa yin gsung / 'o na sangs rgyas gzhan don du rgyun mi 'chad par rtag tu bzhugs yod na/ de bzhugs bzhin du bdag cag da dung 'khor bar lus pa ci yin zhe na/ bshags bstod las/ phyi yi yan lag stobs kun ni/ / khyod kyis yang dag bsgrubs zin gyi/ / nang gi stobs dag ma tshang bas/ / byis pa rnams ni sdug bsngal bsten/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gdul bya'i ngos nas rgyu med pas brag phug kha byang bltas lta bur song ba yin gyi/ rgyu tshogs tshang na sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las dus las yol pa mi srid cing sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu dang /rnam thar zil gnon sogs kyi sgo nas sprul bsgyur sna tshogs la dbang 'byor pa gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i stobs kyis la lar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam pa dang / nyi mas gdungs pa la shing grib dang / chus khyer ba la zam dang /nad kyis gdungs pa la sman pa la sogs pa de 'dra'i gdul bya gang dang gang la skabs su babs pa de'i tshe phan par gyur pa'i snod bcud dang / der dngos su snang nas don mdzad pa'i phyir te/ sdong po bkod pa las/ de dag kun tu 'tsho ba'i chos 'dzin cing / / bla na yod dang bla na med rnams dang / / ral pa rigs dang gzhon nu'i brtul zhugs can/ / de dag gi yang slob dpon 'byung ba yin/ / de dag dgon par ljon shing chen por 'gyur/ / sman dang rin chen mi zad gter rnams dang / / yid bzhin nor bu 'dod pa sbyin shing dang / / lam gol 'khyams pa rnams la lam ston 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs so/ / de ltar na ci phyir gdul bya thams cad la mi snang zhe na/ de dpe'i sgo nas ston pa ni/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang sa bon rul pa sogs mi rung bar gyur pa la myu gu mi 'khrungs pa ltar skal ba med pa la mi snang ngo / / 'dir lha'i rgyal po ni brgya byin la 'dod pa dang / rgyal 539

/ /chen bzhis rang gi gos rgya mtshor bcug te sprugs nas char 'bebs so zhes gsungs pa sogs yod la/ gang ltar yang 'jig rten du dge ba byas pas de dag gi stobs sogs 'phel zhing / des dga' nas 'jig rten la phan pa'i don du char 'bebs so/ / sngar smon gnas mkhyen pa'i skabs su sangs rgyas 'khor ba ji srid bar rtag tu bzhugs par bshad pa dang / dus thams cad du khyab pa zhes brjod mi rigs par thal/ rnam mkhyen de skad cig re re la skye zhing 'jig pa'i phyir dang / rnal 'byor pa rang rang gis lam sgom stobs kyis rgyud la bzos pas so sor nges pa'i rten gye rgyud la yod pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtsod pa khong nas bslangs te/ lan ni 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid 'jig pa der med pas rtag pa dang / phyi rol pas lha chen khyab 'jug gis snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas na khyab par bshad pa de lta bu ma yin gyi/rnam mkhyen gyi rigs 'dra phyi ma 'khor ba ma stongs bar du zad pa'am rgyun chad pa med par gnas pas rtag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las gang zag 'di la 'di 'jug 'di la mi 'jug ces mtha' 'dzin mi nus pas na khyab pa zhes brjod pa yin no/ / spyir lta ba bkar brtag gi phyag rgya bzhi zhes pa ni/rgyal po'i mnga' 'bangs su gtogs pa rnams rgyal po'i bka' khrims sam/phyag rgya las 'da' mi nus pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa rnams kyang phyag rgya bzhi po 'di las 'da' mi rung zhing / gal te 'das na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las rgyab kyis phyogs pa yin pas na bzhi po 'di la phyag rgya zhes zer ro/ / des na nyan thos sde pa na re/ theg chen bka' ma yin te/ phyag rgya bzhi po 'di dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ longs sku rtag par bshad pas na 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par bshad pas phyag rgya dang 'gal/ bde nas bde 'gror 'gro ba la/ / sems shes su zhig spyid lug 5rku

da / /lnga'i ji /sgo go'agyur/ / zhes byang sems so skye bde ba'i rang bzhin du bshad pas zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal bar bshad pa'i phyag rgya dang 'gal/ bde gshegs snying pos sems can thams cad la khyab par bshad pa des/bdag khas blangs par song bas chos thams cad bdag med par bshad pa'i phyag rgya dang 'gal/ dam chos pad dkar las/ khyod ni da dung mya ngan yongs ma 'das/ / sangs rgyas theg pa 'di ni btsal bar bya/ / zhes mya ngan las 'das pa slar 'khor bar skye ba len par bshad pas mya ngan las 'das pa zhi bar bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba'i don ni slar skye ba mi len par mar me shi ba ltar bem rig rgyun chad pa la 'dod pa gang zhig / khyod kyis de slar skye ba len par 'dod pas ma zhi ba'i phyir zhes zer ro/ / des na 'di dag gi phyogs snga'i gtso bo'ang nyan thos sde ba yin nam gsung /gsum pa ngo bo nyid sku dang ye shes chos sku gnyis bshad zin nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ gnas 'og min kho nar 'khor theg chen 'phags pa rnams dang thabs cig tu theg chen gye chos la gtso bor longs spyod cing /gdul bya de dag gi ngor mtshan dpe sogs kyi sku'i rnam pa mi 'dor bar rtag tu bzhugs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i longs spyod kyi gtso bo theg chen gye chos yin la/ 'dir de la rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i rten gyi gang zag la longs skur bzhag pa dang / sngags phyogs nas chos la rdzogs par longs spyod par byed po ni gsung yin pas na gsung la gtso bor longs skur bzhag pa yin no/ / nges pa lnga ldan zhes yongs su grags kyang /gser 'phreng las/ theg bsdus ltar na de la gnod pa'ang snang bas dpyad par bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dogs gzhi che ba zhig yin rgyu red gsung /༅

/ /rin chen phreng bar/ 'khor los bsgyur ba thams cad la/ / 'di dag yod par 'dod mod kyi/ / dag dang mdzes dang gsal ba ni/ / sangs rgyas rnamasakyi char mi phod/ / ces sogs ltar/ 'khor sgyur thams cad dang /dag sa gsum la gnas pa la'ang mtshan bzang rjes mthun pa yod la der ma zad rang rgyal 'ga' zhig la'ang de dag cha 'dra yod kyang / sangs rgyas kyi ni gsal la rdzogs pa dang / de'i nang nas kyang longs skus ni de dag gi rnam pa rtag tu mi gtong ba yin no/ / mtshan dang de'i rgyu gnyis dkyus gcig la bshad na go sla bas/ gzhon nu nor bzang gis rang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyenanams la phyag dang skor ba mang po dang bsu skyel sogs mdo las rgyas bar 'byung ba lta bu byas pa'i stobs kyis phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa ste/de'ang ri mo bris pa lta bu ma yin par bstod sprin rgya mtshor/ rgya las rgya yi 'bur ni gsal ba bzhin/ / zhes pa dang rwa dang ba so la brkos pa bzhin du 'bur du dod pa dang / bdag cag gi ston pa 'di sngon seng ge yid ma brtan pa zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe dam bca' brtan par byas pa lta bu sogs kyis zhabs gnyis kyi mthil rus sbal gyi lto ba bzhin mnyam pa dang /thams cad sgrol du skyes pa'i tshe bsdu dngos bzhi brten pa lta bu sogs kyis phyag zhabs kyi sor tshigs dang po nas brtsams cha seng med par dra bas 'brel yang sor gdub sogs kyi go mi 'gog pa dang / bza' ba zan dang bca' ba shing thog sogs byin pas gzhon sha chags pa ste sha tshags dam pa dang / bldag pa sogs gya nom byin pas phyag zhabs kyi rgyab dang thal gong dang ltag pa'i phyogs na rkong po med par sku shas gang bas bdun dag mtho ba nyid dang / ston pa 'di sems can chen por 'khrungs pa'i tshe stag mo bkres pas rang gi phru gu za bar nye ba na lus sbyin par btang bas stag mo bu dang bcas pa'i srog bskyabs 542

༄/ /pa lta bu sogs kyis sor mo ring ba nyid dang / ston pa 'di rgyal po me long gdong du skyes pa'i tshe drang srong lte'u can sogs phan tshun mi mthun par gyur pa de thabs mkhas kyis bde bar byas pa lta bu sogs kyis zhabs kyi bzhi cha phyir 'phags rting ba yangs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rting ba yangs pa nyid dang /dedadapon du gyur ba'i tshe byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas srog chags grogs bur sogs 'ang srog gcod pa spangs pa'i bden tshig gis rgya mtshor gru bo che mi mthun pa'i rlung gis bskyod pa'i 'jigs pa las grol bar byas pa lta bu sogs kyis sku che zhing drang ba nyid dang / dge ba'i chos yang dag par blangs pas zhabs long bu mi mngon pa nyid dang / dge ba yang dag par blang ba spel bas spu gyen du phyogs pa dang / rig bzo sogs la mkhas kyang khyad du mi gsod par byin pas byin pa sha ra ṇa'am e na ya'i ltar blum zhing 'dril ba nyid dang / byi bi ba'i rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe slong ba po'i tshig phyir mi bzlog par byin pa lta bu sogs kyis phyag ring zhing mdzes pa dang / skye bo thams cad tshangs spyod len du 'jug pa dang / gsang tshig bsrung bas 'doms kyi sba ba spubs su nub pa dang / gding ba gya nom byin pas mdog gser ltar gsal ba dang / khang bzang sogs byin pas pags pa 'jam pa nyid dang /'du 'dzi sogs spangs pas ba spu'i khung bu re re na spu gnyis re med par re re nas g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba nyid dang / bla ma dang pha ma dang grogs rnams go rim ltar rang rang gi tshod kyi bkur gzos legs par byas pa'i stobs kyis zhal mdzod spus brgyan pa ste/ de'ang smin mtshams kyi bar thig le'i gnas na 'jam pa dkar ba mnyen pa drangs na 'dom yin nam khru gang dang khru gnyis dang khru gsum la sogs pa'i tshad 'byung ba btang na g.yas su 'khyil ba/ rtse mo gyen du phyogs pa skyu ru ra'i 'bru'i tshad tsam pa dngul 'bur gyi rnam pa'o/mo3

/ /ston pa 'di khyu mchog tu gyur pa'i tshe spre'u zhig gis gtses pa la nags de na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin gyis khyod kyis 'di la rwa yug gcig gis chog mod ces smras pa na/ ma thub pa la bzod pa bsgoms pa'i ming ci yod gsungs nas bzod pa bsgoms pa lta bu sogs kyis ro stod seng ge 'dra ba nyid dang /snyan smra sogs kyis dpung mgo spyom pa nyid dang / sman sogs byin pas thal gong rgyas pa ste/ gong ma ni shas gang ba yin la/ 'dir dkyel che ba'o/skye bo nad pa'i g.yog byas pas ro bro ba'i mchog mkhyen pa ste/ rgyal po zhig gis sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la rta chas phul ba na kun dga' pos sangs rgyas kyis grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags kyang zas 'di 'dra ba zhes dgos pa ci yin nam snyam du yi mug pas/ sangs rgyas kyis tshems bar nas 'bru gcig gnang ba'i tshe kun dga' bos sngar ma myong ba'i ro zhim por rtogs pa lta bu yin la/ sangs rgyas kyis gsol du bkod tshe ro mi zhim pa'ang ro zhim por gyur pa yin gyi/ ro mi zhim pa sangs rgyas la ro zhim por snang ba ma yin zhes sde bdun nas bshad pa ltar yin gsung / kun dga' rwa ba gtsug lag khang /zhes sogs ltar byas pas n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab pa ste/ spyi gtsug nas zhabs kyi mthil bar dang 'dom g.yas g.yon gyi rtse bar brkyangs na mnyam pa yin la/ dgongs rgyan du n+ya ga ni dma' ba ste sku smad/ ro dha ni mnyam pa ste lte ba nas bzung nas sku smad dang / sku stod tshad mnyam pa'o zhes ga'i srog gi ro phral nas ro dha byas pa yin gsung / gtsug lag khang sogs byin pas dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa nyid dang / 'jam pa sogs gsungs pas ljags ring ba ste 'dul ba lung nas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khebs par bshad pa la gzhan yang tshad med par gsungs pa yod/ 'jig rten sogs kyis yan lag lnga ldan gyi tshangs dbyangs te/ lnga'i nang gi btang mi bra ba zhes pa ni/5yo

da / /:sgo ji ———sde'ajig rten na mi spra zer ba de yin zhing / sangs rgyas kyi gsung nyan skabs nyan 'phro bzhag ste gzhan du 'gro ba la phangs pa lta bu yin gsung / tshig kyal spangs pas 'gram pa seng ge 'dra ba nyid dang / skye bo sogs kyis tshems dkar ba nyid dang / 'tsho ba dag pas tshems ring thung med par mnyam pa dang / bden pa'i tshig gis kun tu spyad pas tshems bar stong med par thags bzang ba nyid dang / phra ma'i tshig spangs pas tshems bzhi bcu mnga' ba dang / sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa dang 'dra bar gzigs pas spyan 'bras bung ba ltar gnag pa dang / de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis dkar ba dang / grwa zur gnyis dmar ba dang / kha so sngo ba dang / steng du gser mdog ltar ser ba ste/ de ltar na khyad par lnga dang ldan gsung / khong khro sogs med par bltas pas dzi ma ba'i lta bu nyid do/ / 'di'i dzi ma ni 'jig rten na smin ma zer ba de de yin la/ 'jig na dzi ma zer ba de gsung rab nas bshad pa'i smin ma yin no/ / smin ma sdeb zer ba de gsung rab nas dzi ma 'khrab par gsungs la/ de lta la 'chi tshe yod kyi rgyun du dzi ma 'khrab pa de med gsung / rgyu de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston tshul dang /gdul bya'i mos pa de'i dor de ltar gsungs kyang yon tan de dag thams cad 'bras bu chos sku yin par 'dra bas rgyu la bzang ngan med de/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ rang sangs rgyas kun las byung dang / / slob dang mi slob las byung dang / / 'jig rten ma lus dpag med gang / / zhes sogs ltar nyan rang dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsod nams gcig tu bsdus pa bcur bsgres pas sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig 'grub/ ba spu nyi khri chig stong gi bar de dang 'dra'o/ / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad bskyed pa'i bsod nams gcig tu bsdus pa brgyar bsgres pas dpe byad 545

/ /bzang po gcig 'grub/ dpe byad brgyad cu'i bar de dang 'dra'o/ / dpe byad brgyad cu 'grub pa'i bsod nams gcig tu bsdoms pa brgyar bsgres pas mtshan bzang gcig 'grub/ mtshan so gnyis kyi bar de dang 'dra/mtshan bzang de dag 'grub pa'i bsod nams thams cad stong du bsgyur bas zla ba nya 'dra'i mdzod spu gcig 'grub/ mdzod spu'i bsod nams dag stong phrag brgyar bsgyur bas sangs rgyas kyi gtsug tor 'grub/ gtsug tor bskyed pa'i bsod nams bye ba grangs med bcu yis yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs 'grub ste/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ / mdzad pa mchog yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / slob dpon 'phags pa ltar na ngo bo nyid sku dang / longs sku dang / sprul sku dang / 'azin las dang bzhi 'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos su 'dod pa dang / slob dpon seng ge bzang po ltar na ngo bo nyid sku/ ye shes chos sku/ longs sprul gyi sku gnyis dang bzhi la 'dodapas longs sku ni mtshan dang dpe byad kyi bdag nyid 'khor ba ma stong bar du sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams dang thabs cig tu theg pa chen po'i chos la longs spyod pa'i mtshan nyid can yin la/ mtshan nyid de dag gi nang nas mtshan dpe ni/ sngags ltar na dbyangs so gnyis rnam par dag pa mtshan dang / gsal byed brgyad cu rnam par dag pa dpe byad bzang por 'dod la/ de'ang rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pa'i stobs kyis phyi rol nas gdos bcas dang sem chos lta bu ma yin par thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba dang / de'ang ngag dben gyi sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo rlung ngag gnyis ngo bo tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs te rlung dag pa na ngag dag pa sogs kyis ye shes kyi rang mdangs gzugs skur shar ba yin gsung / mdo phyogs nas 'di 'dra dngos shig mi 'dod kyang ye shes kyi 546

༄ zirang mdangs gzugs skur shar bar 'dod de/ sangs rgyas kyi gtsug tor mdzod spu sogs kyis kyang chos thams cad mkhyen par gsungs pa ltar khas kyang len dgos la/ ye shes de nyid gzugs skur shar ba ma yin na de ltar mkhyen pa mi srid gsung / dpe byad ni / 'du byed thams cad la 'dod chags dang bral ba nyid kyis sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba dang /sems can la lhag pa'i bsam pa nyid kyis sen mo'i mdog skya shar re mi byed par snum pa nyid dang / byams pa'i dus su bram ze'i rigs la mchog dang /bdag cag gi ston pa'i dus su rgyal rigs la mchog tu byed pa ltar rigs kyi mchog las skyes pas sen mo mtho ba nyid la/ rigs mchog las skyes pa sen mo mtho ba'i rgyur 'ong don med pas dpe byad kyi skabs kyi 'di dag mtshan bzangagi skabs ltar rgyus 'bras bu sgrub pa ma yin gyi/ de'i tshe yod pa'i phyi rol gyi rtags 'di dag ni nang gi yon tan de dag dpog byed kyi rang bzhin gyi rtags lta bu zhig yin gsung / rang bzhin gyis nyes pa de byas na byed pa po de gnong gis thebs nas gzhan la smra mi nus pas nyes pa de la rang bzhin gyi kha na mtho ba zer ba yin la/ de med pa nyid kyis sor mo blum pa nyid dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba sogs kyis sor mo rgyas pa ni sor tshigs 'bur ba dang gnyer ma med pa sogs so/ / sor mo byen gyis phra ba ni pags kyis phra ba dang don 'dra bas sor mo'i rtsa ba nas rtse'i bar je phrar song ba la byed gsung / sor mo dang sen mo'i dpe byad 'di drog ni phyag sor ring ba'i mtshan gyi 'khor dang / dbu rgyas pa dang dbu skra drug ste bdun ni gtsug tor dang sbu g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'khor yin pa sogs slob dpon chos bshes kyis rgyas par bshad la/ mtshan rdzogs pa dang / phyag ring zhing rgyas pa gnyis sbyar dgos pa chad pa dang / gsung la gsum byas pa lhag la/ de ma gtogs 547

/gzhan rnams gser 'phreng nas de la chags bzhag byas pa lta bu zhig red gsung / rtsa phyi rol tu mi mngon pa dang / rtsa gcig gi steng du gcig bsnol te phyi rol nas mi mngon pa rtsa mdud pa med pa dang / long bu mi mngon pa ni/mtshan gyi de dang 'di gnyis che chung dang phyi nang gi long bu la bshad pa dang /zhabs ring thung med pas mi mnyam pa med pa dang / mtshan gyi de zhabs mthil mnyam pas sa la zhabs rjes rdzogs par 'bab pa de yin gsung /seng ge ri dwags gzhan la 'jigs pa med pa ri dwags kyi rgyal po yin pa bzhin du/ sangs rgyas ni rnam rtog gi chos gang la'ang 'jigs pa mi mnga' ba nyid kyis mi yi seng ge dang / glang po che rnams khyu mchog gi rjes su 'brang na gnod pa sogs med pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes su zhugs na lam mi gol bar drang por 'gro ba nyid kyis mi yi khyu mchog yin pas na de dang de'i stabs su gshegs pa mdo dang nyi snang gi dgongs pa dang / slob dpon gyi 'di gnyis mdo gzhan zhig gi rjes su 'brangs pa yin gsung / ngang ba'i stabs su gshegs pa sogs gnyis dang / rten 'brel gyi chos nyid kyis zhal g.yon phyogs su 'khor nas 'gro ba mi srid par zhabs g.yas sngon la spo ba dang g.yas phyogs su 'khor nas phebs pas g.yas su gshegs pa sogs gnyis dang /lam gong 'og tu mi 'gro bar drang por phebs pas mi yo bar gshegs pa sogs gnyis dang / gser btso ma lta bu sku la rngul sogs mi chags pas byi dor byas pa lta bu dang / blo dang 'tsham par chos ston pas phra sar phra sbom sar sbom pa sogs las 'di la phra sbom mi 'tsham zer ba lta bu zhig mi srid pas sku rim par 'tsham pa sogs lnga dang / cha lag yangs pas sku'i kho lag yangs pa dang / gom par ring thung med pas gom pa snyoms pa dang / spyan la ra ri mi mnga' bas rnam par dag pa sogs bdun dang / sku zhes pa ma dag pas 548

༄/ /zinabridakur brten nas zer ba ltar dku rked blum pa nyid dang / sku skabs phyin pa nyid dang / brang sogs kyi ngos la rko rko med pas ma rkongs pa dang / lto ba'i ngos mtho dman med pas phyal phyang nge ba'am phya me ba dang / lte ba'i bu ga zab pa dang / lte ba'i ri mo g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba sogs gsum dang /skyes bu chung ngu la stong nyid ston pa sogs dus min du gdul bya 'dul ba'am nag po'i chos ston pa ni dus ma yin pa'i chos 'dul ba yin la/ de dang bral ba nyid kyis sku la spe ba gnag bag med pa sogs bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ltar nyams su blangs na nam zhig gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub par 'gyur bas na phyi rjes su yongs su dag pa'i chos yin la de ston par mdzad pas phyag gi ri mo ring ba nyid dang / gnang ba'i rjes su dgag pa dang / bkag pa'i rjes su gnang ba sogs bslab pa rab tu mang po ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis zhal ha cang mi ring ba dang / mchu ni nang du gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i bispa ltar dmar ba sogs drug dang / gong ma ltar na nyon mongs thams cad kun sbyor dang / bye smra ltar na rtsa nyon drug las mchog 'dzin gnyis logs su phye ba dang / phrag dog ser sna gnyis bsnan pas kun spyor bcu ste 'di dag yang srid du sbyor bar byed pa'i rkyen gyi gtso bo yin pas na kun spyor zhes bya la/ de bsdams pa nyid kyis mche ba blum pa sogs gsum dang / sa bcu ba pa'ang nang phan tshun yon tan mi mnyam la/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam nyid gsum gyis mnyam pas na mnyam pa'i sa yin la der gnas pa nyid kyis mche ba mnyam pa dang / mche ba je phrar song bas byin gyes phra ba sogs lnga dang / spyan dkar nag ma 'dres pas na 'byes shing pad+ma'i 'dab ma rangs pa lta bu sogs gnyis dang /lus sbyin par gtong ba sogs phyi rol nas bltas na dka' bar snang yang /549

/de dag la nang du zan chang gcig gtong ba'i 'du shes las mi 'byung ba ltar yina'i/ 'jig rten gyi bde ba chung ngu re'i ched du'ang lus la gtar sreg byed pa sogs dka' spyad dgos kyang / chos 'di la dka' rgyu de tsam med par bde nas bde bar 'khrid pas na chos 'dul ba 'jam po ste de la mkhas pa nyid kyis smin ma 'jam pa sogs bcu gnyis dang / skra ha cang 'jam pas kho'u rul ltar 'ching ba min pas mi 'dzings pa nyid dang / dbu skra ha cang tsub pas gyen du ma badzes pas mi gshor ba nyid dang / byang chub yan lag gi me tog bkram pas dbu skra dri zhim pa nyid dang / thams cad la phan pa kho na sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags su thugs ka na bkra shis ba'i dpal be'u dang /mgrin pa na dung g.yas 'khyil gyi ri mo yod pa sogs bkra shis ba'i dge mtshan gyis brgyan pa yin gsung ngo / /bzhi pa sprul sku ni/ ston pa shākya thub pa sogs mchog gi sprul sku dang /bdag cag gi ston pa'i sprul pa bzo po bi sha garma lta bu bzo po sprul sku dang /sku'i rnam pa dri za'i rgyal por sprul pa dang / 'khor sgyur dang / bya dang ri dwags sogs su sprul pa ni skye ba sprul sku yin la/ mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku zhes pa'i don ni/ longs sku yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs sprul sku'i mdzad pa de dag mdzad pa po yin kyang dngos su snang nas don mdzad cing /byang 'phags yan chad kyi mngon sum gye spyod yul yin pas mdzad pa phyogs re ba lta bu song la/ sprul sku ni 'khor ba ji srid bar 'jig rten gye khams thams cad du dag ma dag gi sems can rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi snod bcud mtha' yas ba'i rnam pas ston pas na don mnyam pa nyid du mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ / ye shes la sogs pa la ltos nas/ zhes pa'i don kha cig gis bshad pa mi 'thad la/ rnam bshad las/ ye shes chos sku ye shes kyi tshogs 550

༄/ /zinabribasags pa la ltos nas byung ba dang / longs sku bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la ltos nas byung ba dang / mchog gi sprul sku tshogs gnyis ga'i cha la brten par gsungs pa'i phyi ma 'di gdul bya la gtso bor chos ston pa'i mdzad pa de'i cha nas tshogs gnyis ka la brten par bshad pa yin nam/'di la da dung dpyad rgyu zhig yod pa 'dra gsung / sngar ye shes kyi rang mdangs gzugs skur shar bar bshad pa'ang / kun rdzob tu ye shes kho na zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin gsung / 'phags pa ltar na sprul sku'i de ma thag tu 'phrin las la mtshams sbyor ba yin la/ chos sku mdzad pa zhes 'byung ba ni bstan bshad sbyor ba'i ched du chos sku spyi ldog tsam smos par bzhed do/ / slob dpon ltar na sprul sku'i de ma thag tu 'phrin las ༵rdo bhe kyang ye/ she~X bye ༷༷ ༷dashā /dīdi~X ༵༷ /༷ /༵ ṭ+wāṃ dī diX bhe/ rji rdo 'phrinalas nyer bdun gyi sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa 'di nyid yin la de'ang ye shes chos sku'i bdag rkyen la brten nas byung ba yin no zhes shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ / sdud par sku bzhi re re nas sbyor rgyu'i tshig med pas skabs brgyad pa bsdoms te 'chad par/ bdag gi bde ba btang nas re ba med sems kyis/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig byung / re ba med pa'i sems de 'ong ba la rang don yid byed kyi 'khri ba rtsad nas chod pa zhig dgos la/ de la'ang bden 'dzin gyi bag chags drungs nas phyung ba zhig dgos pas/rnyed ma rnyed bde mi bde la sogs pa'i chos brgyad rags pa ni spong sla'ang /deng sang gi chos pa phal cher chos brgyad phra mo'i dbang du ma song ba med ces yongs 'dzin rin po che nas gsungs la/ chos brgyad dkar pos ma gos pa bden 'dzin gyi bag chags ma spang bar du mi 'byung zhing de ma spang na rang 551

/ /don gyi yid byed kyi 'khri ba mi chod pa dang / thog ma med pa nas rang bden par 'dzin pa'i bag chags a 'thas su song ba'i stobs kyis de'i ring la gzhan don byed pa thams cad la g.yo rgyus ma bslad pa zhig dka' gsung /rang re'i yig char bden 'dzin stong nyid la rnam g.yeng du gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / spyir rnam g.yeng ni sems yul la phyin ci log tu 'phro bar byed pa'i las can zhig yin la/ bden par 'dzin pa'i bag chags kyis kyang sems stong nyid la rtse gcig tu gnas pa de las phyin ci log tu 'phro bar byed pas na de ltar bshad gsung / des na rje rin po che la'ang / chos brgyad spangs pas dal 'byor don yod byas/ / zhes bstod pa'ang chos brgyad rags pa tsam spangs pa la byas na rje la ltos te yi rang yul de tsam ma yin kyang chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum spangs pa la byed na sangs rgyas dgos pas rje'i rnam thar che shos yin gsung / de ltar re ba med pa'i sems kyis nyin mtshan dus drug tu gzigs te bu gcig pa la mas rim 'gro byed pa ltar bsam pa thag pas 'azin las rnam pa nyer bdun gyi sgo nas gzhan don la skyo ba med par 'khor ba ma stongs bar du gnas par bya zhes pa'i don no/ / de nyid brgyad stong par 'chad pa'i tshe rab 'byor gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par de ltar rjes su rig par byed pa dang / rnam par spyod pa dang / 'jug pa dang / rtogs par byed pa dang / sems pa dang 'jal ba dang / nye bar rtogs pa dang / sgyu dang g.yo thams cad rnam par spangs ba'i yid la byed pa dang / zhes pa nas/skye bo thams cad spangs pa'i yid la byed pa dag gis sgom par 'gyur ba de'i tshede la yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bla na med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par rnyed 552

༄ / / na gas ma 11gsadaka' bar mi 'gyur ro/ / 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las rjes su rig pa'i le'u zhes bya ste nyi shu rtsa gu pa'o/ / 'di'i don 'grel chen du/ yid la byed pa dag gis rjes su rig par byed pa dang /zhes yid byed rnams gong du blangs nas/ nye bar rtogs pa dang zhes pa de'i mjug tu sgom par 'gyur ba de'i tshe zhes sogs sbyar nas bshad gsung /de'ang yid la byed pa de dag gi sgo nas chos bcu'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rjes su rig par byed pa dang / rnam mkhyen de thob pa la/ rig can gsum gyi don sgrub pa'i lam shes pa nyid kyi sgo nas rnam par spyod pa dang /de la'ang skyes bu chung 'bring thun mong gi lam la blo sbyong ba sngon du 'gro ba'i ༵dh+ri~X ṭ+wā/ bye ༷ma ngh+rurdo dhis dī//bherdo ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ rdo~X ṭ+wāṃju༈ ༷༷ ༷ bheX ༵ sdidī /yig char mthar gyis sbyor ba'i sgo nas drangs pa'ang 'di yin no/ / mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum bsdus nas bsgom pas rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i sgo nas rtogs par byed pa dang / de ltar sgom pa de la rtse sbyor gye sgos goms pa dbang du byed pa'i sgo nas yang dang yang du sems pa dang /grangs dang go rim sogs la log par rtog pa bsal te 'jal ba dang / de ltar bskal chen grangs med gsum du goms pas zo chun gyi 'khrul 'khor ltar skad cig gcig la mngon du byed nus pa'i skad cig sbyor gyi sgo nas nye bar rtogs pa dang / sku bzhi bsgom par 'gyur ba de'i tshe de la yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / zhes sogs kyis 'bras bu chos sku bstan la de'ang yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs zhes pas spangs rtogs kyi sku gnyis dang / zhing bla na med pa zhes pas longs sku dang / sangs rgyas kyis chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par zhes sogs kyis sprul mdzad dang bcas pa 553

/bstan gsung ngo / /'phrin las ni gser 'phreng nas rtsa 'grel gnyis dkyus gcig tu bshad la/ rnam bshad las/ rtsa ba 'phags pa'i nyi snang ltar dang / 'grel ba slob dpon gyi 'di ltar gsungs pas phyi ma de'i dbang du byas na/ dang po rtsa ba ni/ de bzhin zhes sogs rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis dus kyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ 'gro rnams zhes sogs sh+lau ka drug gis dbye ba'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ chos kyi sku zhes sogs rkang pa tha ma gnyis kyis grangs kyi sgo nas don bsdub dang gsum las/ gnyis pa dbye ba'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa la lam la 'god pa dang / lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa gnyis las dang po la/'gro rnams zhi pa'i las dang ni/ / zhes bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i thar pa don gnyer gyi bsam pa phun tshogs dang / bsdu rnams zhi la 'god pa dang / zhes sbyor ba phun tshogs dang / kun nas nyon mongs bcas pa yi/ rnam par byang pa rtogs pa dang / / zhes kun nyon sdug kun gnyis dang / rnam byang 'gog lam gnyisatogs pa'i lta ba phun tshogs la 'god pa dang gsum ste tshogs lam la 'god pa gsum mo/ / dang pos lam gyi rten la 'god pa shugs la 'phang gsung / sems can rnams don ji bzhin gyi/ / don dang zhes pas rang gisaganas lugs kyi don ji bzhin du rtogs pa de sems can gzhan rnams kyis kyang rtorges na ci ma rung snyam du bsam pa phun tshogs la 'god pa dang /pha rol phyin drug dang / sangs rgyas lam dang / zhes pas phar phyin drug dang / dge bcu'i lam gyis bsdus pa'i spyod pa phun tshogs la 'god pa gnyis dang / rang bzhin dang / stong pa nyid dang zhes pas lta ba rnam dag la 'god pa ste spyor lam la 'god pa bzhi'o/ / gnyis zad dang / zhes 554

༄/ /zinabripas chos dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i don du rtogs pas mthong spang gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa zad par spangs pa'i sa dang po la 'god pa gcig go/ brda dang zhes chos thams cad btags pa tsam du rtogs pa'i sa gnyis pa sa gsum pa gnyis la 'god pa gcig go/ dmigs pa med pa dang / zhes sa bzhi par byang chub phyogs mthun la mkhas pa'i shes rab lhag sa lnga par bden bzhi la mkhas pa'i shes rab lhag sa drug par de kho na nyid la mkhas pa'i shes rab lhag pas/ bden zhen 'joms tshul gyi sgo nas sa de gsum la 'god pa gcig go/ lus can rnams ni yongs smin dang / / zhes thabs mkhas kyi phar phyin gyi sgo nas sa bdun pa la 'god pa gcig go/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni/zhes lam gsum shes pa'i lam shes la 'god pa dang /mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa dang / / zhes bden 'dzin mngon gyur zhi ba la 'god pa dang / byang chub thob dang zhes sangs rgyas dkon mchog btags pa ba dang / rdo rje'i lus rjes mthun pa thob pa la 'god pa dang / sangs rgyas zhing / rnam par dag dang / zhes zhing dag sbyor ba la 'god pa ste sa brgyad pa la 'god pa bzhi'o/ / nges pa dang / zhes sa brgyad pa thob ma thag tu sngar thob ma myong ba'i zhi bdes thugs 'phrog ste zhugs pas yang dag mtha' mngon du ma byed ces gdams dgos la/ sa dgu pa nas zhi bde la yun ring goms shing dman lam du ltung ba'i dogs pa tsam yang med pas rang sangs rgya bar nges pa la 'god pa dang / sems can don ni tshad med dang // zhes sems can gyi don tshad med sgrub pa la 'god pa ste sa dgu pa la 'god pa gnyis so/ / sangs rgyas bsten sogs yon tan dang / / zhes sa bcu pas bsdus pa'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang mchod pa sogs kyi yon tan khyad par can la 'god pa dang / rtogs pa gong 555

/ /nasagong du 'phel ba la 'god pa la brgyad las/ byang chub yan lag ces byang chub kyi rgyu'i nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa la 'god pa dang / las rnams ni / chud mi za dang zhes las 'bras kyi 'brel ba chud mi za bar mngon sum du mthong ba la 'god pa dang / bden mthong dang / zhes bden bzhi mthong ba la 'god pa dang / phyin ci log ni spangs pa dang / zhes gtsang bde rtag bdag gi phyin ci log mngon gyur spangs pa'i stobs kyis phar phyin dam pa bzhi myur du 'dren pa la 'god pa dang / de bzhi med pa'i tshul dang ni / / zhes phyin ci log bzhi skyed pa'i bden 'dzin med pa'i tshul la 'god pa dang / rnam par byang ngang zhes byang sems kyi spyod pa la 'god pa gcig dang / tshogs dang ni/ zhes tshogs gnyis la 'god pa dang /'dusabyas 'du ma byas pa la/ / tha dad yongs su mi shes dang / / zhes srid zhi mnyam nyid du rtogs pa la 'god pa ste sa bcu pa la 'god pa dang dgu'o/ / mya ngan 'das la 'god pa ste/ / zhes 'bras bu mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god pa la gcig go/ nyer bdun po 'di dag 'phags pa'i nyi snang ltar ro/ / slob dpon gyi 'grel pa 'di ltar na 'phrin las nyer bdun gyi dang po lam gyi rten la 'god pa gcig tshogs lam la 'god pa lnga/spyor lam la 'god pa gcig sa dang po gnyis su med pa'i chos la 'god pa gcig 'di 'phags pa dang khyad par med gsung / sa gnyis pa sa gsum pa sa bzhi pa lnga pa'i bar la 'god pa gcig sa drug pa la 'god pa gcigs bdun pa sems can yongs su smin par byed pa la 'god pa gciga'adi la'ang 'phags seng gnyis 'dra gsung / sa brgyad pa la 'god pa gnyis/sa dgu pa la 'god pa gcig sa bcu pa thob ma thag par zhing sna tshogs rnam par dag pa la 'god pa gcig ste/ zhing dag pa la 'god pa 'phags pas sa 556

༄/ /zinabs yodobargyad pa'i zhing dag sbyor ba dang sbyar la/ slob dpon gyis sa bcu par 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur bas snod bcud kyi zhing dag pa la sbyar nas bshad gsung / 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur tshul la/ snang ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / mchod pas dbang bskur ba'o/ / dang po la snod dang bcud dag pa'i snang ba 'phrin las sgrub pa gsum las/ stong gsum 'bum phrag bcu'i rgya dang mnyam pa'i pad+ma rin chen du mas spras pa'i gdan dang / de'i 'khor du stong gsum 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i pad+mas gang bar snang ba ni snod dag pa dang / sa bcu pa rang nyid gdan de la 'tsham zhing rkyen du bab par 'dug la 'khor gyi pad+ma la sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa sogs kyi byang sems rnams bzhugs pas bskor te 'dug par snang ba ni bcud dag pa yin no/ / byang sems de'i sku'i cha las 'od zer 'phros pas rigs drug gi sems can thams cad snang bar byas nas du kha rnams zhi bar byed pa sogs ni 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / yang 'od zer kyis phyogs bcu'i dbang bskur thob pa'i byang sems rnams dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams snang bar byas te de dag gi sku la nub par byed pa ni mchod pa dang / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa de dag gis byang sems de dbang bskur ba'i dus la babs paragazigs te de dag gi sku las 'od zer 'phros pa byang sems de'i lus la nub nas dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin sogs ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa la dbang 'byor par byin gyis brlabs pa ni dbang bskur ba yin gsung /des na phar phyin theg pa yang dbang bskur ba tsam yod do/ / de'i 'og tu skye ba gcig thogs la 'god pa gsum/ srid pa tha ma la 'god pa brgyad 'bras bu la 'god pa gcig ste nyer bdun yod pa'i phyir ro/ / slob dpon gyi lugasal 'azin las don bdun cu'i grangs kyi tha ma min kyang de ltar byas la/557
